abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Contracting out of governmental health services is a financing strategy that governs the way in which public sector funds are used to have services delivered by non-governmental health service providers (NGPs). It represents a contract between the government and an NGP, detailing the mechanisms and conditions by which the latter should provide health care on behalf of the government. Contracting out is intended to improve the delivery and use of healthcare services. This Review updates a Cochrane Review first published in 2009. OBJECTIVES: To assess effects of contracting out governmental clinical health services to non-governmental service provider/s, on (i) utilisation of clinical health services; (ii) improvement in population health outcomes; (iii) improvement in equity of utilisation of these services; (iv) costs and cost-effectiveness of delivering the services; and (v) improvement in health systems performance. SEARCH METHODS: We searched CENTRAL, MEDLINE, Embase, NHS Economic Evaluation Database, EconLit, ProQuest, and Global Health on 07 April 2017, along with two trials registers - ClinicalTrials.gov and the International Clinical Trials Registry Platform - on 17 November 2017. SELECTION CRITERIA: Individually randomised and cluster-randomised trials, controlled before-after studies, interrupted time series, and repeated measures studies, comparing government-delivered clinical health services versus those contracted out to NGPs, or comparing different models of non-governmental-delivered clinical health services. DATA COLLECTION AND ANALYSIS: Two authors independently screened all records, extracted data from the included studies and assessed the risk of bias. We calculated the net effect for all outcomes. A positive value favours the intervention whilst a negative value favours the control. Effect estimates are presented with 95% confidence intervals. We used the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach to assess the certainty of the evidence and we prepared a Summary of Findings table. MAIN RESULTS: We included two studies, a cluster-randomised trial conducted in Cambodia, and a controlled before-after study conducted in Guatemala. Both studies reported that contracting out over 12 months probably makes little or no difference in (i) immunisation uptake of children 12 to 24 months old (moderate-certainty evidence), (ii) the number of women who had more than two antenatal care visits (moderate-certainty evidence), and (iii) female use of contraceptives (moderate-certainty evidence).The Cambodia trial reported that contracting out may make little or no difference in the mortality over 12 months of children younger than one year of age (net effect = -4.3%, intervention effect P = 0.36, clustered standard error (SE) = 3.0%; low-certainty evidence), nor to the incidence of childhood diarrhoea (net effect = -16.2%, intervention effect P = 0.07, clustered SE = 19.0%; low-certainty evidence). The Cambodia study found that contracting out probably reduces individual out-of-pocket spending over 12 months on curative care (net effect = $ -19.25 (2003 USD), intervention effect P = 0.01, clustered SE = $ 5.12; moderate-certainty evidence). The included studies did not report equity in the use of clinical health services and in adverse effects. AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: This update confirms the findings of the original review. Contracting out probably reduces individual out-of-pocket spending on curative care (moderate-certainty evidence), but probably makes little or no difference in other health utilisation or service delivery outcomes (moderate- to low-certainty evidence). Therefore, contracting out programmes may be no better or worse than government-provided services, although additional rigorously designed studies may change this result. The literature provides many examples of contracting out programmes, which implies that this is a feasible response when governments fail to provide good clinical health care. Future contracting out programmes should be framed within a rigorous study design to allow valid and reliable measures of their effects. Such studies should include qualitative research that assesses the views of programme implementers and beneficiaries, and records implementation mechanisms. This approach may reveal enablers for, and barriers to, successful implementation of such programmes.

10.1002/14651858.cd008133.pub2.abstractZh:
背景：将政府提供的医疗服务外包是一种融资策略，它规定了公共部门资金如何用于由非政府医疗服务提供者提供的服务。这实际上是政府与非政府医疗服务提供者之间的一种合同，详细规定了后者代表政府提供医疗服务的机制和条件。外包的目的是改善医疗服务的提供和使用。本综述更新了2009年首次发表的Cochrane综述。

目标：评估将政府提供的临床医疗服务外包给非政府医疗服务提供者对以下方面的影响：(i) 临床医疗服务的利用情况；(ii) 人群健康状况的改善；(iii) 这些服务利用的公平性；(iv) 服务的提供成本及成本效益；(v) 卫生系统的绩效提升。

检索方法：我们在2017年4月7日搜索了CENTRAL、MEDLINE、Embase、NHS经济评估数据库、EconLit、ProQuest和Global Health，并在2017年11月17日搜索了ClinicalTrials.gov和国际临床试验注册平台这两个试验注册库。

选择标准：单独随机化及群组随机化的试验、前后对照研究、中断时间序列研究以及重复测量研究，这些研究比较了政府提供的临床医疗服务与外包给非政府医疗服务提供者的服务，或者比较不同模式下非政府提供的临床医疗服务。

数据收集与分析：两位作者独立筛选所有记录，从纳入的研究中提取数据并评估偏倚风险。我们计算了所有结果的净效应。正值表示干预措施更有益，负值则表示对照措施更有益。效应估计值附有95%的置信区间。我们采用了推荐评估、发展及评估分级（GRADE）方法来评估证据的确定性，并编制了研究结果摘要表。主要结果如下：我们纳入了两项研究，一项是在柬埔寨进行的群组随机试验，另一项是在危地马拉进行的对照前后研究。两项研究均表明，在12个月内将服务外包可能对以下方面的影响较小或没有影响：（i）12至24个月大儿童的免疫接种率（中等确定性证据），（ii）接受两次以上产前护理的女性数量（中等确定性证据），以及（iii）女性使用避孕措施的情况（中等确定性证据）。柬埔寨的试验报告称，在12个月内将服务外包可能对1岁以下儿童的死亡率影响较小或没有影响（净效应=-4.3%，干预效应P=0.36，群组标准误差=3.0%；低确定性证据），对儿童腹泻的发病率也没有影响（净效应=-16.2%，干预效应P=0.07，群组标准误差=19.0%；低确定性证据）。柬埔寨的研究发现，将服务外包可能减少个体在12个月内用于治疗性护理的自付费用（净效应=-19.25美元，干预效应P=0.01，群组标准误差=5.12美元；中等确定性证据）。纳入的研究并未报告临床健康服务使用的公平性以及不良影响的相关信息。作者结论：此次更新证实了最初研究的发现。将服务外包可能减少个体在治疗性护理上的自付费用（中等确定性证据），但可能对其他健康利用或服务提供的结果影响较小或没有影响（中等到低确定性证据）。因此，外包项目可能并不比政府提供的服务更好或更差，尽管经过严格设计的额外研究可能会改变这一结果。文献中提供了许多外包项目的例子，这表明当政府无法提供良好的临床医疗服务时，外包是一种可行的应对方式。未来的外包项目应纳入严格的研究设计，以便能够准确、可靠地评估其效果。此类研究应包括定性研究，以评估项目实施者和受益者的观点，并记录实施机制。这种方法可能揭示出成功实施此类项目的推动因素和障碍。

abstract.text: The relationship between insurance coverage and use of specialty substance use disorder (SUD) treatment is not well understood. In this study, we add to the literature by examining changes in admissions to SUD treatment following the implementation of a 2010 Affordable Care Act provision requiring health insurers to offer dependent coverage to young adult children of their beneficiaries under age 26. We use national administrative data on admissions to specialty SUD treatment and apply a difference-in-differences design to study effects of the expansion on the rate of treatment utilization among young adults and, among those in treatment, changes in insurance status and payment source. We find that admissions to treatment declined by 11% after the expansion. However, the share of young adults covered by private insurance increased by 5.4 percentage points and the share with private insurance as the payment source increased by 3.7 percentage points. This increase was largely offset by decreased payment from government sources.

10.1002/hec.3482.abstractZh: 关于保险覆盖与特殊物质使用障碍治疗使用之间的关系尚未得到充分理解。本研究通过考察2010年《平价医疗法案》实施后，健康保险公司为26岁以下受益人的未成年子女提供保险覆盖后，特殊物质使用障碍治疗入院情况的变化，为相关文献增添了新的内容。我们利用全国性的行政数据来研究这一政策扩展对年轻成年人治疗利用率的影响，以及治疗过程中保险状态和支付来源的变化。研究发现，政策实施后，治疗入院人数减少了11%。然而，拥有私人保险覆盖的年轻成年人比例增加了5.4个百分点，以私人保险作为支付来源的年轻成年人比例则增加了3.7个百分点。不过，政府来源的支付减少在一定程度上抵消了这些增长。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of the 2006 Massachusetts healthcare reform on substance use disorder (SUD) treatment facilities' provision of care. We test the impact of the reform on treatment quantity and access. We couple data on the near universe of specialty SUD treatment providers in the USA with a synthetic control method approach. We find little evidence that the reform lead to changes in treatment quantity or access. Reform effects were similar among for-profit and non-profit facilities. In an extension, we show that the reform altered the setting in which treatment is received, the number of offered services, and the number of programs for special populations. These findings may be useful in predicting the implications of major health insurance expansions on the provision of SUD treatment.

10.1002/hec.3484.abstractZh: 我们研究了2006年马萨诸塞州医疗改革对物质使用障碍治疗设施提供服务的影響。我們測試了該改革對治療數量和獲得治療機會的影響。我們將美國專業物質使用障碍治療提供商的數據與合成控制方法相結合進行分析。研究結果表明，該改革並未導致治療數量或獲得治療機會的變化。盈利性和非盈利性治療機構的改革效果相似。進一步的研究表明，該改革改變了治療的環境、提供的服務數量以及針對特殊人群的程序數量。這些研究結果可能有助于預測大型健康保險擴展對物質使用障碍治療提供服務的影響。

abstract.text: We evaluate the introduction of various forms of antihypertensive treatments in France with a distribution-sensitive cost-benefit analysis. Compared to traditional cost-benefit analysis, we implement distributional weighting based on equivalent incomes, a new concept of individual well-being that does respect individual preferences but is not subjectively welfarist. Individual preferences are estimated on the basis of a contingent valuation question, introduced into a representative survey of the French population. Compared to traditional cost-effectiveness analysis in health technology assessment, we show that it is feasible to go beyond a narrow evaluation of health outcomes while still fully exploiting the sophistication of medical information. Sensitivity analysis illustrates the relevancy of this richer welfare framework, the importance of the distinction between an ex ante and an ex post approach, and the need to consider distributional effects in a broader institutional setting.

10.1002/hec.3515.abstractZh: 我们通过分布敏感的成本效益分析，评估了在法国引入各种形式的降压治疗措施的效果。与传统的成本效益分析相比，我们采用了基于等效收入的分布加权方法，这是一种新的个人福祉概念，它尊重个人偏好，但并非主观上的福利主义。个人偏好是通过在一项针对法国人口的代表性调查中引入的情境估值问题来估计的。与传统的健康技术评估中的成本效益分析相比，我们表明在充分利用医学信息的复杂性的同时，超越对健康结果的狭隘评估是可行的。敏感性分析说明了这种更丰富的福利框架的相关性，区分事前与事后方法的重要性，以及需要在更广泛的制度环境中考虑分布效应。

abstract.text: Reduced muscle strength is an accurate predictor of functional limitations, disability, and mortality. Hence, understanding which socio-economic factors contribute to preserve muscle strength in old age is central to the design of social policies that help reducing these health risks. Using data on handgrip strength collected by the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe for the population of Europeans aged 50+ and the exogenous variation in pension eligibility age across countries over time, we estimate that the retirement transition has a short-term positive causal effect on muscle strength. However, this protective effect is not persistent, as retirement speeds up the age-related trend in muscle strength loss, especially for blue-collar workers and males. The "holy grail" of early retirement may not be such a good deal for retirees' longevity and physical functioning late in life.

10.1002/hec.3517.abstractZh: 肌肉力量的下降是功能受限、残疾和死亡的确切预测因素。因此，了解哪些社会经济因素有助于在老年时期保持肌肉力量，对于制定能够降低这些健康风险的社会政策至关重要。利用欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查收集的手握力数据，以及各国随时间变化的养老金领取资格年龄变化数据，我们估计退休过渡对肌肉力量有短期的积极影响。然而，这种保护作用并不持久，因为退休加速了与年龄相关的肌肉力量下降趋势，尤其是在蓝领工人和男性中。对于退休者在晚年生活的长寿和身体功能而言，提前退休的“圣杯”可能并非那么理想。

abstract.text: There is widespread concern about the quality of care in nursing homes. On the basis of administrative data of a large health insurance fund, we investigate whether nursing home prices are associated with relevant quality of care indicators at the resident level. Our results indicate negative associations between price and both inappropriate and psychotropic medication. In contrast, we do not find any relationship between the price and impairments of physical health.

10.1002/hec.3518.abstractZh: 人们对养老院护理质量存在广泛的担忧。基于一家大型健康保险基金的行政数据，我们研究了养老院的价格是否与居民层面的相关护理质量指标有关。我们的结果显示，价格与不当用药和精神药物的使用之间存在负相关关系。相比之下，我们没有发现价格与身体健康状况的损害之间存在任何关联。

abstract.text: We analyze the impact of short-term alcohol bans on road traffic accidents, traffic injuries, and hospital admissions. We focus on the 2012 Municipal Elections in Brazil, during which 11 out of 27 states imposed on its 2,733 municipalities the decision to adopt alcohol bans. Using day-level data on municipalities, we find that alcohol bans caused substantial reductions in road crashes (19%), traffic injuries (43%), and traffic-related hospitalizations (17%). An analysis of traffic-related hospitalization costs allows us to estimate the lower bound of the negative externality associated with excessive alcohol consumption in this context, which reveals that electoral dry laws saved Brazil's public healthcare system $100,000 per day.

10.1002/hec.3519.abstractZh: 我们分析了短期酒精禁令对交通事故、交通伤害和医院住院率的影响。研究聚焦于2012年巴西的市政选举，当时27个州中有11个州在其2,733个市镇实施了酒精禁令。通过市镇的日级数据分析，我们发现酒精禁令导致交通事故减少了19%，交通伤害减少了43%，与交通相关的住院率也下降了17%。通过对与交通相关的住院成本的分析，我们估算出在这一背景下，过度饮酒所带来的负面外部性的最低限度影响，结果显示，选举期间的禁酒令每天为巴西的公共医疗保健系统节省了10万美元。

abstract.text: This study examines whether a terrorist attack in a developed country, which does not cause major damage to its capital stocks, affects the mental health of its residents. By exploiting variations in survey dates of the European Social Survey, we use a difference-in-differences strategy to show that the attack adversely affects subjective well-being and mental health measures of French respondents. These negative effects are stronger for immigrants and low-income individuals. The impact is less dramatic for politically extreme right-wing supporters. The distance from origin has little impact on these measures.

10.1002/hec.3520.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了在发达国家发生的一次恐怖袭击，即使对首都的资本资产没有造成重大损害，是否会影响当地居民的心理健康。通过利用欧洲社会调查中的调查日期差异，我们采用差异-差异策略来揭示该袭击对法国受访者主观幸福感及心理健康指标的不利影响。这些负面影响在移民和低收入人群中更为明显。对于政治上极右翼的支持者来说，这种影响则较为轻微。距离居住地远近对这些指标的影响较小。

abstract.text: We analyze a game-theoretic model of a risk-sharing agreement between a payer and a pharmaceutical firm. The drug manufacturer chooses the price while the payer sets the rebate rate and decides which patients are eligible for treatment. The manufacturer provides the payer with a rebate for nonresponding patients. We generalize on the existing literature, by making both price and rebate rate decision variables, allowing the rebate rate to be different from 100%, and incorporating 2 types of administrative costs. We identify a threshold for the expected probability of response for classifying the drug as a mass-market or niche type and investigate the optimal solutions for both types. We also identify a threshold for the rebate rate at which the net benefits become equal for responding and nonresponding patients. Through numerical examples, we examine how various parameters impact the drug manufacturer's and the payer's optimal solution.

10.1002/hec.3522.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个关于支付方与制药公司之间风险共享协议的博弈论模型。药品制造商决定价格，而支付方则设定返利率并决定哪些患者有资格接受治疗。制造商向支付方提供对未响应患者的返利。我们在现有文献的基础上进行了扩展，将价格和返利率作为决策变量，并允许返利率不等于100%，同时纳入了两种类型的行政成本。我们确定了将药品分类为大众市场型或利基型所需的响应预期概率的阈值，并研究了两种类型的最优解。我们还确定了返利率的一个阈值，在该阈值下，响应患者和非响应患者的净收益相等。通过数值示例，我们研究了各种参数如何影响药品制造商和支付方的最优解。

abstract.text: This study explores the predictive power of interaction terms between the risk adjusters in the Dutch risk equalization (RE) model of 2014. Due to the sophistication of this RE-model and the complexity of the associations in the dataset (N = ~16.7 million), there are theoretically more than a million interaction terms. We used regression tree modelling, which has been applied rarely within the field of RE, to identify interaction terms that statistically significantly explain variation in observed expenses that is not already explained by the risk adjusters in this RE-model. The interaction terms identified were used as additional risk adjusters in the RE-model. We found evidence that interaction terms can improve the prediction of expenses overall and for specific groups in the population. However, the prediction of expenses for some other selective groups may deteriorate. Thus, interactions can reduce financial incentives for risk selection for some groups but may increase them for others. Furthermore, because regression trees are not robust, additional criteria are needed to decide which interaction terms should be used in practice. These criteria could be the right incentive structure for risk selection and efficiency or the opinion of medical experts.

10.1002/hec.3523.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了2014年荷兰风险均衡模型中风险调整因子之间交互项的预测能力。由于该风险均衡模型的复杂性以及数据集中关联关系的复杂性（样本量约为1670万），理论上存在超过一百万个交互项。我们采用了在风险均衡领域较为少见的回归树建模方法，以识别那些能够统计上显著解释观测到的费用变化的交互项，而这些变化尚未被该模型中的风险调整因子所解释。识别出的交互项被用作风险均衡模型中的额外风险调整因子。我们发现，交互项能够改善对费用的整体预测以及特定群体的费用预测。然而，对于其他一些特定群体，费用预测可能会恶化。因此，交互项可能会降低某些群体的风险选择动机，而提高其他群体的动机。此外，由于回归树模型并不稳健，需要额外的标准来决定在实践中应使用哪些交互项。这些标准可以是风险选择及效率的适当激励结构，也可以是医学专家的意见。

abstract.text: This paper investigates if respondents' choice to not consider all characteristics of a multiattribute health service may represent preferences. Over the last decade, an increasing number of studies account for attribute non-attendance (ANA) when using discrete choice experiments to elicit individuals' preferences. Most studies assume such behaviour is a heuristic and therefore uninformative. This assumption may result in misleading welfare estimates if ANA reflects preferences. This is the first paper to assess if ANA is a heuristic or genuine preference without relying on respondents' self-stated motivation and the first study to explore this question within a health context. Based on findings from cognitive psychology, we expect that familiar respondents are less likely to use a decision heuristic to simplify choices than unfamiliar respondents. We employ a latent class model of discrete choice experiment data concerned with National Health Service managers' preferences for support services that assist with performance concerns. We present quantitative and qualitative evidence that in our study ANA mostly represents preferences. We also show that wrong assumptions about ANA result in inadequate welfare measures that can result in suboptimal policy advice. Future research should proceed with caution when assuming that ANA is a heuristic.

10.1002/hec.3524.abstractZh: 本文探讨了受访者选择不考虑多属性健康服务的所有特征是否可能代表其偏好。在过去十年中，越来越多的研究在离散选择实验中考虑了属性非参与现象，以了解个体的偏好。大多数研究认为这种行为是一种启发式行为，因此缺乏信息性。如果属性非参与反映了偏好，这种假设可能会导致误导性的福利评估。这是第一篇评估属性非参与是否为启发式行为或真实偏好的研究，且首次在健康领域探讨这一问题。基于认知心理学的研究发现，我们认为熟悉的受访者比不熟悉的受访者更不可能使用启发式方法来简化决策。我们采用了一个潜在类别模型来分析离散选择实验数据，该模型涉及国家健康服务管理者对有助于解决绩效问题的支持服务的偏好。我们提供了定量和定性证据，表明在我们的研究中，属性非参与主要代表了偏好。我们还指出，对属性非参与的错误假设会导致不恰当的福利评估，从而可能导致不理想的政策建议。未来研究在假设属性非参与是启发式行为时应当谨慎行事。

abstract.text: The English National Health Service is promoting concentration of the treatment of patients with relatively rare and complex conditions into a limited number of specialist centres. If these patients are more costly to treat, the prospective payment system based on Healthcare Resource Groups (HRGs) may need refinement because these centres will be financially disadvantaged. To assess the funding implications of this concentration policy, we estimate the cost differentials associated with caring for patients that receive complex care and examine the extent to which complex care services are concentrated across hospitals and HRGs. We estimate random effects models using patient-level activity and cost data for all patients admitted to English hospitals during the 2013/14 financial year and construct measures of the concentration of complex services. Payments for complex care services need to be adjusted if they have large cost differentials and if provision is concentrated within a few hospitals. Payments can be adjusted either by refining HRGs or making top-up payments to HRG prices. HRG refinement is preferred to top-payments the greater the concentration of services among HRGs.

10.1002/hec.3525.abstractZh: 英国国家健康服务体系正在将治疗相对罕见且复杂的疾病患者的任务集中到少数专业中心。如果这些患者的治疗成本较高，基于医疗资源组的预付支付系统可能需要改进，因为这些中心将面临财务上的劣势。为了评估这种集中治疗政策对资金的影响，我们估算了接受复杂治疗的患者所需的费用差异，并研究了复杂治疗服务在医院和医疗资源组之间的集中程度。我们使用2013/14财政年度所有在英国医院住院患者的活动数据和成本数据，建立了随机效应模型，并构建了复杂服务集中程度的衡量指标。如果复杂治疗服务的成本差异较大，且服务提供集中在少数医院，那么需要对这些服务的支付进行调整。调整支付的方式可以是改进医疗资源组的结构，或者对医疗资源组的费用进行追加支付。在医疗服务集中在医疗资源组的情况下，改进医疗资源组的结构更为理想。

abstract.text: Partnerships between government and non-state actors that aim to enhance the quality or efficiency of service delivery are increasingly common in today's development policy landscape. We investigate the impacts of such an approach using data from an experimental supportive intervention to India's malaria control program that leveraged local non-state capacity in order to promote mosquito net usage and recommended fever care-seeking patterns. The supportive activities were conducted simultaneously by 3 NGOs, contracted out by the Indian government, in 2 endemic districts in the state of Odisha. We find that program impact significantly varied by location. Examining 3 potential sources of this variation (differential population characteristics, differential health worker characteristics, and differential implementer characteristics), we provide evidence that both population and NGO characteristics significantly affected the success of the program. Specifically, the results suggest that the quality and effort of the local implementer played a key role in the differential effectiveness. We discuss these findings as they relate to the external validity of development policy evaluations and, specifically, for the ability of health and other service delivery systems to benefit from limited non-state capacity in underresourced areas.

10.1002/hec.3529.abstractZh: 在当今的发展政策环境中，政府与非国家行为者之间的合作日益普遍，这些合作旨在提升服务提供的质量或效率。我们通过对印度疟疾控制计划中的一项实验性支持性干预措施的数据分析，来研究这种方法的成效。该干预措施利用了当地非国家力量的能力，以促进蚊帐的使用和推荐发热时的就医方式。这些支持性活动由印度政府委托的3个非政府组织同时在奥里萨邦的两个流行地区开展。我们发现，项目的成效在不同地区存在显著差异。通过考察3个可能导致这种差异的因素（不同的人口特征、不同的卫生工作者特征以及不同的实施者特征），我们发现人口和非政府组织特征对项目的成功有着显著的影响。具体而言，结果显示，当地实施者的工作质量和努力程度在差异化的效果中起到了关键作用。我们讨论了这些发现对于发展政策评估的外部效度的意义，特别是对于卫生和其他服务系统如何利用有限的非国家力量在资源匮乏的地区发挥作用的重要性。

abstract.text: We have taken advantage of a natural experiment to measure the impact of the phased abolition of prescription co-payments in Wales. We investigated 3 study periods covering the phased abolition: from £6 to £4, £4 to £3, and £3 to £0. A difference-in-difference modelling was adopted and applied to monthly UK general practice level dispensing data on 14 selected medicines which had the highest percentage of items dispensed subject to a co-payment prior to abolition. Dispensing from a comparator region (North East of England) with similar health and socio-economic characteristics to Wales, and where prescription co-payments continued during the study periods, was used to isolate any non-price effects on dispensing in Wales. Results show a small increase in dispensing of 14 selected medicines versus the comparator. Compared with NE England, monthly average Welsh dispensing was increased by 11.93 items (7.67%; 95% CI [7.2%, 8.1%]), 6.37 items (3.38%; 95% CI [2.9%, 3.7%]) and 9.18 items (4.54%; 95% CI [4.2%, 4.9%]) per practice per 1,000 population during the periods when co-payment was reduced. Price elasticities of the selected medicines utilisation were -0.23, -0.13, and -0.04 in 3 analyses, suggesting the abolition of co-payment had small effect on Welsh dispensing.

10.1002/hec.3530.abstractZh: 我们利用了一项自然实验来测量威尔士逐步取消处方自付费用的影响。我们研究了三个研究阶段，分别对应于费用从6英镑降至4英镑、从4英镑降至3英镑，以及从3英镑降至0英镑的情况。我们采用了差异模型分析，并应用了英国14种选定药物的月度全科医生处方数据，这些药物在取消自付费用前有较高比例需要支付费用。为了排除其他因素的影响，我们选择了与威尔士具有相似健康和社会经济特征的英格兰东北部作为对照区域，在该区域在研究期间仍实行处方自付费用。结果显示，在费用降低期间，与对照区域相比，14种选定药物的处方数量略有增加。与英格兰东北部相比，威尔士每千人口每诊所的处方数量分别增加了11.93项（7.67%；95%置信区间[7.2%，8.1%]）、6.37项（3.38%；95%置信区间[2.9%，3.7%]）和9.18项（4.54%；95%置信区间[4.2%，4.9%]）。对于这几种选定药物的用量，价格弹性分别为-0.23、-0.13和-0.04，这表明取消自付费用对威尔士的处方行为影响较小。

abstract.text: We provide the first empirical evidence that better economic performances by immigrants' countries of origin, as measured by lower consumer price index (CPI) or higher gross domestic product, improve immigrants' mental health. We use an econometrically-robust approach that exploits exogenous changes in macroeconomic conditions across immigrants' home countries over time and controls for immigrants' observable and unobservable characteristics. The CPI effect is statistically significant and sizeable. Furthermore, the CPI effect diminishes as the time since emigrating increases. By contrast, home countries' unemployment rates and exchange rate fluctuations have no impact on immigrants' mental health.

10.1002/hec.3532.abstractZh: 我们首次提供了实证证据，表明移民原籍国在经济发展方面的表现更好，表现为消费者价格指数较低或国内生产总值较高，能够改善移民的心理健康。我们采用了一种经济计量学上稳健的方法，该方法利用移民原籍国随时间变化的宏观经济条件变化，并控制了移民的可观测与不可观测特征。消费者价格指数的影响在统计上显著且显著程度较高。此外，移民离开原籍国的时间越长，消费者价格指数对移民心理健康的影响就越小。相比之下，原籍国的失业率以及汇率波动对移民的心理健康没有影响。

abstract.text: Researchers have in recent years sought to establish whether the general public value treatment at the end of life (EOL) more highly than other treatments. Results are mixed, with social preferences most often exhibiting lack of preferences for EOL treatments. This null result may be driven by the often applied study design, where respondents are to choose between treatments targeting patients with varying fixed life expectancies. When remaining life is certain and salient, a rule-of-rescue sentiment may drive preferences across all scenarios. This study presents a different design, where the comparator is a preventive intervention. We study preferences from both an individual and social perspective and find no preference for an EOL premium.

10.1002/hec.3534.abstractZh: 近年来，研究人员试图确定公众是否更重视临终关怀的治疗，而非其他治疗方法。研究结果并不一致，大多数情况下，社会偏好并不倾向于临终关怀治疗。这一结果可能源于常用的研究设计，即让受访者在不同固定预期寿命的患者之间选择治疗方法。当剩余寿命是确定且显著的时，出于“救命原则”的偏好可能会驱动所有情况下的选择。本研究采用了不同的设计，以预防性干预作为比较对象。我们从个体和社会两个角度研究了偏好，发现公众并不倾向于对临终关怀治疗支付额外费用。

abstract.text: Antibiotic resistance is a major threat to public health worldwide. As the healthcare sector's use of antibiotics is an important contributor to the development of resistance, it is crucial that physicians only prescribe antibiotics when needed and that they choose narrow-spectrum antibiotics, which act on fewer bacteria types, when possible. Inappropriate use of antibiotics is nonetheless widespread, not least for respiratory tract infections (RTI), a common reason for antibiotics prescriptions. We examine if pay-for-performance (P4P) presents a way to influence primary care physicians' choice of antibiotics. During 2006-2013, 8 Swedish healthcare authorities adopted P4P to make physicians select narrow-spectrum antibiotics more often in the treatment of children with RTI. Exploiting register data on all purchases of RTI antibiotics in a difference-in-differences analysis, we find that P4P significantly increased the share of narrow-spectrum antibiotics. There are no signs that physicians gamed the system by issuing more prescriptions overall.

10.1002/hec.3535.abstractZh: 抗生素耐药性是全球公共卫生面临的主要威胁。由于医疗保健领域对抗生素的使用是导致耐药性产生的重要因素之一，因此医生只有在必要时才应开具抗生素，并尽可能选择对较少细菌类型有效的窄谱抗生素。然而，抗生素的不当使用仍然普遍存在，尤其是在呼吸道感染（RTI）的情况下，这往往是开具抗生素的常见原因。我们研究了“按绩效付费”（P4P）制度是否能为影响初级保健医生选择抗生素的方式提供一条途径。在2006至2013年间，瑞典的8个医疗保健机构采用了P4P制度，促使医生在儿童呼吸道感染的治疗中更频繁地选择窄谱抗生素。通过利用关于呼吸道感染抗生素采购的登记数据，我们发现P4P显著增加了窄谱抗生素的使用比例。没有迹象表明医生通过过度开具处方来钻制度的空子。

abstract.text: There is an increasing evidence that health-related quality of life, income, and social relationships are important to our subjective well-being (SWB). Little is known, however, about the specific indirect pathways that link health to SWB via social relationships and income. On the basis of a unique data set of 7 disease groups from 6 OECD-countries (N = 6,173), we investigate the direct and indirect effects of health on SWB by using structural equation modeling. Three alternative measures of health are used: For generic instruments (EQ-5D-5L; SF-6D), the total indirect effect was stronger (0.226; 0.249) than its direct effect (0.157; 0.205). For the visual analogue scale, the direct effect was stronger (0.322) than its total indirect effect (0.179). Most of the indirect effect of improved health on SWB transmitted through social relationships. The effect via income was small. Nevertheless, the presence of unmeasured confounders may bias the estimates. An important lesson for researchers is to include meaningful items on social relationships when measuring the benefits from improved health. An important lesson for policy makers is that social isolation appears to be more detrimental to overall well-being than ill health. Hence, the Health and Care Services should facilitate social arenas for people with chronic conditions.

10.1002/hec.3536.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，与健康相关的生活质量、收入和社会关系对我们的主观幸福感至关重要。然而，关于健康通过社会关系和收入与主观幸福感之间的具体间接途径，我们知之甚少。基于来自6个经合组织国家的7个疾病组的独特数据集（N = 6,173），我们通过结构方程模型研究了健康对主观幸福感的直接和间接影响。我们使用了三种不同的健康测量工具：对于通用工具（EQ-5D-5L；SF-6D），总间接效应（0.226；0.249）比直接效应（0.157；0.205）更强。对于视觉模拟量表，直接效应（0.322）比总间接效应（0.179）更强。大多数健康改善对主观幸福感的影响是通过社会关系传递的。通过收入传递的影响则较小。不过，未测量的混杂因素可能会影响估计结果。对于研究人员来说，一个重要的教训是在测量健康改善带来的益处时，应包含有关社会关系的有意义指标。对于政策制定者来说，一个重要的教训是，社会隔离似乎比健康状况不佳对整体幸福感更为有害。因此，健康与护理服务应促进患有慢性疾病的人群在社会领域的活动。

abstract.text: Access to cancer drugs used off-label is important to cancer patients but may drive up healthcare costs with little evidence of clinical benefit. We hypothesized that state health insurance mandates for private insurers to provide coverage for off-label use of cancer drugs cause higher rates of off-label use. We used Truven MarketScan data from 1999 to 2007 on utilization of 35 infused chemotherapy drugs in private health plans in the United States, covering the period when eight states implemented off-label coverage laws. We studied trends in off-label use of drugs, distinguishing between appropriate and inappropriate off-label use according to drug compendia, and estimated difference-in-difference regressions of the effect of state laws on off-label use. We estimate 41% of utilization was off-label, including 17% of use conservatively defined as inappropriate. Trends show gradual declines in off-label use over time. We also find no discernable effect of state laws mandating coverage of off-label use of cancer drugs on utilization patterns under multiple empirical specifications. Our conclusion is that policymakers should consider shifting away from mandating coverage as a way to ensure access to drugs off-label and towards incentivizing adherence to clinical practice guidelines to improve the quality and value of off-label use.

10.1002/hec.3537.abstractZh: 非标签使用抗癌药物对癌症患者非常重要，但几乎没有临床益处证据的情况下，这可能会推高医疗成本。我们假设，各州对私人保险公司强制要求覆盖非标签使用抗癌药物的保险政策，会导致非标签使用的比例上升。我们使用了1999年至2007年Truven MarketScan的数据，这些数据涵盖了美国私人健康计划中35种化疗药物的使用情况，时间跨度为8个州实施非标签使用覆盖法律期间。我们研究了药物非标签使用的趋势，根据药物手册将非标签使用分为适当和不适当的两类，并估计了州法律对非标签使用影响的差异回归分析结果。我们估计有41%的使用是非标签使用，其中17%的使用被定义为不适当。趋势显示，非标签使用的比例随时间逐渐下降。我们还发现，在多种实证分析中，强制覆盖非标签使用抗癌药物的政策对使用模式没有明显影响。我们的结论是，政策制定者应考虑不再强制覆盖非标签使用药物，而是转向激励遵守临床实践指南，以提高非标签使用的质量和价值。

abstract.text: An extensive literature documents immediate and persistent adverse labor market outcomes for individuals graduating into an economic downturn, but these effects are heterogeneous across sectors, occupations, and skill levels. In particular, the impact of recessions on the labor market outcomes for new physician graduates remains unknown. We leverage a unique dataset on New York physicians to analyze if and how the Great Recession impacted the labor market of physicians who have completed their residency and fellowship training and are seeking their first job. We find that these physicians do not delay labor market entry and their job searches and other employment outcomes are unaffected by the business cycle. The collage of evidence demonstrates that new graduates were largely unfazed by the recent downturn, which sharply contrasts with other highly educated, high remunerating occupations.

10.1002/hec.3538.abstractZh: 大量文献记录了经济衰退期间新毕业的个人的劳动力市场状况出现立即且持续的负面影响，但这些影响在不同行业、职业和技能水平之间存在差异。特别是，经济衰退对新医生毕业生劳动力市场的影响仍不清楚。我们利用纽约医生独有的数据集，分析大衰退是否以及如何影响了已完成住院医师和专科培训并寻求第一份工作的医生们的劳动力市场状况。研究发现，这些医生并没有延迟进入劳动力市场，他们的求职过程和其他就业状况并未受到商业周期的影响。这些证据表明，新毕业的医生们基本上没有受到近期经济衰退的影响，这与其他高学历、高薪职业形成了鲜明对比。

abstract.text: Vaccine purchase cost has grown substantially over the last few decades. A closer look at vaccine prices reveals that not all vaccines shared the same increasing pattern. Various factors, such as vaccine attributes, competition, and supply shortages, could relate to price changes. In this study, we examined whether a variety of factors influenced the prices of noninfluenza childhood vaccines purchased in the public sector from 1996 to 2014. The association differed among price-capped vaccines and combination vaccines. There was an increasing time trend in real prices for non-price-capped vaccines, which was mostly offset by the effect of market longevity. The effect of competition in lowering prices was more pronounced among non-price-capped vaccines when manufacturer and vaccine component fixed effects were excluded. Supply shortage, manufacturer name change, and number of vaccine doses in series showed no effect. The results may help policy makers better understand price behaviors and make more informed decisions in vaccine planning and financing.

10.1002/hec.3539.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，疫苗购买成本显著上升。仔细观察疫苗价格后发现，并非所有疫苗都呈现出相同的增长趋势。各种因素，如疫苗特性、竞争以及供应短缺，都可能影响价格变化。本研究探讨了1996年至2014年间，公共部门购买的非流感儿童疫苗价格是否受到多种因素的影响。对于价格上限疫苗和组合疫苗而言，这种影响存在差异。非价格上限疫苗的实际价格呈现出上升趋势，但这一趋势大多被市场持续时间的效应所抵消。在排除制造商和疫苗成分的固定效应后，竞争对降低价格的影响在非价格上限疫苗中更为明显。供应短缺、制造商名称变更以及疫苗剂量序列数等因素并未对价格产生影响。这些结果有助于政策制定者更好地理解价格行为，并在疫苗规划和融资方面做出更明智的决策。

abstract.text: Studies of health system responsiveness mostly focus on the demand side by investigating the association between sociodemographic characteristics of patients and their reported level of responsiveness. However, little is known about the influence of supply-side factors. This paper addresses that research gap by analysing the role of hospital-specialty characteristics in explaining variations in patients' evaluation of responsiveness from a sample of about 38,700 in-patients treated in public hospitals within the Italian Region of Emilia-Romagna. The analysis is carried out by adopting a 2-step procedure. First, we use patients' self-reported data to derive 5 measures of responsiveness at the hospital-specialty level. By estimating a generalised ordered probit model, we are able to correct for variations in individual reporting behaviour due to the health status of patients and their experience of being in pain. Second, we run cross-sectional regressions to investigate the association between patients' responsiveness and potential supply-side drivers, including waiting times, staff workload, the level of spending on non-clinical facilities, the level of spending on staff education and training, and the proportion of staff expenditure between nursing and administrative staff. Results suggest that responsiveness is to some extent influenced by the supply-side drivers considered.

10.1002/hec.3540.abstractZh: 关于医疗系统响应性的研究大多集中在需求端，通过调查患者的社会人口学特征与其感知的响应性水平之间的关联来展开。然而，关于供应端因素的影响则知之甚少。本文通过分析医院专科特征在解释意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区公立医院约38,700名患者感知响应性差异中的作用，填补了这一研究空白。分析采用两步法进行：首先，利用患者自我报告的数据，从医院专科层面推导出5个响应性指标。通过估计广义有序Probit模型，我们能够纠正因患者健康状况和疼痛体验导致的个体报告行为差异。其次，进行横截面回归分析，探讨患者的响应性与潜在的供应端因素之间的关联，包括等待时间、工作人员工作量、非临床设施支出水平、工作人员教育和培训支出水平，以及护理与行政人员支出比例。研究结果表明，响应性在某种程度上受到所考虑的供应端因素的影响。

abstract.text: Drug-specific clinical and health economic and outcomes research (HEOR) publications have amassed, but their effect on drug sales is largely unknown. We estimated the impact of publications on pharmaceutical sales in 3 markets (statins, rheumatoid arthritis, and asthma drugs) with varying generic competition. An event-study approach with fixed effects and difference-in-fixed-effects modeling was used to estimate the causal effects of drug-specific publications on subsequent quarter's drug-specific sales and volume. High-impact clinical and HEOR publications have significant positive effects on sales (mediated through price) and volume in the statin market (high generic competition). High-impact clinical publications have a significant positive effect on sales (mediated through volume) in low-generic competition market (asthma). The effects of publications in the rheumatoid arthritis market (no generic competition) on sales were null. Manufacturers' investment in clinical and HEOR publications needs to be strategic and should be anticipated and complemented by public investments in such studies.

10.1002/hec.3546.abstractZh: 关于药物特异性临床及健康经济与结果研究的出版物数量已经相当可观，但它们对药物销售的影响仍不明确。我们估算了这些出版物在三个市场（他汀类药物、类风湿性关节炎药物和哮喘药物）中对药品销售的影响，这些市场的仿制药竞争程度各不相同。采用事件研究法，结合固定效应和固定效应差异建模，来估计药物特异性出版物对后续季度药物销售和销量影响的因果关系。在高仿制药竞争的市场中，高影响力的临床及健康经济与结果研究出版物对销售（通过价格传导）和销量有显著的正面影响。在低仿制药竞争的市场中，高影响力的临床出版物对销售有显著的正面影响（通过销量传导）。而在没有仿制药竞争类风湿性关节炎市场中，出版物的影响对销售没有显著影响。制药企业对于临床及健康经济与结果研究出版物的投入需要具有战略性，并且应该得到公共投资的支持。

abstract.text: Nonmedical use of prescription opioids has reached epidemic levels in the United States and globally. In response, federal, state, and local governments are taking actions to address substantial increases in prescription opioid addiction and its associated harms. This study examines the effect of two state laws specifically designed to curtail access to prescription opioids to nonmedical users: pain management clinic and doctor shopping laws. We use administrative data on overdose deaths and admissions to specialty substance use disorder treatment coupled with a differences-in-differences design. Our findings suggest that both pain management clinic and doctor shopping laws have the potential to reduce prescription opioid overdose deaths. Moreover, doctor shopping laws appear to reduce prescription opioid treatment admissions. As many states have adopted these laws in recent years, the full effects of the laws may not yet be realized. Future research using more postlaw passage data should reevaluate the effectiveness of these laws.

10.1002/hec.3548.abstractZh: 在美国和全球范围内，非医疗用途的处方阿片类药物的使用已经达到了流行病的水平。为此，联邦、州和地方政府正在采取行动，以应对处方阿片类药物成瘾的显著增加及其带来的危害。本研究考察了两项旨在限制非医疗用户获取处方阿片类药物的州法律的效果：疼痛管理诊所法律和医生转介法律。我们使用了关于过量死亡和专门物质使用障碍治疗入院情况的行政数据，并采用了差异-差异设计进行分析。研究结果表明，疼痛管理诊所法律和医生转介法律都有潜力减少处方阿片类药物过量死亡事件。此外，医生转介法律似乎还能减少处方阿片类药物治疗入院的情况。由于许多州在近年来已经实施了这些法律，这些法律的全部效果可能尚未显现。未来的研究需要利用更多法律实施后的数据来重新评估这些法律的有效性。

abstract.text: A randomised control trial was conducted to determine changes in the food and drink choices of adolescents following their participation in a 50-min nutrition workshop. The experiment was conducted at 104 schools in Barcelona (126 classes, 3,291 adolescents). Schools were randomly selected and stratified by district and by public or private status. The students were given three types of vouchers with different options regarding the type of food for which the vouchers could be exchanged (standard for healthy food and drink, two for one for unhealthy food, and two for one for unhealthy drink). Difference-in-differences linear models that control for individual, family, school or neighbourhood characteristics, and the influence of peers were applied. The probability of students' choosing unhealthy food and drink fell by 7.1% and 4.4%, respectively, following participation in the nutrition workshop. The promotion of unhealthy beverages counteracted the positive impact of the workshop on beverage choice.

10.1002/hec.3549.abstractZh: 一项随机对照试验旨在研究青少年在参加50分钟的营养讲座后，食物和饮料选择的变化。实验在巴塞罗那的104所学校进行（共126个班级，3,291名青少年）。学校通过随机方式选取，并按地区及公立或私立性质进行分层。参与者获得了三种类型的代金券，每种代金券可兑换不同类型的食物（标准代金券用于购买健康食品和饮料，两种代金券可兑换一种不健康食品，另外两种代金券可兑换一种不健康饮料）。研究采用了控制个体、家庭、学校或社区特征以及同伴影响的差异线性模型。结果显示，参与营养讲座后，青少年选择不健康食品和饮料的比例分别下降了7.1%和4.4%。此外，不健康饮料的推广抵消了营养讲座对饮料选择的正面影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines how domestic and international financing for HIV is, and ought to be, distributed. We build a theoretical framework that decomposes domestic and international financing for HIV into nonlinear functions of national income, HIV prevalence, and government effectiveness. We test this model, paying particular attention to nonlinearities and to problems of bad controls, multicollinearity, and reverse causality. Finally, we use the fitted values of quartile regressions to study how much countries could reasonably pay domestically and how much they should receive from donors. Worryingly, countries with higher financial means receive on average more aid per PLHIV than very poor ones, and countries with higher HIV prevalence receive on average less aid per people living with HIV. The normative analysis concludes that US$3.08 billion of fiscal space could be created in LIC and MIC. We identify the countries that could be allocated more aid.

10.1002/hec.3550.abstractZh: 本文探讨了国内和国际上为艾滋病提供的资金是如何分配，以及应该如何分配的。我们构建了一个理论框架，将国内和国际艾滋病资金分配分解为国民收入、艾滋病发病率和政府效率的非线性函数。我们对这一模型进行了测试，特别关注非线性问题以及控制不力、多重共线性以及反向因果关系等问题。最后，我们利用四分位回归的拟合值来研究各国在内部支付和从捐助者接收资金方面的合理范围。令人担忧的是，经济条件较好的国家平均每个艾滋病患者获得的援助比经济条件非常贫困的国家更多，而艾滋病发病率较高的国家平均每个艾滋病患者获得的援助则较少。规范性分析得出结论，在低收入国家和中等收入国家可以创造30.8亿美元的资金空间。我们确定了那些可以获得更多援助的国家。

abstract.text: This paper investigates and quantifies the impact of parallel trade in markets for pharmaceuticals. The paper develops a structural model of demand and supply using data on price, sales, and the characteristics of statins in Denmark and simulates outcomes under a complete ban of parallel imports, keeping other regulatory schemes unchanged. There are two sets of key results. The first set focuses on price effects. On average, prices increase more in markets where the molecule has lost patent protection; wholesale prices for both generic and original products increase after competition from parallel importers is removed, but the final price paid by consumers (after deducting reimbursement) increases more for original products than for generics because most changes in wholesale prices are absorbed by the prevailing reimbursement rules. The second set of results reports the effects on market participants. My model takes into consideration consumers' preferences, allowing them to substitute between products. Prohibiting parallel imports induces consumers to substitute towards original products for which they have stronger preferences. In sum, banning parallel imports leads to (a) an increase in variable profits for original producers and a decrease for generic firms, (b) an increase in governmental health-care expenditures, and (c) a decrease in the welfare of Danish patients and firms.

10.1002/hec.3551.abstractZh: 本文研究并量化了平行贸易对药品市场的影响。文章基于丹麦的定价、销售数据以及他汀类药物的特性，构建了一个需求与供给的结构模型，并模拟了在完全禁止平行进口的情况下市场的结果，同时其他监管机制保持不变。研究得出两组关键结果。第一组结果关注价格效应：在药品专利保护失效的市场中，价格平均会上涨更多；在消除平行进口竞争后，无论是仿制药还是原研产品的批发价格都会上升，但消费者实际支付的价格（扣除报销后）对于原研产品来说上升幅度更大，因为批发价格的大部分变化都被现有的报销规则所吸收。第二组结果则关注市场参与者的影响：我的模型考虑了消费者的偏好，使他们能够在不同产品之间进行选择。禁止平行进口会导致消费者更倾向于选择他们更偏好的原研产品。总之，禁止平行进口会导致：(a)原研产品的可变利润增加，而仿制药公司的利润减少；(b)政府医疗保健支出增加；(c)丹麦患者和企业的福利下降。

abstract.text: Patient non-attendance can lead to worse health outcomes and longer waiting times. In the English National Health Service, around 7% of patients who are referred by their general practice for a hospital outpatient appointment fail to attend. An electronic booking system (Choose and Book-C&B) for general practices making hospital outpatient appointments was introduced in England in 2005 and by 2009 accounted for 50% of appointments. It was intended, inter alia, to reduce the rate of non-attendance. Using a 2004-2009 panel with 7,900 English general practices, allowing for the relaxation of constraints on patient of hospital, and for the potential endogeneity of use of C&B, we estimate that the introduction of C&B reduced non-attendance by referred patients in 2009 by 72,160 (8.7%).

10.1002/hec.3552.abstractZh: 患者不按时就诊可能导致更差的健康结果和更长的等待时间。在英国国家卫生服务体系中，约7%由全科医生推荐前往医院门诊的患者未能按时就诊。2005年，英格兰引入了针对全科医生进行医院门诊预约的电子预约系统（Choose and Book-C&B）。到2009年，该系统已占所有预约的50%。该系统的设立旨在降低患者不按时就诊的比例。利用2004-2009年间收集的7,900个英国全科医生的数据，考虑到患者出院限制条件的放宽，以及C&B使用可能的内生性因素，我们估计该系统的引入使2009年被推荐就诊的患者不按时就诊的比例减少了72,160例（8.7%）。

abstract.text: When modelling "social bads," such as illegal drug consumption, researchers are often faced with a dependent variable characterised by a large number of zero observations. Building on the recent literature on hurdle and double-hurdle models, we propose a double-inflated modelling framework, where the zero observations are allowed to come from the following: nonparticipants; participant misreporters (who have larger loss functions associated with a truthful response); and infrequent consumers. Due to our empirical application, the model is derived for the case of an ordered discrete-dependent variable. However, it is similarly possible to augment other such zero-inflated models (e.g., zero-inflated count models, and double-hurdle models for continuous variables). The model is then applied to a consumer choice problem of cannabis consumption. We estimate that 17% of the reported zeros in the cannabis survey are from individuals who misreport their participation, 11% from infrequent users, and only 72% from true nonparticipants.

10.1002/hec.3553.abstractZh: 在建模“社会不良现象”时，例如非法药物消费，研究人员经常面临一个因大量零观测值而特征化的因变量。基于近期关于障碍模型和双障碍模型的文献，我们提出了一种双膨胀建模框架，其中零观测值可以来自以下三类人群：不参与者、报告错误信息的参与者（其真实回答会带来更大的损失函数）以及不常消费该物品的人。由于我们的实证应用，该模型是针对有序离散因变量的情况推导出来的。然而，类似地，也可以对其它零膨胀模型进行扩展（例如，零膨胀计数模型以及针对连续变量的双障碍模型）。随后，该模型被应用于大麻消费的选择问题。我们估计，在关于大麻的调查中，有17%的零观测值来自报告错误参与情况的个体，11%来自不常消费该物品的人，而只有72%来自真正不参与该行为的人。

abstract.text: Public sector organisations pursue multiple objectives and serve a number of stakeholders. But stakeholders are rarely explicit about the valuations they attach to different objectives, nor are these valuations likely to be identical. This complicates the assessment of their performance because no single set of weights can be chosen legitimately to aggregate outputs into unidimensional composite scores. We propose the use of dominance criteria in a multidimensional performance assessment framework to identify best practice and poor performance under relatively weak assumptions about stakeholders' preferences. We use as an example providers of hip replacement surgery in the English National Health Service and estimate multivariate multilevel models to study their performance in terms of length of stay, readmission rates, post-operative patient-reported health status and waiting time. We find substantial correlation between objectives and demonstrate that ignoring the correlation can lead to incorrect assessments of performance.

10.1002/hec.3554.abstractZh: 公共部门组织追求多种目标，并为多个利益相关者服务。然而，利益相关者很少明确说明他们对不同目标的重视程度，这些重视程度也不太可能完全相同。这使得评估其绩效变得复杂，因为无法合理地选择一组权重来将各项产出汇总为单一维度的综合评分。我们建议在多维绩效评估框架中运用优势标准，以在相对简单的利益相关者偏好假设下识别最佳实践和表现不佳的情况。我们以英国国家卫生服务系统中的髋关节置换手术提供者为例，通过估计多变量多层模型来研究其在住院时间、再入院率、术后患者报告的健康状况以及等待时间方面的绩效。我们发现不同目标之间存在显著的相关性，并证明忽略这种相关性会导致对绩效的误判。

abstract.text: This article suggests an enrichment of the standard method for decomposition of the concentration index to account for unobserved heterogeneity and persistence in health behavior. As the underlying regression model in the decomposition, this approach uses a dynamic random-effect probit that both consider individual heterogeneity, using a Mundlak type of specification, and applies a simple solution to account for smoking persistence. I illustrate the suggested approach using a panel of Swedish women in Statistics Sweden's Survey of Living Conditions for one vital health-related behavior, smoking. The results highlight the importance of persistence and show that education and living in a single household are the main drivers of income-related smoking inequality.

10.1002/hec.3555.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种改进的标准方法，用于分解浓度指数，以考虑未观察到的异质性和健康行为的持续性。作为分解的基础回归模型，该方法采用了动态随机效应Probit模型，既考虑了个体异质性，又采用了Mundlak类型的规格化方法，并采用了简单的解决方案来处理吸烟的持续性问题。本文以瑞典统计局的瑞典妇女生活状况调查为例，针对一种重要的健康相关行为——吸烟，对建议的方法进行了实证检验。研究结果强调了持续性的重要性，并表明教育和生活在单一家庭中的情况是导致收入相关吸烟不平等的主要因素。

abstract.text: The availability of health personnel in the rural areas of poor countries is generally seen as problematic. This paper contrasts a lottery-based assignment of personnel between rural and urban areas to a free-market solution in which personnel are paid a premium to accept a rural posting. The lottery system can lower total cost and increase the number of personnel in rural areas. The model benchmarked with published estimates of the premium that would be required under a free market suggests gains from the lottery could be substantial.

10.1002/hec.3556.abstractZh: 贫困国家农村地区的卫生人员供应通常被视为一个问题。本文将基于抽签的农村与城市人员分配方案与一种自由市场解决方案进行了对比，在自由市场方案中，人员被支付较高的报酬以接受农村工作。抽签系统可以降低总成本并增加农村地区的人员数量。通过与已发布的自由市场下所需报酬估算数据对比的模型分析表明，抽签方案的收益可能是相当可观的。

abstract.text: Evidence about cost-effectiveness is increasingly being used to inform decisions about the funding of new technologies that are usually implemented as guidelines from centralized decision-making bodies. However, there is also an increasing recognition for the role of patients in determining their preferred treatment option. This paper presents a method to estimate the value of implementing a choice-based decision process using the cost-effectiveness analysis toolbox. This value is estimated for 3 alternative scenarios. First, it compares centralized decisions, based on population average cost-effectiveness, against a decision process based on patient choice. Second, it compares centralized decision based on patients' subgroups versus an individual choice-based decision process. Third, it compares a centralized process based on average cost-effectiveness against a choice-based process where patients choose according to a different measure of outcome to that used by the centralized decision maker. The methods are applied to a case study for the management of acute coronary syndrome. It is concluded that implementing a choice-based process of treatment allocation may be an option in collectively funded health systems. However, its value will depend on the specific health problem and the social values considered relevant to the health system.

10.1002/hec.3559.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据被用来作为决策依据，以评估新技术项目的成本效益，这些决策通常由中央决策机构制定。然而，人们也越来越认识到患者在选择治疗方案时的作用。本文提出了一种方法，利用成本效益分析工具来估算采用基于选择的决策流程的价值。该价值针对三种不同的情景进行了估算。首先，比较了基于人群平均成本效益的中央决策与基于患者选择的决策流程。其次，比较了基于患者子群体的中央决策与个体选择的决策流程。最后，比较了基于平均成本效益的中央决策流程与基于选择的决策流程，后者中患者的选择依据的是与中央决策者不同的结果衡量标准。这些方法被应用于急性冠状动脉综合征的管理案例研究。研究结果表明，在集体资助的卫生系统中，采用基于选择的决策流程可能是一种可行的选择。不过，其价值取决于具体的健康问题以及被认为与卫生系统相关的社会价值观。

abstract.text: Value sets for the EQ-5D-5L are required to facilitate its use in estimating quality-adjusted life years. An international protocol has been developed to guide the collection of stated preference data for this purpose and has been used to generate EQ-5D-5L valuation data for England. The aim of this paper is report the innovative methods used for modelling those data to obtain a value set. Nine hundred and ninety-six members of the English general public completed time trade-off (TTO) and discrete choice experiment (DCE) tasks. We estimate models, with and without interactions, using DCE data only, TTO data only, and TTO/DCE data combined. TTO data are interpreted as both left and right censored. Heteroskedasticity and preference heterogeneity between individuals are accounted for. We use Bayesian methods in the econometric analysis. The final model is chosen based on the deviance information criterion (DIC). Censoring and taking account of heteroskedasticity have important effects on parameter estimation. For DCE data only, TTO data only, and DCE/TTO data combined, models with parameters for all dimensions and levels perform best, as judged by the DIC. Taking account of heterogeneity improves fit, and the multinomial model reports the lowest DIC. This paper presents approaches that suit observed characteristics of EQ-5D-5L valuation data and recognise respondents' preference heterogeneity. The methods described are potentially relevant to other value set studies.

10.1002/hec.3560.abstractZh: 为了便于使用EQ-5D-5L估算质量调整生命年，需要为其提供价值集。为此目的，已制定了一项国际协议来指导陈述偏好数据的收集，该协议已被用于为英格兰生成EQ-5D-5L估值数据。本文旨在报告用于建模这些数据以获得价值集的创新方法。共有九百九十六名英格兰普通民众完成了时间权衡（TTO）和离散选择实验（DCE）任务。我们使用DCE数据、仅TTO数据以及结合使用TTO/DCE数据进行模型估计，包括考虑交互作用的情况。TTO数据被解释为左右截尾数据。模型中考虑了异方差性和个体间的偏好异质性。在计量经济学分析中采用了贝叶斯方法。最终模型是根据偏差信息准则（DIC）来选择的。截尾处理以及考虑异方差性对参数估计有重要影响。对于仅使用DCE数据、仅使用TTO数据以及结合使用DCE/TTO数据的模型，根据DIC的评估结果，包含所有维度和水平的参数模型表现最佳。考虑偏好异质性可以提高模型的拟合度，而多项式模型报告的DIC值最低。本文提出了适用于EQ-5D-5L估值数据观测特征的方法，并考虑了受访者偏好异质性。所描述的方法对其他价值集研究也可能具有相关性。

abstract.text: This paper presents a conceptual framework to analyse the design of the cost-effectiveness appraisal process of new healthcare technologies. The framework characterises the appraisal processes as a diagnostic test aimed at identifying cost-effective (true positive) and non-cost-effective (true negative) technologies. Using the framework, factors that influence the value of operating an appraisal process, in terms of net gain to population health, are identified. The framework is used to gain insight into current policy questions including (a) how rigorous the process should be, (b) who should have the burden of proof, and (c) how optimal design changes when allowing for appeals, price reductions, resubmissions, and re-evaluations. The paper demonstrates that there is no one optimal appraisal process and the process should be adapted over time and to the specific technology under assessment. Optimal design depends on country-specific features of (future) technologies, for example, effect, price, and size of the patient population, which might explain the difference in appraisal processes across countries. It is shown that burden of proof should be placed on the producers and that the impact of price reductions and patient access schemes on the producer's price setting should be considered when designing the appraisal process.

10.1002/hec.3561.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个概念框架，用于分析新型医疗技术的成本效益评估过程设计。该框架将评估过程视为一种诊断测试，旨在识别具有成本效益的技术（真阳性）和不具备成本效益的技术（真阴性）。通过这一框架，可以识别出影响评估过程价值的因素，即其对人群健康带来的净收益。该框架有助于理解当前政策问题，包括：评估过程应有多严格；谁应承担举证责任；以及在允许上诉、降价、重新提交和评估时，评估过程应如何优化设计。研究表明，并不存在一种最优的评估过程，评估过程应随着时间推移以及针对具体的评估技术进行调整。最优设计取决于（未来）技术的国家特定特征，例如效果、价格以及患者群体的规模，这些因素可能解释了不同国家之间评估过程的差异。此外，还指出举证责任应落在生产者身上，在设计评估过程时，还应考虑降价措施和患者获取方案对生产者定价的影响。

abstract.text: Despite the importance of including children's preferences in the valuation of their own health benefits, no study has investigated the ability of children to understand willingness-to-pay (WTP) questions. Using a contingent valuation method, we elicit children's and parents' WTP to reduce children's risk of an asthma attack. Our results suggest that children are able to understand and value their own health risk reductions, and their ability to do so improves with age. Child age was found to be inversely related to parents' and children's WTP. The results also suggest that non-paternalistic altruism is predictive of children's WTP. For parents, care for their own health was found to be inversely related with their WTP for children's risk reductions. Comparison of parents' and children's WTP suggests that parents are willing to sacrifice for their child's health risk reduction an amount that is approximately twice that of their children. The analysis of matched pairs of parents and children suggest that there are within-household similarities as the child's WTP is positively related to parents' WTP.

10.1002/hec.3562.abstractZh: 尽管在评估儿童自身健康收益时考虑其偏好非常重要，但尚无研究探讨儿童理解支付意愿问题的能力。我们采用条件价值评估方法，调查了儿童及其父母对减少儿童哮喘发作风险的支付意愿。研究结果表明，儿童能够理解并评估自身健康风险降低的价值，且这一能力随年龄增长而提高。儿童年龄与父母及儿童的支付意愿呈负相关。研究结果还表明，非父权式的利他行为能够预测儿童的支付意愿。对于父母而言，关注自身健康与他们对儿童健康风险降低的支付意愿呈负相关。父母与儿童支付意愿的比较表明，父母愿意为儿童的健康风险降低做出相当于儿童两倍的牺牲。对父母与儿童配对数据的分析显示，家庭内部存在相似性，即儿童的支付意愿与父母的支付意愿呈正相关。

abstract.text: Health is well known to show a clear gradient by occupation. Although it may appear evident that occupation can affect health, there are multiple possible sources of selection that can generate a strong association, other than simply a causal effect of occupation on health. We link job characteristics to German panel data spanning 29 years to characterize occupations by their physical and psychosocial burden. Employing a dynamic model to control for factors that simultaneously affect health and selection into occupation, we find that selection into occupation accounts for at least 60% of the association. The effects of occupational characteristics such as physical strain and low job control are negative and increase with age: late-career exposure to 1 year of high physical strain and low job control is comparable to the average health decline from ageing 16 and 6 months, respectively.

10.1002/hec.3563.abstractZh: 众所周知，健康状况在不同职业之间存在明显差异。虽然职业对健康的影响似乎显而易见，但除了职业对健康的直接因果效应之外，还有许多可能的选择因素会导致这种强烈的关联。我们通过使用德国29年的面板数据，将工作特征与职业进行关联，以描述职业在身体和心理社会方面的负担。采用动态模型来控制同时影响健康和职业选择的因素后，我们发现职业选择至少解释了60%的关联程度。诸如身体压力较大和职业控制较低等职业特征的影响是负面的，并且随着年龄的增长而加剧：在职业生涯后期经历1年的高身体压力和低职业控制，相当于因年龄增长而平均健康状况下降16个月和6个月的情况。

abstract.text: A new version of the EQ-5D, the EQ-5D-5L, is available. The aim of this study is to produce a value set to support use of EQ-5D-5L data in decision-making. The study design followed an international research protocol. Randomly selected members of the English general public completed 10 time trade-off and 7 discrete choice experiment tasks in face-to-face interviews. A 20-parameter hybrid model was used to combine time trade-off and discrete choice experiment data to generate values for the 3,125 EQ-5D-5L health states. Valuation data are available for 996 respondents. Face validity of the data has been demonstrated, with more severe health states generally given lower values. Problems with pain/discomfort and anxiety/depression received the greatest weight. Compared to the existing EQ-5D-3L value set, there are considerably fewer "worse than dead" states (5.1%, compared with over one third), and the minimum value is higher. Values range from -0.285 (extreme problems on all dimensions) to 0.950 (for health states 11211 and 21111). Results have important implications for users of the EQ-5D-5L both in England and internationally. Quality-adjusted life year gains from interventions seeking to improve very poor health may be smaller using this value set and may previously have been overestimated.

10.1002/hec.3564.abstractZh: 新版EQ-5D，即EQ-5D-5L，现已推出。本研究的目的是制定一个价值体系，以支持在决策过程中使用EQ-5D-5L数据。研究设计遵循国际研究规范，随机选取的英国普通民众在面对面访谈中完成了10项时间权衡和7项离散选择实验任务。采用了一个包含20个参数的混合模型，将时间权衡和离散选择实验数据结合起来，为3,125种EQ-5D-5L健康状态生成了相应的价值。已有996名受访者的评估数据可供使用。数据的表面有效性已得到验证，健康状况越严重，得到的价值通常越低。疼痛/不适以及焦虑/抑郁问题被赋予了最大的权重。与现有的EQ-5D-3L价值体系相比，存在“比死亡更差”的状态数量显著减少（从超过三分之一减少到5.1%），且最低价值也有所提高。价值范围从-0.285（所有维度都面临极端问题）到0.950（适用于健康状态11211和21111）。这些结果对英国及国际上的EQ-5D-5L使用者具有重要意义。使用这一价值体系，旨在改善极重度健康状况的干预措施可能带来的质量调整生命年收益较小，而且之前对这些收益的估计可能偏高。

abstract.text: Despite a widely held belief that alcohol use should negatively impact wages, much of the literature on the topic suggests a positive relationship between nonproblematic alcohol use and wages. Studies on the effect of alcohol use on educational attainment have also failed to find a consistent, negative effect of alcohol use on years of education. Thus, the connections between alcohol use, human capital, and wages remain a topic of debate in the literature. In this study, we use the 1997 cohort of the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth to estimate a theoretical model of wage determination that links alcohol use to wages via human capital. We find that nonbinge drinking is associated with lower wage returns to education whereas binge drinking is associated with increased wage returns to both education and work experience. We interpret these counterintuitive results as evidence that alcohol use affects wages through both the allocative and productive efficiency of human capital formation and that these effects operate in offsetting directions. We suggest that alcohol control policies should be more nuanced to target alcohol consumption in the contexts within which it causes harm.

10.1002/hec.3565.abstractZh: 尽管普遍认为酒精使用会对工资产生负面影响，但许多相关文献表明，非问题的酒精使用与工资之间可能存在正相关关系。关于酒精使用对教育成就影响的研究也未能发现酒精使用对教育年限的持续负面影响。因此，酒精使用、人力资本与工资之间的关系仍然是学术界争论的话题。在这项研究中，我们采用了1997年《全国青年纵向调查》的数据，建立了一个理论模型，将酒精使用与工资联系起来，并通过人力资本来解释这种关系。我们发现，非酗酒行为与较低的工资回报相关，而酗酒行为则与更高的工资回报以及教育和工作经验相关。我们认为这些反直觉的结果表明，酒精使用通过人力资本的形成效率和生产力效率来影响工资，并且这些影响的方向是相互抵消的。因此，酒精控制政策应更加细致，以针对那些酒精使用造成伤害的情境。

abstract.text: Little is known about the response of physicians to changes in compensation: Do increases in compensation increase or decrease labour supply? In this paper, we estimate wage elasticities for physicians. We apply both a structural discrete choice approach and a reduced-form approach to examine how these different approaches affect wage elasticities at the intensive margin. Using uniquely rich data collected from a large sample of general practitioners (GPs) and specialists in Australia, we estimate 3 alternative utility specifications (quadratic, translog, and box-cox utility functions) in the structural approach, as well as a reduced-form specification, separately for men and women. Australian data is particularly suited for this analysis due to a lack of regulation of physicians' fees leading to variation in earnings. All models predict small negative wage elasticities for male and female GPs and specialists passing several sensitivity checks. For this high-income and long-working-hours population, the translog and box-cox utility functions outperform the quadratic utility function. Simulating the effects of 5% and 10% wage increases at the intensive margin slightly reduces the full-time equivalent supply of male GPs, and to a lesser extent of male specialists and female GPs.

10.1002/hec.3572.abstractZh: 关于医生对薪酬变化的反应，目前了解甚少：薪酬的增加是会增加还是减少劳动力供应？在本文中，我们估算了医生的工资弹性。我们采用了结构性离散选择方法和简化形式方法来研究这两种方法如何影响劳动市场的工资弹性。利用从澳大利亚大量普通医生和专家那里收集到的丰富数据，我们在结构性方法中分别针对男性和女性估算了三种不同的效用函数模型（二次型、反Log形式和Box-Cox效用函数），同时也采用了简化形式模型。由于澳大利亚对医生收费缺乏监管，导致收入存在较大差异，因此澳大利亚的数据特别适合进行此类分析。所有模型都预测出男性和女性普通医生及专家的工资弹性为小负值，并且这些预测结果通过了多项敏感性检验。对于这一高收入且工作时间较长的群体而言，反Log形式和Box-Cox效用函数比二次型效用函数表现更好。模拟5%和10%的工资增长对全职医生供应的影响时，结果显示男性全职医生的供应略有减少，男性专科医生和女性全职医生的供应减少幅度则较小。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of spousal bereavement on hospital inpatient use for the surviving bereaved by following the experience of 94,272 married Scottish individuals from 1991 until 2009 using a difference-in-difference model. We also consider the sample selection issues related to differences in survival between the bereaved and non-bereaved using a simple Cox Proportional-Hazard model. Before conducting these estimations, propensity score approaches are used to re-weight the non-bereaved to generate a more random-like comparison sample for the bereaved. We find that those bereaved who survive are both more likely to be admitted and to stay longer in hospital than a comparable non-bereaved cohort. Bereavement is estimated to induce on average an extra 0.24 (95% CI [0.15, 0.33]) hospital inpatient days per year. Similar to previous studies, we estimate the bereaved have a 19.2% (95% CI [12.5%, 26.3%]) higher mortality rate than the comparable non-bereaved cohort.

10.1002/hec.3573.abstractZh: 本文通过采用差异-差异模型，基于1991年至2009年间94,272名已婚苏格兰人的数据，估计了配偶丧亲对幸存者住院使用的影响。同时，我们还利用简单的Cox比例风险模型，考虑了丧亲与非丧亲人群在生存时间上的差异所带来的样本选择问题。在进行这些估计之前，我们使用倾向得分法对非丧亲人群进行了重新加权，以生成更接近随机样本的对照组。研究发现，与对照组相比，丧亲后幸存者更有可能住院，并且住院时间也更长。估计显示，丧亲行为平均每年会导致额外0.24天的住院时间（95%置信区间[0.15, 0.33]）。与以往的研究类似，我们估计丧亲者的死亡率比对照组高出19.2%（95%置信区间[12.5%, 26.3]）。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether increases in minimum wages are associated with higher life satisfaction by using monthly-level state minimum wages and individual-level data from the 2005-2010 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System. The magnitude I find suggests that a 10% increase in the minimum wage is associated with a 0.03-point increase in life satisfaction for workers without a high school diploma, on a 4-point scale. Contrary to popular belief that higher minimum wages hurt business owners, I find little evidence that higher minimum wages lead to the loss of well-being among self-employed people.

10.1002/hec.3577.abstractZh: 本文通过使用2005-2010年行为风险因素监测系统的月度最低工资数据以及个人数据，研究最低工资的提高是否与更高的生活满意度相关。我的研究发现，对于没有高中学历的劳动者来说，最低工资提高10%，生活满意度会相应提高0.03分，满分为4分。与普遍观点相反，较高的最低工资并不会对企业家造成伤害，反而几乎没有证据表明较高的最低工资会导致自雇人士的幸福感下降。

abstract.text: We investigate whether interventions by (a) medical doctors and (b) occupational specialists are effective in reducing sick leave durations among self-employed workers. Therefore, we exploit unique administrative data comprising all sick leave claims by self-employed workers insured with a major Dutch private insurer between January 2009 and March 2014. We estimate a multivariate duration model dealing with nonrandom selection into the two intervention types by controlling for observable and unobservable claimant characteristics. We find adverse treatment effects for both interventions, irrespective of whether they are started early or (middle) late in the sickness spell.

10.1002/hec.3578.abstractZh: 我们研究了（a）医生和（b）职业专家进行的干预措施在减少个体经营者缺勤时长方面是否有效。为此，我们利用了一项独特的行政数据，该数据包含了2009年1月至2014年3月期间，在一家荷兰主要私人保险公司投保的个体经营者所有缺勤申请记录。我们建立了一个多变量持续时间模型，通过控制可观测和不可观测的申请者特征，来研究两种干预措施的非随机选择效应。研究发现，无论干预措施是在疾病发作早期还是（中期）晚期实施，这两种干预措施都产生了负面效果。

abstract.text: The questionable ability of the U.S. pension system to provide for the growing elderly population combined with the rising number of people affected by depression and other mental health issues magnifies the need to understand how these household characteristics affect retirement. Mental health problems have a large and significant negative effect on retirement savings. Specifically, psychological distress is associated with decreasing the probability of holding retirement accounts by as much as 24 percentage points and decreasing retirement savings as a share of financial assets by as much as 67 percentage points. The magnitude of these effects underscores the importance of employer management policy and government regulation of these accounts to help ensure households have adequate retirement savings.

10.1002/hec.3579.abstractZh: 美国养老金体系在应对不断增长的老龄人口方面的能力存在疑问，同时受抑郁症和其他心理健康问题影响的人数也在增加，这进一步凸显了了解这些家庭特征如何影响退休计划的重要性。心理健康问题对退休储蓄有着巨大且显著的负面影响。具体而言，心理困扰会使持有退休账户的概率降低多达24个百分点，并使退休储蓄在金融资产中的比例降低多达67个百分点。这些影响的严重性强调了雇主管理政策和政府监管这些账户的重要性，以确保家庭拥有足够的退休储蓄。

abstract.text: We use register data for Denmark (IDA) merged with the Danish Work Environment Cohort Survey (1995, 2000, and 2005) to estimate the effect of perceived employment insecurity on perceived health for a sample of Danish employees. We consider two health measures from the SF-36 Health Survey Instrument: a vitality scale for general well-being and a mental health scale. We first analyse a summary measure of employment insecurity. Instrumental variables-fixed effects estimates that use firm workforce changes as a source of exogenous variation show that 1 additional dimension of insecurity causes a shift from the median to the 25th percentile in the mental health scale and to the 30th in that of energy/vitality. It also increases by about 6 percentage points the probability to develop severe mental health problems. Looking at single insecurity dimensions by naïve fixed effects, uncertainty associated with the current job is important for mental health. Employability has a sizeable relationship with health and is the only insecurity dimension that matters for the energy and vitality scale. Danish employees who fear involuntary firm internal mobility experience worse mental health.

10.1002/hec.3580.abstractZh: 我们利用了丹麦的注册数据（IDA）与丹麦工作环境队列调查（1995年、2000年和2005年）的数据，来估计感知到的就业不安全性对丹麦员工健康感知的影响。我们从SF-36健康调查工具中选取了两个健康指标：一个用于衡量整体福祉的活力量表，以及一个用于衡量心理健康的量表。我们首先分析了就业不安全的综合指标。通过固定效应模型分析，发现额外的不安全感维度会导致心理健康量表中的中位数值向第25百分位移动，能量/活力量表中的中位数值则向第30百分位移动。此外，这种不安全感还会使出现严重心理健康问题的概率增加约6个百分点。从单一不安全感维度来看，与当前工作相关的不确定性对心理健康具有重要影响。就业能力与健康之间存在显著关联，而就业能力是唯一对能量和活力量表有影响的维度。那些担心公司可能强制进行内部调动的丹麦员工，其心理健康状况更为糟糕。

abstract.text: We provide original, international evidence documenting that self-assessed health (SAH) is a leading health indicator, that is, a significant predictor of future changes in health conditions, in a large sample of Europeans aged above 50 and living in 13 different countries. We find that, after controlling for attrition bias, lagged SAH is significantly and negatively correlated with changes in the number of chronic diseases, net of the correlations with levels, and changes in sociodemographic factors and health styles, country and regional health system effects, and declared symptoms. Illness-specific estimates document that lagged SAH significantly correlates with arthritis, cholesterol, and lung diseases (and weakly so with ulcer, hypertension, and cataracts) and has a significant correlation with the probability of contracting cancer. Interpretations and policy implications of our findings are discussed in the paper.

10.1002/hec.3581.abstractZh: 我们提供了原始的国际证据，证明自我评估的健康状况是主要的健康指标，即它是未来健康状况变化的显著预测因素。这项研究针对的是13个不同国家中50岁以上的欧洲人，样本规模较大。我们发现，在控制流失偏差后，滞后自我评估的健康状况与慢性疾病的数量变化之间存在显著且负相关的关系，这一关系在排除与疾病水平的关联以及社会人口因素和健康习惯的影响后仍然成立。此外，该指标与关节炎、胆固醇和肺部疾病之间存在显著相关性（与溃疡、高血压和白内障的相关性则较弱），并且与患癌症的概率也存在显著相关性。本文还讨论了我们的研究结果的意义及政策启示。

abstract.text: Much of the debate surrounding reform of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) revolves around its insurance market regulation. This paper studies the impact on health insurance coverage of those provisions. Using data from the American Community Survey, years 2008-2015, I focus on individuals, ages 26 to 64, who are ineligible for the subsidies or Medicaid expansions included in the ACA to isolate the effect of its market regulation. To account for time trends, I utilize a differences-in-differences approach with a control group of residents of Massachusetts who were already subject to a similarly regulated health insurance market. I find that the ACA's regulations caused an increase of 0.95 percentage points in health insurance coverage for my sample in 2014. This increase was concentrated among younger individuals, suggesting that the law's regulations ameliorated adverse selection in the individual health insurance market.

10.1002/hec.3585.abstractZh: 关于《患者保护法案》和《平价医疗法案》改革的大部分讨论都围绕其保险市场监管展开。本文研究了这些条款对健康保险覆盖程度的影响。利用2008年至2015年的美国社区调查数据，我重点关注26至64岁的个体，这些个体不符合《平价医疗法案》中规定的补贴或医疗补助扩展条件，以分析其市场监管的影响。为了考虑时间趋势，我采用了差异-差异方法，并选取了已经处于类似监管下的马萨诸塞州居民作为对照组。研究发现，《平价医疗法案》的法规使得我样本中的健康保险覆盖程度在2014年增加了0.95个百分点。这一增长主要集中在较年轻的人群中，表明该法规有效缓解了个体健康保险市场中的逆向选择问题。

abstract.text: A core feature of the capability approach is that a person's capabilities (what they are able to do and be in their life) can differ from their functionings (what they actually do and are in their life). However, the degree to which capability and functioning differ in practice is unclear. This paper investigates this issue, focusing on capability and functioning differences (CFD) across different aspects of life and different individuals. In the study, the ICECAP-A capability questionnaire was modified to measure both functionings and capabilities and was completed by U.K.-based convenience sample of 943 people. Around one third of people reported CFD in at least one area of their life, most commonly in terms of their "achievement." People were more likely to report CFD when they had a degree-level education and when they had impaired health. An additional finding was that capability varied more with education whereas functioning varied more with health status. This finding needs further examination, but it suggests that the choice of evaluative space may influence how priorities are set for public spending.

10.1002/hec.3586.abstractZh: 能力主义的核心特征在于，一个人的能力（他们能够做什么以及在生活中扮演什么角色）可能与他们的实际表现（他们实际做什么以及在生活中处于什么状态）有所不同。然而，能力和实际表现在实践中存在差异的程度并不明确。本文探讨了这一问题，重点关注不同生活领域和不同个体在能力和实际表现方面的差异。研究中，对ICECAP-能力问卷进行了修改，以同时衡量实际表现和能力，共有943名来自英国的受访者参与了调查。大约三分之一的受访者表示，在他们的至少一个生活领域中存在能力与实际表现的差异，最常见的是在“成就”方面。受教育程度较高以及健康状况较差的人更有可能报告能力与实际表现的差异。此外，研究发现，能力与教育水平的关系更为密切，而实际表现则与健康状况更为相关。这一发现需要进一步研究，但它表明，评估空间的选择可能会影响公共支出的优先安排。

abstract.text: The subsidisation of mosquito nets has been widely used to increase ownership in countries where malaria represents a public health problem. However, an important question that has not been addressed empirically is how far net subsidy programmes increase ownership above the level that would have prevailed in the absence of the subsidy (i.e., incremental ownership). This study addresses that gap by investigating the impact of a large-scale mosquito net voucher subsidy--the Tanzania National Voucher Scheme (TNVS)--on short-term demand for unsubsidised commercial nets, estimating a household demand model with nationally representative household survey data. The results suggest that, despite the TNVS using a categorical targeting approach that did not discriminate by wealth, it still led to a large increase in incremental ownership of mosquito nets, with limited evidence of displacement of unsubsidised sales. Although no evidence is found of an additional TNVS voucher decreasing the number of unsubsidised sales in the same period, results indicate that an additional TNVS voucher reduced the probability of purchasing any unsubsidised net in the same period by 14%. The findings also highlight the critical role played by social learning or campaign messaging in increasing mosquito net ownership.

10.1002/hec.3587.abstractZh: 在疟疾成为公共卫生问题的国家，对蚊帐的补贴被广泛用于提高蚊帐的拥有率。然而，一个尚未通过实证研究解决的问题是，补贴计划在多大程度上增加了蚊帐的拥有率，超过了没有补贴情况下的拥有率水平（即增量拥有率）。本研究通过调查坦桑尼亚国家补贴计划对未补贴商业蚊帐短期需求的影响，来填补这一空白。研究使用了具有全国代表性家庭调查数据的家庭需求模型。结果表明，尽管坦桑尼亚国家补贴计划采用了不按财富进行区分的分类目标设定方法，但它仍然显著增加了蚊帐的增量拥有率，且几乎没有证据表明未补贴销售被取代。虽然没有证据表明在同一时期，额外的补贴计划券减少了未补贴销售的数量，但研究结果表明，额外的补贴计划券使在同一时期购买未补贴蚊帐的概率降低了14%。研究结果还强调了社会学习或宣传活动在增加蚊帐拥有率方面所起的关键作用。

abstract.text: Social scientists have increasingly invested in understanding how to improve data quality and measurement of sensitive topics in household surveys. We utilize the technique of list randomization to collect measures of physical intimate partner violence in an experimental impact evaluation of the Government of Zambia's Child Grant Program. The Child Grant Program is an unconditional cash transfer, which targeted female caregivers of children under the age of 5 in rural areas to receive the equivalent of US $24 as a bimonthly stipend. The implementation results show that the list randomization methodology functioned as planned, with approximately 15% of the sample identifying 12-month prevalence of physical intimate partner violence. According to this measure, after 4 years, the program had no measurable effect on partner violence. List randomization is a promising approach to incorporate sensitive measures into multitopic evaluations; however, more research is needed to improve upon methodology for application to measurement of violence.

10.1002/hec.3588.abstractZh: 社会科学家越来越致力于研究如何提高家庭调查中敏感话题的数据质量和测量方法。我们在对赞比亚政府儿童补助计划的实验性影响评估中，采用了列表随机化的技术来收集关于身体亲密伴侣暴力的数据。该儿童补助计划是一项无条件的现金转移项目，旨在为农村地区5岁以下儿童的女性看护人提供每月24美元的津贴。实施结果显示，列表随机化方法按预期有效，约15%的样本数据显示了12个月内的身体亲密伴侣暴力发生情况。根据这一数据，在4年后，该计划对伴侣暴力几乎没有产生明显影响。列表随机化是一种将敏感指标纳入多主题评估中的有前景的方法；然而，还需要更多的研究来改进该方法在暴力测量中的应用。

abstract.text: Despite its high political interest, the impact of removing user charges for health care in low-income settings remains a debatable issue. We try to clear up this contentious issue by estimating the short-term effects of a policy change that occurred in 2006 in Zambia, when 54 of 72 districts removed fees. We use a pooled synthetic control method in order to estimate the causal impact of the policy on health care use, the provider chosen, and out-of-pocket medical expenses. We find no evidence that user fee removal increased health care utilisation, even among the poorest group. However, we find that the policy is likely to have led to a substitution away from the private sector for those using care and that it virtually eliminated medical expenditures, thereby providing financial protection to service users. We estimate that the policy was equivalent to a transfer of US$3.2 per health visit for the 50% richest but of only US$1.1 for the 50% poorest.

10.1002/hec.3589.abstractZh: 尽管这一政策在政治上备受关注，但在低收入地区取消医疗服务收费的影响仍是一个有争议的问题。我们试图通过估算2006年赞比亚的一项政策变革的短期效应来澄清这一争议。当时，72个地区中有54个取消了费用。我们采用了合成控制法来估算该政策对医疗服务使用、选择的服务提供者以及自付医疗费用的影响。我们发现，即使是在最贫困的人群中，取消费用并没有增加医疗服务的利用。然而，我们发现该政策可能导致人们从私人部门转向公共部门寻求医疗服务，并且几乎消除了医疗费用，从而为服务使用者提供了经济保障。我们估计，该政策相当于为最富有的50%人群每次就诊提供3.2美元的补助，而为最贫困的50%人群提供的补助仅为1.1美元。

abstract.text: Although healthcare provider payments have been studied extensively in the literature, little is known about the optimal compensation rule when, in addition to unobservable provider effort (moral hazard), the provider's ability type is also private information (adverse selection). We find that when only provider effort is unobservable, to induce the first-best outcome the optimal compensation rule requires zero fee-for-service. When both provider moral hazard and adverse selection exist, the first-best outcome will be infeasible. The second-best compensation rule entails combined use of capitation, fee-for-service, and pay-for-performance.

10.1002/hec.3590.abstractZh: 尽管在文献中已经对医疗服务提供商的支付方式进行了广泛研究，但对于在不可观测的提供者努力（道德风险）以及提供者的能力类型属于私人信息（逆向选择）的情况下，最优补偿规则却知之甚少。我们发现，当只有提供者努力不可观测时，为了获得最优结果，最优补偿规则要求采用零收费模式。而当同时存在提供者道德风险和逆向选择问题时，最优结果将不可实现。第二最优的补偿规则则涉及混合使用计件收费、零收费模式以及绩效付费模式。

abstract.text: Medicaid and uninsured patients are disadvantaged in access to care and are disproportionately Black and Hispanic. Using a national audit of primary care physicians, we examine the relationship between state Medicaid fees for primary care services and access for Medicaid, Medicare, uninsured, and privately insured patients who differ by race/ethnicity and sex. We found that states with higher Medicaid fees had higher probabilities of appointment offers and shorter wait times for Medicaid patients, and lower probabilities of appointment offers and longer wait times for uninsured patients. Appointment offers and wait times for Medicare and privately insured patients were unaffected by Medicaid fees. At mean state Medicaid fees, our analysis predicts a 27-percentage-point disadvantage for Medicaid versus Medicare in appointment offers. This decreases to 6 percentage points when Medicaid and Medicare fees are equal, suggesting that permanent fee parity with Medicare could eliminate most of the disparity in appointment offers for Medicaid patients. The predicted decrease in the disparity is smaller for Black and Hispanic patients than for White patients. Our research highlights the importance of considering the effects of policy on nontarget patient groups, and the consequences of seemingly race-neutral policies on racial/ethnic and sex-based disparities.

10.1002/hec.3591.abstractZh: 医疗补助计划和无保险患者在获得医疗服务方面处于劣势，其中黑人和西班牙裔患者尤为突出。通过对全国初级保健医生的审计，我们研究了各州医疗补助服务费用与医疗补助、医疗保险、无保险以及私人保险患者获取医疗服务之间的关系，这些患者之间存在种族/民族和性别差异。研究发现，医疗补助费用较高的州，医疗补助患者的预约机会更多，等待时间更短；而无保险患者的预约机会较少，等待时间更长。医疗保险和私人保险患者的预约机会及等待时间不受医疗补助费用的影响。根据平均州医疗补助费用，我们的分析预测，医疗补助在预约机会方面比医疗保险少27个百分点。当医疗补助和医疗保险费用相等时，这一差距缩小到6个百分点，这表明与医疗保险实现永久性的费用平等，可以消除医疗补助患者在预约机会上的大部分差异。对于黑人和西班牙裔患者而言，这种差异的减少幅度小于白人患者。我们的研究强调了考虑政策对非目标患者群体影响的必要性，以及看似与种族无关的政策对种族/民族和性别差异的影响。

abstract.text: Due to its fast economic growth and lifestyle changes, China is experiencing a rapid epidemiological transition from communicable to noncommunicable diseases (NCDs). Mental disorder such as depression is an important yet often neglected NCD and is becoming a growing cause of disability, suicides, and disease burden. This paper provides the first nationally representative estimate of the medical cost attributable to depression and depressive symptoms among the adult population in China. On the basis of the 2012 China Family Panel Studies survey, our results indicate that these mental health conditions have significant impacts on the individual medical expenditure, and they jointly contribute to 14.7% of total personal expected medical spending in China, with depression and depressive symptoms accounting for 6.9% and 7.8%, respectively. Given that patients with mental illness face multiple psychological and institutional barriers in seeking appropriate treatment, the high depression-induced medical costs may be primarily driven by the cost-shifting effect from mental health care to general health care, as mental disorders often coexist with other NCDs such as diabetes and hypertension. As an implication, our study calls for an urgent reform of China's mental health and insurance systems to remove the policy-induced obstacles for the access to mental health care resources.

10.1002/hec.3604.abstractZh: 由于经济的快速增长和生活方式的变化，中国正经历着从传染病向非传染性疾病的快速流行病学转变。抑郁症等精神障碍是一种重要但常被忽视的非传染性疾病，正在成为导致残疾、自杀和疾病负担的重要因素。本文首次提供了中国成年人口因抑郁症及抑郁症状而产生的医疗成本的全国代表性估计。根据2012年中国家庭追踪调查的结果，这些心理健康问题对个人医疗支出有显著影响，它们共同占了中国个人预期医疗支出的14.7%，其中抑郁症及抑郁症状分别占6.9%和7.8%。由于精神疾病患者在寻求适当治疗时面临多种心理和制度障碍，高额的抑郁症相关医疗成本可能主要源于心理健康护理向一般健康护理的成本转移效应，因为精神障碍往往与其他非传染性疾病如糖尿病和高血压并存。因此，我们的研究呼吁中国尽快改革心理健康和保险体系，消除政策对获取心理健康资源方面的障碍。
