We use administrative data on hospitalizations for acute myocardial infarction, which allow to measure the short-run effects of the policy on an objective metric of health. We show that the incidence of acute myocardial infarction decreases by approximately 8% immediately after implementation of the law with large heterogeneity across regions. Our results indicate that the policy was effective in reducing the negative externality of smoking with potential spillovers on health inequality.

10.1002/hec.3778.abstractZh: 本文通过分析2007至2011年间瑞士实施公共场所禁烟政策的时间和地理差异，评估了环境烟草暴露对健康的影响。我们利用关于急性心肌梗死住院病例的行政数据，以此作为衡量政策对健康影响的客观指标。研究发现，该政策实施后立即使急性心肌梗死的发病率下降了约8%，且不同地区的差异较大。我们的结果表明，该政策在减少吸烟带来的负面外部性方面是有效的，并可能对健康不平等问题产生积极影响。

abstract.text: Australia is one of nine Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) countries that utilise deputising services to provide after-hours primary care. While the provision of this service is supposed to be on behalf of regular general practitioners, businesses have adapted to the financial incentives on offer and are directly advertising their services to consumers emphasising patient convenience and no copayments. The introduction of corporate entities has changed the way that deputising services operate. We use a difference-in-difference approach to estimate the amount of growth in urgent after-hours services that was not warranted by urgent medical need. These estimates are calculated by comparing the growth in urgent attendances that occurred during times of the day that are classified as "after-hours" (e.g., 6 pm-11 pm Monday to Friday) with those that are classified as "unsociable-hours" (e.g., 11 pm-7 am Monday to Friday). For the national level, we estimate that 593,141 unwarranted attendances were induced as urgent after-hours consultations in a single year. This corresponds to a national estimate of the total benefits paid for unwarranted demand of approximately $77 million. While deputising services have filled a short-fall in after-hours services, the overuse of urgent items has meant that that this has been achieved at a considerable cost to the Australian Government.

10.1002/hec.3779.abstractZh: 澳大利亚是九个使用代理服务提供晚间初级医疗服务的经济合作与发展组织成员国之一。虽然这项服务的提供本应代表普通全科医生，但各企业已经适应了所提供的经济激励措施，并直接向消费者宣传其服务，强调患者的便利性和无需支付额外费用。企业实体的引入改变了代理服务的运作方式。我们采用差异分解法来估算那些并非由紧急医疗需求引起的晚间紧急服务增长情况。通过对比被归类为“晚间时段”（例如周一至周五的下午6点至11点）和“非社交时段”（例如周一至周五的晚上11点至早上7点）的紧急就诊数量，计算出年度内因晚间紧急咨询而发生的不合理就诊次数。全国范围内，我们估计每年有593,141次不合理的就诊是由于晚间紧急咨询而产生的。这相当于全国因不合理需求而支付的总费用约为7700万美元。虽然代理服务弥补了晚间服务的不足，但紧急项目的过度使用意味着澳大利亚政府为此付出了相当大的成本。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effects of friends' smoking and drinking on own behavior while controlling for correlated unobservables between friends. The effect of friends' behaviors is identified by comparing similar individuals who have similar friendship opportunities and make similar friendship choices, exploiting the idea that friendship choice reveals information about unobservables. We combine this identification strategy with an across-cohort within school design so that identification arises in our reduced form estimates from across-grade differences in the clustering of health behaviors. Finally, we use estimated information on correlated unobservables to examine longitudinal data on the onset of health behaviors, where the likelihood of reverse causality should be minimal. We find evidence that this strategy produces somewhat smaller (no more than 16% smaller) friendship effect estimates than the more standard school fixed effect models consistent with at most modest bias from correlated unobservables.

10.1002/hec.3780.abstractZh: 本文在控制朋友之间相关不可观测变量的基础上，估计了朋友吸烟和饮酒行为对自身行为的影响。通过比较具有相似交友机会和相似交友选择的相似个体，利用交友选择能够揭示不可观测变量的信息这一原理，来识别朋友行为的影响。我们将这一识别策略与跨队列的校内设计相结合，使得在减少形式的估计中，能够从不同年级的健康行为聚类差异中得出结果。最后，我们利用关于相关不可观测变量的估计信息，来检验健康行为发生的时间序列数据，在这种情况下，反向因果关系的可能性应该很小。我们发现，这种策略得出的友谊效应估计值比更为标准的学校固定效应模型要小一些（不超过16%），且由于相关不可观测变量的影响，偏差也较为温和。

abstract.text: This paper utilizes the eradication campaign in Taiwan in the 1950s to estimate the long-term impacts of early-life (in utero and postnatal) exposure to malaria. Matching adults in the 1992-2012 Taiwan Social Change Survey to the malaria intensity in their individual place and year of birth, difference-in-difference estimation shows strong evidence that the eradication increased men's own educational attainment as well as their family income in adulthood. We also use the 1980 census data to show there was a sharp education increase after the eradication. Furthermore, the eradication increased the educational attainment of married men's spouses. Finally, quantile regressions show that the effect concentrated on the lower percentile of the income distribution. Overall, our results suggest negative effects of early-life exposure to malaria.

10.1002/hec.3781.abstractZh: 本文利用20世纪50年代台湾的疟疾根除运动，来估算早期生活（子宫内及产后）接触疟疾的长期影响。通过1992-2012年台湾社会变迁调查中的成年人数据与其出生地及年份的疟疾强度数据进行匹配，差异估计显示，疟疾根除政策显著提升了男性自身的教育水平以及成年后的家庭收入。此外，1980年的人口普查数据表明，疟疾根除后教育水平出现了显著增长。而且，疟疾根除政策还提升了已婚男性配偶的教育水平。最后，分位数回归分析表明，这种影响主要集中在收入分布的较低百分位数上。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，早期接触疟疾存在负面影响。

abstract.text: The decline in the working hours of general practitioners (GPs) is a key factor influencing access to health care in many countries. We investigate the effect of changes in hours worked by GPs on waiting times in primary care using the Medicine in Australia: Balancing Employment and Life longitudinal survey of Australian doctors. We estimate GP fixed effects models for waiting time and use family circumstances to instrument for GP's hours worked. We find that a 10% reduction in hours worked increases average patient waiting time by 12%. Our findings highlight the importance of GPs' labor supply at the intensive margin in determining the length of time patients must wait to see their doctor.

10.1002/hec.3782.abstractZh: 全科医生工作时间的减少是许多国家影响医疗保健获取的关键因素。我们利用澳大利亚医生纵向调查“Medicine in Australia: Balancing Employment and Life”的数据，研究了全科医生工作时间变化对初级医疗等待时间的影响。我们建立了全科医生工作时间固定效应模型，并使用家庭状况作为全科医生工作时间的工具变量。研究发现，工作时间减少10%会使平均患者等待时间增加12%。我们的研究结果强调了全科医生在决定患者等待时间方面的重要性。

abstract.text: Understanding how family physicians respond to incentives from remuneration schemes is a central theme in the literature. One understudied aspect is referrals to specialists. Although the theoretical literature has suggested that capitation increases referrals to specialists, the empirical evidence is mixed. We push forward the empirical research on this question by studying family physicians who switched from blended fee-for-service to blended capitation in Ontario, Canada. Using several health administrative databases from 2005 to 2013, we rely on inverse probability weighting with fixed-effects regression models to account for observed and unobserved differences between the switchers and nonswitchers. Switching from blended fee-for-service to blended capitation increases referrals to specialists by about 5% to 7% per annum. The cost of specialist referrals is about 7 to 9% higher in the blended capitation model relative to the blended fee-for-service. These results are generally robust to a variety of alternative model specifications and matching techniques, suggesting that they are driven partly by the incentive effect of remuneration. Policy makers need to consider the benefits of capitation payment scheme against the unintended consequences of higher referrals to specialists.

10.1002/hec.3783.abstractZh: 了解家庭医生对薪酬制度激励的反应是相关研究的中心主题之一。一个被忽视的方面是转诊到专科医生的情况。尽管理论文献表明按服务收费制度会增加转诊专科医生的频率，但实证研究结果并不一致。我们通过研究加拿大安大略省从混合服务收费制度转向混合按服务收费制度的家庭医生，来推进这一问题的实证研究。利用2005年至2013年的多个卫生行政数据库，我们采用逆概率加权法结合固定效应回归模型，以解释转换前后家庭医生的差异。从混合服务收费制度转向混合按服务收费制度后，每年转诊专科医生的频率增加了约5%至7%。在混合按服务收费模式下，专科医生转诊的成本比混合服务收费制度高出约7%至9%。这些结果在多种不同的模型设定和匹配技术下仍然保持稳定，表明这些差异部分是由薪酬制度的激励效应所驱动的。政策制定者需要在考虑按服务收费制度带来的好处与转诊专科医生所带来的意外后果之间做出权衡。

abstract.text: Evidence suggests that economic factors play an important role in commercial sex work, in particular that condomless sex commands a price premium relative to condom-protected sex. This paper explores whether the use of a new HIV prevention product, with 100% efficacy but modeled after pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), could change the price and quantity of condomless commercial sex supplied. We collected stated preference data from 122 HIV-negative female sex workers in urban South Africa, using a repeated choice experiment to simulate the impact of using PrEP on choices. Results suggest that the price premium for condomless sex would decrease by 73% with PrEP use and the quantity of condomless sex is predicted to increase by a factor of 2.27. Act price does not significantly affect choices without protection but strongly influences choices under full HIV protection. The utility offered by condoms reduces by around 15% under PrEP use. Because new HIV prevention products do not protect against other STIs or pregnancy, the unintended consequences of introducing HIV prevention products should be closely monitored, whereas users should not face stigma or blame for reacting rationally to exogenous changes to market conditions.

10.1002/hec.3784.abstractZh: 有证据表明，经济因素在商业性工作中起着重要作用，尤其是无套性行为相对于使用避孕套的性行为而言，其价格更高。本文探讨了一种新型HIV预防产品的使用是否会影响无套商业性行为的价格和数量。该产品具有100%的防护效果，其设计理念类似于暴露前预防（PrEP）。我们收集了122名南非城市地区的HIV阴性女性性工作者的偏好数据，通过重复选择实验来模拟使用PrEP对她们选择的影响。结果表明，使用PrEP后，无套性行为的价格将降低73%，而无套性行为的数量则预计会增加2.27倍。在没有防护措施的情况下，价格对选择的影响并不显著，但在完全HIV防护的情况下，价格对选择的影响却非常显著。使用PrEP后，避孕套提供的效用减少了约15%。由于新型HIV预防产品无法预防其他性传播感染或怀孕，因此应密切监控引入此类产品可能带来的意外后果，同时用户不应因理性应对市场变化而受到污名或指责。

abstract.text: Fee-for-service physicians are responsible for planning for their retirements, and there is no mandated retirement age. Changes in financial markets may influence how long they remain in practice and how much they choose to work. The 2008 crisis provides a natural experiment to analyze elasticity in physician service supply in response to dramatic financial market changes. We examined quarterly fee-for-service data for specialist physicians over the period from 1999/2000 to 2013/2014 in Canada. We used segmented regression to estimate changes in the number of physicians receiving payments, per-physician service counts, and per-physician payments following the 2008 financial crisis and explored whether patterns differed by physician age. The number of specialist physicians increased more rapidly in the period since 2008 than in earlier years, but increases were largest within the youngest age group, and we observed no evidence of delayed retirement among older physicians. Where changes in service volume and payments were observed, they occurred across all ages and not immediately following the 2008 financial crisis. We conclude that any response to the financial crisis was small compared with demographic shifts in the physician population and changes in payments per service over the same time period.

10.1002/hec.3786.abstractZh: 按服务收费的医生需要自行规划退休事宜，并没有强制性的退休年龄。金融市场的变动可能会影响他们继续执业的时间以及他们愿意工作的时长。2008年的危机为分析医生服务供应对剧烈金融市场变化的弹性提供了一个自然实验。我们研究了1999/2000年至2013/2014年期间加拿大专科医生的按服务收费数据。我们使用分段回归模型来估计2008年金融危机后每位医生获得的支付金额、每位医生的服务次数以及每位医生的支付金额的变化，并探讨了这些变化是否因医生年龄的不同而有所差异。自2008年以来，专科医生的数量增长速度比之前更快，但增长幅度最大的是最年轻的医生群体，我们没有观察到年长医生出现延迟退休的现象。在观察到服务量和支付金额的变化时，这些变化发生在所有年龄段的医生身上，而不是在2008年金融危机之后立即发生的。我们得出结论，与医生人口的人口统计变化以及同一时期每服务次数的支付金额变化相比，对金融危机的任何反应都是微不足道的。

abstract.text: Recent advances in social science surveys include collection of biological samples. Although biomarkers offer a large potential for social science and economic research, they impose a number of statistical challenges, often being distributed asymmetrically with heavy tails. Using data from the UK Household Panel Survey, we illustrate the comparative performance of a set of flexible parametric distributions, which allow for a wide range of skewness and kurtosis: the four-parameter generalized beta of the second kind (GB2), the three-parameter generalized gamma, and their three-, two-, or one-parameter nested and limiting cases. Commonly used blood-based biomarkers for inflammation, diabetes, cholesterol, and stress-related hormones are modelled. Although some of the three-parameter distributions nested within the GB2 outperform the latter for most of the biomarkers considered, the GB2 can be used as a guide for choosing among competing parametric distributions for biomarkers. Going "beyond the mean" to estimate tail probabilities, we find that GB2 performs fairly well with some disparities at the very high levels of glycated hemoglobin and fibrinogen. Commonly used linear models are shown to perform worse than almost all the flexible distributions.

10.1002/hec.3787.abstractZh: 近期在社会科学调查领域取得的进展包括生物样本的收集。尽管生物标志物在社会科学和经济研究中具有巨大的潜力，但它们带来了许多统计上的挑战，这些挑战往往表现为分布的不对称性以及重尾特性。通过英国家庭面板调查的数据，我们展示了几种灵活的参数分布在不同情况下的表现：包括四参数广义贝塔第二类（GB2）、三参数广义伽马，以及它们的三参数、二参数或单参数嵌套和极限情况。我们模拟了常用的基于血液的炎症、糖尿病、胆固醇和应激相关激素的生物标志物。虽然某些三参数分布在大多数被考虑的生物标志物上表现优于GB2，但GB2仍可以作为选择其他参数分布时的参考。在估计尾部概率时，我们发现GB2在某些极端情况下表现不佳，尤其是在糖化血红蛋白和纤维蛋白原水平非常高时。与几乎所有灵活的分布相比，常用的线性模型表现较差。

abstract.text: I estimate the impact of group purchasing on medicine prices in French hospitals, taking advantage of the entry of hospitals into regional purchasing groups between 2009 and 2014. Based on a new database providing the average annual prices paid for all innovative and high-priced medicines in public hospitals, I use a two-way fixed effects model that controls for hospitals' medicine-specific bargaining power and medicine-specific price trends. I find that group purchasing slightly reduces the overall prices of medicines but has no impact on the prices of medicines that have no alternative on the market. On the contrary, prices of medicines in oligopoly markets are extensively impacted.

10.1002/hec.3788.abstractZh: 我利用2009年至2014年间医院加入区域采购团体这一契机，评估了团购对法国医院药品价格的影响。基于一个新的数据库，该数据库提供了公立医院中所有创新药品和高价药品的平均年支付价格，我采用双向固定效应模型进行分析，该模型控制了医院在药品采购方面的议价能力和药品价格趋势。研究发现，团购略微降低了药品的整体价格，但对市场上没有替代品的药品价格没有影响。相反，在寡头市场中的药品价格受到了显著影响。

abstract.text: International students offer a unique window into the role environmental factors play in driving obesity. Naïve estimates of the relationship between environmental factors and obesity are often plagued by reverse causation, sample selection, and omitted variable bias. In this study, we survey international students at 40 public universities across the United States. We use this unique data to link the weight gain of international students to the prevalence of obesity where they live. We argue that our estimates are less likely to be biased as international students have limited control over the environment to which they are exposed upon arrival in the United States. We find that students living in areas with a higher prevalence of obesity show a biologically important and statistically significantly greater increase in weight as compared to those living in areas with a lower prevalence of obesity. Results provide cautious evidence that environmental characteristics of a region can affect the weight gain of individuals.

10.1002/hec.3789.abstractZh: 国际学生为我们提供了一个独特的视角，以了解环境因素在导致肥胖中的作用。对于环境因素与肥胖之间关系的初步估计往往受到反向因果关系、样本选择以及遗漏变量偏差的影响。在这项研究中，我们调查了美国40所公立大学的国际学生。我们利用这些独特的数据，将国际学生的体重增长与他们所在地区的肥胖患病率联系起来。我们认为，由于国际学生在抵达美国后对其所处环境的控制有限，我们的估计结果不太可能出现偏差。研究发现，居住在肥胖患病率较高的地区的学生，其体重增长幅度比居住在肥胖患病率较低地区的学生更大，且这种增长具有生物学上的重要性。研究结果谨慎地表明，一个地区的环境特征确实会影响个体的体重增长。

abstract.text: In this paper, we consider a switching regression model with count data outcomes, where the possible outcome differs across two alternate states and individuals endogenously select one of the states. We assume lognormal latent heterogeneity. Building on the switching regression model, we derive estimators of various treatment effects: the average treatment effect, the average treatment effect on the treated, the local average treatment effect, and the marginal treatment effect. We illustrate an application that examines the effects of public insurance on the number of doctor visits using the data employed by previous studies.

10.1002/hec.3790.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们考虑了一个具有计数数据结果的切换回归模型，其中可能的结果在两种不同状态之间有所不同，个体会内生地选择其中一种状态。我们假设存在对数正态的潜在异质性。基于切换回归模型，我们推导出了各种处理效应的估计量：平均处理效应、对受处理者的平均处理效应、局部平均处理效应以及边际处理效应。我们通过一个实例来说明该模型的应用，该实例利用先前研究使用的数据，探讨了公共保险对医生就诊次数影响的研究结果。

abstract.text: Senegal is the only African country where sex work is legal and regulated by a health policy. Senegalese female sex workers (FSWs) are required to register with a health facility and to attend monthly routine health checks aimed at testing and treating sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Compliance to those routine visits is recorded on a registration card that must be carried by FSWs in order to avoid sanctions in case of police arrests. Although this policy was first introduced in 1969 to limit the spread of STIs, there is no evidence so far of its impact on FSWs' health and well-being. The paper aims to fill this gap by exploiting a unique data set of registered and unregistered Senegalese FSWs. Using propensity score matching, we find that registration has a positive effect on FSWs' health. However, we find that registration reduces FSWs' subjective well-being. This finding is explained by the fact that registered FSWs are found to engage in more sex acts, in riskier sex acts, have less social support from their peers, and are more likely to experience violence from clients and police officers. We prove that those results are robust to the violation of the conditional independence assumption, to misspecification of the propensity score model, and that covariate balance is achieved. The results suggest that more efforts should be deployed to reduce the stigma associated with registration and to address the poor well-being of FSWs, which is counterproductive to HIV prevention efforts.

10.1002/hec.3791.abstractZh: 塞内加尔是非洲唯一一个性工作合法化且受到健康政策监管的国家。塞内加尔的性工作者必须向医疗机构登记，并每月接受常规健康检查，以检测和治疗性传播感染疾病。这些常规检查的记录会记录在登记卡上，性工作者必须随身携带该卡，以避免在被警方逮捕时受到处罚。尽管这一政策最初于1969年出台，目的是限制性传播感染的传播，但迄今为止没有证据表明它对性工作者的健康和福祉产生了影响。本文旨在利用一份关于登记和未登记性工作者的独特数据集来填补这一空白。通过倾向得分匹配分析，我们发现登记对性工作者的健康有积极影响。然而，我们发现登记反而降低了性工作者的主观幸福感。这一发现可以归因于：登记性工作者从事的性行为更加危险，来自同龄人的社会支持较少，且更容易遭受客户和警察的暴力行为。我们证明，即使违反条件独立性假设、倾向得分模型存在误设，以及协变量平衡得到维持的情况下，这些结果仍然成立。研究结果表明，应进一步努力减少与登记相关的污名化现象，并改善性工作者的福祉，因为这与艾滋病毒预防工作背道而驰。

abstract.text: The literature on provider ownership has primarily focused broadly on for-profits compared with nonprofits and chains versus nonchains. However, the understanding of more nuanced ownership arrangements within individual facilities is limited. Utilizing the principal-agent and managerial control frameworks, we study the role of managerial ownership and its relationship to quality among for-profit nursing homes (NHs). We identify NH administrators with more than 5% ownership (owner-manager) from Ohio Medicaid Cost Reports (2005-2010) and link these data to long-stay resident records in the Minimum Data Set. Using differential distance to the nearest NHs with a salaried manager relative to an owner-manager, we address the differential selection into these two types of NHs. After instrumenting for admissions to owner-managed NHs, quality among long-stay residents at owner-managed NHs is generally better than NHs with salaried managers. We find suggestive evidence that the magnitudes of quality difference are larger when the principal-agent problem is likely more pronounced, such as when NHs that are part of a multifacility chain and located in more concentrated markets.

10.1002/hec.3792.abstractZh: 关于提供者所有权的研究主要集中在营利性机构与非营利性机构之间，以及连锁企业与非连锁企业之间的对比上。然而，对于单个机构内部更为复杂的所有权安排的理解却较为有限。我们利用委托-代理框架和管理控制框架，研究了管理所有权在营利性养老院中的角色及其与服务质量之间的关系。我们从俄亥俄州医疗补助成本报告（2005-2010年）中筛选出拥有超过5%所有权的养老院管理者，并将这些数据与《最低数据集》中的长期居民记录进行关联。通过比较拥有固定薪酬管理者与拥有所有权的管理者所管理的养老院之间的距离，我们探讨了这两种类型养老院之间的选择差异。在控制了进入拥有管理权的养老院的因素后，我们发现，拥有管理权的养老院中的长期居民服务质量通常优于拥有固定薪酬管理者的养老院。我们的研究还发现，当委托-代理问题更为明显时，例如那些位于集中市场的多机构连锁中的养老院，服务质量差异更为显著。

abstract.text: Health economics studies with missing data are increasingly using approaches such as multiple imputation that assume that the data are "missing at random." This assumption is often questionable, as-even given the observed data-the probability that data are missing may reflect the true, unobserved outcomes, such as the patients' true health status. In these cases, methodological guidelines recommend sensitivity analyses to recognise data may be "missing not at random" (MNAR), and call for the development of practical, accessible approaches for exploring the robustness of conclusions to MNAR assumptions. Little attention has been paid to the problem that data may be MNAR in health economics in general and in cost-effectiveness analyses (CEA) in particular. In this paper, we propose a Bayesian framework for CEA where outcome or cost data are missing. Our framework includes a practical, accessible approach to sensitivity analysis that allows the analyst to draw on expert opinion. We illustrate the framework in a CEA comparing an endovascular strategy with open repair for patients with ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm, and provide software tools to implement this approach.

10.1002/hec.3793.abstractZh: 在健康经济学研究中，当数据缺失时，越来越多地采用多重插补等方法，这些方法假设数据“随机缺失”。然而，这一假设往往存在疑问，因为即使根据观察到的数据，数据缺失的概率也可能反映了真实但未观察到的结果，例如患者的真实健康状况。在这种情况下，方法论指南建议进行敏感性分析，以识别数据可能是“非随机缺失”的情况，并呼吁开发实用且易于理解的方法，以评估结论对“非随机缺失”假设的稳健性。在健康经济学以及成本效益分析领域，数据可能呈现非随机缺失的情况这一问题尚未得到足够的关注。在本文中，我们提出了一个贝叶斯框架，用于处理结果或成本数据缺失的情况。我们的框架包含一种实用且易于操作的敏感性分析方法，允许分析师参考专家意见。我们以一项成本效益分析为例，比较了腔内修复术与开放修复术在破裂性腹主动脉瘤患者中的治疗效果，并提供了实现该方法的软件工具。

abstract.text: In health economics, the use of patient recall of health care utilisation information is common, including in national health surveys. However, the types and magnitude of measurement error that relate to different recall periods are not well understood. This study assessed the accuracy of recalled doctor visits over 2-week, 3-month, and 12-month periods by comparing self-report with routine administrative Australian Medicare data. Approximately 5,000 patients enrolled in an Australian study were pseudo-randomised using birth dates to report visits to a doctor over three separate recall periods. When comparing patient recall with visits recorded in administrative information from Medicare Australia, both bias and variance were minimised for the 12-month recall period. This may reflect telescoping that occurs with shorter recall periods (participants pulling in important events that fall outside the period). Using shorter recall periods scaled to represent longer periods is likely to bias results. There were associations between recall error and patient characteristics. The impact of recall error is demonstrated with a cost-effectiveness analysis using costs of doctor visits and a regression example predicting number of doctor visits. The findings have important implications for surveying health service utilisation for use in economic evaluation, econometric analyses, and routine national health surveys.

10.1002/hec.3794.abstractZh: 在健康经济学领域，患者回忆医疗利用信息的做法很常见，甚至出现在国家健康调查中。然而，不同回忆期相关的测量误差类型和程度尚未得到充分理解。本研究通过比较自我报告数据与澳大利亚Medicare系统的常规行政数据，评估了2周、3个月和12个月期间医生就诊回忆的准确性。大约5000名参与澳大利亚研究的患者被随机分组，根据出生日期报告在三个不同回忆期间的医生就诊情况。当将患者回忆与Medicare Australia的行政记录进行比较时，12个月回忆期的偏差和变异都得到了最小化。这可能是由于较短回忆期导致的信息重叠现象（参与者会合并一些不在该期间发生的事件）。使用较短的回忆期来代表较长的时期可能会引入偏差。回忆误差与患者特征之间存在关联。通过成本效益分析，结合医生就诊的成本数据，以及利用回归模型预测医生就诊次数的例子，可以体现回忆误差的影响。这些发现对于调查医疗服务利用情况、进行经济评估、计量经济学分析以及常规国家健康调查具有重要意义。

abstract.text: In most medical decisions, probabilities are ambiguous and not objectively known. Empirical evidence suggests that people's preferences are affected by ambiguity. Health economic analyses generally ignore ambiguity preferences and assume that they are the same as preferences under risk. We show how health preferences can be measured under ambiguity, and we compare them with health preferences under risk. We assume a general ambiguity model that includes many of the ambiguity models that have been proposed in the literature. For health gains, ambiguity preferences and risk preferences were indeed the same. For health losses, they differed with subjects being more pessimistic in decision under ambiguity. Utility and loss aversion were the same for risk and ambiguity. Our results imply that reducing the clinical ambiguity of health losses has more impact than reducing the ambiguity of health gains, that utilities elicited with known probabilities may not carry over to an ambiguous setting, and that ambiguity aversion may impact value of information analyses if losses are involved. These findings are highly relevant for medical decision making, because most medical interventions involve losses.

10.1002/hec.3795.abstractZh: 在大多数医学决策中，概率往往是模糊的，无法客观确定。实证研究表明，人们的偏好会受到模糊性的影响。健康经济分析通常忽略模糊性偏好，并假设其等同于风险下的偏好。我们展示了如何在模糊性条件下测量健康偏好，并将其与风险下的健康偏好进行比较。我们假设一个包含许多文献中提出的模糊性模型的通用模糊性模型。对于健康收益而言，模糊性偏好和风险偏好确实是一致的。而对于健康损失，两者存在差异，因为受试者在模糊性决策下表现得更为悲观。对于风险和模糊性，效用和损失厌恶是相同的。我们的结果表明，减少健康损失的临床模糊性比减少健康收益的模糊性更有影响力；已知概率下获得的效用可能不会在模糊性环境中延续；如果涉及损失，模糊性厌恶可能会影响信息分析的价值。这些发现对于医学决策具有高度相关性，因为大多数医学干预措施都涉及损失。

abstract.text: Substituting generic for brand name drugs whenever possible has been proposed to control prescription drug expenditure growth in the United States. This work investigates two types of state laws that regulate the procedures under which pharmacists substitute bioequivalent generic versions of brand name drugs. Mandatory substitution laws require pharmacists to use the generic as a default, and presumed consent laws allow them to assume that the patient agrees to the substitution. Both situations can be overruled by the patient. Using plausibly exogenous changes in states' laws, we use difference-in-differences and a discrete choice model to show that although the mandatory switching laws have little effect, the presumed consent laws reduce consumers' probability of purchasing brand name drugs by 3.2% points. The differential effectiveness of the laws is likely caused by pharmacists' profit motives. These results offer important implications for policies that seek to reduce drug expenditures by incentivizing the use of generic drugs.

10.1002/hec.3796.abstractZh: 在可能的情况下，使用通用品牌药物替代品牌药物已被提出作为控制美国处方药支出增长的方法。本研究调查了两类州法律，这些法律规定了药剂师使用生物等效的通用品牌药物版本进行替代的程序。强制性替代法律要求药剂师默认使用通用药物，而假定同意法律则允许药剂师假设患者同意进行替代。这两种情况都可以被患者推翻。通过模拟州法律的合理外生变化，我们使用差异-差异模型和离散选择模型表明，尽管强制性替代法律效果有限，但假定同意法律使消费者购买品牌药物的概率降低了3.2个百分点。这些法律的不同效果可能是由于药剂师的盈利动机所致。这些结果对于旨在通过激励使用通用药物来减少药物支出的政策具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper studies the short-term impact of public smoking bans on hospitalizations in Germany. It exploits the staggered implementation of smoking bans over time and across the 16 federal states along with the universe of hospitalizations from 2000 to 2008 and daily county-level weather and pollution data. Smoking bans in bars and restaurants have been effective in preventing 1.9 hospital admissions (-2.1%) due to cardiovascular diseases per day, per 1 million population. We also find a decrease by 0.5 admissions (-6.5%) due to asthma per day, per 1 million population. The health prevention effects are more pronounced on sunny days and days with higher ambient pollution levels.

10.1002/hec.3798.abstractZh: 本文研究了公共禁烟令对德国住院率的短期影响。通过分析2000至2008年间各联邦州禁烟令的实施时间差异，并结合住院数据、每日县级天气和污染数据，研究发现：酒吧和餐馆禁烟令每天可防止每百万人因心血管疾病导致的1.9次住院；同时，每百万人因哮喘导致的住院次数也减少了0.5次。这些健康预防效果在晴天和污染程度较高的日子里更为显著。

abstract.text: In principle, questionnaire data on public views about hypothetical trade-offs between improving total health and reducing health inequality can provide useful normative health inequality aversion parameter benchmarks for policymakers faced with real trade-offs of this kind. However, trade-off questions can be hard to understand, and one standard type of question finds that a high proportion of respondents-sometimes a majority-appear to give exclusive priority to reducing health inequality. We developed and tested two e-learning interventions designed to help respondents understand this question more completely. The interventions were a video animation, exposing respondents to rival points of view, and a spreadsheet-based questionnaire that provided feedback on implied trade-offs. We found large effects of both interventions in reducing the proportion of respondents giving exclusive priority to reducing health inequality, though the median responses still implied a high degree of health inequality aversion and-unlike the video-the spreadsheet-based intervention introduced a substantial new minority of non-egalitarian responses. E-learning may introduce as well as avoid biases but merits further research and may be useful in other questionnaire studies involving trade-offs between conflicting values.

10.1002/hec.3799.abstractZh: 原则上，关于公众对改善整体健康与减少健康不平等之间假设性权衡的看法问卷数据可以为面临此类实际权衡的政策制定者提供有用的规范性的健康不平等厌恶参数基准。然而，权衡问题可能难以理解，有一种标准类型的问题发现，有很高比例的受访者——有时甚至是大多数受访者——似乎将减少健康不平等视为唯一优先事项。我们开发并测试了两种电子学习干预措施，旨在帮助受访者更全面地理解这个问题。这两种干预措施包括一个视频动画，让受访者了解不同的观点，以及一种基于电子表格的问卷，该问卷提供了关于隐含权衡的反馈。我们发现，这两种干预措施都在减少将减少健康不平等视为唯一优先事项的受访者比例方面取得了显著效果，尽管中位回应仍然表明存在高度的健康不平等厌恶——与视频不同，基于电子表格的干预措施引入了一个新的非平等主义回应群体。电子学习可能既会引入偏见，也会避免偏见，但值得进一步研究，并且可能在涉及冲突价值之间权衡的其他问卷研究中发挥作用。

abstract.text: Recently, new emphasis was put on reducing waiting times in mental health services as there is an ongoing concern that longer waiting time for treatment leads to poorer health outcomes. However, little is known about delays within the mental health service system and its impact on patients. We explore the impact of waiting times on patient outcomes in the context of early intervention in psychosis (EIP) services in England from April 2012 to March 2015. We use the Mental Health Services Data Set and the routine outcome measure the Health of the Nation Outcome Scale. In a generalised linear regression model, we control for baseline outcomes, previous service use, and treatment intensity to account for possible endogeneity in waiting time. We find that longer waiting time is significantly associated with a deterioration in patient outcomes 12 months after acceptance for treatment for patients that are still in EIP care. Effects are strongest for waiting times longer than 3 months, and effect sizes are small to moderate. Patients with shorter treatment periods are not affected. The results suggest that policies should aim to reduce excessively long waits in order to improve outcomes for patients waiting for treatment for psychosis.

10.1002/hec.3800.abstractZh: 近年来，人们越来越重视减少心理健康服务中的等待时间，因为人们普遍担心治疗等待时间的延长会导致健康状况恶化。然而，关于心理健康服务系统内的延误及其对患者的影响，目前了解甚少。本研究探讨了2012年4月至2015年3月期间英格兰在精神病早期干预服务中，等待时间对患者结果的影响。我们使用了心理健康服务数据集以及常规的结果衡量指标“国家健康结果量表”。在广义线性回归模型中，我们控制了基线结果、之前的服务使用情况以及治疗强度，以排除等待时间内生性的影响。研究发现，对于仍处于早期干预护理中的患者而言，等待时间延长与12个月后的患者结果恶化之间存在显著关联。这种影响在等待时间超过3个月时最为明显，效应大小介于小到中等之间。而治疗时间较短的患者则未受到显著影响。研究结果表明，政策应致力于减少过长的等待时间，以改善等待治疗的精神病患者的状况。

abstract.text: Empirical estimates of price elasticities of demand (PED) for pharmaceuticals suggest that they are relatively price inelastic. However, in many settings, a medication and its substitutes and complements face simultaneous differential changes in prices that affect the observed "composite" PED. We exploit an implementation of a value-based formulary (VBF) that utilized drug-specific incremental cost-effectiveness ratios (ICERs) to inform drug copayments, resulting in increases in copayments for some medications and decreases in copayments for others. We first show theoretically that by changing the price of a medication and its substitute in opposite directions, VBF designs can leverage cross-price effects to increase the range of composite PEDs. We then empirically estimate PED and welfare effects using a consumer surplus approach. Overall PED was -0.16, similar to the RAND Health Insurance Experiment estimate. However, there was substantial dispersion of PED across the VBF copayment tiers ranging from -0.09 to -0.87 with a statistically significant trend aligned with the levels of value as reflected by the ICER estimates (p < 0.001). The net welfare increase was $147,000 for the cohort or $28 per member over the postpolicy year. Further experimentations of VBF designs with alternative cost-effectiveness thresholds, copayment levels and value definitions could be quite promising for improving welfare.

10.1002/hec.3801.abstractZh: 对药品需求价格弹性（PED）的实证估计表明，药品相对价格缺乏弹性。然而，在许多情况下，一种药物及其替代品和互补品的价格同时发生差异变化，这会影响所观察到的“综合”PED。我们采用了一种基于价值的处方格式（VBF），该格式利用特定药物的增量成本效益比（ICER）来指导药物共付额，导致某些药物的共付额增加，而其他药物的共付额减少。我们首先从理论上证明，通过改变一种药物及其替代品的定价方向，VBF设计可以利用交叉价格效应来增加综合PED的范围。然后，我们使用消费者剩余方法对PED和福利效应进行了实证估计。总体PED为-0.16，与RAND健康保险实验的估计结果相似。然而，VBF共付额等级之间的PED存在显著差异，范围从-0.09到-0.87，且随着ICER估计所反映的价值水平的变化，这种差异呈现出统计学上的显著趋势（p < 0.001）。政策实施后的净福利增加为147,000美元，即每位成员在政策实施后的年度内增加28美元。进一步对VBF设计进行实验，采用不同的成本效益阈值、共付额水平和价值定义，可能会有助于改善福利状况。

abstract.text: This paper discusses how limited ability to predict illness and treatment response may affect the welfare achieved in patient care. The discussion covers both decentralized clinical decision making and care that adheres to clinical practice guidelines. I explain why predictive ability has been limited, calling attention to questionable methodological practices in the research that supports evidence-based medicine. I summarize research on identification whose objective is to yield credible prediction of patient outcomes. Recognizing that uncertainty will continue to afflict medical decision making, I apply basic decision theory to suggest reasonable decision criteria with well-understood welfare properties. Previous research on medical decision making has largely embraced Bayesian decision theory. I summarize research studying the minimax-regret criterion, which seeks uniformly near-optimal decisions.

10.1002/hec.3803.abstractZh: 本文探讨了预测疾病和治疗反应的能力有限可能如何影响患者护理的福利。讨论涵盖了分散式的临床决策制定以及遵循临床实践指南的护理。我解释了预测能力为何受到限制，并指出了支持循证医学的研究中一些存在争议的方法论实践。我总结了旨在提供可靠患者结果预测的研究。鉴于不确定性将继续困扰医疗决策，我运用基本决策理论提出了具有明确福利属性的合理决策标准。以往关于医疗决策的研究大多采用了贝叶斯决策理论。我总结了研究最小最大遗憾准则的研究，该准则旨在寻求近乎最优的决策方案。

abstract.text: Accreditation of providers helps resolve the pervasive information asymmetries in health care markets. However, meeting accreditation standards typically involves flexibility in implementation, leading to heterogeneity in performance. For example, the patient-centered medical home (PCMH) is a leading model for recognizing high-performing primary care practices. Flexibility in PCMH implementation allows for varying degrees of emphasis on processes designed to enhance medication adherence. To assess the impact of the PCMH on adherence, we combine 6 years of detailed patient claims data with a novel dataset containing detailed practice-level PCMH attributes. We study the effects of the number and configuration of adherence-relevant capabilities, using variation in the timing of PCMH adoption to estimate its impact. While PCMH adoption improved overall medication adherence, when combining claims data with the unique recognition data detailing what PCMH capabilities were adopted, we find that these gains are concentrated among patients in practices that adopted more adherence-relevant capabilities. Despite mixed evidence in the literature concerning costs and utilization, our results indicate that PCMH recognition improves medication adherence.

10.1002/hec.3804.abstractZh: 提供商的认证有助于解决医疗保健市场中普遍存在的信息不对称问题。然而，达到认证标准通常需要在实施过程中保持灵活性，从而导致绩效的多样性。例如，以患者为中心的医疗之家是一种用于表彰表现优异的初级保健实践的模式。在PCMH实施过程中，对旨在提高药物依从性的流程的重视程度可以有所不同。为了评估PCMH对药物依从性的影响，我们将6年的详细患者索赔数据与包含PCMH相关属性信息的新型数据集相结合。我们研究了与药物依从性相关的功能的数量和配置，并通过PCMH采用时间的差异来估计其影响。虽然PCMH的采用总体上提高了药物依从性，但当将索赔数据与详细记录哪些PCMH功能被采用的独特识别数据相结合时，我们发现这些收益主要集中在那些采用了更多与药物依从性相关的功能的实践中。尽管文献中关于成本和利用率的证据并不一致，但我们的结果表明，PCMH的认证确实提高了药物依从性。

abstract.text: In several countries, health care services are provided by public and/or private subjects, and they are reimbursed by the government, on the basis of regulated prices (in most countries, diagnosis-related group). Providers take prices as given and compete on quality to attract patients. In some countries, regulated prices differ across regions. This paper focuses on the interdependence between regional regulators within a country: It studies how price setters of different regions interact, in a simple but realistic framework. Specifically, we model a circular city as divided in two administrative regions. Each region has two providers and one regulator, who sets the local price. Patients are mobile and make their choice on the basis of provider location and service quality. Interregional mobility occurs in the presence of asymmetries in providers' cost efficiency, regulated prices, and service quality. We show that the optimal regulated price is higher in the region with the more efficient providers; we also show that decentralisation of price regulation implies higher expenditure but higher patients' welfare.

10.1002/hec.3805.abstractZh: 在多个国家，医疗服务由公共和/或私人机构提供，并且这些服务由政府根据规定的价格进行报销（在大多数国家，这一价格基于诊断相关组）。医疗服务提供者接受既定价格，并通过质量竞争来吸引患者。在一些国家，不同地区的价格规定有所不同。本文重点关注一个国家内不同地区监管机构之间的相互依赖关系：研究不同地区的价格制定者如何互动，采用了一个简单但现实的框架。具体来说，我们将一个环形城市模型划分为两个行政区域。每个地区有两名医疗服务提供者和一名监管机构，后者负责制定当地价格。患者具有流动性，他们的选择基于医疗服务提供者的位置和服务质量。在提供者成本效率、价格规定和服务质量存在不对称的情况下，会出现跨地区流动。我们表明，在提供效率更高的地区，最优价格会更高；同时，价格监管的权力下放意味着更高的支出，但也能提升患者的福利。

abstract.text: Wellness programs constitute central components of disease prevention efforts under the Affordable Care Act and are likely to remain a component of employer provided health insurance. This paper evaluates the impact of such programs on medical utilization 4 to 7 years after enrollment in the plan. Using a unique suited data provided by a large private employer, I analyze medical expenditure and utilization for individuals enrolled in a wellness plan. The analysis compares expenditures and visits between wellness members and nonmembers who are matched through propensity score methods. The results show that although the wellness program increases utilization of preventive and outpatient care, by as much as 1.57 visits per year, there is no comparable decline in emergency or inpatient care, resulting in an overall increase in medical expenditure of around $507 per person per year. The increase in medical expenditure persists even 6 to 7 years of continued enrollment in wellness. I find some evidence of improved health, as diagnoses of diabetes decline 0.8 percentage points among wellness members. The results suggest that employer savings stemming from improved health and more judicious use of medical services are not likely to materialize in this wellness program.

10.1002/hec.3806.abstractZh: 根据《平价医疗法案》的规定，健康计划是疾病预防工作的核心组成部分，并且很可能会继续作为雇主提供的健康保险的一部分。本文评估了这些计划在计划注册后4到7年内对医疗使用的影响。利用一家大型私人雇主提供的独特数据，我分析了参加健康计划的个人的医疗支出和医疗使用情况。分析通过倾向评分方法将健康计划成员与非成员之间的支出和就诊情况进行了比较。结果显示，尽管健康计划增加了预防性和门诊护理的使用，每年最多增加了1.57次就诊，但急诊或住院护理的使用并没有相应减少，导致人均医疗支出每年增加约507美元。即使持续参加健康计划6到7年，医疗支出的增加仍然持续。我发现一些健康改善的迹象，例如健康计划成员中糖尿病的诊断率下降了0.8个百分点。结果表明，由于健康状况的改善以及医疗服务使用的更加合理，雇主在健康计划中的节省效果并不明显。

abstract.text: Private insurance market risk pools are likely to be directly affected by expansions of public insurance, in turn affecting premiums. We investigate the effects of Medicaid expansion on private health insurance markets using data on the plans offered through the health insurance "Marketplaces" (also known as Exchanges) established by the Affordable Care Act. We employ geographic matching to compare premiums for private plans in neighboring counties that straddle expansion and nonexpansion states and find that premiums of Marketplace plans are 11% lower in Medicaid expansion states, controlling for demographic and health characteristics as well as measures of health care access. These results are consistent with evidence on the composition of the private insurance risk pool in expansion versus nonexpansion states and associated differences in expected health spending.

10.1002/hec.3809.abstractZh: 私人保险市场的风险池可能会受到公共保险扩展的直接影响，进而影响到保费。我们利用《平价医疗法案》所建立的健康保险“市场”平台提供的计划数据，研究医疗补助扩展对私人健康保险市场的影响。通过地理匹配，我们比较了扩展州与未扩展州相邻县中私人计划的保费，发现控制人口统计和健康特征以及医疗保健获取情况后，医疗补助扩展州的平台计划保费比未扩展州低11%。这些结果与关于扩展州与未扩展州私人保险风险池构成以及预期健康支出差异的研究结果一致。

abstract.text: School starting age has been shown to have long-run effects that persist throughout adolescence and into adulthood. Using variation from state-level school starting age laws in the United States, we find that males who are older when they enter school are more likely to have higher levels of self-reported health later in life. We are largely able to rule out education and labor market outcomes as significant channels for this finding. Building from the previous studies that have found conflicting evidence on the effect of school starting age on educational attainment and labor market outcomes in the United States, we find that school starting age decreases the likelihood of high school completion among males but has no significant effect for females. We do not find that labor market outcomes are affected by school starting age.

10.1002/hec.3810.abstractZh: 研究表明，入学年龄具有长期影响，这种影响会持续整个青春期直至成年期。通过对比美国各州关于入学年龄的法律差异，我们发现，入学年龄较大的男性在日后生活中更有可能拥有较高的自我健康水平。我们基本上可以排除教育和劳动力市场结果作为这一发现的显著影响因素。基于之前的研究结果，这些研究对于入学年龄对教育成就和劳动力市场结果的影响存在不同的结论，我们发现入学年龄会降低男性完成高中学业的可能性，但对女性则没有显著影响。我们并未发现劳动力市场结果会受到入学年龄的影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the variation in the effects of various determinants on the per capita health-care expenditure. A total of 28 Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development countries are studied over the period 1990-2012, employing an instrumental variable quantile regression method for a dynamic panel model with fixed effects. The results show that the determinants of per capita health-care expenditure growth, involving the growth of lagged health spending, of per capita gross domestic product (GDP), of physician density, of elderly population, of life expectancy, of urbanization, and of female labor force participation, do vary with the conditional distribution of the health-care expenditure growth, while the changing patterns are dissimilar. Moreover, we show that Baumol's model of "unbalanced growth" has a significantly positive effect on per capita health spending growth, and its effect is quite stable over the entire distribution. However, the correlation between the components (wage growth and labor productivity growth) of the "Baumol variable" and health expenditure growth is more varied. As a comparison, only the growth of lagged health spending, per capita GDP, and the Baumol variable (or its components) are found related to health spending growth in conditional mean regressions. The prediction results were also quite different between the quantile regression dynamic panel instrumental variable models and linear panel data models. More attention needs to be paid to the varying influence of determinants in health expenditure study.

10.1002/hec.3811.abstractZh: 本文研究了各种决定因素对人均医疗保健支出影响的变化情况。研究范围涵盖了1990至2012年间28个经济合作与发展组织国家的数据，采用工具变量分位数回归方法，构建了一个具有固定效应的动态面板模型。研究结果表明，人均医疗保健支出增长的决定因素，如滞后期的医疗保健支出增长、人均国内生产总值、医生密度、老年人口比例、预期寿命、城市化程度以及女性劳动力参与率等，会随着医疗保健支出增长的条件分布而变化，且这些变化的模式各不相同。此外，我们发现Baumol的“不平衡增长”模型对人均医疗保健支出增长有显著的正面影响，且这种影响在整个分布范围内都相当稳定。然而，“Baumol变量”中的工资增长和劳动生产率增长与医疗保健支出增长之间的相关性则更为复杂。相比之下，在条件均值回归分析中，只有滞后期的医疗保健支出增长、人均国内生产总值以及Baumol变量（或其组成部分）被发现与医疗保健支出增长相关。分位数回归动态面板工具变量模型与线性面板数据模型在预测结果上也存在显著差异。在研究医疗保健支出的决定因素影响时，需要更加关注这些决定因素的不同作用。

abstract.text: Reforming the payment system of public health insurance from fee-for-service to more efficient alternative schemes has become an urgent policy issue in developing countries. Using a large sample of administrative data drawn from China, we examine a variety of econometric models for predicting the medical expenditures of individuals. We show that the standard ordinary least squares model performs relatively well compared with other models. We then propose two alternative payment schemes on risk-adjusted capitation. The first is a prospective capitation model and the second incorporates both prospective and retrospective features. We simulate the corresponding payments based on model predictions and evaluate the payment/cost ratios for health care providers. The results show that the prospective capitation method generates smaller financial fluctuation, suggesting that policymakers may prefer this method to achieve a smooth transition.

10.1002/hec.3812.abstractZh: 将公共健康保险的支付制度从按服务收费模式改革为更高效的替代方案，已成为发展中国家的紧迫政策问题。我们基于中国的大量行政数据，检验了多种计量经济模型来预测个人医疗支出。结果表明，标准普通最小二乘法模型与其他模型相比表现相对较好。随后，我们提出了两种基于风险调整制费的替代支付方案。第一种是前瞻性制费模型，第二种则结合了前瞻性和回顾性特征。我们根据模型预测模拟了相应的支付情况，并评估了医疗服务提供者的支付成本比率。结果显示，前瞻性制费方法产生的财务波动较小，这表明政策制定者可能更倾向于采用这种方法以实现平稳过渡。

abstract.text: In 2004, France introduced a national program of organized breast cancer screening. The national program built on preexisting local programs in some, but not all, départements. Using data from multiple waves of a nationally representative biennial survey of the French population, we estimate the effect of organized screening on the percentage of women obtaining a mammogram. The analysis uses difference-in-differences methods to exploit the fact that the program was targeted at women in a specific age group: 50 to 74 years old. We find that organized screening significantly raised mammography rates among women in the target age range. Just above the lower age threshold, the percentage of women reporting that they had a mammogram in the past 2 years increased by over 10 percentage points after the national program went into effect. Mammography rates increased even more among women in their 60s. Estimated effects are particularly large for women with less education and lower incomes, suggesting that France's organized screening program has reduced socioeconomic disparities in access to mammography.

10.1002/hec.3813.abstractZh: 2004年，法国实施了一项全国性的乳腺癌筛查计划。该计划在一些省份而非所有省份都基于已有的地方筛查计划进行实施。我们利用一项具有全国代表性的双年度调查的多轮数据，估算了有组织筛查对女性接受乳腺X光检查比例的影响。分析采用差异-差异方法，利用该计划针对特定年龄组——50至74岁女性这一事实进行分析。研究发现，有组织筛查显著提高了目标年龄组女性的乳腺X光检查率。在年龄门槛略高于50岁这一范围内，实施全国筛查计划后，过去两年内有乳腺X光检查的女性比例增加了10个百分点以上。对于60岁以上的女性来说，乳腺X光检查率的增长更为显著。对于教育程度较低和收入较低的女性来说，这种影响尤为明显，这表明法国的有组织筛查计划有效减少了女性在乳腺X光检查方面的社会经济差异。

abstract.text: This paper presents new decomposition-based approaches to measure inequality of opportunity in health that capture Roemer's distinction between circumstances and effort and are consistent with both compensation and reward principles. Our approach is fully nonparametric in the way that it handles differences in circumstances and provides decompositions of both a rank-dependent relative (the Gini coefficient) and a rank-independent absolute inequality index (the variance). The decompositions distinguish the contribution of effort from the direct and indirect (through effort) contribution of circumstances to the total inequality. Our approach is illustrated by an empirical application that uses objectively measured biomarkers as health outcomes and as proxies for relevant effort variables. Using data from the Health Survey for England from 2003 to 2012, we find that circumstances are the leading determinant of inequality in cholesterol, glycated haemoglobin, and in a combined ill-health index whereas effort plays a substantial role in explaining inequality in fibrinogen only.

10.1002/hec.3814.abstractZh: 本文提出了新的基于分解的方法，用于衡量健康领域机会不平等，这些方法能够捕捉Roemer关于环境和努力差异的区分，并且与补偿和奖励原则相一致。我们的方法完全是非参数化的，能够处理环境差异，并提供了依赖等级的相对不平等指数（基尼系数）和独立等级的绝对不平等指数（方差）的分解。这些分解区分了努力对总不平等的直接和间接贡献。我们通过一个实证应用来说明这种方法，该应用使用客观测量的生物标志物作为健康结果，并作为相关努力变量的代理。利用2003至2012年英格兰健康调查的数据，我们发现环境是胆固醇、糖化血红蛋白以及综合健康指数不平等的主要决定因素，而努力仅在解释纤维蛋白原不平等方面发挥重要作用。

abstract.text: We study the differential impacts of public and private sources of health spending on health outcomes using a triple difference approach. We find that private health spending has on average a higher health-promoting effect than public health spending. This result is robust with respect to the choice of outcome measure and covariates in the regression and driven primarily by the countries with ineffective governments. Once we restrict our sample to countries with effective governments, private health spending is found to be no better than public health spending in improving the health outcome.

10.1002/hec.3817.abstractZh: 我们通过三重差分法研究了公共和私人健康支出对健康结果的差异影响。研究发现，私人健康支出的健康促进效果平均而言优于公共健康支出。这一结果在回归分析中不受结果衡量方式和协变量的选择影响，并且主要源于那些政府效率不高的国家。当我们将样本范围限制在政府效率较高的国家时，发现私人健康支出在改善健康结果方面并不比公共健康支出更优。

abstract.text: Theory suggests that the medical costs of obesity should be passed on to obese workers, in the form of lower wages, whenever health coverage is a part of employee compensation. In contrast to existing work on this topic, this paper illustrates that the medical expenditures caused by obesity among working adults are relatively small and that wage offsets should therefore be difficult to detect. The paper supports this claim by exploiting the variation provided by the Affordable Care Act's employer mandate. Findings suggest that obese workers tend to bear the approximate cost of their medical expenditures via lower wages. However, the observed effects are often insignificantly different from zero.

10.1002/hec.3818.abstractZh: 理论表明，当健康保险成为员工薪酬的一部分时，肥胖带来的医疗费用应该由肥胖工人承担，表现为较低的工资。与现有研究不同，本文指出，工作成年人因肥胖而产生的医疗费用相对较小，因此工资补偿的效果往往难以被察觉。本文通过利用《平价医疗法案》对雇主的强制要求所提供的差异来支持这一观点。研究结果表明，肥胖工人往往通过较低的工资来承担其医疗费用。然而，观察到的效果通常与零相差无几，并不显著。

abstract.text: We investigate the causal impact of retirement on health care utilization using SHARE data for 10 European countries. We show that the number of doctor's visits and the probability of visiting a doctor more than four times a year (our measures of health care utilization) increase after retirement. The increase in health care utilization is found to depend mainly on the years spent in retirement, suggesting that adjustment may take time. We find evidence of heterogeneous effects by gender and across different patterns of time use prior to retirement (i.e., working long hours and combined work and out-of-work activities). Overall, the empirical findings suggest that the increase in health care utilization is consistent with the decrease in the opportunity cost of time faced by individuals when they retire.

10.1002/hec.3819.abstractZh: 我们利用SHARE数据对10个欧洲国家的退休对医疗保健利用的因果影响进行了研究。研究发现，退休后，医生就诊的次数以及每年就诊超过四次的概率（我们用来衡量医疗保健利用的指标）都会增加。医疗保健利用的增加主要取决于退休后的年数，这表明适应这一过程可能需要时间。我们还发现，不同性别以及退休前不同的时间使用模式（如长时间工作以及工作与休闲活动的结合）会导致不同的效果。总体而言，这些实证结果表明，医疗保健利用的增加与个体退休后面临的时间机会成本的减少是一致的。

abstract.text: In developing a theory of medical insurance and health behavior with bequest motive, we discover that whether ex ante moral hazard or the opposite occurs hinges upon the differential effects of health behavior on morbidity and mortality. Providing insurance can encourage healthy living by making longevity more affordable. We test the theory utilizing a unique experiment of China introducing the new cooperative medical scheme, unique in its long-term credibility necessary for our proposed channel. This scheme reduced cigarette use by around 9%. Further empirical analysis failed to falsify our theory or the alternative mechanism of health insurance reducing stress and thus the demand for cigarettes and hard liquor. Both newly proposed mechanisms alleviate concerns over ex ante moral hazard caused by providing affordable care for the poor.

10.1002/hec.3820.abstractZh: 在开发一种以遗产动机为目标的医疗保险和健康行为理论时，我们发现，究竟是发生事前道德风险还是相反的情况，取决于健康行为对发病率和死亡率的不同影响。提供保险可以通过使长寿变得更加可负担来鼓励健康生活。我们通过中国引入新的合作医疗计划这一独特实验来验证这一理论，该计划具有长期可信度，这是我们提出的机制所必需的。该计划使香烟使用量减少了约9%。进一步的实证分析未能证明我们的理论或替代机制——即医疗保险通过减轻压力从而减少了对香烟和烈酒的需求——是错误的。这两种新提出的机制都缓解了为穷人提供可负担医疗护理所带来的事前道德风险问题。

abstract.text: We utilize panel data from the Health and Retirement Study to investigate the impact of retirement on physical and mental health, life satisfaction, and health care utilization. Because poor health can induce retirement, we instrument for retirement using eligibility for Social Security and employer-sponsored pensions and coverage by the Social Security earnings test. We find strong evidence that retirement improves reported health, mental health, and life satisfaction. In addition, we find evidence of improvements in functional limitations in the long run. Although the impact on life satisfaction occurs within the first 4 years of retirement, many of the improvements in health show up four or more years later, consistent with the view that health is a stock that evolves slowly. We find no evidence that the health improvements are driven by increased health care utilization. In fact, results suggest decreased utilization in some categories.

10.1002/hec.3821.abstractZh: 我们利用《健康与退休研究》的面板数据，来探讨退休对身体健康、心理健康、生活满意度以及医疗保健利用的影响。由于健康状况不佳可能导致退休，我们通过社会保障资格和雇主提供的养老金来作为退休的工具变量，并通过社会保障收入测试来筛选样本。我们发现，退休确实能够改善报告的身体健康状况、心理健康状况以及生活满意度。此外，我们还发现，从长期来看，功能限制有所改善。虽然生活满意度的改善在退休后的前四年出现，但许多健康方面的改善则出现在四年后或更长时间，这与健康是一种缓慢发展的资产的观点一致。我们没有发现健康改善是由医疗保健利用增加所驱动的。事实上，结果表明某些类别的医疗保健利用有所减少。

abstract.text: Pay-for-performance programs are introduced in an increasing number of low- and middle-income countries with the goal of reducing maternal and child mortality and morbidity through increased health service utilization and quality. Although most programs incentivize formal health providers, some constraints to utilization might be better alleviated by incentivizing other actors in the health care system. This paper presents results from a randomized controlled trial set to evaluate the effects of two incentive schemes that were introduced on top of Rwanda's national Performance-Based Financing program at the health facility level. One scheme rewarded community health worker cooperatives for the utilization of five services by their communities. The second scheme provided in-kind transfers to users of three services. The analysis finds no impact of the cooperative performance payments on coverage of the targeted services, behaviors of community health workers, or outcomes at the cooperative level. Although health centers experienced frequent stock outs of the gifts, the demand-side intervention significantly increased timely antenatal care by 9.3 percentage points and timely postnatal care by 8.6 percentage points. This study shows that demand-side incentives can increase service utilization also when provided in addition to a supply-side pay-for-performance scheme.

10.1002/hec.3822.abstractZh: 越来越多的低收入和中等收入国家开始实施基于绩效的支付计划，旨在通过提高医疗服务的使用率和质量来降低孕产妇和儿童死亡率及发病率。虽然大多数计划都激励了正规医疗服务提供者，但通过激励医疗系统中的其他参与者，可能会更好地缓解使用率方面的限制。本文报告了一项随机对照试验的结果，该试验旨在评估在卢旺达国家基于绩效的融资计划基础上实施的两种激励方案对医疗机构层面的影响。其中一种方案奖励社区卫生工作者合作社对其社区内五项服务的利用情况，另一种方案则向三项服务的用户提供实物转移。分析发现，合作社绩效奖励对目标服务的覆盖率、社区卫生工作者的行为或合作社层面的结果没有影响。尽管卫生中心经常缺货，但需求端干预措施使及时产前护理增加了9.3个百分点，及时产后护理增加了8.6个百分点。这项研究表明，即使是在供应端基于绩效的支付计划之外，需求端激励措施也能增加服务使用率。

abstract.text: The objective of this article is to provide the analyst with the necessary tools that allow for a robust ordering of joint distributions of health and income. We contribute to the literature on the measurement and inference of socioeconomic health inequality in three distinct but complementary ways. First, we provide a formalization of the socioeconomic health inequality-specific ethical principle introduced by Erreygers et al. (2012) . Second, we propose new graphical tools and dominance tests for the identification of robust orderings of joint distributions of income and health associated with this new ethical principle. Finally, based on both pro-poor and pro-extreme ranks ethical principles we address a very important aspect of dominance literature: the inference. To illustrate the empirical relevance of the proposed approach, we compare joint distributions of income and a health-related behavior in the United States in 1997 and 2014.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.004.abstractZh: 本文的目的是为分析人员提供必要的工具，以对健康与收入的联合分布进行有序化处理。我们主要从三个不同但互补的角度为社会经济健康不平等的测量与推断研究做出贡献。首先，我们提出了Erreygers等人（2012年）提出的特定于社会经济健康不平等的伦理原则的形式化表述。其次，我们提出了新的图形工具和优势检验方法，用于识别与这一新伦理原则相关的收入与健康的联合分布的有序化。最后，基于有利于穷人和反对极端主义的伦理原则，我们探讨了优势理论中的一个非常重要的方面：推断方法。为了说明所提出方法的实证相关性，我们比较了1997年和2014年美国收入与某种健康相关行为的联合分布情况。

abstract.text: Equity of access is a key policy objective in publicly-funded healthcare systems. However, observed inequalities of access by socioeconomic status may result from differences in patients' choices. Using data on non-emergency coronary revascularisation procedures in the English National Health Service, we found substantive differences in waiting times within public hospitals between patients with different socioeconomic status: up to 35% difference, or 43 days, between the most and least deprived population quintile groups. Using selection models with differential distances as identification variables, we estimated that only up to 12% of these waiting time inequalities can be attributed to patients' choices of hospital and type of treatment (heart bypass versus stent). Residual inequality, after allowing for choice, was economically significant: patients in the least deprived quintile group benefited from shorter waiting times and the associated health benefits were worth up to £850 per person.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.06.005.abstractZh: 公平获取是公共财政支持的医疗保健体系中的关键政策目标。然而，观察到的基于社会经济地位的获取不平等可能源于患者选择上的差异。利用英国国家卫生服务体系中的非紧急冠状动脉血运重建手术数据，我们发现不同社会经济地位的患者在公立医院内的等待时间存在显著差异：最贫困与最富裕人群之间的等待时间差异可达35%，即43天。通过选择模型并采用差异距离作为识别变量，我们估计这些等待时间的不平等中，仅有12%可以归因于患者选择的医院和治疗类型（心脏搭桥手术与支架植入）。在考虑患者选择因素后，剩余的不平等仍然具有经济意义：最贫困人群组的患者在等待时间上获得了更大的优势，而由此带来的健康收益对每个人而言价值高达850英镑。

abstract.text: US policymakers place high priority on tying Medicare payments to the value of care delivered. A critical part of this effort is the Hospital Value-based Purchasing Program (HVBP), which rewards or penalizes hospitals based on their quality and episode-based costs of care and incentivizes integration between hospitals and post-acute care providers. Within HVBP, each patient affects hospital performance on a variety of quality and spending measures, and performance translates directly to changes in program points and ultimately dollars. In short, hospital revenue from a patient consists not only of the DRG payment, but also of that patient's marginal future reimbursement. We estimate the magnitude of the marginal future reimbursement for individual patients across each type of quality and performance measure. We describe how those incentives differ across hospitals, including integrated and safety-net hospitals. We find evidence that hospitals improved their performance over time in the areas where they have the highest marginal incentives to improve care, and that integrated hospitals responded more than non-integrated hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.07.006.abstractZh: 美国政策制定者高度重视将医疗保险支付与所提供的医疗服务价值挂钩。这一举措的关键部分就是医院价值采购计划（HVBP），该计划根据医院的服务质量和病例成本对医院进行奖励或惩罚，并激励医院与急性后期护理机构之间的合作。在HVBP中，每位患者都影响着医院在多种质量和成本方面的表现，而这些表现会直接转化为计划积分的变化，最终转化为实际的资金收益。简而言之，医院从每位患者那里获得的收入不仅包括DRG支付，还包括该患者未来的边际报销金额。我们估算了各类质量和绩效指标下，每位患者未来的边际报销金额。我们还研究了不同医院之间的激励差异，包括整合型医院和福利型医院。我们发现，在那些有最高边际激励来改进服务的领域，医院的表现随着时间的推移而有所提升，而整合型医院比非整合型医院反应更为积极。

abstract.text: Previous research has found strong evidence that legal access to alcohol is associated with sizable increases in criminality. We revisit this relationship using the census of judicial records on criminal charges filed in Oregon Courts, the ability to separately track crimes involving firearms, and to track individuals over time. We find that crime increases at age 21, with increases mostly due to assaults that lack premeditation, and alcohol-related nuisance crimes. We find no evident increases in rape or robbery. Among those with no prior criminal records, increases in crime are 50% larger-still larger for the most socially costly crimes of assault and drunk driving.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.08.001.abstractZh: 先前的研究发现，法律对酒精的获取与犯罪行为的显著增加存在密切关联。我们利用俄勒冈州法院提交的刑事指控的司法记录数据，能够单独追踪涉及枪支的犯罪，并随时间跟踪个体情况，重新探讨了这种关系。研究发现，犯罪率在21岁时开始上升，这种上升主要源于无预谋的袭击行为以及与酒精相关的滋扰犯罪。而强奸或抢劫行为的犯罪率并未出现明显的增加。对于没有犯罪记录的人来说，犯罪率的上升幅度为50%，对于社会成本最高的袭击和酒驾犯罪来说，这一幅度甚至更大。

abstract.text: That well-being is decreasing in others' income is termed the "relative income hypothesis" (RIH) by scholars of subjective well-being (SWB) and has substantial empirical support. Some studies, however, present evidence of both positive and negative explanatory channels in the relationship between others' income and SWB. We develop a theoretical framework integrating four distinct channels through which neighbors' income can affect utility: public goods, cost of living, expectations of future income, and direct effects (RIH or altruism). We estimate the relationship with SWB data from the U.S. Gallup-Healthways Well-Being Index and median-income data from the American Community Survey for ZIP codes and MSAs. The relationship is proximity-dependent: positive (negative) when using ZIP-code (MSA) median income as reference income, suggesting that positive (negative) channels dominate locally (regionally) and reconciling the literature's seemingly divergent results. These findings are consistent across SWB measures and many health-related indices. Additional analyses support the public-goods and cost-of-living channels.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.08.003.abstractZh: 学者们将“他人收入减少导致幸福感下降”的现象称为“相对收入假说”（RIH），这一理论得到了大量实证研究的支持。然而，一些研究也发现了他人收入与幸福感之间存在正负两种解释渠道。我们构建了一个理论框架，整合了四种不同的渠道，通过这些渠道可以解释邻居收入如何影响幸福感：公共物品、生活成本、对未来收入的预期以及直接效应（RIH或利他主义）。我们利用美国盖洛普-健康之路幸福感指数中的幸福感数据，以及美国社区调查中的邮政编码和州级行政区的中位数收入数据，来估计这种关系。研究发现，这种关系取决于地理位置：当以邮政编码或州级行政区的中位数收入作为参照收入时，幸福感会呈现正相关（或负相关），这表明在局部或区域范围内，正负两种解释渠道占据主导地位，从而解释了文献中看似矛盾的结果。这些发现与多种幸福感测量指标以及许多健康相关指标一致。进一步的分析也支持了公共物品和生活成本这两个解释渠道的作用。

abstract.text: We use stated-preference methods to estimate the cancer Value per Statistical Life (VSL) and Value per Statistical Case (VSCC) from a representative sample of 45-60-year olds in four countries in Europe. We ask respondents to report information about their willingness to pay for health risk reductions that are different from those used in earlier valuation work because they are comprised of two probabilities-that of getting cancer, and that of dying from it (conditional on getting it in the first place). The product of these two probabilities is the unconditional cancer mortality risk. Our hypothetical risk reductions also include two severity-related attributes-quality-of-life impacts and pain. The results show that respondents did appear to have an intuitive grasp of compound probabilities, and took into account each component of the unconditional cancer mortality risk when answering the valuation questions. We estimate the cancer VSL to be between approximately € 2 and 5.950 million, depending on whether the (unconditional) mortality risk was reduced by lowering the chance of getting cancer, increasing the chance of surviving cancer, or both. The VSCC is estimated to be up to € 0.578 million euro, and its magnitude depends on the initial (conditional) cancer mortality and on the improvement in survival. The survey responses show that our measures of cancer severity-impacts on daily activities and pain-have little or no effect on the WTP to reduce the adverse health risks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.08.004.abstractZh: 我们使用陈述偏好方法，从欧洲四个国家45至60岁的人群中选取代表性样本，来估算癌症的统计生命价值（VSL）和统计病例价值（VSCC）。我们要求受访者报告他们对减少健康风险所愿意支付的费用信息，这些信息与之前的价值评估工作有所不同，因为它们包含了两个概率——患癌的概率，以及在患癌后死亡的概率（前提条件是先患癌）。这两个概率的乘积就是无条件的癌症死亡风险。我们的假设性风险降低措施还包括两个与严重程度相关的属性：生活质量影响和疼痛。结果显示，受访者似乎能够直观地理解复合概率，并在回答价值评估问题时考虑了无条件癌症死亡风险的每个组成部分。我们估计癌症的VSL大约在200万到5950万欧元之间，这取决于减少癌症发生几率、提高癌症存活几率，还是两者兼有的方式来降低死亡风险。VSCC的估计值高达578万欧元，其大小取决于初始的癌症死亡概率以及生存率的改善。调查结果显示，我们对癌症严重程度的衡量指标——对日常活动的影晌和疼痛——对人们愿意支付费用以减少健康风险的影响很小或没有影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies changes in the patterns of drug consumption and attitudes towards drugs in relation to sky-high (youth) unemployment rates brought about by the Great Recession. Our analysis is based on data for 28 European countries that refer to young people. We find that the consumption of cannabis and 'new substances' is positively related to increasing unemployment rates. An increase of 1% in the regional unemployment rate is associated with an increase of 0.7 percentage points in the ratio of young people who state that they have consumed cannabis at some point in time. Our findings also indicate that higher unemployment may be associated with more young people perceiving that access to drugs has become more difficult, particularly access to ecstasy, cocaine and heroin. According to young Europeans, when the economy worsens, anti-drug policies should focus on the reduction of poverty and unemployment, and not on implementing tougher measures against users.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.08.005.abstractZh: 本文研究了由于大衰退导致的高失业率对年轻人药物消费模式和态度的影响。我们的分析基于28个欧洲国家的相关数据。研究发现，大麻和“新型毒品”的消费与失业率上升之间存在正相关关系。地区失业率每上升1%，表示曾经使用过大麻的年轻人比例就会增加0.7个百分点。研究还表明，较高的失业率可能导致更多年轻人认为获取毒品变得更加困难，尤其是摇头丸、可卡因和海洛因等毒品。根据欧洲年轻人的看法，当经济恶化时，反毒品政策应侧重于减少贫困和失业问题，而不是采取更严格的措施来打击吸毒者。

abstract.text: In exchange for tax exemptions, Blue Cross and Blue Shield (BCBS) health insurers were expected to provide health insurance to the "bad risks," those for whom coverage was unavailable from other insurers. I present evidence that five years after a BCBS plan converted to for-profit status, the probability of having insurance was 1.4 percentage points higher, a 9% reduction in the uninsured. The increase in coverage does not mask reductions among populations often targeted by public policies. However, there is evidence of increased risk selection which suggests that the bad risks might have been worse off after a conversion.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.09.001.abstractZh: 作为税收豁免的交换，蓝十字蓝盾保险公司被期望为那些其他保险公司无法提供保险服务的“高风险人群”提供健康保险。我有证据表明，在蓝十字蓝盾保险公司转为营利性机构五年后，获得保险的概率提高了1.4个百分点，无保险人口的比例减少了9%。保险覆盖范围的扩大并没有掩盖那些经常成为公共政策目标的人群中无保险现象的增加。不过，有证据表明风险选择有所增加，这表明在转换后，这些高风险人群的情况可能变得更糟。

abstract.text: Parental fear of vaccines has limited vaccination rates in the United States. I test whether disease outbreaks increase vaccination using a new dataset of county-level disease and vaccination data. I find that pertussis (whooping cough) outbreaks in a county decrease the share of unvaccinated children entering kindergarten. These responses do not reflect changes in the future disease risk. I argue that these facts are best fit by a model in which individuals are both myopic and irrational. This suggests that better promotion of information about outbreaks could enhance the response.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.10.003.abstractZh: 家长对疫苗的恐惧限制了美国的疫苗接种率。我使用一个新的包含县级疾病和疫苗接种数据的数据集，来测试疾病爆发是否会增加疫苗接种率。我发现，某个县内百日咳的爆发会降低未接种疫苗的儿童进入幼儿园的比例。这些反应并不反映未来疾病风险的变化。我认为，这些现象最适合用一种既短视又非理性的模型来解释。这表明，更好地宣传关于疾病爆发的信息可能会增强人们的疫苗接种行为。

abstract.text: This paper presents evidence on intra-household retirement externalities by assessing the causal effect of spousal retirement on various health behaviors and health status across 19 European countries. We identify partner's and own retirement effects by applying a fuzzy regression discontinuity design using retirement eligibility as exogenous instruments for spousal and own retirement status. We find significant increases in the frequency and intensity of alcohol consumption combined with a significant decrease in moderate physical activities as a response to partner's retirement. In line with the existing literature, we find that own retirement has significant positive effects on engaging in moderate and vigorous physical activities but also leads to a significant increase in the frequency of alcohol intake. Overall, subjective health is negatively affected by spousal retirement and positively by own retirement.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.10.005.abstractZh: 本文通过评估配偶退休对19个欧洲国家中各种健康行为和健康状况的因果效应，提出了关于家庭内部退休外部性的证据。我们采用模糊回归断点设计，以退休资格作为配偶和自身退休状态的外生工具变量，来识别配偶退休和自身退休的影响。研究发现，由于配偶退休，酒精消费的频率和强度显著增加，而适度体育活动的频率则显著下降。与现有文献一致，我们发现自身退休对参与适度及剧烈体育活动有显著的正面影响，但同时也导致酒精摄入频率的显著增加。总体而言，配偶退休对主观健康有负面影响，而自身退休则具有正面影响。

abstract.text: This paper aims to identify the causal effect of smoking on body mass index (BMI) using data from the Lung Health Study, a randomized trial of smoking cessation treatments. Since nicotine is a metabolic stimulant and appetite suppressant, quitting or reducing smoking could lead to weight gain. Using randomized treatment assignment to instrument for smoking, we estimate that quitting smoking leads to an average long-run weight gain of 1.8-1.9 BMI units, or 11-12 pounds at the average height. Semi-parametric models provide evidence of a diminishing marginal effect of smoking on BMI, while subsample regressions show that the impact is largest for younger individuals, those with no college degree, and those in the lowest quartile of baseline BMI.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.10.006.abstractZh: 本文旨在利用“肺健康研究”的数据，分析吸烟对体重指数（BMI）的因果效应。该研究是一项关于戒烟治疗的随机对照试验。由于尼古丁具有刺激代谢和抑制食欲的作用，戒烟或减少吸烟量可能会导致体重增加。通过随机处理分配方法对吸烟的影响进行估计，我们发现戒烟会导致平均长期体重增加1.8-1.9个BMI单位，相当于平均身高下增加11-12磅。半参数模型表明，吸烟对BMI的边际影响逐渐减弱，而子样本回归分析显示，这种影响在较年轻的人群、没有大学学历的人群以及BMI基线处于最低四分位的人群中最为显著。

abstract.text: Using data from a major educational reform in England and Wales, we examine heterogeneity in the long-term impacts of the exposure to different secondary schooling systems, characterized by selective early-tracking system versus non-selective comprehensive schooling, on health outcomes and smoking. We adopt a local instrumental variables approach to estimate person-centered treatment (PeT) effects, thereby recovering the full distribution of individual-level causal effects. We find that the transition from a selective early-tracking system to a non-selective one produced, on a fraction of individuals, significantly increased depression and cigarette smoking. These effects were persistent over time. Cognitive abilities did not moderate the effects, but students with lower non-cognitive skills were most likely to be negatively affected by this exposure.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.10.007.abstractZh: 通过研究英格兰和威尔士一项重大教育改革的数据，我们探讨了不同中学教育制度对长期健康结果和吸烟行为影响的异质性。这些教育制度包括选择性早期跟踪制与非选择性综合制。我们采用局部工具变量方法来估计以个人为中心的处理效应，从而完整地捕捉到个体层面的因果效应分布。研究发现，从选择性早期跟踪制转向非选择性综合制会导致部分个体的抑郁和吸烟行为显著增加，且这些效应具有持续性。认知能力并未起到调节作用，但非认知能力较低的学生更有可能受到这种教育制度带来的负面影响。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of employment on elderly men's health. A typical OLS analysis yields a positive relationship between employment and health for individuals in their sixties. Causality, however, is difficult to infer because healthier individuals are more capable of working than others. To overcome this endogeneity problem, this paper exploits the increase in the full retirement age for men in Israel from sixty-five to sixty-seven in 2004. After this change, the employment rate of men in this age bracket jumped significantly compared to the last cohort that was able to retire at sixty-five. Using the new retirement law as an exogenous source of variation in the employment status of elderly men, a significant causal relationship in the opposite direction of the correlation is found: employment at older ages impairs health. These findings are found across a broad array of datasets and health outcomes. The results are significantly stronger among less-educated workers, suggesting that employment in physically demanding occupations is more detrimental to health. Placebo analyses using the years preceding the new retirement regime and other health measures unrelated to employment (e.g., dentist visits) reinforce a causal interpretation of my main findings.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.10.008.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了就业对老年男性健康的影响。典型的OLS分析显示，对于六十多岁的个体而言，就业与健康状况之间存在正相关关系。然而，由于健康状况较好的个体比其他人更有能力工作，因此很难推断出因果关系。为了克服这种内生性问题，本文利用了以色列在2004年将男性法定退休年龄从65岁提高到67岁的政策变化。这一变化后，该年龄段的男性就业率相比能够65岁退休的上一个群体显著上升。利用新的退休法律作为老年男性就业状况的外生变量，研究发现了一个与相关性方向相反的显著因果关系：在较老年时就业会损害健康。这些发现适用于多种数据集和健康状况。在受教育程度较低的劳动者中，这一结果更为明显，表明从事体力要求较高的职业对健康的危害更大。使用新退休制度实施前的年份以及其他与就业无关的健康指标（如看牙医次数）进行的安慰剂分析，进一步支持了我对主要发现的因果解释。

abstract.text: In Volume 36 of this journal, Yoruk (2014) uses data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 and finds that false ID laws with scanner provisions have large impacts on binge drinking participation, frequency of alcohol consumption and binge drinking frequency among minors. This paper reexamines how false ID laws with scanner provisions affect underage drinking. I first demonstrate that analyses based on NLSY97 data fail falsification exercises testing for significant pre-intervention effects, and that the estimated effects based on these data are highly sensitive to the inclusion of a lead term and to sample selection, which weakens confidence in the large estimated effects reported in Yoruk (2014). I then use data from the Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System to show that false ID laws with scanner provisions have no effect on underage drinking behavior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.10.009.abstractZh: 在本期刊的第36卷中，Yoruk（2014）使用了1997年青年纵向调查的数据，发现带有扫描仪功能的虚假身份证件法律对未成年人的酗酒参与率、饮酒频率以及酗酒频率产生了重大影响。本文重新审视了带有扫描仪功能的虚假身份证件法律对未成年人饮酒行为的影响。首先，我证明了基于NLSY97数据的分析在验证干预前显著影响的实验中未能通过伪造测试，并且基于这些数据的估计效果对引入引导项以及样本选择非常敏感，这削弱了人们对Yoruk（2014）报告中估计出的巨大效果的信心。随后，我使用青少年风险行为监测系统的数据表明，带有扫描仪功能的虚假身份证件法律对未成年人饮酒行为没有任何影响。

abstract.text: This paper uses Hospital Episode Statistics, English administrative data, to investigate the growth in admitted patient health care expenditures and the implications of an ageing population. We use two samples of around 40,000 individuals who (a) used inpatient health care in the financial year 2005/06 and died by the end of 2011/12 and (b) died in 2011/12 and had some hospital utilisation since 2005/06. We use a panel structure to follow individuals over seven years of this administrative data, containing estimates of inpatient health care expenditures (HCE), information regarding individuals' age, time-to-death (TTD), morbidities at the time of an admission, as well as the hospital provider, year and season of admission. We show that HCE is principally determined by proximity to death rather than age, and that proximity to death is itself a proxy for morbidity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.11.001.abstractZh: 本文利用医院病例统计数据和英文行政数据，研究了住院患者医疗支出的增长以及人口老龄化所带来的影响。我们选取了两组样本，每组约40,000人：(a) 在2005/06财年曾接受住院治疗，并在2011/12财年底去世的人；(b) 在2011/12财年去世，但自2005/06财年以来仍有一些住院记录的人。我们利用面板结构，对这些行政数据中的个体进行七年跟踪分析，其中包括住院医疗支出的估算、个体的年龄、死亡时间、入院时的疾病状况，以及医院提供方、入院年份和季节等信息。研究表明，住院医疗支出的大小主要取决于个体距离死亡的时间，而非年龄；而距离死亡的时间本身则可以作为疾病状况的替代指标。

abstract.text: I study a managed health service market where differentiated providers compete for consumers by choosing multiple service qualities, and where copayments that consumers pay and payments that providers receive for services are set by a payer. The optimal regulation scheme is two-sided. On the demand side, it justifies and clarifies value-based reference pricing. On the supply side, it prescribes pay for performance when consumers misperceive service benefits or providers have intrinsic quality incentives. The optimal bonuses are expressed in terms of demand elasticities, service technology, and provider characteristics. However, pay for performance may not outperform prospective payment when consumers are rational and providers are profit maximizing, or when one of the service qualities is not contractible.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.11.002.abstractZh: 我研究的是一个有管理的健康服务市场，在这个市场中，不同的服务提供者通过选择多种服务品质来争夺消费者。消费者需要支付的共付费用以及服务提供者获得的服务报酬是由支付方设定的。最优的监管方案是双边的。在需求方面，它合理且清晰地定义了基于价值的参考定价。在供应方面，当消费者误解了服务收益或服务提供者有内在的质量激励时，它规定了对绩效的支付。最优的奖励机制是根据需求弹性、服务技术和服务提供者的特点来确定的。然而，当消费者是理性的且服务提供者是追求利润最大化的，或者当某种服务品质不可协商时，对绩效的支付可能并不会优于预期支付。

abstract.text: Average body mass index (BMI) and depression prevalence grew over the last several decades, increasing medical expenditures. There is a strong correlation between obesity and depression but limited evidence on the causal effect of weight on mental health. I use an index of genetic risk for high BMI as a source of exogenous variation in weight to provide novel evidence on the effect of weight on mental health. This is one of the first studies to use genetics as an instrument for BMI and to examine the causal relationship between weight and depression. Results are mixed; I find a meaningful and significant effect of weight on suicidal ideation but no effects on counseling and an index of depression. The effect on suicidal ideation is concentrated in white females. From respondent and interviewer opinions of respondent attractiveness, social stigma is a mechanism through which weight affects mental health for white women.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.11.003.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，平均体质指数（BMI）和抑郁症的患病率都有所上升，这导致了医疗支出的增加。肥胖与抑郁症之间存在很强的相关性，但关于体重对心理健康影响的因果效应，现有证据有限。我采用遗传风险指数作为体重的外生变量来源，以提供关于体重对心理健康影响的新证据。这是首批使用遗传学作为BMI研究工具，并探讨体重与抑郁症之间因果关系的研究之一。研究结果并不一致；我发现体重对自杀意念有显著的影响，但对咨询和抑郁症指数的影响则不明显。体重对自杀意念的影响主要集中在白人女性身上。根据受访者和访谈者的观点，社会污名是体重影响白人女性心理健康的一个机制。

abstract.text: Technological changes in medicine have created new opportunities to provide surgical care in lower cost, specialized facilities. This paper examines patient outcomes in ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs), which were developed as a low-cost alternative to outpatient surgery in hospitals. Because we are concerned that selection into ASCs may bias estimates of facility quality, we use predicted changes in federally set Medicare facility payment rates as an instrument for ASC utilization to estimate the effect of location of treatment on patient outcomes. We find that patients treated in an ASC are less likely to be admitted to a hospital or visit an emergency room a short time after outpatient surgery. The findings in this paper indicate that factors other than patient and physician heterogeneity contribute to the observed returns to specialization in the ASC market.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.11.004.abstractZh: 医学领域的技术变革为在成本更低、专业性更强的设施中提供外科手术创造了新的机会。本文研究了门诊手术中心（ASCs）中的患者治疗效果，这些中心作为医院门诊手术的低成本替代方案而应运而生。由于担心进入门诊手术中心可能会影响对设施质量的评估，我们采用联邦政府设定的Medicare设施支付率的变化作为工具，来估算治疗地点对患者治疗效果的影响。研究发现，在门诊手术中心接受治疗的患者在手术后不久，进入医院或前往急诊室的可能性较低。本文的研究结果表明，除了患者和医生之间的异质性之外，还有其他因素对门诊手术中心市场的专业化效益产生了影响。

abstract.text: We use a natural experiment to estimate the causal impact of a public health intervention aimed at reducing teenage childbearing. The geographic and timing variation in the rollout of the South African National Adolescent Friendly Clinic Initiative (NAFCI) in the early 2000s provides a plausibly exogenous increase in reproductive health knowledge and clinical access for teens. We investigate the causal pathway from the intervention's initial impact on early-teen childbearing to subsequent consequences for later-life outcomes of prime policy interest - education, employment and child health. Our empirical strategy uses GPS data from the National Income Dynamics Study to geolink women's location of residence during adolescence to the location and timing of the rollout. Our results show that living near a NAFCI clinic during adolescence delayed childbearing, substantially lowering the likelihood of early teen childbearing. We estimate that adolescents who had access to NAFCI completed more years of schooling and, consistent with increased human capital investments, earn substantially higher wages as young adults. Finally, children born to women who had access to youth-friendly services as teens show substantial health advantages, indicating a strong intergenerational benefit of delaying early teen childbearing in a developing country context.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.11.006.abstractZh: 我们通过一项自然实验来估算一项旨在减少青少年生育的公共卫生干预措施的因果效应。20世纪00年代初，南非国家青少年友好诊所计划（NAFCI）在各地的实施时间和范围存在差异，这为青少年提供了可推测的外生性生殖健康知识和临床服务机会。我们研究了从干预措施最初对青少年早期生育的影响到后续对教育、就业和儿童健康等核心政策目标影响的因果路径。我们的实证策略利用国民收入动态研究中的GPS数据，将女性青少年时期的居住位置与诊所实施的时间和地点进行关联。研究结果表明，在青少年时期居住在NAFCI诊所附近可以推迟生育，显著降低青少年早期生育的可能性。我们估计，能够使用NAFCI服务的青少年完成更多的学校教育年限，并且与增加人力资本投资相一致，他们在成年后获得的工资水平也更高。最后，那些在青少年时期能够享受到青少年友好服务的女性的子女，在健康方面表现出显著的优势，这表明在发展中国家背景下，推迟青少年早期生育具有强大的代际效益。

abstract.text: Data from the first two waves of the Fragile Family and Child Wellbeing study indicate that infants who look like their father at birth are healthier one year later. The reason is such father-child resemblance induces a father to spend more time engaged in positive parenting. An extra day (per month) of time-investment by a typical visiting father enhances child health by just over 10% of a standard deviation. This estimate is not biased by the effect of child health on father-involvement or omitted maternal ability, thereby eliminating endogeneity biases that plague existing studies. The result has implications regarding the role of a father's time in enhancing child health, especially in fragile families.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2017.11.007.abstractZh: 《脆弱家庭与儿童福祉》研究的前两波数据表明，出生时外貌与父亲相似的婴儿在一年后的健康状况更好。原因在于这种父子相似性促使父亲投入更多时间进行积极的育儿活动。典型父亲每月多投入一天时间，能够使儿童健康水平提高超过10个标准差。这一估计并未受到儿童健康对父亲参与程度的影响或母亲能力的遗漏影响，从而消除了现有研究中存在的内生性偏差。这一结果对于理解父亲时间对儿童健康的影响具有重要意义，尤其是在脆弱家庭中。
