10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.09.005.abstractZh: 理解医生在自身经济利益与患者经济或健康利益发生冲突时的决策，在健康经济学和政策中至关重要。这一问题在某些医学专业领域尤为突出，因为医生较少的利他行为反而能带来显著的财务收益。本研究通过实验方式测量了来自美国各地医学院的医学生的利他偏好，并探讨这些偏好是否能够预测学生预期的医学专业选择。实验设计包括一系列基于计算机的显示偏好决策问题，要求实验对象在自身与一名匿名人物之间分配实际金钱。这些数据被用来为每位参与者制定一个创新的利他主义衡量指标。随后，在控制了从配套调查问卷中收集到的广泛协变量后，我进一步研究了利他主义与预期专业选择之间的关联。结果显示，具有较低利他倾向的医学生在控制一系列协变量后，更有可能选择高收入的专业。这一利他主义衡量指标在预测专业收入方面比其他多种特征更具预测性，包括父母收入、学生贷款金额以及医学入学考试（MCAT）成绩。另一方面，这一利他主义衡量指标并不能预测医学生选择初级保健专业的情况。我还发现，利他主义能够预测学生自我报告的在欠发达地区从事医学工作的可能性。

abstract.text: I evaluate a program aimed at strictly enforcing a requirement that people on long-term sick leave be partly back at work unless explicitly defined as an exception. Employing the synthetic control method, I find that the reform reduced work-hours lost due to sickness absenteeism by 12% in the reform region compared to a comparison unit created by a weighted average of similar regions. The effect is driven by both increased part-time presence of temporary disabled workers and accelerated recovery. Musculoskeletal disorders was the diagnosis group declining the most. The findings imply large savings in social security expenditures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.09.007.abstractZh: 我评估了一个旨在严格实施一项要求的计划，即长期病假人员应部分重返工作岗位，除非有明确的例外情况。采用合成控制方法后，我发现与通过加权平均法选取的类似地区相比，该改革措施使病假缺勤导致的工作时间损失减少了12%。这一效果主要得益于临时残疾工人的兼职比例增加以及康复速度的加快。其中，肌肉骨骼疾病患者的减少最为显著。这些发现意味着社会保障支出将大幅减少。

abstract.text: Although mental health disorders such as anxiety and depression are common, there is little research on whether individuals in poor mental health react differently from others to financial incentives. This paper exploits an experiment from the UK Understanding Society Innovation Panel to assess how the participation response to randomly-assigned financial incentives differs by mental health status. We find that individuals in good mental health are more likely to respond when offered a higher financial incentive, whereas those in poor mental health are indifferent to the increased incentive. We find no comparable differences for physical health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.09.008.abstractZh: 尽管焦虑、抑郁等心理健康问题很常见，但关于心理健康状况不佳的个体在面对财务激励时是否会有不同反应的研究却很少。本文利用英国“理解社会创新小组”的一项实验，评估不同心理健康状况的人在随机分配的财务激励下参与行为的差异。研究发现，心理健康状况良好的个体在面临更高财务激励时更有可能做出回应，而心理健康状况不佳的个体则对增加的激励无动于衷。对于身体健康状况，我们没有发现类似的差异。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of retirement on healthcare utilization in China using longitudinal data. We use a nonparametric fuzzy regression discontinuity design, exploiting the statutory retirement age in urban China as a source of exogenous variation in retirement. In contrast to previous results for developed countries, we find that in China retirement increases healthcare utilization. This increase can be attributed to deteriorating health and in particular to the reduced opportunity cost of time after retirement. For the sample as a whole, income is not a dominating mechanism. People with low education, however, are more likely to forego recommended inpatient care after retirement.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.09.009.abstractZh: 我们利用纵向数据研究退休对中国医疗利用的影响。采用非参数模糊回归断点设计，以中国城市法定的退休年龄作为退休状况的外生变量。与发达国家的结果不同，我们发现在中国，退休反而增加了医疗利用。这种增加可以归因于健康状况的恶化，尤其是退休后时间机会成本的降低。总体而言，收入并非主要影响因素。然而，受教育程度较低的人更有可能放弃退休后推荐的住院治疗。

abstract.text: Addressing early-life micronutrient deficiencies can improve short- and long-term outcomes. In most contexts, private supply chains will be key to effective and efficient preventative supplementation. With established vendors, we conducted a 60-week market trial for a food-based micronutrient supplement in rural Burkina Faso with randomized price and non-price treatments. Repeat purchases - critical for effective supplementation - are extremely price sensitive. Loyalty cards boost demand more than price discounts, particularly in non-poor households where the father is the cardholder. A small minority of households achieved sufficient supplementation for their children through purely retail distribution, suggesting the need for more creative public-private delivery platforms informed by insights into household demand persistence and heterogeneity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.09.010.abstractZh: 解决儿童早期微量营养素缺乏问题可以改善短期和长期的健康状况。在大多数情况下，私人供应链将是实现有效和高效预防性补充的关键。我们与已建立的供应商合作，在布基纳法索农村地区进行了一项为期60周的市场试验，测试了基于食物的微量营养素补充剂的效果，并采用了随机价格和非价格干预措施。重复购买对于有效的补充至关重要，而价格敏感度非常高。忠诚卡对需求的影响大于价格折扣，尤其是在父亲是卡持有人的非贫困家庭中。少数家庭通过纯零售方式实现了对儿童的充分补充，这表明需要更多具有创新性的公私合作交付平台，这些平台应基于对家庭需求持久性和异质性的深入了解来设计。

abstract.text: Targeting the Ultra-poor (TUP) is an integrated programme that combines the transfer of income-generating assets and multifaceted training on entrepreneurship, health-nutrition, and social awareness over a two-year period to graduate ultra-poor with mainstream poverty. While positive socioeconomic effects and spill-over effects are well-documented, this is the first paper to evaluate the effects of the programme on nutritional outcomes of under-5 children using data from a randomized control trial over a four-year period. We find notable improvements in nutritional outcomes of children in participating households. TUP is further seen to improve food-security, sanitation and duration of exclusive-breastfeeding. Nutrition status of children living in poor non-participant households are also positively affected though no effects were found on children from non-poor households. We conclude that programmes that combine asset transfer with multifaceted training such as TUP can have significant long-term positive health effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2018.09.011.abstractZh: “针对极端贫困群体”是一项综合性计划，该计划在两年时间内结合收入生成资产的转移以及关于创业能力、健康营养和社会意识的多方面培训，旨在帮助极端贫困的毕业生摆脱贫困。虽然该计划带来的积极社会经济效应和溢出效应已有充分记录，但本文首次通过为期四年的随机对照试验数据，评估了该计划对5岁以下儿童营养状况的影响。我们发现，参与该计划的家庭中的儿童营养状况有显著改善。此外，该计划还提升了食品安全、卫生条件以及纯母乳喂养的持续时间。虽然未发现对非贫困家庭中的儿童产生积极影响，但贫困非参与家庭中的儿童营养状况也得到了改善。我们得出结论，将资产转移与诸如“针对极端贫困群体”这样的多方面培训相结合的计划，能够带来显著的长期健康积极影响。

abstract.text: Blacks and whites in the United States adopt widely different parental behaviors, but the underlying causes of these differences are not well understood. This paper documents large-scale increases in cognitively stimulating parenting among southern black mothers who came of age in the period immediately following the civil rights movement. The total magnitude of these improvements was approximately 0.5 standard deviations between the 1957 and 1964 birth cohorts, while no significant trends occurred among blacks outside of the South or among whites from any region.

10.1086/694205.abstractZh: 美国的黑人和白人在育儿方式上存在显著差异，但这些差异的根本原因尚不清楚。本文记录了在民权运动之后成长起来的南方黑人母亲在育儿方式上出现了显著改善。这些改善的幅度大约在0.5个标准差左右，这一变化发生在1957年至1964年出生的人群中。而在南方以外的黑人以及来自其他地区的白人中，并未观察到类似的显著变化。

abstract.text: The gravity equation in international trade states that bilateral exports are proportional to economic size and inversely proportional to geographic distance. While the role of size is well understood, that of distance remains mysterious. I offer an explanation for the role of distance: If (i) the distribution of firm sizes is Pareto, (ii) the average squared distance of a firm's exports is an increasing power function of its size, and (iii) a parameter restriction holds, then the distance elasticity of trade is constant for long distances. When the firm size distribution follows Zipf's law, trade is inversely proportional to distance.

10.1086/694292.abstractZh: 国际贸易中的重力方程表明，双边出口与经济规模成正比，与地理距离成反比。虽然规模的作用已经得到充分理解，但距离的作用仍然是个谜。我提出了一种解释距离作用的理论：如果（i）企业规模分布符合帕累托分布，（ii）企业出口的平均平方距离是其规模的增长幂函数，并且（iii）存在参数限制，那么长距离贸易的距离弹性是恒定的。当企业规模分布遵循齐夫定律时，贸易与距离成反比。

abstract.text: We consider collective decisions made by agents whose preferences and power depend on past events and decisions. Faced with an inefficient equilibrium and an opportunity to commit to a policy, can the agents reach an agreement on such a policy? We provide a consistency condition linking power structures in the dynamic setting and at the commitment stage. When the condition holds, commitment has no value: any agreement that may be reached at the outset coincides with the equilibrium without commitment. When the condition fails, as in the case of time-inconsistent preferences, commitment can improve outcomes. We discuss several applications.

10.1086/694294.abstractZh: 我们考虑由代理人做出的集体决策，这些代理人的偏好和权力取决于过去的事件和决策。面对一个低效的均衡状态，以及采取某种政策的机会，这些代理人能否就这种政策达成一致？我们提出了一个一致性条件，将动态环境中的权力结构与承诺阶段联系起来。当这个条件成立时，承诺是没有意义的：在初始阶段可能达成的任何协议，实际上与没有承诺时的均衡状态是一致的。当这个条件不成立时，比如在时间不一致的偏好情况下，承诺可能会改善结果。我们讨论了几个应用案例。

abstract.text: This paper quantitatively assesses time inconsistency, moral hazard, and political ideology in monopoly regulation of electricity distribution. We specify and estimate a dynamic model of utility regulation featuring investment and moral hazard. We find underinvestment in electricity distribution capital aiming to reduce power outages and use the estimated model to quantify the value of regulatory commitment in inducing greater investment. Furthermore, more conservative political environments grant higher regulated returns but have higher rates of electricity loss. Using the estimated model, we quantify how conservative regulators thus mitigate welfare losses due to time inconsistency but worsen losses from moral hazard.

10.1086/695474.abstractZh: 本文定量评估了电力分配垄断监管中的时间不一致性、道德风险以及政治意识形态问题。我们构建并估计了一个包含投资与道德风险的效用监管动态模型。研究发现，电力分配资本的投资不足会导致停电现象，我们利用该模型量化了监管承诺在促进更多投资方面的价值。此外，较为保守的政治环境虽然能带来更高的监管回报，但也会导致更高的电力损失率。通过该模型，我们进一步量化了监管机构如何因时间不一致性而减轻福利损失，但同时也加剧了因道德风险导致的损失。

abstract.text: Exploiting the discontinuity in advertising along the borders of television markets, I estimate that television advertising of prescription antidepressants exhibits significant positive spillovers on rivals' demand. I apply this identification in a demand model, where estimated parameters indicate significant and persistent spillovers driven by market expansion. Using the demand estimates to calibrate a stylized supply model, I explore the consequences of the positive spillovers on firm advertising choice. Compared with a competitive benchmark in which firms optimally free ride, simulations suggest that a category-wide advertising cooperative would produce a significant increase in total advertising.

10.1086/695475.abstractZh: 通过利用电视市场边界处广告的不连续性，我估计处方抗抑郁药的电视广告对竞争对手的需求具有显著的积极溢出效应。我在需求模型中应用了这一识别方法，估计的参数表明这种溢出效应是由市场扩张所驱动的，并且是显著且持久的。利用这些需求估计值来校准一个简化的供给模型，我探讨了这种积极溢出效应对企业广告选择的影响。与企业在竞争环境中最优选择不投放广告的情况相比，模拟结果显示，整个类别范围内的广告合作将显著增加总广告投放量。

abstract.text: The arrival of global retail chains in developing countries is causing a radical transformation in the way households source their consumption. This paper draws on a rich collection of Mexican microdata to estimate the effect of foreign supermarket entry on household welfare and decomposes this effect into six channels. We find that foreign entry causes large welfare gains for the average household predominantly driven by a reduction in the cost of living--both through price reductions at domestic stores and through the direct consumer gains from foreign stores. These gains are, on average, positive for all income groups but are regressive.

10.1086/695476.abstractZh: 全球零售连锁企业在发展中国家的出现，正在彻底改变家庭消费的来源方式。本文基于墨西哥丰富的微观数据，估计了外国超市进入对家庭福利的影响，并将这一影响分解为六个渠道。研究发现，外国超市的进入为普通家庭带来了显著的福利收益，这主要得益于生活成本的降低——既体现在国内商店的价格下降上，也体现在消费者从外国商店获得的直接利益上。这些收益对所有收入群体来说都是积极的，但存在递减趋势。

abstract.text: We study unanimous decision making under incomplete information. We argue that unanimous decision rules are not all equivalent. We show that majority rules with veto power are (i) Pareto superior to commonly used unanimous rules and (ii) ex ante efficient in a broad class of situations.

10.1086/695477.abstractZh: 我们研究了在不完全信息下的一致决策问题。我们认为，一致决策规则并非全部等效。我们证明，具有否决权的多数决策规则在以下两个方面优于常用的一致决策规则：(i) 帕累托效率更高；(ii) 在广泛的情境下具有事前效率。

abstract.text: Suppose that, when evaluating two alternatives x and y by means of a parametric utility function, low values of the parameter indicate a preference for x and high values indicate a preference for y. We say that a stochastic choice model is monotone whenever the probability of choosing x is decreasing in the preference parameter. We show that the standard use of random utility models in the context of risk and time preferences may sharply violate this monotonicity property and argue that their use in preference estimation may be problematic. They may pose identification problems and could yield biased estimations. We then establish that the alternative random parameter models are always monotone.

10.1086/695504.abstractZh: 假设通过参数效用函数评估两个备选方案x和y时，参数的较低值表示偏好方案x，较高的值表示偏好方案y。当选择方案x的概率随偏好参数的增加而减小时，我们称这种随机选择模型为单调的。我们指出，在风险和时间偏好背景下，随机效用模型的标准使用可能会严重违反这种单调性属性，并认为其在偏好估计中的使用可能存在问题。这些模型可能会引发识别问题，并可能导致有偏的估计结果。随后，我们证明了其他随机参数模型始终具有单调性。

abstract.text: Why do firms pay different wages? Empirical evidence suggests the presence of substantial differences in firm pay controlling for worker skill. Moreover, these differences are uncorrelated with skills, indicating the absence of sorting. I show that the face value interpretation is inconsistent with evidence on coworker segregation. I interpret the evidence by applying a sorting model and show that the correlation is biased. I identify nonmonotonicities in wages as the reason for this bias and show that a measure of worker-coworker sorting is more accurate. By calibrating the model to US data, I confirm that the model matches many job market characteristics.

10.1086/695505.abstractZh: 为什么企业会支付不同的工资？实证证据表明，在控制工人技能的情况下，企业工资存在显著差异。此外，这些差异与技能无关，表明不存在排序现象。我指出，表面价值解释与关于同事隔离的证据不一致。我通过应用排序模型来解释这些证据，并表明这种相关性存在偏差。我确定工资的非单调性是这种偏差的原因，并表明衡量工人与同事之间的排序更为准确。通过将该模型校准到美国数据，我确认该模型符合许多就业市场特征。

abstract.text: This paper provides new evidence that Medicaid's introduction reduced infant and child mortality in the 1960s and 1970s. Mandated coverage of all cash welfare recipients induced substantial cross-state variation in the share of children immediately eligible for the program. Before Medicaid, higher- and lower-eligibility states had similar infant and child mortality trends. After Medicaid, public insurance utilization increased and mortality fell more rapidly among children and infants in high-Medicaid-eligibility states. Mortality among nonwhite children on Medicaid fell by 20 percent, leading to a reduction in aggregate nonwhite child mortality rates of 11 percent.

10.1086/695528.abstractZh: 本文提供了新的证据，表明在1960年代和1970年代，医疗补助制度的引入降低了婴儿和儿童的死亡率。强制要求所有现金福利领取者参加医疗补助计划，导致各州之间儿童立即享有该计划资格的比例存在显著差异。在医疗补助制度实施之前，资格较高和较低的州在婴儿和儿童死亡率方面趋势相似。而在医疗补助制度实施后，公共保险的使用率增加，资格较高的州中儿童和婴儿的死亡率下降得更快。在医疗补助计划下，非白人儿童死亡率下降了20%，从而使得非白人儿童的整体死亡率降低了11%。

abstract.text: Auctions were very popular in the early days of internet commerce, but today online sellers mostly use posted prices. We model the choice between auctions and posted prices as a trade-off between competitive price discovery and convenience. Evidence from eBay fits the theory. We then show that the decline in auctions was not driven by compositional shifts in seller experience or items sold, but by changing seller incentives. We estimate the demand facing sellers and document falling sale probabilities and falling relative demand for auctions. Both favor posted prices; our estimates suggest the latter is more important for the auction decline. Survey evidence provides further support.

10.1086/695529.abstractZh: 在互联网商业的早期阶段，拍卖非常流行，但如今在线卖家大多使用标价销售。我们将拍卖与标价销售之间的选择建模为竞争性的价格发现和便利性之间的权衡。eBay的实证数据支持了这一理论。我们进一步指出，拍卖的衰落并非由卖家经验或销售物品类型的结构变化所驱动，而是由卖家激励的变化所导致。我们估算了卖家面临的需求，并记录了拍卖销售概率的下降以及相对需求的减少。这两种情况都更倾向于标价销售；我们的估计表明，后者对拍卖的衰落更为重要。调查数据进一步支持了我们的结论。

abstract.text: A randomized control trial with 432 small and medium enterprises in Mexico shows positive impact of access to 1 year of management consulting services on total factor productivity and return on assets. Owners also had an increase in “entrepreneurial spirit” (an index that measures entrepreneurial confidence and goal setting). Using Mexican social security data, we find a persistent large increase (about 50 percent) in the number of employees and total wage bill even 5 years after the program. We document large heterogeneity in the specific managerial practices that improved as a result of the consulting, with the most prominent being marketing, financial accounting, and long-term business planning.

10.1086/696154.abstractZh: 一项针对墨西哥432家小型和中型企业的随机对照试验表明，获得一年的管理咨询服务对全要素生产力和资产回报率有积极影响。企业主的“创业精神”也有所提升（该指数用于衡量创业信心和目标设定）。通过墨西哥社会保障数据，我们发现即使在项目结束5年后，员工数量和总工资额仍持续大幅增加，增幅约为50%。我们观察到，由于咨询带来的管理实践存在显著差异，其中市场营销、财务会计和长期业务规划方面的改进最为明显。

abstract.text: This paper documents how life cycle wage growth varies across countries. We harmonize repeated cross-sectional surveys from a set of countries of all income levels and then measure how wages rise with potential experience. Our main finding is that experience-wage profiles are on average twice as steep in rich countries as in poor countries. In addition, more educated workers have steeper profiles than the less educated; this accounts for around one-third of cross-country differences in aggregate profiles. Our findings are consistent with theories in which workers in poor countries accumulate less human capital or face greater search frictions over the life cycle.

10.1086/696225.abstractZh: 本文记录了不同国家中生命周期工资增长的变化情况。我们整合了来自多个国家、涵盖所有收入水平的重复横截面调查数据，然后测量工资随潜在经验的增长情况。我们的主要发现是，在富裕国家，经验与工资的关系曲线平均是贫穷国家的两倍陡峭。此外，受教育程度较高的工人其工资增长曲线比受教育程度较低的工人更为陡峭；这一因素解释了跨国间工资增长差异的约三分之一。我们的研究结果与某些理论一致，这些理论认为贫穷国家的工人积累的人力资本较少，或者在整个生命周期中面临更大的搜寻摩擦。

abstract.text: Redistribution programs in developing countries often "leak" because local officials do not implement programs as the central government intends. We study one approach to reducing leakage. In an experiment in over 550 villages, we test whether mailing cards with program information to targeted beneficiaries increases the subsidy they receive from a subsidized rice program. On net, beneficiaries received 26 percent more subsidy in card villages. Ineligible households received no less, so this represents substantially lower leakage.

10.1086/696226.abstractZh: 发展中国家的再分配计划常常出现“泄漏”现象，因为当地官员并未按照中央政府的意图执行这些计划。我们研究了一种减少泄漏的方法。在超过550个村庄进行的实验中，我们测试了向目标受益人邮寄计划信息卡片是否会增加他们从补贴大米计划中获得的补贴金额。结果显示，在实验村中，受益人的补贴金额增加了26%。而不符合条件的家庭所获得的补贴并未减少，因此这代表了显著较低的泄漏情况。

abstract.text: We quantify the effect of deliberation on the decisions of US appellate courts. We estimate a model in which strategic judges communicate before casting their votes and then compare the probability of mistakes in the court with deliberation with a counterfactual of no communication. The model has multiple equilibria, and preferences and information parameters are only partially identified. We find that there is a range of parameters in the identified set--when judges tend to disagree ex ante or their private information is imprecise--in which deliberation can be beneficial; otherwise, deliberation reduces the effectiveness of the court.

10.1086/696228.abstractZh: 我们量化了审议对美国上诉法院决策的影响。我们建立了一个模型，在该模型中，法官在投票前进行沟通，然后比较有审议情况下的错误概率与无沟通情况下的错误概率。该模型存在多个均衡状态，偏好和信息参数仅部分确定。我们发现，在已确定的参数范围内——当法官在事前存在分歧或他们的私人信息不精确时——审议可以带来益处；否则，审议会降低法院的效率。

abstract.text: We explore the consequence of quality unpredictability for the welfare benefit of new products, using recent developments in recorded music as our context. We quantify the effects of new music on welfare using an explicit structural model of demand and entry with potentially unpredictable product quality. On the basis of plausible forecasting models of expected appeal, a tripling of the choice set according to expected quality adds substantially more consumer surplus as the usual long-tail benefits from a tripling of the choice set according to realized quality.

10.1086/696229.abstractZh: 我们探讨了产品质量不可预测性对新产品福利影响的后果，以现代录音音乐产业的发展为案例进行研究。我们通过一个明确的需求与进入模型来量化新音乐对福利的影响，该模型考虑了可能不可预测的产品质量。基于合理的预测模型，我们发现，如果预期质量与实际质量相比增加了三倍，那么消费者剩余将大幅增加，因为实际质量与预期质量相比增加了三倍所带来的长期效益也会相应增加。

abstract.text: We show that supply-side financial shocks have a large impact on firms’ investment. We develop a new methodology to separate firm borrowing shocks from bank supply shocks using a vast sample of matched bank-firm lending data. We decompose aggregate loan movements in Japan for the period 1990–2010 into bank, firm, industry, and common shocks. The high degree of financial institution concentration means that individual banks are large relative to the size of the economy, which creates a role for granular shocks as in Gabaix’s (2011) study. We show that idiosyncratic granular bank supply shocks explain 30–40 percent of aggregate loan and investment fluctuations.

10.1086/696272.abstractZh: 我们表明，供给侧金融冲击对企业的投资有重大影响。我们开发了一种新的方法，利用大量匹配的银行-企业贷款数据，将企业借贷冲击与银行供应冲击区分开来。我们对1990至2010年间日本的整体贷款变动进行了分解，将其分解为银行、企业、行业和普遍冲击。由于金融机构的高度集中，单个银行相对于经济规模来说规模较大，这就使得细粒度的冲击变得重要，正如Gabaix在2011年的研究所示。我们发现，特定的银行供应冲击可以解释30%到40%的整体贷款和投资波动。

abstract.text: We revisit the Tiebout hypothesis in a world in which agents may learn extra information as to how they value the various local public goods once located, and jurisdictions are free to commit to whatever mechanism to attract citizens. It is shown in quasi-linear environments that efficiency can be achieved as a competitive equilibrium when jurisdictions seek to maximize local revenues but not necessarily when they seek to maximize local welfare. Interpretations and limitations of the result are discussed.

10.1086/696273.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了Tiebout假说，在这个世界中，个体可以获取更多关于他们对各种地方公共产品价值的评价信息，而各辖区可以自由选择任何机制来吸引公民。在准线性环境中，当各辖区寻求最大化地方收入时，可以实现效率作为竞争均衡，而当它们寻求最大化地方福利时则不一定如此。我们对这一结果的解释和局限性进行了讨论。

abstract.text: We investigate whether US government spending multipliers are higher during periods of economic slack or when interest rates are near the zero lower bound. Using new quarterly historical US data covering multiple large wars and deep recessions, we estimate multipliers that are below unity irrespective of the amount of slack in the economy. These results are robust to two leading identification schemes, two different estimation methodologies, and many alternative specifications. In contrast, the results are more mixed for the zero lower bound state, with a few specifications implying multipliers as high as 1.5.

10.1086/696277.abstractZh: 我们研究了在经济疲软时期或利率接近零下限时，美国政府支出的乘数是否会更高。利用涵盖多次大规模战争和严重经济衰退的新季度美国历史数据，我们发现无论经济中的疲软程度如何，乘数都低于1。这些结果对于两种主要的识别方案、两种不同的估计方法以及许多不同的模型设定都是稳健的。相比之下，在零下限状态下的结果则更为复杂，某些模型设定下的乘数甚至高达1.5。

abstract.text: Since the early 1990s, as the United States borrowed heavily from the rest of the world, employment in the US goods-producing sector has fallen. We construct a dynamic general equilibrium model with several mechanisms that could generate declining goods-sector employment: foreign borrowing, nonhomothetic preferences, and differential productivity growth across sectors. We find that only 15.1 percent of the decline in goods-sector employment from 1992 to 2012 stems from US trade deficits; most of the decline is due to differential productivity growth. As the United States repays its debt, its trade balance will reverse, but goods-sector employment will continue to fall.

10.1086/696279.abstractZh: 自20世纪90年代初以来，由于美国大量向其他国家借款，美国的商品生产部门的就业人数持续下降。我们构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，该模型包含多种可能导致商品部门就业下降的机制：外国借款、非同质偏好以及各部门之间生产率增长的差异。研究发现，从1992年到2012年，商品部门就业人数下降的15.1%是由美国贸易逆差引起的；而大部分下降是由于生产率增长的差异造成的。随着美国偿还债务，其贸易平衡将得到改善，但商品生产部门的就业人数仍将继续下降。

abstract.text: Collateral constraints widely used in models of financial crises feature a pecuniary externality: Agents do not internalize how borrowing decisions made in “good times” affect collateral prices during a crisis. We show that under commitment the optimal financial regulator’s plans are time inconsistent and study time-consistent policy. Quantitatively, this policy reduces sharply the frequency and magnitude of crises, removes fat tails from the distribution of asset returns, and increases social welfare. In contrast, constant debt taxes are ineffective and can be welfare reducing, while an optimized “macroprudential Taylor rule” is effective but less so than the optimal time-consistent policy.

10.1086/696280.abstractZh: 在金融危机模型中广泛使用的抵押约束具有金钱外部性特征：参与者并未将“好时期”的借贷决策对危机期间抵押品价格的影响内部化。我们指出，在承诺机制下，最优的金融监管机构政策存在时间不一致性，并研究了时间一致性的政策。从数量上看，这种政策显著降低了危机的频率和严重程度，消除了资产回报分布中的厚尾现象，并提升了社会福祉。相比之下，持续性的债务税政策无效，甚至可能降低社会福利；而优化的“宏观审慎泰勒规则”虽然有效，但其效果仍不如时间一致性的最优政策。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic spatial growth theory with realistic geography. We characterize the model and its balanced-growth path and propose a methodology to analyze equilibria with different levels of migration frictions. Different migration scenarios change local market size, innovation incentives, and the evolution of technology. We bring the model to the data for the whole world economy at a 1° × 1° geographic resolution. We then use the model to quantify the gains from relaxing migration restrictions. Our results indicate that fully liberalizing migration would increase welfare about threefold and would significantly affect the evolution of particular regions of the world.

10.1086/697084.abstractZh: 我们发展了一个具有现实地理特征的动态空间增长理论。我们对该模型及其均衡增长路径进行了描述，并提出了一种分析方法，用于研究不同迁移摩擦水平下的均衡状态。不同的迁移情景会改变当地市场规模、创新激励以及技术发展。我们将该模型应用于全球经济的地理数据，采用1°×1°的地理分辨率。随后，我们利用该模型量化了放宽迁移限制所带来的收益。我们的研究结果表明，完全放开迁移政策将使福利增加约三倍，并且会对世界特定地区的经济发展产生显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the extent to which tariff cooperation is observed among World Trade Organization members. With the help of a simple political economy model, we show that tariffs are positively correlated with the importer’s market power when they are set noncooperatively but negatively correlated when set cooperatively. We use this prediction to empirically identify the extent of cooperation in the WTO and find that more than three-quarters of WTO members’ tariffs are set noncooperatively.

10.1086/697085.abstractZh: 本文探讨了世界贸易组织成员国之间在关税合作方面的程度。通过一个简单的政治经济学模型，我们发现，当关税不是通过合作方式设定时，关税与进口商的市场力量呈正相关；而当关税通过合作方式设定时，两者则呈负相关。基于这一预测，我们通过实证分析确定了世界贸易组织中合作的程度，发现超过四分之三的成员国关税是未经合作方式设定的。

abstract.text: We study favoritism via hometown ties, a common source of favor exchange in China, in fellow selection of the Chinese Academies of Sciences and Engineering. Hometown ties to fellow selection committee members increase candidates’ election probability by 39 percent, coming entirely from the selection stage involving an in-person meeting. Elected hometown-connected candidates are half as likely to have a high-impact publication as elected fellows without connections. CAS/CAE membership increases the probability of university leadership appointments and is associated with a US$9.5 million increase in annual funding for fellows’ institutions, indicating that hometown favoritism has potentially large effects on resource allocation.

10.1086/697086.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过家乡关系进行的偏袒现象，这是中国科学界和工程界院士选拔中常见的偏袒来源。与院士委员会成员有家乡关系的人，其当选概率增加了39%，这一影响完全来自面对面会议这一选拔阶段。拥有家乡关系的当选院士，其发表高影响力论文的可能性是那些没有这种关系的院士的一半。中国科学院/中国工程院院士资格提升了大学领导职务的获得概率，并使得院士所在机构的年度资金增加950万美元，这表明家乡关系对资源分配有着巨大的影响。

abstract.text: Politicians may strategically time unpopular measures to coincide with newsworthy events that distract the media and the public. We test this hypothesis in the context of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. We find that Israeli attacks are more likely to occur when US news on the following day is dominated by important predictable events. Strategic timing applies to attacks that bear risk of civilian casualties and are not too costly to postpone. Content analysis suggests that Israel’s strategy aims at minimizing next-day coverage, which is especially charged with negative emotional content. Palestinian attacks do not appear to be timed to US news.

10.1086/697202.abstractZh: 政客们可能会战略性地选择时机，将不受欢迎的措施安排在具有新闻价值的事件期间，以此分散媒体和公众的注意力。我们在以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突的背景下对这一假设进行了测试。我们发现，当次日美国的头条新闻由重要的、可预测的事件主导时，以色列的攻击更有可能发生。这种战略性时机选择适用于那些存在平民伤亡风险且推迟成本不高的攻击。内容分析表明，以色列的策略旨在最小化第二天的报道量，尤其是那些带有负面情绪的报道。而巴勒斯坦的攻击似乎并没有按照美国新闻的节奏来安排。

abstract.text: We show that oil production from existing wells in Texas does not respond to oil prices, while drilling activity and costs respond strongly. To explain these facts, we reformulate Hotelling’s classic model of exhaustible resource extraction as a drilling problem: firms choose when to drill, but production from existing wells is constrained by reservoir pressure, which decays as oil is extracted. The model implies a modified Hotelling rule for drilling revenues net of costs, explains why the production constraint typically binds, and rationalizes regional production peaks and observed patterns of prices, drilling, and production following demand and supply shocks.

10.1086/697203.abstractZh: 我们指出，德克萨斯州现有油井的石油产量并不受油价的影响，而钻探活动和成本则表现出强烈的响应。为了解释这些现象，我们将霍特林的经典资源开采模型重新表述为钻探问题：企业选择何时进行钻探，但现有油井的产量受到储层压力的限制，这种压力会随着石油的提取而下降。该模型提出了一种修正后的霍特林规则，用于计算扣除成本后的钻探收入，并解释了为什么产量限制通常会起作用，同时解释了区域产量高峰以及价格、钻探和产量在需求与供应冲击后的变化规律。

abstract.text: Technological change can increase the productivity of the various factors of production in equal terms, or it can be biased toward a specific factor. We directly assess the bias of technological change by measuring, at the level of the individual firm, how much of it is labor augmenting and how much is factor neutral. To do so, we develop a framework for estimating production functions when productivity is multidimensional. Using panel data from Spain, we find that technological change is biased, with both its labor-augmenting and its factor-neutral components causing output to grow by about 1.5 percent per year.

10.1086/697204.abstractZh: 技术变革可以在同等条件下提高各种生产要素的生产力，或者它可能会偏向某一特定要素。我们通过衡量单个企业在技术变革中的偏向性来直接评估这种偏向性，即技术变革中多大程度上是劳动增强型的，又有多少是要素中性的。为此，我们开发了一个框架，用于在生产力是多维的情况下估算生产函数。利用西班牙的面板数据，我们发现技术变革存在偏向性，其劳动增强型和要素中性型成分分别使产出每年增长约1.5%。

abstract.text: I study intermediation via sequential bilateral bargaining in markets with a network structure. A partition of the network into layers captures intermediation power. Competition governs trade within layers, and hold-ups generate intermediation rents in transactions between layers. Each trader’s intermediation power reflects the competition among intermediation chains as measured by the number of layers separating the trader from buyers. Trade does not maximize welfare or minimize intermediation. The interplay between competition and hold-ups determines the level of inefficiency. Eliminating middlemen or transferring intermediation costs downstream increases seller profits. Downstream and upstream competition respond oppositely to either horizontal or vertical integration.

10.1086/697205.abstractZh: 我研究具有网络结构的市场中通过顺序双边谈判进行的中介行为。将网络划分为多个层次可以捕捉中介能力。层内的竞争决定了交易行为，而拖延行为则会在层与层之间的交易中产生中介租金。每个交易者的中介能力反映了中介链之间的竞争程度，这一竞争程度可以通过将交易者与买家分隔开的层次数量来衡量。交易行为并不会最大化福利或最小化中介成本。竞争与拖延行为之间的相互作用决定了低效率的水平。消除中间商或将中介成本转移给下游会增加卖方的利润。下游和上游的竞争对横向或纵向整合的反应则相反。

abstract.text: We propose an original model of human capital investments after leaving school in which individuals differ in their initial human capital obtained at school, their rates of return and costs of human capital investments, and their terminal values of human capital at an arbitrary date in the future. We derive a tractable reduced-form Mincerian model of log earnings profiles along the life cycle that is written as a linear factor model in which levels, growth, and curvature of earnings profiles are individual specific. This provides a structural interpretation of results obtained in the empirical literature on the dynamics of earnings and acknowledges its limitations.

10.1086/697206.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个原创的人力资本投资模型，该模型描述了个体在离开学校后的情况。模型中，个体在学校的初始人力资本水平、资本投资的回报率与成本，以及未来某个特定日期的人力资本终值都存在差异。我们推导出一个易于处理的简化形式Mincer模型，该模型描述了生命周期内对数收入曲线，并将其视为一个线性因子模型，其中收入曲线的水平、增长和曲率都是个体特有的。这一模型为实证文献中关于收入动态的研究成果提供了结构性的解释，同时也承认了这些研究的局限性。

abstract.text: House prices exhibit substantially more momentum, positive autocorrelation in price changes, than existing theories can explain. I introduce an amplification mechanism to reconcile this discrepancy. Sellers do not set a unilaterally high or low list price because they face a concave demand curve: increasing the price of an above-average-priced house rapidly reduces its sale probability, but cutting the price of a below-average-priced house only slightly improves its sale probability. The resulting strategic complementarity amplifies frictions because sellers gradually adjust their price to stay near average. I provide empirical evidence for concave demand using a quantitative search model that amplifies momentum two- to threefold.

10.1086/697207.abstractZh: 房价表现出比现有理论所能解释的更为明显的动量效应和价格变化的正自相关现象。我提出了一种放大机制来调和这一差异。卖家不会单方面设定过高或过低的挂牌价格，因为他们面临的是凹形需求曲线：将高于平均价格的房子的价格提高会迅速降低其销售可能性，而将低于平均价格的房子的价格降低则只会略微提高销售可能性。由此产生的战略互补性放大了摩擦效应，因为卖家会逐渐调整价格以保持在平均水平附近。我通过定量搜索模型提供了凹形需求的实证证据，该模型能够将房价动量的效应放大两到三倍。

abstract.text: We use a rich new body of data on the experiences of unemployed job seekers to determine the sources of wage dispersion and to create a search model consistent with the acceptance decisions the job seekers made. We identify the distributions of four key variables: offered wages, offered nonwage job values, job seekers' nonwork alternatives, and job seekers' personal productivities. We find that, conditional on personal productivity, the standard deviation of offered log wages is moderate, at 0.24, whereas the dispersion of the offered nonwage component is substantially larger, at 0.34. The resulting dispersion of offered job values is 0.38.

10.1086/697739.abstractZh: 我们利用大量关于失业求职者经历的新数据，来确定工资差异的来源，并构建一个与求职者决策相一致的搜索模型。我们确定了四个关键变量的分布：提供的工资、提供的非工资性工作价值、求职者可选择的非工作替代方案以及求职者的个人生产力。研究发现，在个人生产力不变的情况下，提供的工资对数的标准差为0.24，而提供的非工资性工作价值的分散度则明显更高，达到了0.34。因此，提供的非工资性工作价值的分散度为0.38。

abstract.text: Agents in two-sided matching games vary in characteristics that are unobservable in typical data on matching markets. We investigate the identification of the distribution of unobserved characteristics using data on who matches with whom. In full generality, we consider many-to-many matching and matching with trades. The distribution of match-specific unobservables cannot be fully recovered without information on unmatched agents, but the distribution of a combination of unobservables, which we call unobserved complementarities, can be identified. Using data on unmatched agents restores identification.

10.1086/697740.abstractZh: 在双边匹配游戏中，参与者的特征在典型的匹配市场数据中是不可观测的。我们研究了如何利用匹配双方的数据来识别这些不可观测特征的分布。在一般情况下，我们考虑的是多对多匹配以及涉及交易的匹配情况。如果没有未匹配参与者的信息，就无法完全恢复特定匹配情况下的不可观测特征分布，但我们可以识别出一组不可观测特征的联合分布，我们将其称为“不可观测互补性”。通过使用未匹配参与者的数据，我们可以恢复这种识别。

abstract.text: Revealed preference theory is brought to bear on the problem of recovering approximate parametric preferences from consistent and inconsistent consumer choices. We propose measures of the incompatibility between the revealed preference ranking implied by choices and the ranking induced by the considered parametric preferences. These incompatibility measures are proven to characterize well-known inconsistency indices. We advocate a recovery approach that is based on such incompatibility measures and demonstrate its applicability for misspecification measurement and model selection. Using an innovative experimental design, we empirically substantiate that the proposed revealed-preference-based method predicts choices significantly better than a standard distance-based method.

10.1086/697741.abstractZh: 揭示性偏好理论被应用于从一致性和非一致性消费者选择中恢复近似参数偏好的问题。我们提出了衡量选择所暗示的揭示性偏好排序与考虑的参数偏好所引导的排序之间不兼容性的指标。这些不兼容性指标被证明能够表征众所周知的不一致性指标。我们提倡一种基于这些不兼容性指标的恢复方法，并证明了其适用于错误规范度量和模型选择。通过创新的实验设计，我们实证验证了所提出的基于揭示性偏好的方法在预测选择方面明显优于基于标准距离的方法。

abstract.text: We employ a unique data set on members of an elite service club in Germany to investigate how social connections in elite networks affect the allocation of resources. Specifically, we investigate credit allocation decisions of banks to firms inside the network. Using a quasi-experimental research design, we document misallocation of bank credit inside the network, with bankers with weakly aligned incentives engaging most actively in crony lending. Our findings, thus, resonate with existing theories of elite networks as rent extractive coalitions that stifle economic prosperity.

10.1086/697742.abstractZh: 我们采用德国一个精英服务俱乐部的独特数据集，研究精英网络中的社交关系如何影响资源的分配。具体来说，我们研究了银行对网络内企业的信贷分配决策。通过准实验研究设计，我们发现网络内银行信贷存在分配不当的情况，那些激励机制较弱的银行家最为活跃地参与裙带式贷款。因此，我们的发现与现有关于精英网络作为抑制经济繁荣的租金提取联盟的理论相吻合。

abstract.text: We build a tractable growth model in which multiproduct incumbents invest in internal innovations to improve their existing products, while new entrants and incumbents invest in external innovations to acquire new product lines. External and internal innovations generate heterogeneous innovation qualities, and firm size affects innovation incentives. We analyze how different types of innovation contribute to economic growth and the role of the firm size distribution. Our model aligns with many observed empirical regularities, and we quantify our framework with Census Bureau and patent data for US firms. Internal innovation scales moderately faster with firm size than external innovation.

10.1086/697901.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个可行的增长模型，在该模型中，多产品领域的现有企业会投资于内部创新以改进现有产品，而新进入者和现有企业则投资于外部创新以开发新的产品线。外部和内部创新会产生不同的创新质量，企业规模也会影响创新的激励因素。我们分析了不同类型创新对经济增长的贡献，以及企业规模分布的作用。我们的模型与许多观察到的经验规律相一致，并且我们通过美国企业的人口普查局和专利数据来量化我们的框架。与外部创新相比，内部创新的规模随企业规模的扩大而适度更快地增长。

abstract.text: We study multiproduct firms in the contexts of unregulated monopoly, regulated monopoly, and Cournot oligopoly. Using the concept of consumer surplus as a function of quantities (rather than prices), we present simple formulas for optimal prices and show that Cournot equilibrium exists and corresponds to a Ramsey optimum. We then discuss a tractable class of preferences that involve a generalized form of homotheticity. Profit-maximizing quantities are proportional to efficient quantities. We discuss optimal monopoly regulation when the firm has private information about its cost vector and find situations in which optimal regulation leaves relative price decisions to the firm.

10.1086/697902.abstractZh: 我们研究了在不受监管的垄断、受监管的垄断以及库诺尔寡头垄断情境下的多产品企业。通过以数量而非价格作为消费者剩余的函数这一概念，我们提出了最优价格的计算公式，并证明库诺尔均衡确实存在，且对应于拉姆齐最优解。接着，我们讨论了一类涉及广义同质性偏好问题的可处理情况。利润最大化数量与有效数量成正比。我们还探讨了当企业对其成本向量有私人信息时的最优垄断监管问题，并发现了在某些情况下，最优监管方案会由企业自行决定相对价格。

abstract.text: I argue that firms use referrals from current workers to mitigate a moral hazard problem. I develop a model in which referrals relax a limited liability constraint by allowing the firm to punish the referral provider if the recipient has low output. I test the model’s predictions using household survey data that I collected in Bangladesh. I can control for correlated wage shocks within a network and correlated unobserved type between the recipient and provider. I reject the testable implications of models in which referrals help firms select unobservably good workers or are solely a nonwage benefit to providers.

10.1086/697903.abstractZh: 我认为，企业利用现有员工的推荐来缓解道德风险问题。我构建了一个模型，该模型通过允许企业在推荐者表现不佳时对其进行惩罚，从而缓解有限责任约束。我使用在孟加拉国收集的家庭调查数据来验证该模型的预测结果。我可以控制网络内相关工资冲击以及推荐者与推荐者之间的相关未观测类型差异。我否定了那些认为推荐有助于企业选择表现不佳的员工或仅仅是推荐者获得非工资福利的模型中的可检验结论。

abstract.text: The increasing availability of data derived from linked consumer financial accounts has the potential to dramatically expand the potential for research. Examining the most comprehensive existing set of linked-account data, consisting of transaction and balance sheet data for millions of Americans, I demonstrate the power and versatility of such sources. I discuss advantages and concerns arising from this type of data and match a range of distributional moments to external sources. As one application, I test consumption elasticities across households with varying levels, and types, of debt. I find that heterogeneity in consumption elasticity can be explained entirely by credit and liquidity.

10.1086/698106.abstractZh: 来自关联消费者金融账户的数据日益丰富，这为研究提供了巨大的扩展潜力。通过对现有最全面的关联账户数据集进行分析，该数据集包含了数百万美国人的交易和资产负债表数据，我展示了这类数据的强大性和多功能性。我讨论了这类数据带来的优势与问题，并将一系列分布统计量与外部数据源进行了对比。作为一个应用实例，我测试了不同债务水平和类型的家庭之间的消费弹性。我发现，消费弹性的差异完全可以由信贷和流动性因素来解释。

abstract.text: This paper defines the power of a media organization as its ability to induce voters to make electoral decisions they would not make if reporting were unbiased. It derives a robust upper bound to media power over a range of assumptions about the beliefs and attention patterns of voters. The paper then presents estimates of the power index for the United States and shows how these can inform merger analysis and other policy debates.

10.1086/698107.abstractZh: 本文将媒体组织的力量定义为其促使选民做出那些在报道无偏见的情况下不会做出的选举决策的能力。文章基于一系列关于选民信念和注意力模式的假设，推导出了媒体力量的一个稳健上限。随后，文章对美国媒体的力量指数进行了估算，并展示了这些指数如何为合并分析和其他政策讨论提供参考。

abstract.text: Experimental economists currently lack a convention for how to pay subjects in experiments with multiple tasks. We provide a theoretical framework for analyzing this question. Assuming statewise monotonicity and nothing else, we prove that paying for one randomly chosen problem--the random problem selection mechanism--is essentially the only incentive compatible mechanism. Paying for every period is similarly justified when we assume only a "no complementarities at the top" condition. To help experimenters decide which is appropriate for their particular experiment, we discuss empirical tests of these two assumptions.

10.1086/698136.abstractZh: 实验经济学家目前缺乏关于如何在包含多个任务的实验中向受试者支付报酬的规范。我们提供了一个理论框架来分析这个问题。假设只有状态间的单调性，没有其他条件，我们证明了为随机选出的一个问题支付报酬，实际上是唯一符合激励相容性的机制。当仅假设“顶层不存在互补性”时，为每个周期支付报酬也是合理的。为了帮助实验者决定哪种方法适合他们的具体实验，我们讨论了这两个假设的实证检验。

abstract.text: We develop an equilibrium life cycle model of education, marriage, labor supply, and consumption in a transferable utility context. Individuals start by choosing their investments in education anticipating returns in the marriage market and the labor market. They then match on the basis of the economic value of marriage and preferences. Equilibrium in the marriage market determines intrahousehold allocation of resources. Following marriage households (married or single) save, supply labor, and consume private and public commodities under uncertainty. Marriage thus has the dual role of providing public goods and offering risk sharing. The model is estimated using the British Household Panel Survey.

10.1086/698748.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个关于教育、婚姻、劳动力供给和消费的均衡生命周期模型，该模型基于可转移效用理论。个体首先选择教育投资，期望在婚姻市场和劳动力市场中获得回报。随后，他们根据婚姻的经济价值和个人偏好进行匹配。婚姻市场的均衡决定了家庭内部资源的分配。已婚或单身的家庭在不确定性下进行储蓄、提供劳动力以及消费私人和公共商品。因此，婚姻具有提供公共产品和分担风险双重作用。该模型采用英国家庭面板调查数据进行了估计。

abstract.text: We analyze how insurance arrangements, labor supply, moral hazard, and outright cheating are affected by social norms. One question is under what conditions norms may improve social welfare. Another is under what conditions people should be allowed to opt out of social insurance. We introduce an informal production sector to analyze the consequences of alternative assumptions about the information available to norm enforcers. This highlights one important aspect of norms, namely, that they may compensate for the insurer’s limited information.

10.1086/698749.abstractZh: 我们分析了保险安排、劳动力供应、道德风险以及直接欺诈如何受到社会规范的影响。其中一个问题是，在什么条件下，社会规范能够提升社会福利。另一个问题是，在什么情况下，人们应该被允许选择不参加社会保险。我们引入了一个非正式的生产部门来分析关于规范执行者所掌握信息的不同假设所带来的后果。这凸显了规范的一个重要方面，即它们可以弥补保险公司的信息有限性。

abstract.text: Entrepreneurship requires energy and creativity as well as business acumen. Some factors that contribute to entrepreneurship decline with age, but business skills increase with experience in high-level positions. Having too many older workers in society slows entrepreneurship. When older workers occupy key positions, they block younger workers from acquiring skills. A theory is formulated and tested using the Global Entrepreneurship Monitor data. A one standard deviation decrease in a country’s median age increases new business formation by 2.5 percentage points, which is about 40 percent of the mean rate. Furthermore, older societies have lower rates of entrepreneurship at every age.

10.1086/698750.abstractZh: 创业需要精力、创造力以及商业头脑。虽然一些对创业有贡献的因素会随着年龄的增长而下降，但担任高级职位时的商业技能则会随着经验的增加而提升。社会中老年工人过多会减缓创业活动的发展。当老年工人占据关键职位时，他们会阻碍年轻工人获得相关技能。本文利用全球创业监测数据构建并测试了这一理论。一个国家中位年龄每下降一个标准差，新企业成立的数量就会增加2.5个百分点，这大约相当于平均水平的40%。此外，老年社会在各个年龄段的创业率都较低。

abstract.text: We study choices of households deciding on consumption and allocation of spouses' time to work, leisure, and child care. With uncertainty, the allocation of goods and time over the life cycle also serves the purpose of smoothing marginal utility in response to shocks. Combining data on consumption, wages, hours of work, and time spent with children, we compute the sensitivity of consumption and time allocation to transitory and permanent wage shocks. We find that family labor supply responses depend on three counteracting forces: complementarity of leisure time, substitutability of time in the production of child services, and added worker effects.

10.1086/698752.abstractZh: 我们研究了家庭在消费决策以及分配配偶时间用于工作、休闲和育儿方面的选择。由于存在不确定性，生命周期内商品和时间的分配还起到平滑边际效用的作用，以应对冲击。结合消费、工资、工作时间和与子女相处时间的数据，我们计算了消费和时间分配对短暂性和永久性工资冲击的敏感性。我们发现，家庭劳动力供给的反应取决于三种相互制衡的力量：休闲时间的互补性、时间在生产子女服务中的可替代性，以及额外工人的效应。

abstract.text: We study the link between market forces, cross-sectional inequality, and intergenerational mobility. Emphasizing complementarities in the production of human capital, we show that wealthy parents invest, on average, more in their offspring than poorer ones. As a result, economic status persists across generations even in a world with perfect capital markets and without differences in innate ability. In fact, under certain conditions, successive generations of the same family may cease to regress toward the mean. We also consider how short- and long-run mobility are affected by changes in the returns to human capital.

10.1086/698759.abstractZh: 我们研究了市场力量、横截面不平等与代际流动性的关系。强调人力资本生产的互补性，我们发现富裕的父母平均而言会为子女投入更多的资源。因此，即使在一个资本市场完善且没有先天能力差异的世界中，经济状况仍会延续到下一代。事实上，在某些条件下，同一家族的连续几代人可能不再向平均水平回归。我们还研究了人力资本回报的变化对短期和长期流动性产生的影响。

abstract.text: This paper estimates returns to education using a dynamic model of educational choice that synthesizes approaches in the structural dynamic discrete choice literature with approaches used in the reduced form treatment effect literature. It is an empirically robust middle ground between the two approaches which estimates economically interpretable and policy-relevant dynamic treatment effects that account for heterogeneity in cognitive and non-cognitive skills and the continuation values of educational choices. Graduating college is not a wise choice for all. Ability bias is a major component of observed educational differentials. For some, there are substantial causal effects of education at all stages of schooling.

10.1086/698760.abstractZh: 本文采用动态教育选择模型来估算教育回报，该模型结合了结构动态离散选择文献中的方法和简化形式处理效应文献中的方法。这是一种在两种方法之间的实证稳健折中方案，能够估算出经济可解释且具有政策相关性的动态处理效应，同时考虑到认知和非认知技能的异质性以及教育选择的持续价值。对于所有人来说，从大学毕业并非明智之选。能力偏差是观察到的教育差异的主要组成部分。对于某些人来说，教育的效果在教育的各个阶段都存在显著的因果效应。

abstract.text: We evaluate the impact of a randomized educational intervention on children's intertemporal choices. The intervention aims to improve the ability to imagine future selves and encourages forward-looking behavior using a structured curriculum delivered by children's own trained teachers. We find that treated students make more patient intertemporal decisions in incentivized experimental tasks. The results persist almost 3 years after the intervention, replicate well in a different sample, and are robust across different experimental elicitation methods. The effects also extend beyond experimental outcomes: we find that treated students are significantly less likely to receive a low "behavior grade."

10.1086/699007.abstractZh: 我们评估了随机教育干预对儿童跨时选择的影响。该干预旨在提高儿童想象未来自我的能力，并通过由儿童自己培训的教师提供的结构化课程来鼓励前瞻性行为。我们发现，接受干预的学生在激励性实验任务中做出了更耐心的跨时决策。这些结果在干预后几乎持续了3年，并且在不同的样本中得到良好复制，且在不同实验方法下依然保持稳定。这些效应还超出了实验结果的范围：我们发现，接受干预的学生获得低“行为评分”的可能性显著降低。

abstract.text: Teachers affect a variety of student outcomes through their influence on both cognitive and noncognitive skill. I proxy for students’ noncognitive skill using non–test score behaviors. These behaviors include absences, suspensions, course grades, and grade repetition in ninth grade. Teacher effects on test scores and those on behaviors are weakly correlated. Teacher effects on behaviors predict larger impacts on high school completion and other longer-run outcomes than their effects on test scores. Relative to using only test score measures, using effects on both test score and noncognitive measures more than doubles the variance of predictable teacher impacts on longer-run outcomes.

10.1086/699018.abstractZh: 教师通过影响学生的认知和非认知技能，对多种学生成果产生影响。我采用非测试成绩行为来代表学生的非认知技能。这些行为包括缺勤、停学、课程成绩以及九年级的留级情况。教师对测试成绩的影响与对行为的影响之间的相关性较弱。教师对行为的影响在预测高中毕业及其他长期成果方面，比其对测试成绩的影响更为显著。与仅使用测试成绩指标相比，同时考虑测试成绩和非认知指标时，教师对长期成果的影响预测范围将增加一倍多。

abstract.text: We develop a model of consumption and income that allows for pervasive heterogeneity in the parameters of both processes. Introducing codependence between household income parameters and preference parameters, we also allow for heterogeneity in the impact of income shocks on consumption. We estimate the parameters of the model using a sample from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, covering the period 1968–2009. We find considerable codependent heterogeneity in the parameters governing income and consumption processes. Our results suggest a great deal of heterogeneity in the reaction of consumption to income shocks, highlighting the heterogeneity in the self-insurance available to households.

10.1086/699186.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个消费和收入模型，该模型允许这两个过程的参数具有广泛的异质性。通过引入家庭收入参数与偏好参数之间的相互依赖性，我们还允许收入冲击对消费的影响具有异质性。我们使用“收入动态面板研究”中的样本数据来估计模型的参数，这些数据涵盖了1968年至2009年的时期。我们发现，控制收入和消费过程的参数存在显著的相互依赖性异质性。我们的研究结果表明，消费对收入冲击的反应具有很大的异质性，这凸显了家庭可获得的自我保险机制的异质性。

abstract.text: We model criminal investigation as a principal-agent-monitor problem in which the agent can bribe the monitor to destroy evidence. Building on insights from Laffont and Martimort’s 1997 paper, we study whether the principal can profitably introduce asymmetric information between agent and monitor by randomizing the monitor’s incentives. We show that it can be the case, but the optimality of random incentives depends on unobserved preexisting patterns of private information. We provide a data-driven framework for policy evaluation requiring only unverified reports. A potential local policy change is an improvement if, everything else equal, it is associated with greater reports of crime.

10.1086/699188.abstractZh: 我们将刑事调查建模为一个委托-代理-监控问题，其中代理人可以贿赂监控人员以销毁证据。基于Laffont和Martimort在1997年的研究见解，我们探讨了委托人是否可以通过随机化监控人员的激励措施，在代理人和监控人员之间引入不对称信息，从而获得利润。我们证明这是可能的，但随机激励措施的最优性取决于未观察到的私人信息模式。我们提供了一个数据驱动的评估政策框架，该框架仅需要未经验证的报告。如果其他条件不变，潜在的局部政策变化如果伴随着更多的犯罪报告，则被视为一种改进。

abstract.text: Concave hiring rules imply that firms respond more to bad shocks than to good shocks. They provide a unified explanation for several seemingly unrelated facts about employment growth in macro- and microdata. In particular, they generate countercyclical movement in both aggregate conditional “macro” volatility and cross-sectional “micro” volatility, as well as negative skewness in the cross section and in the time series at different levels of aggregation. Concave establishment-level responses of employment growth to total factor productivity shocks estimated from census data induce significant skewness, movements in volatility, and amplification of bad aggregate shocks.

10.1086/699189.abstractZh: 凹形招聘规则意味着企业对负面冲击的反应比对正面冲击的反应更为敏感。这些规则为宏观数据和微观数据中几个看似无关的事实提供了统一的解释。具体而言，它们导致总体条件“宏观”波动和横截面“微观”波动都出现反周期变动，并且在不同层次的聚合中，横截面和时间序列都表现出负偏度。从人口普查数据估计出的就业增长对全要素生产率冲击的凹形响应，会导致显著的偏度、波动变化以及负面总体冲击的放大。

abstract.text: Top income inequality rose sharply in the United States over the last 40 years but increased only slightly in France and Japan. Why? We explore a model in which heterogeneous entrepreneurs, broadly interpreted, exert effort to generate exponential growth in their incomes, which tends to raise inequality. Creative destruction by outside innovators restrains this expansion and induces top incomes to obey a Pareto distribution. Economic forces that affect these two mechanisms—including information technology, taxes, and policies related to innovation blocking—may explain the varied patterns of top income inequality that we see in the data.

10.1086/699190.abstractZh: 在过去40年里，美国的收入不平等程度急剧上升，而法国和日本的收入不平等程度则仅略有增加。为什么会这样呢？我们探讨了一个模型，该模型认为，不同背景的企业家会努力实现收入的指数级增长，而这往往会导致不平等的加剧。外部创新者的创造性破坏则限制了这种扩张，使得高收入人群的分布呈现出帕累托分布特征。影响这两种机制的经济因素——包括信息技术、税收以及与创新限制相关的政策——可能解释了数据中观察到的不同收入不平等模式。

abstract.text: This paper examines the extent to which government audits of public resources can reduce corruption by enhancing political and judiciary accountability. We do so in the context of Brazil’s anticorruption program, which randomly audits municipalities for their use of federal funds. We find that being audited in the past reduces future corruption by 8 percent, while also increasing the likelihood of experiencing a subsequent legal action by 20 percent. We interpret these reduced-form findings through a political agency model, which we structurally estimate. Our results suggest that the reduction in corruption comes mostly from the audits increasing the perceived nonelectoral costs of engaging in corruption.

10.1086/699209.abstractZh: 本文探讨了政府对公共资源的审计在多大程度上能够通过增强政治和司法问责制来减少腐败。我们以巴西的反腐败计划为背景进行分析，该计划随机对市政当局使用联邦资金的情况进行审计。研究发现，过去曾接受过审计的市政当局，未来发生腐败的可能性降低8%，同时遭遇后续法律诉讼的可能性也增加了20%。我们通过政治代理模型对这些结果进行解释，并对该模型进行了结构性估计。我们的结果表明，腐败的减少主要源于审计提高了人们认为参与腐败所带来的非选举成本。

abstract.text: We explore how television broadcasting of unrelated criminal justice events affects sentencing. Exploiting as-good-as-random variation in news content before a verdict, we find that sentences are 3 months longer when the verdict is reached after coverage of crime. Sentences increase with media exposure to crime, not crime itself, and the effect tapers off quickly. Our results suggest that professional experience and expertise mitigate the effect of irrelevant external information. This paper highlights the influence of noise in the news cycle: media can temporarily influence decisions by changing what is top of the mind rather than signaling deeper changes in offending or societal concerns.

10.1086/699210.abstractZh: 我们探讨了电视报道与刑事司法事件无关的内容对量刑的影响。通过利用判决前新闻内容的“似好似随机”变化，我们发现，当犯罪事件被报道后判决作出时，刑期会延长3个月。刑期随着媒体对犯罪的报道而增加，而非犯罪本身；这种影响很快会减弱。我们的研究结果表明，专业经验和专业知识能够减轻无关外部信息的影响。本文强调了新闻周期中“噪声”的作用：媒体可以通过改变人们脑海中首要关注的内容来暂时影响决策，而不是传达犯罪或社会问题的深层变化。

abstract.text: Buyers often search across sellers to learn which product best fits their needs. We study how sellers manage these search incentives through their disclosure strategies (e.g., product trials, reviews, and recommendations) and ask how competition affects information provision. If sellers can observe the beliefs of buyers or can coordinate their strategies, then there is an equilibrium in which sellers provide the "monopoly level" of information. In contrast, if buyers' beliefs are private, then there is an equilibrium in which sellers provide full information as search costs vanish. Anonymity and coordination thus play important roles in understanding how advice markets work.

10.1086/699211.abstractZh: 买家通常会在多个卖家之间搜索，以找出最适合他们需求的产品。我们研究了卖家如何通过披露策略（如产品试用、评价和推荐）来管理这些搜索激励，并探讨了竞争如何影响信息的提供。如果卖家能够了解买家的信念或协调他们的策略，那么就会存在一个卖家提供“垄断级”信息的均衡状态。相反，如果买家的信念是私密的，那么就会存在一个卖家提供完整信息的均衡状态，因为搜索成本消失了。因此，匿名性和协调在理解咨询市场运作方式方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: We examine how a 16-week cut in potential unemployment insurance (UI) duration in Missouri affected search behavior of UI recipients and the aggregate labor market. Using a regression discontinuity design (RDD), we estimate marginal effects of maximum duration on UI and nonemployment spells of 0.45 and 0.25, respectively. We simulate the unemployment rate implied by the RDD estimates assuming no market-level externalities. The implied response closely approximates the decline in the unemployment rate following the benefit cut, suggesting that, even in a period of high unemployment, the labor market absorbed the influx of workers without crowding out other job seekers.

10.1086/699973.abstractZh: 我们研究了密苏里州将潜在失业保险期限缩短16周对失业保险领取者及整体劳动力市场搜索行为的影响。通过回归不连续设计（RDD）方法，我们估计了失业保险最长期限对非就业期的边际效应分别为0.45和0.25。在假设不存在市场层面的外部性情况下，我们模拟了RDD估计所推断出的失业率变化。模拟结果与失业保险期限缩短后失业率的下降情况非常接近，这表明即使在高失业率时期，劳动力市场也能吸收新增劳动力，而不会挤占其他求职者的机会。

abstract.text: We show that in the presence of admissions reserves, the effect of the precedence order (i.e., the order in which different types of seats are filled) is comparable to the effect of adjusting reserve sizes. Either lowering the precedence of reserve seats at a school or increasing the school’s reserve size weakly increases reserve-group assignment at that school. Using data from Boston Public Schools, we show that reserve and precedence adjustments have similar quantitative effects. Transparency about these issues—in particular, how precedence unintentionally undermined intended policy—led to the elimination of walk zone reserves in Boston’s public school match.

10.1086/699974.abstractZh: 我们表明，在存在招生储备的情况下，优先顺序的影响（即不同类型座位被填饱的顺序）与调整储备规模的效果相当。无论是降低某学校的储备席位的优先顺序，还是增加该学校的储备规模，都会对该学校内的储备群体分配产生微弱的影响。利用波士顿公立学校的数据，我们发现储备和优先顺序的调整在数量上具有相似的效果。对这些问题的透明度——特别是优先顺序如何无意中破坏了原本的政策目标——促使波士顿公立学校比赛取消了步行区储备制度。

abstract.text: It is conventional wisdom that transparency in cartels--monitoring of competitors' prices, sales, and profits--facilitates collusion. However, in several recent cases cartels have instead worked to preserve the privacy of their participants' actions and outcomes. Toward explaining this behavior, we show that cartels can sometimes sustain higher profits when actions and outcomes are observed only privately, because better information can hinder collusion by helping firms devise more profitable deviations from the collusive agreement. We provide conditions under which maintaining privacy is optimal for cartels that follow a market-segmentation strategy.

10.1086/699975.abstractZh: 传统观点认为，卡特尔中的透明度——即对竞争对手的价格、销售和利润进行监控——会促进勾结行为。然而，在最近的一些案例中，卡特尔反而努力保护参与者的行为及结果的隐私性。为了解释这种行为，我们发现，当行为和结果仅被私下观察时，卡特尔有时能够维持更高的利润，因为更好的信息可以阻碍勾结行为，帮助企业设计出更有利可图的偏离勾结协议的行为。我们提出了一些条件，在这些条件下，对于遵循市场分割策略的卡特尔来说，保持隐私是最优选择。

abstract.text: We analyze how academic experts and nonexperts forecast the results of 15 piece-rate and behavioral treatments in a real-effort task. The average forecast of experts closely predicts the experimental results, with a strong wisdom-of-crowds effect: the average forecast outperforms 96 percent of individual forecasts. Citations, academic rank, field, and contextual experience do not correlate with accuracy. Experts as a group do better than nonexperts, but not if accuracy is defined as rank-ordering treatments. Measures of effort, confidence, and revealed ability are predictive of forecast accuracy to some extent and allow us to identify “superforecasters” among the nonexperts.

10.1086/699976.abstractZh: 我们分析了学术专家和非专家如何预测15种计件工资和基于行为的处理方式在真实努力任务中的结果。专家的平均预测结果与实验结果高度一致，表现出强烈的群体智慧效应：专家的平均预测结果优于96%的个人预测。引用次数、学术地位、研究领域以及背景经验与预测准确性并无关联。作为群体的专家表现优于非专家，但如果以排名来定义准确性，则情况并非如此。努力程度、信心以及显露出的能力等指标在某种程度上能够预测预测准确性，并使我们能够在非专家中识别出“超级预测者”。

abstract.text: This paper estimates a model of the effort decisions of students and teachers in a classroom setting to understand the performance of Mexican high school students on curriculum-based examinations. The model allows for student heterogeneity in initial mathematics preparation and knowledge preference and for teacher heterogeneity in instructional ability and preferences for student knowledge. Survey data include multiple measurements of student and teacher effort, student and teacher preferences, student initial knowledge, and teacher ability. The most important factor accounting for poor performance, the lack of sufficient prior preparation, suggests a mismatch between the curriculum content and entering grade-level mathematics knowledge.

10.1086/699977.abstractZh: 本文建立了一个模型，用于分析学生在课堂环境中的努力决策，以了解墨西哥高中学生在基于课程的标准考试中的表现。该模型考虑了学生在数学基础知识和知识偏好方面的异质性，以及教师在教学能力和对学生知识需求的偏好方面的异质性。调查数据包括对学生和教师努力程度的多维度测量、学生和教师的偏好、学生的初始知识水平以及教师的能力。导致表现不佳的最重要因素是缺乏足够的预备知识，这表明课程内容与进入相应年级的数学知识之间存在不匹配。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a new methodology for analyzing nonlinear pricing data. We establish identification of the model primitives with a known tariff and characterize the model restrictions on observables. We propose a quantile-based nonparametric estimator that achieves consistency at the parametric rate. We introduce unobserved product heterogeneity with an unknown tariff and show how our identification and estimation results extend. A Monte Carlo study analyzes the robustness of our methodology to menus of two-part tariffs. Analysis of cellular service data assesses the performance of various pricing strategies. We discuss extensions to network effects, multiproduct firms, bundling, differentiated products, and oligopolies.

10.1086/699978.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种分析非线性定价数据的新方法。我们建立了具有已知关税的模型原语的识别方法，并描述了模型对可观测变量的限制。我们提出了一种基于分位数的非参数估计方法，该方法在参数率上实现了一致性。我们引入了具有未知关税的未观测产品异质性，并展示了我们的识别与估计结果如何扩展。蒙特卡洛研究分析了我们的方法对两部分定价方案的鲁棒性。对蜂窝服务数据的分析评估了各种定价策略的性能。我们还讨论了对网络效应、多产品企业、捆绑销售、差异化产品和寡头垄断的扩展应用。

abstract.text: We examine heterogeneous treatment effects of a universal child care program in Germany by exploiting variation in attendance caused by a reform that led to a large expansion staggered across municipalities. Drawing on novel administrative data from the full population of compulsory school entry examinations, we find that children with lower (observed and unobserved) gains are more likely to select into child care than children with higher gains. Children from disadvantaged backgrounds are less likely to attend child care than children from advantaged backgrounds but have larger treatment effects because of their worse outcome when not enrolled in child care.

10.1086/699979.abstractZh: 我们研究了德国一项通用儿童保育计划的不同处理效应，通过利用因改革导致各市镇实施儿童保育的时间安排出现差异这一现象，来研究其效果。基于强制性入学考试的完整人口数据，我们发现，收益较低（无论是实际观察到的还是未观察到的）的儿童比收益较高的儿童更有可能选择参加儿童保育。来自弱势背景的儿童比来自优势背景的儿童更不可能参加儿童保育，但由于没有参加儿童保育会导致更差的结果，因此他们的处理效应更大。

abstract.text: This paper models decisions to apply to and attend charter schools in Boston using a generalized Roy selection framework linking preferences to the achievement gains generated by charter attendance. The model is estimated with instruments based on randomized admission lotteries and distance to charter schools. Charter schools generate larger gains for disadvantaged students, but demand for charters is stronger among more advantaged students. Similarly, gains are inversely related to unobserved preferences for charters. As a result, counterfactual simulations indicate that charter expansion is likely to be most effective when accompanied by efforts to target students who are unlikely to apply.

10.1086/699980.abstractZh: 本文使用广义的Roy选择框架来模拟波士顿地区对特许学校的申请和就读决策，将偏好与特许学校带来的学业收益联系起来。模型基于随机录取彩票和距离特许学校的距离作为工具变量进行估计。特许学校为弱势学生带来更大的收益，但优势学生对特许学校的需求更为强烈。同样，收益与未观察到的对特许学校的偏好呈负相关。因此，反事实模拟表明，当同时采取措施针对那些不太可能申请特许学校的学生时，特许学校的扩展效果最为显著。

abstract.text: A nudge is a paternalistic government intervention that attempts to improve choices by changing the framing of a decision problem. We propose a welfare-theoretic foundation for nudging similar in spirit to the classical revealed preference approach, by investigating a framework in which preferences and mistakes of an agent can be elicited from her choices under different frames. We provide characterizations of the classes of behavioral models in which the information required for nudging can or cannot be deduced from choice data.

10.1086/700072.abstractZh: “助推”是一种以家长式态度进行的政府干预措施，其目的是通过改变决策问题的表述方式来改善人们的选择。我们提出了一种基于福利理论的基础框架来研究“助推”现象，这一框架与经典的揭示偏好方法类似。该框架通过研究在不同框架下，代理人的偏好和错误如何被引出，从而为“助推”提供了理论依据。我们还描述了那些在“助推”过程中所需信息可以从选择数据中推导出来的行为模型类别，以及那些无法从选择数据中推导出所需信息的模型类别。

abstract.text: We show how data from online social networking services can help researchers better understand the effects of social interactions on economic decision making. We combine anonymized data from Facebook, the largest online social network, with housing transaction data and explore both the structure and the effects of social networks. Individuals whose geographically distant friends experienced larger recent house price increases are more likely to transition from renting to owning. They also buy larger houses and pay more for a given house. Survey data show that these relationships are driven by the effects of social interactions on individuals' housing market expectations.

10.1086/700073.abstractZh: 我们展示了来自在线社交网络服务的数据如何帮助研究人员更好地理解社交互动对经济决策的影响。我们将脸书这一最大的在线社交网络提供的匿名数据，与房屋交易数据相结合，来探讨社交网络的结构及其影响。那些地理位置上距离较远的朋友最近房价上涨幅度较大的个体，更有可能从租赁转变为拥有房产。他们还会购买更大的房屋，并且为同一房屋支付更高的价格。调查数据表明，这些关系是由社交互动对个体房屋市场预期的影响所驱动的。

abstract.text: This paper studies how interest groups allocate campaign contributions when congressmen are connected by social ties. We establish conditions for the existence of a unique Nash equilibrium in pure strategies for the contribution game and characterize the associated allocation of the interest groups’ moneys. While the allocations are generally complex functions of the environment (the voting function, the legislators’ preferences, and the social network topology), they are simple, monotonically increasing functions of the respective legislators’ Katz-Bonacich centralities. Using data on the 109th–113th Congresses and on congressmen’s alumni connections, we estimate the model and find evidence supporting its predictions.

10.1086/700074.abstractZh: 本文研究了当国会议员之间存在社会联系时，利益集团如何分配竞选捐款。我们确定了纯策略下唯一纳什均衡存在的条件，并描述了利益集团资金分配的具体方式。虽然这些分配结果通常是环境因素（如投票函数、立法者的偏好以及社交网络拓扑结构）的复杂函数，但它们实际上是各立法者Katz-Bonacich中心性的简单且单调递增的函数。通过利用第109届至第113届国会的资料以及国会议员的校友关系数据，我们对模型进行了估计，并发现了支持其预测的证据。

abstract.text: In the centuries leading up to the Industrial Revolution, Western Europe gradually pulled ahead of other world regions in terms of technological creativity, population growth, and income per capita. We argue that superior institutions for the creation and dissemination of productive knowledge help explain the European advantage. We build a model of technological progress in a preindustrial economy that emphasizes the person-to-person transmission of tacit knowledge. The young learn as apprentices from the old. Institutions such as the family, the clan, the guild, and the market organize who learns from whom. We argue that medieval European institutions such as guilds, and specific features such as journeymanship, can explain the rise of Europe relative to regions that relied on the transmission of knowledge within closed kinship systems (extended families or clans).

10.1093/qje/qjx026.abstractZh: 在工业革命前的几个世纪里，西欧在技术创造力、人口增长和人均收入方面逐渐领先于其他世界地区。我们认为，优越的生产知识创造与传播机制有助于解释欧洲的竞争优势。我们构建了一个关于前工业经济中技术进步的模型，该模型强调隐性知识的人际传递。年轻人通过学徒的方式向长辈学习。家庭、氏族、行会和市场等机构负责安排谁向谁学习。我们认为，中世纪的欧洲行会制度以及诸如旅行贸易等特定特征，能够解释欧洲相对于那些依赖封闭亲属体系（大家庭或氏族）进行知识传递的地区所取得的优势。

abstract.text: We propose a new approach to studying the pass-through of credit expansion policies that focuses on frictions, such as asymmetric information, that arise in the interaction between banks and borrowers. We decompose the effect of changes in banks’ cost of funds on aggregate borrowing into the product of banks’ marginal propensity to lend (MPL) to borrowers and those borrowers’ marginal propensity to borrow (MPB), aggregated over all borrowers in the economy. We apply our framework by estimating heterogeneous MPBs and MPLs in the U.S. credit card market. Using panel data on 8.5 million credit cards and 743 credit limit regression discontinuities, we find that the MPB is declining in credit score, falling from 59% for consumers with FICO scores below 660 to essentially zero for consumers with FICO scores above 740. We use a simple model of optimal credit limits to show that a bank’s MPL depends on a small number of parameters that can be estimated using our credit limit discontinuities. For the lowest FICO score consumers, higher credit limits sharply reduce profits from lending, limiting banks’ optimal MPL to these consumers. The negative correlation between MPB and MPL reduces the impact of changes in banks’ cost of funds on aggregate household borrowing, and highlights the importance of frictions in bank-borrower interactions for understanding the pass-through of credit expansions.

10.1093/qje/qjx027.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种研究信贷扩张政策传递效应的新方法，重点关注银行和借款人之间互动中出现的摩擦，如信息不对称问题。我们将银行资金成本变化对总体借贷的影响分解为银行向借款人放贷的边际倾向（MPL）与借款人的借贷边际倾向（MPB）的乘积，该乘积涵盖了经济中的所有借款人。我们通过估计美国信用卡市场的异质性MPB和MPL来应用这一框架。利用包含850万张信用卡和743个信用额度回归不连续性的面板数据，我们发现借款人的借贷边际倾向随着信用评分的下降而减少，对于FICO评分低于660的消费者，这一比例从59%降至FICO评分高于740的消费者的几乎为零。我们使用一个简单的信用额度最优模型表明，银行的MPL取决于少数几个可以通过信用额度不连续性来估计的参数。对于FICO评分最低的消费者来说，较高的信用额度会大幅降低放贷收益，从而限制银行对这些消费者的最优MPL。MPB与MPL之间的负相关关系减少了银行资金成本变化对家庭总体借贷的影响，并强调了银行在借款人之间的互动中出现的摩擦对于理解信贷扩张的传递效应的重要性。

abstract.text: “Ban the Box” (BTB) policies restrict employers from asking about applicants’ criminal histories on job applications and are often presented as a means of reducing unemployment among black men, who disproportionately have criminal records. However, withholding information about criminal records could risk encouraging racial discrimination: employers may make assumptions about criminality based on the applicant's race. To investigate BTB’s effects, we sent approximately 15,000 online job applications on behalf of fictitious young, male applicants to employers in New Jersey and New York City before and after the adoption of BTB policies. These applications varied whether the applicant had a distinctly black or distinctly white name and the felony conviction status of the applicant. We confirm that criminal records are a major barrier to employment: employers that asked about criminal records were 63% more likely to call applicants with no record. However, our results support the concern that BTB policies encourage racial discrimination: the black-white gap in callbacks grew dramatically at companies that removed the box after the policy went into effect. Before BTB, white applicants to employers with the box received 7% more callbacks than similar black applicants, but BTB increased this gap to 43%. We believe that the best interpretation of these results is that employers are relying on exaggerated impressions of real-world racial differences in felony conviction rates.

10.1093/qje/qjx028.abstractZh: “禁止信息栏”政策限制雇主在招聘申请中询问申请人的犯罪记录，这一政策常被视为减少黑人男性失业率的手段，因为黑人男性中有较高的犯罪记录比例。然而，隐瞒犯罪记录信息可能会助长种族歧视：雇主可能会根据申请人的种族来推断其犯罪倾向。为了研究“禁止信息栏”政策的影响，我们代表15,000名虚构的年轻男性申请人，在“禁止信息栏”政策实施前后，将他们的在线招聘申请发送给了新泽西州和纽约市的雇主。这些申请中，申请人的姓名是明显带有黑人或白人特征的，同时申请人的重罪定罪情况也有所不同。我们的研究证实，犯罪记录是就业的主要障碍：在询问犯罪记录的雇主中，没有犯罪记录的申请人被电话回访的可能性高出63%。然而，我们的研究结果支持了“禁止信息栏”政策可能助长种族歧视的担忧：在政策实施后移除信息栏的公司，黑人申请人与白人申请人在被电话回访的比例差距显著扩大。在“禁止信息栏”政策实施之前，有信息栏的雇主对白人申请人的回访率比黑人申请人高出7%，而政策实施后这一差距扩大到了43%。我们认为，这些结果的最佳解释是，雇主基于对实际种族差异的过度印象来做出决策。

abstract.text: JEL Codes: I14, O15 For forty years, the Tuskegee Study of Untreated Syphilis in the Negro Male passively monitored hundreds of adult black males with syphilis despite the availability of effective treatment. The study's methods have become synonymous with exploitation and mistreatment by the medical profession. To identify the study's effects on the behavior and health of older black men, we use an interacted difference-in-difference-in-differences model, comparing older black men to other demographic groups, before and after the Tuskegee revelation, in varying proximity to the study's victims. We find that the disclosure of the study in 1972 is correlated with increases in medical mistrust and mortality and decreases in both outpatient and inpatient physician interactions for older black men. Our estimates imply life expectancy at age 45 for black men fell by up to 1.5 years in response to the disclosure, accounting for approximately 35% of the 1980 life expectancy gap between black and white men and 25% of the gap between black men and women.

10.1093/qje/qjx029.abstractZh: JEL代码：I14, O15 四十年来，塔斯基吉未治疗梅毒研究被动地监测了数百名患有梅毒的成年黑人男性，尽管当时已有有效的治疗方法。该研究的方法被视作医学界剥削和虐待的代名词。为了了解该研究对老年黑人男性的行为和健康产生了什么影响，我们使用了一个交互式差异-差异-差异模型，比较了老年黑人男性在研究揭露前后与其他人口群体的情况，以及他们与研究对象的距离。我们发现，1972年该研究的揭露与老年黑人男性对医疗服务的不信任增加、死亡率上升以及门诊和住院医生互动减少有关。我们的估计表明，由于该研究的揭露，黑人男性在45岁时的预期寿命减少了1.5年，这大约占1980年黑人男性与白人男性之间预期寿命差距的35%，以及黑人男性与女性之间预期寿命差距的25%。

abstract.text: We explore the role of natural characteristics in determining the worldwide spatial distribution of economic activity, as proxied by lights at night, observed across 240,000 grid cells. A parsimonious set of 24 physical geography attributes explains 47% of worldwide variation and 35% of within-country variation in lights. We divide geographic characteristics into two groups, those primarily important for agriculture and those primarily important for trade, and confront a puzzle. In examining within-country variation in lights, among countries that developed early, agricultural variables incrementally explain over 6 times as much variation in lights as do trade variables, while among late developing countries the ratio is only about 1.5, even though the latter group is far more dependent on agriculture. Correspondingly, the marginal effects of agricultural variables as a group on lights are larger in absolute value, and those for trade smaller, for early developers than for late developers. We show that this apparent puzzle is explained by persistence and the differential timing of technological shocks in the two sets of countries. For early developers, structural transformation due to rising agricultural productivity began when transport costs were still high, so cities were localized in agricultural regions. When transport costs fell, these agglomerations persisted. In late-developing countries, transport costs fell before structural transformation. To exploit urban scale economies, manufacturing agglomerated in relatively few, often coastal, locations. Consistent with this explanation, countries that developed earlier are more spatially equal in their distribution of education and economic activity than late developers.

10.1093/qje/qjx030.abstractZh: 我们探讨了自然特征在决定全球经济活动空间分布中的作用，这一作用通过夜间灯光的变化来反映，研究范围覆盖了240,000个网格单元。一组包含24个自然地理属性的变量能够解释全球范围内灯光变化的47%，以及各国内部灯光变化的35%。我们将地理特征分为两类：一类主要与农业相关，另一类主要与贸易相关。研究发现，在发达国家中，农业变量对灯光变化的解释力是贸易变量的6倍多；而在发展中国家，这一比例仅为1.5倍，尽管后者更依赖农业。相应地，农业变量对灯光变化的边际效应绝对值更大，而贸易变量的边际效应则较小。我们认为，这种看似矛盾的现象可以通过持续性以及技术冲击在不同国家中的时间差异来解释。对于早期发展的国家来说，由于农业生产力提升导致的结构转型在运输成本仍然较高的时期就开始了，因此城市主要集中在农业区。当运输成本下降时，这些城市群仍然持续存在。而在发展中国家，运输成本下降之后才发生结构转型。为了利用城市规模经济，制造业往往集中在少数几个沿海地区。与这一解释一致的是，早期发展的国家在教育和经济活动的分布上更为均衡。

abstract.text: We propose a simple model of the international monetary system. We study the world supply and demand for reserve assets denominated in different currencies under a variety of scenarios: a hegemon versus a multipolar world; abundant versus scarce reserve assets; and a gold exchange standard versus a floating rate system. We rationalize the Triffin dilemma, which posits the fundamental instability of the system, as well as the common prediction regarding the natural and beneficial emergence of a multipolar world, the Nurkse warning that a multipolar world is more unstable than a hegemon world, and the Keynesian argument that a scarcity of reserve assets under a gold standard or at the zero lower bound is recessionary. Our analysis is both positive and normative.

10.1093/qje/qjx031.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个简单的国际货币体系模型。我们研究了在不同货币体系下，全球储备资产的需求与供应情况，考虑了多种情景：霸权与多极世界；充裕与稀缺的储备资产；金本位制与浮动汇率制度。我们解释了Triffin困境，该困境指出了系统的根本不稳定性，同时也考虑了关于多极世界自然且有益的出现的普遍预测。Nurkse警告说，多极世界比霸权世界更加不稳定，而凯恩斯则认为，在金本位制或零下限条件下，储备资产的稀缺会导致经济衰退。我们的分析既具有实证性，也具有规范性。

abstract.text: Can machine learning improve human decision making? Bail decisions provide a good test case. Millions of times each year, judges make jail-or-release decisions that hinge on a prediction of what a defendant would do if released. The concreteness of the prediction task combined with the volume of data available makes this a promising machine-learning application. Yet comparing the algorithm to judges proves complicated. First, the available data are generated by prior judge decisions. We only observe crime outcomes for released defendants, not for those judges detained. This makes it hard to evaluate counterfactual decision rules based on algorithmic predictions. Second, judges may have a broader set of preferences than the variable the algorithm predicts; for instance, judges may care specifically about violent crimes or about racial inequities. We deal with these problems using different econometric strategies, such as quasi-random assignment of cases to judges. Even accounting for these concerns, our results suggest potentially large welfare gains: one policy simulation shows crime reductions up to 24.7% with no change in jailing rates, or jailing rate reductions up to 41.9% with no increase in crime rates. Moreover, all categories of crime, including violent crimes, show reductions; and these gains can be achieved while simultaneously reducing racial disparities. These results suggest that while machine learning can be valuable, realizing this value requires integrating these tools into an economic framework: being clear about the link between predictions and decisions; specifying the scope of payoff functions; and constructing unbiased decision counterfactuals. JEL Codes: C10 (Econometric and statistical methods and methodology), C55 (Large datasets: Modeling and analysis), K40 (Legal procedure, the legal system, and illegal behavior).

10.1093/qje/qjx032.abstractZh: 机器学习能否改善人类的决策能力？监狱判决提供了一个很好的测试案例。每年，法官都会做出关押或释放的判决，这些判决基于对未来被释放者行为的预测。预测任务的现实性以及可用数据的丰富性，使得机器学习在这一领域具有很大的应用潜力。然而，将算法与法官的判决进行比较却相当复杂。首先，现有的数据是由先前的法官判决生成的。我们只能观察到被释放的被告的犯罪结果，而无法了解那些被拘留的法官的判决结果。这使得基于算法预测来评估反事实决策规则变得困难。其次，法官的偏好可能比算法预测的变量更为广泛；例如，法官可能特别关注暴力犯罪或种族不平等问题。我们通过不同的计量经济学策略来解决这些问题，比如将案件随机分配给不同的法官。即使考虑到这些问题，我们的研究结果表明，潜在的福利收益相当大：一种政策模拟显示，犯罪率可降低24.7%，而监禁率保持不变；或者监禁率可降低41.9%，而犯罪率保持不变。此外，所有类型的犯罪，包括暴力犯罪，都显示出减少的趋势；而且这些收益可以在减少种族不平等的同时实现。这些结果表明，虽然机器学习具有价值，但要实现这一价值，需要将这些工具整合到经济框架中：明确预测与决策之间的联系；明确收益函数的范围；构建无偏见的反事实决策。JEL代码：C10（计量经济学与统计方法及方法论），C55（大型数据集：建模与分析），K40（法律程序、法律体系与违法行为）。

abstract.text: More than half a century after the first experiment on the finitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma, evidence on whether cooperation decreases with experience—as suggested by backward induction—remains inconclusive. This article provides a meta-analysis of prior experimental research and reports the results of a new experiment to elucidate how cooperation varies with the environment in this canonical game. We describe forces that affect initial play (formation of cooperation) and unraveling (breakdown of cooperation). First, contrary to the backward induction prediction, the parameters of the repeated game have a significant effect on initial cooperation. We identify how these parameters impact the value of cooperation—as captured by the size of the basin of attraction of always defect—to account for an important part of this effect. Second, despite these initial differences, the evolution of behavior is consistent with the unraveling logic of backward induction for all parameter combinations. Importantly, despite the seemingly contradictory results across studies, this article establishes a systematic pattern of behavior: subjects converge to use threshold strategies that conditionally cooperate until a threshold round; conditional on establishing cooperation, the first defection round moves earlier with experience. Simulation results generated from a learning model estimated at the subject level provide insights into the long-term dynamics and the forces that slow down the unraveling of cooperation.

10.1093/qje/qjx033.abstractZh: 在首次关于有限重复囚徒困境的实验半个多世纪后，关于合作是否会随着经验的增加而减少——正如逆向归纳法所暗示的那样——的证据仍然没有定论。本文对先前的实验研究进行了元分析，并报告了一项新的实验结果，以阐明在这种典型游戏中合作如何随环境变化。我们描述了影响初始行为（合作的形成）和合作瓦解（合作的崩溃）的因素。首先，与逆向归纳法的预测相反，重复游戏的参数对初始合作有显著影响。我们分析了这些参数如何影响合作的价值——通过始终背叛的吸引范围的大小来体现——以解释这种影响的重要部分。其次，尽管存在这些初始差异，行为的演变与逆向归纳法的逻辑一致，适用于所有参数组合。重要的是，尽管不同研究的结果看似矛盾，本文揭示了一种系统的行为模式：受试者逐渐采用阈值策略，在达到某个阈值轮次之前保持合作；在建立合作之后，首次背叛的轮次会随着时间的推移提前发生。从学习模型中生成的模拟结果，以个体为单位进行估计，为我们提供了关于长期动态以及减缓合作瓦解的力量的见解。

abstract.text: We document a form of excess volatility that is difficult to reconcile with standard models of prices, even after accounting for variation in discount rates. We compare prices of claims on the same cash flow stream but with different maturities. Standard models impose precise internal consistency conditions on the joint behavior of long- and short-maturity claims and these are strongly rejected in the data.
