For a range of relevant cases, a conventional 95% CI has coverage between 70% and 90%, and our adjustment amounts to replacing the conventional critical value 1.96 with a number between 2.2 and 2.8. Our results also apply to other settings involving trimmed data, such as trimming to ensure overlap in treatment effect estimation. We illustrate our approach with three empirical applications.

10.1093/restud/rdx051.abstractZh: 在回归不连续设计中，基于核的估计量，如局部多项式估计量，通常会在多个带宽下进行评估，作为敏感性分析的一种形式。然而，如果研究人员根据这种分析来选择带宽，那么相关的置信区间可能不具备正确的覆盖度，即使估计量是无偏的。本文提出了一种简单的调整方法，可以在这种情况下获得正确的覆盖度：用仅依赖于核以及研究人员考虑的最大和最小带宽之比的临界值来替代正态分位数。我们列出了这些临界值，并量化了传统置信区间的覆盖度损失。对于一系列相关案例，传统的95%置信区间的覆盖度在70%到90%之间，而我们的调整方法相当于将传统的临界值1.96替换为2.2到2.8之间的数值。我们的结果也适用于其他涉及修剪数据的情形，例如为了确保治疗效果估计的重叠而进行的修剪。我们通过三个实证应用来说明我们的方法。

abstract.text: This article studies non-parametric panel data models with multidimensional, unobserved individual effects when the number of time periods is fixed. I focus on models where the unobservables have a factor structure and enter an unknown structural function non-additively. The setup allows the individual effects to impact outcomes differently in different time periods and it allows for heterogeneous marginal effects. I provide sufficient conditions for point identification of all parameters of the model. Furthermore, I present a non-parametric sieve maximum likelihood estimator as well as flexible semiparametric and parametric estimators. Monte Carlo experiments demonstrate that the estimators perform well in finite samples. Finally, in an empirical application, I use these estimators to investigate the relationship between teaching practice and student achievement. The results differ considerably from those obtained with commonly used panel data methods.

10.1093/restud/rdx052.abstractZh: 本文研究在时间周期数量固定的情况下，具有多维、未观测个体效应的非参数面板数据模型。我们重点关注那些未观测变量具有因子结构，并且以非加性方式进入未知结构函数的模型。这种设定允许个体效应在不同时间周期对结果产生不同的影响，并允许边际效应存在异质性。我们提出了所有模型参数的点识别充分条件。此外，我们还提出了一种非参数的筛选最大似然估计方法，以及灵活的半参数和参数估计方法。蒙特卡洛实验表明，这些估计方法在有限样本情况下表现良好。最后，在一个实证应用中，我们使用这些估计方法来研究教学实践与学生成绩之间的关系。结果与常用的面板数据方法所得出的结果有很大差异。

abstract.text: Recent literature analysing wage effects of immigration assumes labour supply is fixed across education-experience cells. This article departs from this assumption estimating a labour market equilibrium dynamic discrete choice model on U.S. micro-data for 1967–2007. Individuals adjust to immigration by changing education, participation, and/or occupation. Adjustments are heterogeneous: 4.2–26.2% of prime-aged native males change their careers; of them, some switch to white-collar careers and increase education by about three years; others reduce labour market attachment and reduce education also by about three years. These adjustments mitigate initial effects on wages and inequality. Natives that are more similar to immigrants are the most affected on impact, but also have a larger margin to adjust and differentiate. Adjustments also produce a self-selection bias in the estimation of wage effects at the lower tail of the distribution, which the model corrects.

10.1093/restud/rdx053.abstractZh: 近期分析移民对工资影响的文献假设不同教育经验群体之间的劳动力供给是固定的。本文基于这一假设，利用1967年至2007年美国微观数据，建立了一个动态离散选择模型来研究劳动力市场均衡。个体通过改变教育、参与程度和职业来适应移民环境。这些调整具有异质性：4.2%至26.2%的本土男性壮年群体改变了职业选择，其中一些人转向白领职业并提高了约三年的教育水平；另一些则减少了劳动力市场的参与度，同时教育水平也降低了约三年。这些调整有助于缓解移民对工资和不平等的初始影响。与移民更为相似的本土人群受到的影响最大，但他们也有更大的调整空间和能力进行差异化选择。此外，这些调整还会在工资效应估计中产生自我选择偏差，而模型能够对此进行修正。

abstract.text: We propose a stylized dynamic model to understand the role of social networks in the phenomenon we call “globalization”. In a nutshell, this term refers to the process by which even agents who are geographically far apart come to interact, thus being able to overcome what would otherwise be a fast saturation of local opportunities. A key feature of our model is that the social network is the main channel through which agents exploit new opportunities. Therefore, only if the social network becomes global (heuristically, it “reaches far in few steps”) can global interaction be steadily sustained. An important insight derived from the model is that, for the social network to turn global, the long-range links required (bridges) cannot endogenously arise unless the matching mechanism displays significant local structure (cohesion). This sheds novel light on the dichotomy between bridging and cohesion that has long played a prominent role in the socio-economic literature. Our analysis also relates the process of globalization to other features of the environment such as the quality of institutions or the arrival rate of fresh ideas. The model is partially studied analytically for a limit scenario with a continuum population and is fully solved numerically for finite-population contexts.

10.1093/restud/rdx054.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个简化的动态模型，以理解社交网络在我们所称的“全球化”现象中的作用。简而言之，这一术语指的是即使地理位置相距甚远的主体也能相互交流的过程，从而克服局部机会的快速饱和问题。我们模型的一个关键特征是，社交网络是主体利用新机会的主要渠道。因此，只有当社交网络实现全球化（从逻辑上讲，它可以通过“少步骤实现远距离传播”）时，全球性的互动才能持续稳定地发生。该模型得出的一个重要见解是，要使社交网络实现全球化，所需的长期联系（桥梁）不能自发产生，除非匹配机制具有显著的局部结构（凝聚力）。这一发现为长期以来在社会经济文献中备受关注的“桥梁作用与凝聚力”之间的二分法提供了新的视角。我们的分析还将全球化过程与环境的其他特征联系起来，例如制度质量或新思想的出现率。该模型已通过分析研究了一个有限人口情景下的极限情况，并且对于有限人口环境也进行了数值求解。

abstract.text: We document contemporaneous differences in the aggregate labour supply of married couples across seventeen European countries and the U.S. Based on a model of joint household decision making, we quantify the contribution of international differences in non-linear labour income taxes and consumption taxes to the international differences in hours worked in the data. Through the lens of the model, taxes, together with wages and the educational composition, account for a significant part of the small differences in married men’s and the large differences in married women’s hours worked in the data. Taking the full non-linearities of labour income tax codes, including the tax treatment of married couples, into account is crucial for generating the low cross-country correlation between married men’s and women’s hours worked in the data, and for explaining the variation of married women’s hours worked across European countries.

10.1093/restud/rdx057.abstractZh: 我们记录了17个欧洲国家和美国的已婚夫妇在总体劳动力供应方面的差异。基于联合家庭决策模型，我们量化了非线性劳动所得税和消费税的国际差异对数据中所呈现的已婚男性与已婚女性工作小时数的国际差异的贡献。通过模型分析，税收、工资以及教育结构共同构成了已婚男性与已婚女性工作小时数中微小差异和巨大差异的重要部分。考虑到劳动所得税制度的全部非线性特征，包括已婚夫妇的税收待遇，对于解释数据中已婚男性与已婚女性工作小时数的低跨国相关性以及欧洲各国已婚女性工作小时数的变化至关重要。

abstract.text: This article studies the transmission of financial shocks in a model where corporate credit is intermediated via both banks and bond markets. In choosing between bank and bond financing, firms trade-off the greater flexibility of banks in case of financial distress against the lower marginal costs of large bond issuances. I find that, in response to a contraction in bank credit supply, aggregate bond issuance in the corporate sector increases, but not enough to avoid a decline in aggregate borrowing and investment. Keeping leverage constant while retiring bank debt would expose firms to a higher risk of financial distress; they offset this by reducing total borrowing. A calibration of the model to the Great Recession indicates that this precautionary mechanism can account for one-third of the total decline in investment by firms with access to bond markets.

10.1093/restud/rdx058.abstractZh: 本文研究在银行与债券市场双重中介的企业信贷体系下，金融冲击的传递机制。企业在选择银行融资或债券融资时，会权衡银行在财务困境下的更高灵活性与大额债券发行的较低边际成本。研究发现，在银行信贷供应收缩的情况下，企业部门的债券发行量会增加，但这一增加幅度不足以避免整体借贷和投资的下降。在保持杠杆率不变的情况下，企业通过偿还银行债务会面临更高的财务困境风险；为此，企业会通过减少总借款来抵消这一风险。模型在大衰退时期的校准表明，这种预防机制可以解释有债券市场渠道的企业投资总量下降的三分之一原因。

abstract.text: The recent unravelling of the Eurozone’s financial integration raised concerns about feedback loops between sovereign and banking insolvency. This article provides a theory of the feedback loop that allows for both domestic bailouts of the banking system and sovereign debt forgiveness by international creditors or solidarity by other countries. Our theory has important implications for the re-nationalization of sovereign debt, macroprudential regulation, and the rationale for banking unions.

10.1093/restud/rdx059.abstractZh: 最近对欧元区金融整合的揭露引发了人们对主权债务违约与银行破产之间反馈循环的担忧。本文提出了一种反馈循环理论，该理论允许通过国内救助银行系统以及国际债权人免除主权债务或其他国家提供援助等方式来应对这一问题。我们的理论对主权债务的重新国有化、宏观审慎监管以及银行联盟的合理性具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Recent empirical work shows large consumption responses to house price movements. This is at odds with a prominent theoretical view which, using the logic of the permanent income hypothesis, argues that consumption responses should be small. We show that, in contrast to this view, workhorse models of consumption with incomplete markets calibrated to rich cross-sectional micro facts actually predict large consumption responses, in line with the data. To explain this result, we show that consumption responses to permanent house price shocks can be approximated by a simple and robust rule-of-thumb formula: the marginal propensity to consume out of temporary income times the value of housing. In our model, consumption responses depend on a number of factors such as the level and distribution of debt, the size and history of house price shocks, and the level of credit supply. Each of these effects is naturally explained with our simple formula.

10.1093/restud/rdx060.abstractZh: 最近的实证研究表明，消费者对于房价变动的反应相当强烈。这与一种主流理论观点相悖，该观点基于永久收入假说，认为消费者的反应应该较为温和。我们的研究表明，与这一观点相反，那些针对不完全市场状况而构建的消费者模型，实际上能够预测出强烈的消费反应，这与数据结果一致。为了解释这一结果，我们提出了一个简单而稳健的估算公式：消费者从临时收入中支出的边际倾向乘以房屋的价值。在我们的模型中，消费者的反应取决于多种因素，如债务水平和分布、房价变动的规模和历史、以及信贷供应的水平。这些因素都可以通过我们的简单公式得到合理的解释。

abstract.text: We extend the model of risk sharing with limited commitment by introducing both a public and a private (unobservable and/or non-contractible) storage technology. Positive public storage relaxes future participation constraints, hence it can improve risk sharing, contrary to the case where hidden income or effort is the deep friction. The characteristics of constrained-efficient allocations crucially depend on the storage technology’s return. At the steady state, if the return on storage is (i) moderately high, both assets and the consumption distribution may remain time-varying; (ii) sufficiently high, assets converge almost surely to a constant and the consumption distribution is time-invariant; (iii) equal to agents’ discount rate, perfect risk sharing is self-enforcing. Agents never have an incentive to use their private storage technology, |$i.e.$| Euler inequalities are always satisfied, at the constrained-efficient allocation of our model, while this is not the case without optimal public asset accumulation. Finally, we find that, in contrast with the limited-commitment model without storage, past income affects consumption growth negatively both in our model with storage and in data from Indian villages.

10.1093/restud/rdx061.abstractZh: 我们通过引入公共和私人（不可观测和/或非可合约的）存储技术，扩展了有限承诺下的风险共享模型。积极的公共存储可以放松未来的参与约束，因此它可以改善风险共享，这与隐藏收入或努力作为深层摩擦的情况相反。受限-高效分配的特性在很大程度上取决于存储技术的回报。在稳态下，如果存储的回报为：（i）适度高，那么资产和消费分配可能会保持时间变化；（ii）足够高，资产几乎肯定会收敛到一个常数，而消费分配则变为时间不变；（iii）等于代理人的折现率，则完美风险共享会自我实现。在受限-高效分配的情况下，代理人永远没有使用私人存储技术的动机，即欧拉不等式始终得到满足，而在没有最优公共资产积累的情况下则不是这样。最后，我们发现，与没有存储的有限承诺模型相比，过去的收入在我们的模型中以及印度村庄的数据中都会对消费增长产生负面影响。

abstract.text: In the regression discontinuity design (RDD), it is common practice to assess the credibility of the design by testing whether the means of baseline covariates do not change at the cut-off (or threshold) of the running variable. This practice is partly motivated by the stronger implication derived by Lee (2008), who showed that under certain conditions the distribution of baseline covariates in the RDD must be continuous at the cut-off. We propose a permutation test based on the so-called induced ordered statistics for the null hypothesis of continuity of the distribution of baseline covariates at the cut-off; and introduce a novel asymptotic framework to analyse its properties. The asymptotic framework is intended to approximate a small sample phenomenon: even though the total number |$n$| of observations may be large, the number of effective observations local to the cut-off is often small. Thus, while traditional asymptotics in RDD require a growing number of observations local to the cut-off as |$n\to \infty$|⁠, our framework keeps the number |$q$| of observations local to the cut-off fixed as |$n\to \infty$|⁠. The new test is easy to implement, asymptotically valid under weak conditions, exhibits finite sample validity under stronger conditions than those needed for its asymptotic validity, and has favourable power properties relative to tests based on means. In a simulation study, we find that the new test controls size remarkably well across designs. We then use our test to evaluate the plausibility of the design in Lee (2008), a well-known application of the RDD to study incumbency advantage.

10.1093/restud/rdx062.abstractZh: 在回归不连续设计（RDD）中，通常通过检验基线协变量的均值在运行变量的临界值处是否不变来评估该设计的可信度。这一做法部分源于Lee（2008）提出的观点，他认为在某些条件下，RDD中基线协变量的分布必须在临界值处是连续的。我们提出了一种基于所谓诱导有序统计量的排列检验方法，用于检验基线协变量在临界值处连续性的零假设；并引入了一种新的渐近框架来分析其性质。该渐近框架旨在近似一种小样本现象：尽管观测总数|$n$|可能很大，但位于临界值附近的有效观测数量通常很少。因此，虽然传统的RDD渐近方法要求随着|$n\to \infty$|，位于临界值附近的观测数量不断增加，但我们的框架使得位于临界值附近的观测数量|$q$|在|$n\to \infty$|时保持不变。这种新检验易于实施，在弱条件下具有渐近有效性，在比其渐近有效性所需的更强条件下仍表现出有限样本有效性，并且相对于基于均值的检验，其功效特性更为优越。在模拟研究中，我们发现这种新检验在不同设计中的控制效果非常好。随后，我们使用该检验来评估Lee（2008）提出的设计的合理性，这是RDD在研究在位优势方面的一个著名应用。

abstract.text: We provide a Keynesian growth theory in which pessimistic expectations can lead to very persistent, or even permanent, slumps characterized by high unemployment and weak growth. We refer to these episodes as stagnation traps, because they consist in the joint occurrence of a liquidity and a growth trap. In a stagnation trap, the central bank is unable to restore full employment because weak growth depresses aggregate demand and pushes the policy rate against the zero lower bound, while growth is weak because low aggregate demand results in low profits, limiting firms’ investment in innovation. Aggressive policies aiming at restoring growth, such as subsidies to investment, can successfully lead the economy out of a stagnation trap by generating a regime shift in agents’ growth expectations.

10.1093/restud/rdx063.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种凯恩斯主义增长理论，该理论指出悲观的预期可能导致持续甚至永久性的经济衰退，表现为高失业率和低增长。我们将这些现象称为“停滞陷阱”，因为它们同时包含了流动性和增长方面的陷阱。在停滞陷阱中，中央银行无法恢复充分就业，因为低增长会抑制总需求，并使政策利率面临零下限的约束；同时，低增长又会导致低利润，从而限制企业在创新方面的投资。旨在促进增长的积极政策，如对投资的补贴，可以通过改变经济主体的增长预期，成功将经济从停滞陷阱中解救出来。

abstract.text: An agent chooses among projects with random outcomes. His payoff is increasing in the outcome and in an observer's expectation of the outcome. With some probability, the agent will be able to disclose some information about the true outcome to the observer. We show that choice is inefficient in general. We illustrate this point with a characterization of the inefficiencies that result when the agent can perfectly disclose the outcome with some probability and can disclose nothing otherwise as in Dye (1985a). In this case, the agent favours riskier projects even with lower expected returns. On the other hand, if information can also be disclosed by a challenger who prefers lower beliefs of the observer, the chosen project is excessively risky when the agent has better access to information, excessively risk-averse when the challenger has better access, and efficient otherwise. We also characterize the agent's worst-case equilibrium payoff. We give examples of alternative disclosure technologies illustrating other forms the inefficiencies can take. For example, in a two-dimensional setting, we demonstrate a “hitting for the fences” effect where the agent systematically focuses on the “harder” dimension at the expense of success on the easier.

10.1093/restud/rdx064.abstractZh: 一个代理人需要在具有随机结果的多个项目中做出选择。他的收益随着结果的变化以及观察者对结果的预期而变化。以一定的概率，代理人能够向观察者透露一些关于真实结果的信息。我们证明，通常情况下，这种选择是低效的。我们通过一个例子来说明这一点：当代理人能够以一定的概率完全揭示结果，而在其他情况下则无法透露任何信息时，就会出现效率低下的情况，正如Dye在1985a中所描述的那样。在这种情况下，即使预期回报较低，代理人仍然倾向于选择风险较高的项目。另一方面，如果信息也可以由一个偏好较低观察者信念的对手来透露，那么当代理人拥有更好的信息获取能力时，选择的项目就会过于冒险；而当对手拥有更好的信息获取能力时，选择的项目就会过于规避风险。我们还描述了代理人最坏情况下的均衡收益。我们给出了一些替代披露技术的例子，这些例子展示了效率低下可能采取的其他形式。例如，在二维环境中，我们展示了一种“全力以赴”的效果，即代理人系统性地关注“更困难”的维度，而牺牲了在较容易的维度上的成功。

abstract.text: Most governments in the world, including the U.S., prohibit sex work. Given these types of laws rarely change and are fairly uniform across regions, our knowledge about the impact of decriminalizing sex work is largely conjectural. We exploit the fact that a Rhode Island District Court judge unexpectedly decriminalized indoor sex work to provide causal estimates of the impact of decriminalization on the composition of the sex market, reported rape offences, and sexually transmitted infections. While decriminalization increases the size of the indoor sex market, reported rape offences fall by 30% and female gonorrhoea incidence declines by over 40%.

10.1093/restud/rdx065.abstractZh: 世界上大多数政府，包括美国，都禁止性工作。鉴于这类法律很少发生变化，且在不同地区几乎保持一致，我们对性工作非刑事化影响的了解仍然相当有限。我们利用罗德岛地方法院法官意外地将室内性工作非刑事化这一事实，来估算非刑事化对性市场构成、报告的强奸案件数量以及性传播感染率的影响。结果显示，非刑事化确实增加了室内性市场的规模，但报告的强奸案件数量减少了30%，女性淋病发病率则下降了40%以上。

abstract.text: In this article, we use micro data on both trade and production for a sample of large Chinese manufacturing firms in the footwear industry from 2002 to 2006 to estimate an empirical model of export demand, pricing, and market participation by destination market. We use the model to construct indexes of firm-level demand, marginal cost, and fixed cost. The empirical results indicate substantial firm heterogeneity in all three dimension with demand being the most dispersed. The firm-specific demand and marginal cost components account for over 30% of market share variation, 40% of sales variation, and over 50% of price variation among exporters. The fixed cost index is the primary factor explaining differences in the pattern of destination markets across firms. The estimates are used to analyse the supply reallocation following the removal of the quota on Chinese footwear exports to the EU. This led to a rapid restructuring of export supply sources on both the intensive and extensive margins in favour of firms with high demand and low fixed costs indexes, with marginal cost differences not being important.

10.1093/restud/rdx066.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们采用2002至2006年间中国鞋业大型制造企业的微观数据，建立了一个关于出口需求、定价以及各目标市场参与情况的实证模型。该模型用于构建企业层面的需求指数、边际成本指数和固定成本指数。实证结果表明，在这三个维度上，企业之间存在显著的异质性，其中需求的变化最为分散。企业特定的需求和边际成本因素分别解释了市场份额变化、销售额变化以及价格变化中的30%以上、40%以及超过50%。固定成本指数是解释不同企业目标市场选择模式差异的主要因素。这些估计结果被用于分析中国鞋业出口欧盟配额取消后供应结构的重新分配情况。这一变化导致出口供应来源在集约型和扩展型市场上迅速重组，有利于那些需求高且固定成本指数低的企业，而边际成本差异则不再是一个重要因素。

abstract.text: Economists often favour market-based mechanisms over non-market based mechanisms to allocate scarce public resources on grounds of economic efficiency and revenue generation. When the usage of the resources in question generates type-dependent negative externalities, the welfare comparison can become ambiguous. Both types of allocation mechanisms are being implemented in China's major cities to distribute limited vehicle licences as a measure to combat worsening traffic congestion and air pollution. While Beijing employs non-transferable lotteries, Shanghai uses an auction system. This article empirically quantifies the welfare consequences of the two mechanisms by taking into account both allocation efficiency and automobile externalities post-allocation. Our analysis shows that different allocation mechanisms lead to dramatic differences in social welfare. Although Beijing's lottery system has a large advantage in reducing automobile externalities over auction, the advantage is offset by the significant allocative cost from misallocation. The lottery system in Beijing resulted in a social welfare loss of 30 billion Yuan (nearly $5 billion) in 2012 alone. A uniform-price auction would have generated nearly 20 billion Yuan to Beijing municipal government, more than covering all its subsidies to the local public transit system.

10.1093/restud/rdx067.abstractZh: 经济学家通常更倾向于采用基于市场的机制而非非市场机制来分配稀缺的公共资源，以追求经济效率和收入创造。当相关资源的使用产生类型依赖的负面外部性时，福利比较就会变得模糊不清。在中国的主要城市，为了缓解日益严重的交通拥堵和空气污染问题，正在实施两种类型的资源分配机制：北京采用不可转让的抽签方式，而上海则采用拍卖系统。本文通过实证分析，量化了这两种机制带来的福利后果，同时考虑了分配效率以及分配后的汽车外部性。我们的分析表明，不同的分配机制会导致社会福利的巨大差异。尽管北京的抽签系统在减少汽车外部性方面具有明显优势，但这种优势被因分配不当而产生的显著成本所抵消。仅2012年，北京的抽签系统就导致了300亿元人民币（约合50亿美元）的社会福利损失。而统一价格拍卖则能为北京市政府带来近200亿元人民币的收入，这足以覆盖其对本地公共交通系统的所有补贴。

abstract.text: We develop a model of crime in which the number of police, the crime rate, the arrest rate, the employment rate, and the wage rate are joint outcomes of a subgame perfect Nash equilibrium. The local government chooses the size of its police force and citizens choose among work, home, and crime alternatives. We estimate the model using metropolitan statistical area (MSA)-level data. We use the estimated model to examine the effects on crime of targeted federal transfers to local governments to increase police. We find that knowledge about unobserved MSA-specific attributes is critical for the optimal allocation of police across MSA’s.

10.1093/restud/rdx068.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个犯罪模型，其中警察数量、犯罪率、逮捕率、就业率和工资率都是子博弈完美纳什均衡的联合结果。地方政府决定其警察力量的规模，而公民则可以在工作、家庭与犯罪之间做出选择。我们使用大都市统计区级别的数据来估计该模型。我们利用所估计的模型来研究联邦政府向地方政府提供资金以增加警察力量对犯罪的影响。研究发现，了解未观测到的大都市统计区特定属性对于实现警察资源的最优分配至关重要。

abstract.text: This article shows that accounting for variation in mistakes can be crucial for welfare analysis. Focusing on consumer under-reaction to not-fully-salient sales taxes, we show theoretically that the efficiency costs of taxation are amplified by differences in under-reaction across individuals and across tax rates. To empirically assess the importance of these issues, we implement an online shopping experiment in which 2,998 consumers purchase common household products, facing tax rates that vary in size and salience. We replicate prior findings that, on average, consumers under-react to non-salient sales taxes—consumers in our study react to existing sales taxes as if they were only 25% of their size. However, we find significant individual differences in this under-reaction, and accounting for this heterogeneity increases the efficiency cost of taxation estimates by at least 200%. Tripling existing sales tax rates nearly doubles consumers’ attention to taxes, and accounting for this endogeneity increases efficiency cost estimates by 336%. Our results provide new insights into the mechanisms and determinants of boundedly rational processing of not-fully-salient incentives, and our general approach provides a framework for robust behavioural welfare analysis.

10.1093/restud/rdx069.abstractZh: 本文指出，考虑错误变异对福利分析至关重要。通过研究消费者对非显性收入税的不充分反应，我们从理论上证明了税收的效率成本会因个体反应差异和税率差异而加剧。为了实证评估这些问题的重要性，我们开展了一项在线购物实验，2,998名消费者购买常见的家庭用品，所面临的税收税率在大小和显著性上有所不同。我们重复了先前的研究结果，即平均而言，消费者对非显性收入税的反应不足——在我们的研究中，消费者对现有税收的反应程度仅为实际税收的25%。然而，我们发现这种反应不足存在显著的个体差异，而考虑这种异质性后，税收效率成本的估计值至少增加了200%。将现有税收税率提高三倍几乎会使消费者的注意力加倍关注税收问题，而考虑这种内生性后，效率成本估计值增加了336%。我们的研究结果为有限理性处理非显性收入激励的机制和决定因素提供了新的见解，我们的总体方法为稳健的行为福利分析提供了框架。

abstract.text: Sender, who is either good or bad, wishes to look good at an exogenous deadline. Sender privately observes if and when she can release a public flow of information about her private type. Releasing information earlier exposes to greater scrutiny, but signals credibility. In equilibrium bad Sender releases information later than good Sender. We find empirical support for the dynamic predictions of our model using data on the timing of U.S. presidential scandals and U.S. initial public offerings. In the context of elections, our results suggest that October Surprises are driven by the strategic behaviour of bad Sender.

10.1093/restud/rdx070.abstractZh: 发送者，无论好坏，都希望能在外部设定的截止日期前展现出良好的形象。发送者会私下观察自己何时能够发布关于自己私生活的公开信息。提前发布信息会面临更大的审查压力，但也能显示出可信度。在均衡状态下，表现较差的发送者会比表现良好的发送者更晚发布信息。我们通过美国总统丑闻和美国首次公开募股的时间数据，发现我们的模型动态预测得到了实证支持。在选举背景下，我们的研究结果表明，10月的意外事件是由表现较差的发送者的策略性行为所驱动的。

abstract.text: Between 2007 and 2013, U.S. households experienced a large and persistent decline in net worth. The objective of this article is to study the business cycle implications of such a decline. We first develop a tractable monetary model in which households face idiosyncratic unemployment risk that they can partially self-insure using savings. A low level of liquid household wealth opens the door to self-fulfilling fluctuations: if wealth-poor households expect high unemployment, they have a strong precautionary incentive to cut spending, which can make the expectation of high unemployment a reality. Monetary policy, because of the zero lower bound, cannot rule out such expectations-driven recessions. In contrast, when wealth is sufficiently high, an aggressive monetary policy can keep the economy at full employment. Finally, we document that during the U.S. Great Recession wealth-poor households increased saving more sharply than richer households, pointing towards the importance of the precautionary channel over this period.

10.1093/restud/rdx074.abstractZh: 在2007年至2013年期间，美国家庭净资产出现了大幅且持续的下降。本文旨在研究这种下降对经济周期的影响。我们首先建立了一个易于分析的货币模型，在该模型中，家庭面临特有的失业风险，他们可以通过储蓄来部分自我保险。家庭财富流动性较低时，容易出现自我实现的波动：如果财富匮乏的家庭预期失业率高，他们就有强烈的预防性动机减少支出，这可能会使高失业的预期成为现实。由于零下限约束，货币政策无法排除这种由预期驱动的衰退。相反，当财富足够高时，积极的货币政策可以保持经济充分就业。最后，我们发现，在美国大衰退期间，财富匮乏的家庭比富裕家庭更大幅度地增加储蓄，这表明在这一时期，预防性渠道的重要性。

abstract.text: We study environments in which agents are randomly matched to play a Prisoner’s Dilemma, and each player observes a few of the partner’s past actions against previous opponents. We depart from the existing related literature by allowing a small fraction of the population to be commitment types. The presence of committed agents destabilizes previously proposed mechanisms for sustaining cooperation. We present a novel intuitive combination of strategies that sustains cooperation in various environments. Moreover, we show that under an additional assumption of stationarity, this combination of strategies is essentially the unique mechanism to support full cooperation, and it is robust to various perturbations. Finally, we extend the results to a setup in which agents also observe actions played by past opponents against the current partner, and we characterize which observation structure is optimal for sustaining cooperation.

10.1093/restud/rdx076.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种环境，其中代理人随机匹配进行囚徒困境博弈，每位玩家只能观察到部分对手过去对当前对手的行为。我们通过允许一小部分代理人属于“承诺型”来区别于现有相关文献。承诺型代理人的存在会破坏之前提出的维持合作机制。我们提出了一种新颖的策略组合，能够在各种环境中维持合作。此外，我们表明在另一个假设——即状态稳定的情况下，这种策略组合实际上是支持完全合作的唯一机制，并且能够抵御各种干扰。最后，我们将结果扩展到另一种情境，即代理人还能观察到对手过去对当前对手的行为，并确定了哪种观察结构最有利于维持合作。

abstract.text: We study asset prices and portfolio choice with overlapping generations, where the young disregard history to learn from own experience. Disregarding history implies less precise estimates of output growth, which in equilibrium leads the young to increase their investment in risky assets after positive returns, that is, they act as trend chasers. In equilibrium, the risk premium decreases after a positive shock and, therefore, trend chasing young agents lose wealth relative to old agents who behave as contrarians. Consistent with findings from survey data, the average belief about the risk premium in the economy relates negatively to future excess returns and is smoother than the true risk premium.

10.1093/restud/rdx077.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有重叠世代的资产价格与投资组合选择问题，其中年轻人不参考历史数据来从自身经验中学习。不参考历史数据意味着对产出增长的估计不够精确，这在均衡状态下会导致年轻人会在正回报后增加风险资产的投资，即他们表现为趋势追逐者。在均衡状态下，风险溢价在正面冲击后会下降，因此，趋势追逐的年轻代理人相对于行为如逆向投资者的老年代理人而言会失去财富。与调查数据的结果一致，人们对经济中风险溢价的平均预期与未来超额回报呈负相关，并且这种预期比真实风险溢价更为平滑。

abstract.text: In this article, I study how relative wages and border enforcement affect immigration from Mexico to the U.S. To do this, I develop a discrete choice dynamic programming model where people choose from a set of locations in both the U.S. and Mexico, while accounting for the location of one’s spouse when making decisions. I estimate the model using data on individual immigration decisions from the Mexican Migration Project. Counterfactuals show that a 10% increase in Mexican wages reduces migration rates and durations, overall decreasing the number of years spent in the U.S. by about 5%. A 50% increase in enforcement reduces migration rates and increases durations of stay in the U.S., and the overall effect is a 7% decrease in the number of years spent in the U.S.

10.1093/restud/rdx078.abstractZh: 在本文中，我研究了相对工资和边境执法对墨西哥移民到美国的影响。为此，我建立了一个离散选择动态规划模型，其中人们在美国和墨西哥的多个地点中选择居住地，同时考虑配偶的居住地对决策的影响。我利用墨西哥移民项目中的个人移民决策数据对模型进行了估计。反事实分析表明，墨西哥工资增加10%会降低移民率和移民时间，使在美国的居住年限减少约5%。而执法力度增加50%则会降低移民率并延长在美国的停留时间，整体效果是将在美国的居住年限减少7%。

abstract.text: I show that, in a benchmark model, debt securities minimize the welfare losses associated with the moral hazards of excessive risk-taking and lax effort. For any security design, the variance of the security payoff is a statistic that summarizes these welfare losses. Debt securities have the least variance, among all limited liability securities with the same expected value. In other models, mixtures of debt and equity are exactly optimal, and pure debt securities are approximately optimal. I study both static and dynamic security design problems, and show that these two types of problems are equivalent. I use moral hazard in mortgage lending as a recurring example, but my results apply to other corporate finance and principal-agent problems.

10.1093/restud/rdx080.abstractZh: 我证明，在一个基准模型中，债务证券能够最小化与过度冒险和懈怠行为相关的福利损失。对于任何证券设计，证券收益的方差是一个统计指标，能够综合这些福利损失。在所有具有相同预期价值的有限责任证券中，债务证券的方差最小。在其他模型中，债务与股权的混合形式是最优的，而纯债务证券则近似最优。我研究了静态和动态证券设计问题，并证明这两种类型的问题实际上是等价的。我以抵押贷款中的道德风险为例进行说明，但我的研究结果同样适用于其他企业金融和主体-代理问题。

abstract.text: We study the impact of intersectoral and interregional trade linkages in propagating disaggregated productivity changes to the rest of the economy. Using U.S. regional and industry data, we obtain the aggregate, regional and sectoral elasticities of measured total factor productivity, GDP, and employment to regional and sectoral productivity changes. We find that the elasticities vary significantly depending on the sectors and regions affected, and are importantly determined by the spatial structure of the economy. We use our calibrated model to perform a variety of counterfactual exercises including several specific studies of the aggregate and disaggregate effects of shocks to productivity and infrastructure. The specific episodes we study include the boom in California’s computer industry, the productivity boom in North Dakota associated with the shale oil boom, the disruptions in New York’s finance and real state industries during the 2008 crisis, as well as the effect of the destruction of infrastructure in Louisiana following hurricane Katrina.

10.1093/restud/rdx082.abstractZh: 我们研究了跨行业和跨地区贸易联系对将分解后的生产率变化传播到整个经济的影响。利用美国的地区和行业数据，我们获得了衡量总要素生产率、GDP和就业对地区和行业生产率变化的综合、地区和行业弹性系数。我们发现，这些弹性系数因受影响的行业和地区而异，并且主要由经济的空间结构决定。我们使用经过校准的模型进行了多种反事实模拟，包括几项关于生产率和基础设施冲击的综合和分解效应的具体研究。我们研究的特定案例包括加利福尼亚州计算机行业的繁荣、与页岩油繁荣相关的北达科他州的生产率提升、2008年危机期间纽约金融和房地产行业的动荡，以及飓风卡特里娜后路易斯安那州基础设施破坏的影响。

abstract.text: We provide new empirical evidence for the way in which financial markets process information. Our results rely critically on high-frequency intraday price and volume data for the S&P 500 equity portfolio and U.S. Treasury bonds, along with new econometric techniques, for making inference on the relationship between trading intensity and spot volatility around public news announcements. Consistent with the predictions derived from a theoretical model in which investors agree to disagree, our estimates for the intraday volume-volatility elasticity around important news announcements are systematically below unity. Our elasticity estimates also decrease significantly with measures of disagreements in beliefs, economic uncertainty, and textual-based sentiment, further highlighting the key role played by differences-of-opinion.

10.1093/restud/rdy003.abstractZh: 我们为金融市场处理信息的方式提供了新的实证证据。我们的研究结果高度依赖于S&P 500股票组合和美国国债的高频日内价格和成交量数据，同时运用新的计量经济学技术，以推断交易强度与公共新闻公告前后即时波动性之间的关系。与理论模型中投资者存在分歧的预测一致，我们在重要新闻公告期间对日内成交量与波动性关系的估计值系统性地低于1。此外，随着信念分歧、经济不确定性以及基于文本的情绪变化的衡量标准增加，我们的弹性估计值显著下降，这进一步凸显了意见分歧所起的关键作用。

abstract.text: We present a dynamic model of trading under adverse selection in which a seller sequentially meets buyers, each of whom receives a noisy signal about the quality of the seller’s asset and offers a price. We fully characterize the equilibrium trading dynamics and show that buyers’ beliefs about the quality of the asset can either increase or decrease over time, depending on the initial level. This result demonstrates how the introduction of private buyer signals enriches the set of trading patterns that can be accommodated within the framework of dynamic adverse selection, thereby broadening its applicability. We also examine the economic effects of search frictions and the informativeness of buyers’ signals in our model and discuss the robustness of our main insights in multiple directions.

10.1093/restud/rdy007.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个在逆向选择情境下的动态交易模型。在该模型中，卖方依次与买家进行接触，每位买家都会收到关于卖方资产质量的噪声信号，并据此提出价格。我们详细描述了均衡交易动态，并发现买家对资产质量的信念会随时间变化，这取决于初始水平。这一结果表明，引入私人买家信号能够丰富在动态逆向选择框架下可容纳的交易模式，从而扩大其应用范围。我们还研究了搜索摩擦以及买家信号的信息含量对模型经济效应的影响，并探讨了我们的主要见解在多个方向上的稳健性。

abstract.text: This article shows how input heterogeneity triggers productivity spillovers at the workplace. In an egg production plant in rural Peru, workers produce output combining effort with inputs of heterogeneous quality. Exploiting variation in the productivity of inputs assigned to workers, we find evidence of a negative causal effect of an increase in coworkers’ daily output on own output and its quality. We show theoretically and suggest empirically that the effect captures free riding among workers, which originates from the way the management informs its dismissal decisions. Our study and results show that input heterogeneity and information on input quality contribute to determine the shape of incentives and have implications for human resource management, production management, and the interaction between the two. Counterfactual analyses show that processing information on inputs or changing their allocation among workers can generate significant productivity gains.

10.1093/restud/rdy010.abstractZh: 本文揭示了投入的异质性如何引发工作场所的生产率溢出效应。在秘鲁农村的一个鸡蛋生产工厂中，工人通过结合不同质量的投入来生产产品。通过利用分配给工人的投入的生产率差异，我们发现同事每日产量的增加会对自身产量及其质量产生负向的因果效应。我们从理论和实证角度表明，这种效应反映了工人之间的搭便车行为，而这种行为源于管理层在做出解雇决策时的信息处理方式。我们的研究结果表明，投入的异质性和投入质量的信息有助于决定激励措施的形式，并对人力资源管理、生产管理以及两者之间的互动产生重要影响。反事实分析表明，处理投入信息或改变其分配方式可以为工人带来显著的生产率提升。

abstract.text: We find that daily air pollution levels have a significant effect on the decision to purchase or cancel health insurance in a manner inconsistent with rational choice theory. A one standard deviation increase in daily air pollution leads to a 7.2% increase in the number of insurance contracts sold that day. Conditional on purchase, a one standard deviation decrease in air pollution during the cooling-off (i.e. cost-free cancellation) period relative to the order-date level increases the return probability by 4.0%. We explore a range of potential mechanism and find the most support for projection bias and salience.

10.1093/restud/rdy016.abstractZh: 我们发现，日常空气污染水平对购买或取消健康保险的决策有着显著影响，这一影响与理性选择理论并不一致。日常空气污染水平增加一个标准差，会导致当天销售的保险合同数量增加7.2%。在购买决策的条件下，与订单日期相比，冷却期（即免费取消期）内空气污染水平下降一个标准差，会使保险合同的回购概率增加4.0%。我们探讨了多种可能的机制，并发现投影偏差和显著性是最有支持的解释。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To demonstrate regression to the mean bias introduced by matching on preperiod variables in difference-in-differences studies. DATA SOURCES: Simulated data. STUDY DESIGN: We performed a Monte Carlo simulation to estimate the effect of a placebo intervention on simulated longitudinal data for units in treatment and control groups using unmatched and matched difference-in-differences analyses. We varied the preperiod level and trend differences between the treatment and control groups, and the serial correlation of the matching variables. We assessed estimator bias as the mean absolute deviation of estimated program effects from the true value of zero. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: When preperiod outcome level is correlated with treatment assignment, an unmatched analysis is unbiased, but matching units on preperiod outcome levels produces biased estimates. The bias increases with greater preperiod level differences and weaker serial correlation in the outcome. This problem extends to matching on preperiod level of a time-varying covariate. When treatment assignment is correlated with preperiod trend only, the unmatched analysis is biased, and matching units on preperiod level or trend does not introduce additional bias. CONCLUSIONS: Researchers should be aware of the threat of regression to the mean when constructing matched samples for difference-in-differences. We provide guidance on when to incorporate matching in this study design.

10.1111/1475-6773.12993.abstractZh:
目的：揭示在差异中差异研究中，基于前期变量进行匹配所引入的回归均值偏差。  
数据来源：模拟数据。  
研究设计：我们进行了蒙特卡洛模拟，以估计安慰剂干预对治疗组和对照组模拟纵向数据的影响，分别采用未匹配和匹配的差异中差异分析。我们改变了治疗组和对照组之间的前期水平差异以及趋势差异，并考虑了匹配变量的序列相关性。我们将估计的程序效应与零的真实值之间的平均绝对偏差作为估计器的偏差来评估。  
主要发现：当前期结果水平与处理分配相关时，未匹配分析是无偏的，但基于前期结果水平进行匹配会导致有偏估计。随着前期水平差异的增加以及结果的序列相关性减弱，偏差会增大。这一问题也适用于基于时变协变量前期的匹配。当处理分配仅与前期趋势相关时，未匹配分析是有偏的，而基于前期水平或趋势进行匹配并不会引入额外的偏差。  
结论：研究人员在构建差异中差异的匹配样本时，应意识到回归均值偏差的威胁。我们提供了关于何时应在这种研究设计中纳入匹配的指导。

abstract.text: Health services research (HSR) is the science of the evaluation and improvement of health care provision. HSR can be used by health care organisations to develop and understand administrative, financial and organisational processes in order to improve efficacy of clinical treatments, efficiency of their delivery, and ultimately patient outcomes. HSR applies both quantitative and qualitative methodology, utilising data collected from real-life clinical practice, rather than the confines of more controlled traditional efficacy trials. With new and developing therapies, HSR provides an opportunity to enhance the delivery of cost-effective and efficient health care. Level of evidence: Not applicable (educational article).

10.1177/2051415818754578.abstractZh: 健康服务研究是评估和改进医疗服务提供方式的科学。健康服务研究可以被医疗机构用来开发和理解行政、财务和组织流程，从而提高临床治疗的疗效、服务的效率，最终改善患者的治疗效果。健康服务研究采用定量和定性方法，利用从实际临床实践中收集的数据，而不是局限于更严格的传统疗效试验。对于新疗法和正在发展的疗法，健康服务研究为提升成本效益高且高效的医疗服务提供了机会。证据等级：不适用（教育类文章）。

abstract.text: PURPOSE: To update the ASCO clinical practice guideline on adjuvant endocrine therapy based on emerging data about the optimal duration of aromatase inhibitor (AI) treatment. METHODS: ASCO conducted a systematic review of randomized clinical trials from 2012 to 2018. Guideline recommendations were based on the Panel's review of the evidence from six trials. RESULTS: The six included studies of AI treatment beyond 5 years of therapy demonstrated that extension of AI treatment was not associated with an overall survival advantage but was significantly associated with lower risks of breast cancer recurrence and contralateral breast cancer compared with placebo. Bone-related toxic effects were more common with extended AI treatment. RECOMMENDATIONS: The Panel recommends that women with node-positive breast cancer receive extended therapy, including an AI, for up to a total of 10 years of adjuvant endocrine treatment. Many women with node-negative breast cancer should consider extended therapy for up to a total of 10 years of adjuvant endocrine treatment based on considerations of recurrence risk using established prognostic factors. The Panel noted that the benefits in absolute risk of reduction were modest and that, for lower-risk node-negative or limited node-positive cancers, an individualized approach to treatment duration that is based on considerations of risk reduction and tolerability was appropriate. A substantial portion of the benefit for extended adjuvant AI therapy was derived from prevention of second breast cancers. Shared decision making between clinicians and patients is appropriate for decisions about extended adjuvant endocrine treatment, including discussions about the absolute benefits in the reduction of breast cancer recurrence, the prevention of second breast cancers, and the impact of adverse effects of treatment. Additional information can be found at www.asco.org/breast-cancer-guidelines .

10.1200/jco.18.01160.abstractZh:
目的：根据关于芳香化酶抑制剂治疗最佳持续时间的新的数据，更新ASCO关于辅助内分泌治疗的临床实践指南。  
方法：ASCO对2012年至2018年的随机临床试验进行了系统回顾。指南建议基于小组对六项试验证据的审查。  
结果：包括在内的六项关于超过5年治疗的芳香化酶抑制剂研究的结果表明，延长治疗与总体生存优势无关，但与乳腺癌复发和对侧乳腺癌的风险降低显著相关。与安慰剂相比，延长芳香化酶抑制剂治疗更常出现与骨骼相关的毒性效应。  
建议：小组建议，患有淋巴结阳性乳腺癌的女性应接受长达10年的辅助内分泌治疗，包括芳香化酶抑制剂治疗。许多淋巴结阴性乳腺癌的女性也应考虑接受长达10年的辅助内分泌治疗，具体时间应根据已建立的预后因素考虑复发风险。小组指出，绝对风险降低的益处较为有限，对于低风险淋巴结阴性或局限性淋巴结阳性癌症，基于风险降低和耐受性的个体化治疗时间安排是合适的。延长辅助芳香化酶抑制剂治疗的显著益处来自于预防第二原发乳腺癌。临床医生与患者之间的共同决策适用于关于延长辅助内分泌治疗的决策，包括讨论减少乳腺癌复发、预防第二原发癌以及治疗不良副作用所带来的绝对益处。更多相关信息可访问www.asco.org/breast-cancer-guidelines。

abstract.text: Richard H. Thaler delivered his Prize Lecture on 8 December 20167 at the Aula Magna, Stockholm University.

10.1257/aer.108.6.1265.abstractZh: 理查德·H·泰勒于2016年12月8日在斯德哥尔摩大学的Aula Magna发表了他的获奖演讲。

abstract.text: Marketplaces are often small parts of large markets, and both markets and marketplaces come in many varieties. Market design seeks to understand what marketplaces must accomplish to enable different kinds of markets. Marketplaces can have varying degrees of success, and there can be marketplace failures. I’ll discuss labor markets like the market for new economists, and also markets for new lawyers and doctors that have suffered from the unraveling of appointment dates to well before employment begins. Markets work best if they enjoy social support, but some markets are repugnant in the sense that some people think they should be banned, even though others want to participate in them. Laws banning such markets often contribute to the design of illegal black markets, and this raises new issues for market designers. I’ll briefly discuss markets and black markets for narcotics, marijuana, sex, and surrogacy, and the design of markets for kidney transplants, in the face of widespread laws against (and broader repugnance for) compensating organ donors. I conclude with open questions and engineering challenges.

10.1257/aer.108.7.1609.abstractZh: 市场往往是大型市场的组成部分，而市场和市场形式多种多样。市场设计旨在理解市场必须实现的目标，以促成不同类型的市场。市场的成功程度各不相同，也可能出现市场失败的情况。我将讨论像新经济学家市场这样的劳动力市场，以及那些因任命日期推迟而遭受损失的律师和医生市场。如果市场能够获得社会支持，其运作效果最佳，但有些市场却令人反感，因为有些人认为应该禁止这类市场，尽管其他人希望参与这些市场。禁止此类市场的法律往往会导致非法黑市的出现，这给市场设计者带来了新的问题。我将简要讨论毒品、大麻、性交易和代孕等市场的状况，以及面对普遍禁止补偿器官捐赠者行为的法律时，肾脏移植市场的设计问题。最后，我将提出一些开放性问题以及工程上的挑战。

abstract.text: How large are the benefits of transportation infrastructure projects, and what explains these benefits? This paper uses archival data from colonial India to investigate the impact of India's vast railroad network. Guided by four results from a general equilibrium trade model, I find that railroads: (1) decreased trade costs and interregional price gaps; (2) increased interregional and international trade; (3) increased real income levels; and (4) that a sufficient statistic for the effect of railroads on welfare in the model accounts well for the observed reduced-form impact of railroads on real income in the data. (JEL H54, L92, N75, O22, R12, R42)

10.1257/aer.20101199.abstractZh: 交通基础设施项目的收益有多大，又是什么解释了这些收益呢？本文利用印度殖民时期的档案数据，研究了印度庞大的铁路网络的影响。根据一般均衡贸易模型的四个结果，我发现铁路：1）降低了贸易成本和地区间价格差距；2）增加了地区间和国际间的贸易；3）提高了实际收入水平；4）模型中用于衡量铁路对福利影响的指标能够很好地解释数据中铁路对实际收入影响的降低形式。 (JEL H54, L92, N75, O22, R12, R42)

abstract.text: Market economies are intrinsically unstable. The standard search model of equilibrium unemployment, once solved accurately with a globally nonlinear algorithm, gives rise endogenously to rare disasters. Intuitively, in the presence of cumulatively large negative shocks, inertial wages remain relatively high, and reduce profits. The marginal costs of hiring run into downward rigidity, which stems from the trading externality of the matching process, and fail to decline relative to profits. Inertial wages and rigid hiring costs combine to stifle job creation flows, depressing the economy into disasters. The disaster dynamics are robust to extensions to home production, capital accumulation, and recursive utility. (JEL E22, E23, E24, E32, J41, J63, N12)

10.1257/aer.20130025.abstractZh: 市场经济本质上是不稳定的。标准的均衡失业搜索模型，一旦通过全局非线性算法准确求解，就会内生性地引发罕见的灾难。直观上，在累积的负面冲击下，惯性工资仍然保持较高水平，从而降低利润。招聘的边际成本出现下降刚性，这源于匹配过程的交易外部性，导致成本相对于利润无法下降。惯性工资和刚性招聘成本共同作用，抑制了就业创造，使经济陷入灾难。这种灾难动态对于家庭生产、资本积累和递归效用等扩展情况仍然具有鲁棒性。（JEL E22, E23, E24, E32, J41, J63, N12）

abstract.text: We build a model of firm-level innovation, productivity growth, and reallocation featuring endogenous entry and exit. A new and central economic force is the selection between high- and low-type firms, which differ in terms of their innovative capacity. We estimate the parameters of the model using US Census microdata on firm-level output, R&D, and patenting. The model provides a good fit to the dynamics of firm entry and exit, output, and R&D. Taxing the continued operation of incumbents can lead to sizable gains (of the order of 1.4 percent improvement in welfare) by encouraging exit of less productive firms and freeing up skilled labor to be used for R&D by high-type incumbents. Subsidies to the R&D of incumbents do not achieve this objective because they encourage the survival and expansion of low-type firms. (JEL D21, D24, H25, L52, O31, O34)

10.1257/aer.20130470.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个关于企业层面创新、生产率增长以及资源重新分配的模型，该模型以内生性的企业进入和退出为特点。一个新的核心经济力量是企业在高类型与低类型之间的选择，这两种企业在其创新能力上存在差异。我们利用美国人口普查局关于企业产出、研发和专利数据的微观数据来估计模型的参数。该模型很好地解释了企业进入与退出、产出以及研发的动态变化。对现有企业继续运营征税可以带来显著的收益（约1.4%的福利改善），因为这将促使低效率的企业退出市场，从而使高类型企业能够利用这些技能劳动力进行研发。而对现有企业研发提供的补贴则无法实现这一目标，因为它们反而促进了低类型企业的生存和扩张。（JEL D21, D24, H25, L52, O31, O34）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the incidence of corporate taxes on wages using a 20-year panel of German municipalities exploiting 6,800 tax changes for identification. Using event study designs and difference-in-differences models, we find that workers bear about one-half of the total tax burden. Administrative linked employer-employee data allow us to estimate heterogeneous firm and worker effects. Our findings highlight the importance of labor market institutions and profit-shifting opportunities for the incidence of corporate taxes on wages. Moreover, we show that low-skilled, young, and female employees bear a larger share of the tax burden. This has important distributive implications. (JEL H25, H31, H71, J16, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20130570.abstractZh: 本文利用德国20年面板数据，通过6,800个税收变化的样本，估算了企业税对工资的影响。通过事件研究设计和差异-差异模型分析，我们发现工人承担了约一半的总税收负担。通过行政链接的雇主-雇员数据，我们能够估计出企业和工人的异质性效应。我们的研究强调了劳动力市场制度以及利润转移机会对企业税对工资影响的重要性。此外，我们还发现低技能、年轻和女性员工承担了更大的税收负担，这对分配问题具有重要意义。（JEL H25, H31, H71, J16, J24, J31）

abstract.text: This paper proposes a theory of the fiscal foundations of inflation based on imperfect knowledge and learning. Because imperfect knowledge breaks Ricardian equivalence, the scale and composition of the public debt matter for inflation. High and moderate duration debt generates wealth effects on consumption demand that impairs the intertemporal substitution channel of monetary policy: aggressive monetary policy is required to anchor inflation expectations. Counterfactual experiments conducted in an estimated model reveal that the US economy would have been substantially more volatile over the Great Inflation and Great Moderation periods if US debt levels had been those observed in Italy or Japan. (JEL D84, E31, E32, E52, E62, H63)

10.1257/aer.20131461.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于不完全知识与学习机制的通胀财政基础理论。由于不完全知识会破坏李嘉图等价条件，公共债务的规模与构成对通胀具有重要影响。长期且规模较大的债务会引发消费需求的财富效应，从而削弱货币政策的跨期替代效应；因此，需要采取激进的货币政策来稳定通胀预期。在估算模型中进行的事后实验表明，如果美国债务水平与意大利或日本相当，美国经济在“大通胀”和“大缓和”时期将会更加不稳定。（JEL D84, E31, E32, E52, E62, H63）

abstract.text: We develop a structural model to investigate the effects of pharmaceutical price regulation on demand and on manufacturers’ price-setting behavior in France. We estimate price-cost margins in a regulated market with price constraints and infer whether these constraints are binding, exploiting cost restrictions across drugs, which come from observing the same drugs in potentially price-constrained markets (France) and in markets where prices are unregulated (United States and Germany). Our counterfactual simulations suggest that price constraints generated modest savings for anti-ulcer drugs in 2003–2013 (2 percent of total expenses), relative to a free pricing scenario, and shifted consumption from generic to branded drugs. (JEL C51, D24, I18, L13, L51, L65)

10.1257/aer.20140202.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个结构模型，以研究药品价格管制对法国需求以及制造商定价行为的影响。我们在存在价格约束的管制市场中估算了价格成本利润率，并通过比较不同药品的成本限制情况，推断这些限制是否具有约束力。这一比较基于在可能受到价格管制的市场（法国）以及价格不受管制的市场（美国和德国）中对相同药品的观察结果。我们的反事实模拟表明，在2003至2013年间，价格管制为抗溃疡药物带来了适度的成本节约，占总支出的2%，并且这种管制促使消费者从使用仿制药转向使用品牌药品。（JEL C51, D24, I18, L13, L51, L65）

abstract.text: Macro developments leading up to the 2008 crisis displayed an unprecedented degree of international synchronization. Before the crisis, all G7 countries experienced credit growth and, around the time of the Lehman bankruptcy, they all faced sharp and large contractions in both real and financial activity. Using a two-country model with financial frictions, we show that a global liquidity shortage induced by pessimistic self-fulfilling expectations can quantitatively generate patterns like those observed in the data. The model also suggests that crises are less frequent with more international financial integration but, when they hit, they are larger and more synchronized across countries. (JEL E23, E32, E44, F44, G01)

10.1257/aer.20140412.abstractZh: 2008年危机前的宏观发展显示出前所未有的国际同步性。在危机之前，所有G7国家都经历了信贷增长，而在雷曼破产前后，这些国家的实际和金融活动都出现了急剧且大幅的收缩。通过构建一个包含金融摩擦的两国模型，我们发现，由悲观的自我实现预期引发的全球流动性短缺可以定量地产生与数据中所观察到的模式相似的情景。该模型还表明，随着国际金融一体化的加强，危机发生的频率会降低，但一旦发生，其影响会更加严重，且各国之间的同步性也会增强。（JEL E23, E32, E44, F44, G01）

abstract.text: We study the optimal accumulation of international reserves in a quantitative model of sovereign default with long-term debt and a risk-free asset. Keeping higher levels of reserves provides a hedge against rollover risk, but this is costly because using reserves to pay down debt allows the government to reduce sovereign spreads. Our model, parameterized to mimic salient features of a typical emerging economy, can account for significant holdings of international reserves, and the larger accumulation of both debt and reserves in periods of low spreads and high income. We also show that income windfalls, improved policy frameworks, and an increase in the importance of rollover risk imply increases in the optimal holdings of reserves that are consistent with the upward trend in reserves in emerging economies. It is essential for our results that debt maturity exceeds one period. (JEL E21, E43, F32, F34, H63)

10.1257/aer.20140443.abstractZh: 我们在一个包含长期债务和无风险资产的主权违约定量模型中，研究了国际储备的最优积累问题。保持较高的储备水平可以对冲滚动风险，但这代价高昂，因为使用储备来偿还债务可以使政府降低主权利差。我们的模型经过参数化设计，能够模拟典型新兴经济体的显著特征，并能够考虑到国际储备的显著持有情况。在利差较低且收入较高的时期，债务和储备的积累幅度更大。我们还指出，收入意外收益、改进的政策框架以及滚动风险重要性的增加，都意味着储备的最优持有量会增加，这与新兴经济体中储备的上升趋势是一致的。我们的研究结果强调，债务到期时间应超过一个周期。（JEL E21, E43, F32, F34, H63）

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between the destination of exports and the input prices paid by firms, using detailed customs and firm-product-level data from Portugal. Both ordinary least squares regressions and an instrumental-variable strategy using exchange-rate movements (interacted with indicators for initial exports) as a source of variation in destinations indicate that exporting to richer countries leads firms to pay higher prices for inputs, other things equal. The results are supportive of what we call the income-based quality-choice channel: selling to richer destinations leads firms to raise the average quality of goods they produce and to purchase higher-quality inputs. (JEL D22, D24, F14, F31, L15)

10.1257/aer.20140647.abstractZh: 本文通过利用葡萄牙的详细海关数据和企业产品层面的数据，探讨了出口目的地与企业支付的生产资料价格之间的关系。普通最小二乘回归分析以及采用汇率变动作为变量来源的工具变量分析表明，在其他条件相同的情况下，向富裕国家出口会导致企业支付更高的生产资料价格。这些结果支持了我们所提出的“基于收入的品质选择渠道”理论：向富裕目的地出口促使企业提高所生产商品的平均质量，并购买更高质量的生产资料。（JEL D22, D24, F14, F31, L15）

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of unemployment insurance (UI) on the housing market. Exploiting heterogeneity in UI generosity across US states and over time, we find that UI helps the unemployed avoid mortgage default. We estimate that UI expansions during the Great Recession prevented more than 1.3 million foreclosures and insulated home values from labor market shocks. The results suggest that policies that make mortgages more affordable can reduce foreclosures even when borrowers are severely underwater. An optimal UI policy during housing downturns would weigh, among other benefits and costs, the deadweight losses avoided from preventing mortgage defaults. (JEL D14, E32, G21, J65, R31)

10.1257/aer.20140989.abstractZh: 本文研究了失业保险对房地产市场的影响。通过利用美国各州以及不同时期失业保险福利差异性的分析，我们发现失业保险有助于失业者避免抵押贷款违约。我们的估计表明，大衰退期间失业保险的扩大减少了超过130万次房屋止赎，并保护了房屋价值免受劳动力市场冲击的影响。研究结果表明，即使借款人面临严重的抵押贷款违约风险，使抵押贷款更加可负担的政策也能减少房屋止赎现象。在房地产市场低迷时期，最优的失业保险政策应综合考虑防止抵押贷款违约所带来的无谓损失等因素，来权衡各种利益与成本。（JEL D14, E32, G21, J65, R31）

abstract.text: We study the effects of a positive export shock on labor allocation between the informal, microenterprise sector and the formal firm sector in a low-income country. The United States-Vietnam Bilateral Trade Agreement led to large reductions in US tariffs on Vietnamese exports. We find that the share of manufacturing workers in Vietnam in the formal sector increased by 5 percentage points in response to the US tariff reductions. The reallocation was greater for workers in more internationally integrated provinces and for younger cohorts. We estimate the gap in labor productivity within manufacturing across the informal and formal sectors. This gap and the aggregate labor productivity gain from the export-induced reallocation of workers across the two sectors are reduced when we account for worker heterogeneity, measurement error, and differences in labor intensity of production. (JEL F16, J24, O14, O17, O19, P23, P33)

10.1257/aer.20141096.abstractZh: 我们研究了积极出口冲击对低收入国家中非正式微型企业部门与正式企业部门之间劳动力分配的影响。美国与越南的双边贸易协定导致美国对越南出口的关税大幅降低。我们发现，由于美国关税的降低，越南正式部门中的制造业工人比例增加了5个百分点。这种重新分配在更国际化省份的工人以及年轻一代中更为明显。我们估算了制造业中非正式部门与正式部门之间的劳动生产率差距。当我们考虑工人异质性、测量误差以及生产劳动强度的差异时，这一差距以及出口带来的劳动力重新分配所带来的总体劳动生产率提升得到了减少。（JEL F16, J24, O14, O17, O19, P23, P33）

abstract.text: We study the response of international investment flows to shortand long-run growth news. Among developed G7 countries, positive long-run news for domestic productivity induces a net outflow of investments, in contrast to the effects of short-run growth shocks. We document that a standard Backus, Keho, and Kydland (1994) (BKK) model fails to reproduce this novel empirical evidence. We augment this model with Epstein and Zin (1989) preferences (EZ-BKK) and characterize the resulting recursive risk-sharing scheme. The response of international capital flows in the EZ-BKK model is consistent with the data. (JEL F14, F32, F43, G12)

10.1257/aer.20141123.abstractZh: 我们研究了国际投资流动对短期和长期增长信息的反应。在G7发达国家中，对国内生产力的长期积极信息会导致投资的净流出，这与短期增长冲击的影响相反。我们发现，标准的Backus、Keho和Kydland（1994年）模型无法再现这一新的实证结果。我们通过引入Epstein和Zin（1989年）的偏好模型（EZ-BKK模型），并描述了由此产生的递归风险分担机制。在EZ-BKK模型中，国际资本流动的反应与数据一致。（JEL F14, F32, F43, G12）

abstract.text: The National Resident Matching program seeks a stable matching of medical students to teaching hospitals. With couples, stable matchings need not exist. Nevertheless, for any student preferences, we show that each instance of a matching problem has a "nearby" instance with a stable matching. The nearby instance is obtained by perturbing the capacities of the hospitals. In this perturbation, aggregate capacity is never reduced and can increase by at most four. The capacity of each hospital never changes by more than two.

10.1257/aer.20141188.abstractZh: 国家住院医师匹配计划旨在实现医学生与教学医院之间的稳定匹配。对于非配对的情况，稳定匹配可能并不存在。然而，对于任何学生的偏好，我们证明了匹配问题的每个实例都存在一个“邻近”实例，该实例具有稳定的匹配。这种邻近实例是通过调整医院的容量来实现的。在这种调整中，总容量不会减少，最多可以增加四倍。而每家医院的容量变化不会超过两倍。

abstract.text: We propose and estimate a novel specification of labor demand which encompasses search frictions and the role of entrepreneurs in new firm creation. Using city-industry variation over four decades, we estimate the wage elasticity of employment demand to be close to −1 at the industry-city level and −0.3 at the city level. We argue that the difference between these estimates reflects the congestion externalities predicted by the search literature. Our estimates also indicate that entrepreneurship should be treated as a scarce factor in the determination of labor demand. We use our estimates to evaluate the impact of large changes in the minimum wage on employment. (JEL J23, J31, J38, L26, M13, R23)

10.1257/aer.20141374.abstractZh: 我们提出并估计了一种新的劳动需求模型，该模型考虑了搜索摩擦以及企业家在新企业创建中的作用。通过对比四十年来城市与行业的差异，我们发现就业需求的工资弹性在行业-城市层面上接近-1，在城市层面上则约为-0.3。我们认为，这些估计值之间的差异反映了搜索文献所预测的拥堵外部性。我们的估计还表明，企业家精神应被视为决定劳动需求中的稀缺因素。我们利用这些估计值来评估最低工资大幅变动对就业的影响。（JEL J23, J31, J38, L26, M13, R23）

abstract.text: This paper studies the welfare effects of a “partial banking union” in which cross-country transfers for bailouts are set at the supranational level, but policymakers in member countries decide the distribution of funds. This allows the self-interested policymakers to extract rents in the bailout process. In equilibrium, such a banking union can actually lower the welfare of citizens in the country receiving transfers compared to the autarky case, as the receiving country must increase its share of the overall burden of the bailout, in order to compensate for the rent-seeking distortion. Supranational fiscal rules are ineffective at reversing this result. (JEL D72, E44, E61, G01, G21, G28)

10.1257/aer.20141388.abstractZh: 本文研究了“部分银行联盟”的福利效应。在这种模式下，跨国救助资金的分配由超国家层面决定，而具体资金如何分配则由成员国政策制定者决定。这使得自私的政策制定者在救助过程中能够获取利益。在均衡状态下，这种银行联盟实际上可能会降低接受救助国家的公民福利，因为该国必须承担更多的救助负担，以弥补寻租行为的扭曲效应。超国家的财政规则无法扭转这一结果。（JEL D72, E44, E61, G01, G21, G28）

abstract.text: This paper studies how in utero exposure to maternal stress from family ruptures affects later mental health. We find that prenatal exposure to the death of a maternal relative increases take-up of ADHD medications during childhood and anti-anxiety and depression medications in adulthood. Further, family ruptures during pregnancy depress birth outcomes and raise the risk of perinatal complications necessitating hospitalization. Our results suggest large welfare gains from preventing fetal stress from family ruptures and possibly from economically induced stressors such as unemployment. They further suggest that greater stress exposure among the poor may partially explain the intergenerational persistence of poverty.

10.1257/aer.20141406.abstractZh: 本文研究了母体在怀孕期间因家庭破裂而承受的压力对后期心理健康的影响。研究发现，母亲在怀孕期间遭遇亲属死亡的情况，会增加儿童时期对ADHD药物的服用，以及成年后对抗焦虑药物和抗抑郁药物的依赖。此外，怀孕期间的家庭破裂会严重影响分娩结果，并增加围产期并发症的风险，导致需要住院治疗。我们的研究结果表明，预防胎儿因家庭破裂而承受的压力，以及可能由经济因素引起的压力（如失业），能够带来巨大的福利收益。研究还表明，贫困群体所承受的更大压力，可能部分解释了贫困现象的代际延续问题。

abstract.text: A salient characteristic of sovereign defaults is that they are typically accompanied by large devaluations. This paper presents new evidence of this empirical regularity known as the Twin Ds and proposes a model that rationalizes it as an optimal policy outcome. The model combines limited enforcement of debt contracts and downward nominal wage rigidity. Under optimal policy, default is shown to occur during contractions. The role of default is to free up resources for domestic absorption, and the role of exchange rate devaluation is to lower the real value of wages, thereby reducing involuntary unemployment. (JEL E24, E32, E52, F31, F34, F41)

10.1257/aer.20141558.abstractZh: 主权违约的一个显著特征是，它们通常伴随着严重的货币贬值。本文提出了这一经验规律性的新证据，并提出了一种模型来解释这一现象，认为这是一种最优政策结果。该模型结合了债务合同的有限执行和名义工资的向下刚性。在最优政策下，违约发生在经济收缩期间。违约的作用是将资源释放出来用于国内消费，而货币贬值的作用则是降低工资的实际价值，从而减少非自愿失业现象。（JEL E24, E32, E52, F31, F34, F41）

abstract.text: Despite facing significant uncertainty about their lifespans and health care costs, most retirees do not buy annuities or long-term care insurance. In this paper, I find that retirees’ saving and insurance choices are highly inconsistent with standard life-cycle models in which people care only about their own consumption but match well models in which bequests are luxury goods. Bequest motives tend to reduce the value of insurance by reducing the opportunity cost of precautionary saving. The results suggest that bequest motives significantly increase saving and significantly decrease purchases of long-term care insurance and annuities.

10.1257/aer.20141651.abstractZh: 尽管面临寿命和医疗保健成本方面的重大不确定性，大多数退休人员并不购买年金或长期护理保险。本文发现，退休人员的储蓄和保险选择与标准生命周期模型存在很大差异，在标准生命周期模型中，人们只关心自己的消费，而这一模型则与将遗产视为奢侈品的模型更为吻合。遗产动机往往会通过降低预防性储蓄的机会成本来降低保险的价值。研究结果表明，遗产动机显著增加了储蓄，并显著减少了长期护理保险和年金的购买行为。

abstract.text: We consider the classic problem of estimating group treatment effects when individuals sort based on observed and unobserved characteristics. Using a standard choice model, we show that controlling for group averages of observed individual characteristics potentially absorbs all the across-group variation in unobservable individual characteristics. We use this insight to bound the treatment effect variance of school systems and associated neighborhoods for various outcomes. Across multiple datasets, we find that a ninetieth versus tenth percentile school/neighborhood increases the high school graduation probability and college enrollment probability by at least 0.04 and 0.11 and permanent wages by 13.7 percent. (JEL C51, H75, I21, I26, J24, J31, R23)

10.1257/aer.20141708.abstractZh: 我们考虑了在个体基于可观测和不可观测特征进行排序时，估计群体处理效应的经典问题。通过标准选择模型，我们表明，控制可观测个体特征的群体平均值可能会掩盖不可观测个体特征的群体差异。我们利用这一洞察力来界定学校系统及其相关社区对各种结果的处理效应方差。在多个数据集的对比中，我们发现，将学校/社区处于第九百分位与第十百分位相比，高中毕业概率和大学入学概率分别增加了0.04和0.11，永久工资则增加了13.7%。（JEL C51, H75, I21, I26, J24, J31, R23）

abstract.text: We develop a quantifiable general equilibrium model of trade and multinational production (MP) in which countries can specialize in innovation or production. Home market effects or comparative advantage leads some countries to specialize in innovation and relegate manufacturing operations to other countries via outward MP. Counterfactual analysis reveals that the reduction in the cost of MP or the integration of China into the world economy may hurt countries that are driven to specialize in production, although these losses tend to be very small. Contrary to popular fears, production workers gain even in countries that further specialize in innovation. (JEL D58, F12, F14, F23, L60, O31)

10.1257/aer.20141743.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个可量化的一般均衡模型，用于研究贸易和跨国生产。在该模型中，各国可以专注于创新或生产。本土市场效应或比较优势使得一些国家选择专注于创新，而将制造业务外包给其他国家。反事实分析表明，降低跨国生产的成本或中国融入世界经济可能会损害那些被迫专注于生产的国家的利益，尽管这些损失通常非常微小。与普遍担忧相反，即使在那些进一步专注于创新的国家，生产工人也会受益。（JEL D58, F12, F14, F23, L60, O31）

abstract.text: This paper develops and estimates an equilibrium model where heterogeneous firms can exploit two margins of informality: (i) not register their business, the extensive margin; and (ii) hire workers “off the books,” the intensive margin. The model encompasses the main competing frameworks for understanding informality and provides a natural setting to infer their empirical relevance. The counterfactual analysis shows that once the intensive margin is accounted for, firm and labor informality need not move in the same direction as a result of policy changes. Lower informality can be, but is not necessarily associated with higher output, TFP, or welfare. (JEL D22, E26, H26, J46, O14, O17)

10.1257/aer.20141745.abstractZh: 本文发展并估计了一个均衡模型，该模型允许异质企业利用两种非正式性：一是不注册企业，即广泛的非正式性；二是雇佣“账外”工人，即高度非正式性。该模型涵盖了理解非正式性的主要框架，并为推断其实证相关性提供了自然的环境。反事实分析表明，一旦考虑了高度非正式性，企业和劳动力的非正式性并不一定会因政策变化而朝同一方向变化。较低的非正式性可能与更高的产出、全要素生产率或福利无关，但并非必然如此。（JEL D22, E26, H26, J46, O14, O17）

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of the mortgage interest tax deduction on equilibrium house prices, rents, homeownership, and welfare. We build a dynamic model of the housing market that features a realistic progressive tax system in which owner-occupied housing services are tax-exempt and mortgage interest payments are tax-deductible. We simulate the effect of tax reform on the housing market. Eliminating the mortgage interest deduction causes house prices to decline, increases homeownership, decreases mortgage debt, and improves welfare. Our findings challenge the widely held view that repealing the preferential tax treatment of mortgages would depress homeownership. (JEL H24, H31, R21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20141751.abstractZh: 本文研究了 mortgage利息税收减免对房价、租金、房屋所有权以及福利的影响。我们构建了一个动态住房市场模型，该模型包含了一个现实的累进税制，其中自住住房服务免税，而抵押贷款利息支出则可抵税。我们模拟了税收改革对住房市场的影响。取消 mortgage利息税收减免会导致房价下降，增加房屋所有权，减少抵押贷款债务，并改善福利状况。我们的研究结果挑战了普遍的观点，即废除对抵押贷款的优惠税收待遇会抑制房屋所有权。（JEL H24, H31, R21, R31）

abstract.text: To account for the uneven distribution of economic activity in space, I propose a theory of the location choices of heterogeneous firms in a variety of sectors across cities. In equilibrium, the distribution of city sizes and the sorting patterns of firms are uniquely determined and affect aggregate TFP and welfare. I estimate the model using French firm-level data and find that nearly half of the productivity advantage of large cities is due to firm sorting, the rest coming from agglomeration economies. I quantify the general equilibrium effects of place-based policies: policies that subsidize smaller cities have negative aggregate effects. (JEL D22, D24, R11, R32)

10.1257/aer.20150361.abstractZh: 为了解释经济活动在空间上的不均匀分布，我提出了一个理论，用于解释不同行业企业在不同城市中的选址选择。在均衡状态下，城市规模的分布和企业排序模式是唯一确定的，这些因素会影响总体技术效率和福利水平。我使用法国企业层面的数据对模型进行了估计，发现大城市的生产力优势几乎有一半是由于企业排序造成的，其余部分则来自集聚经济效应。我量化了基于地点的政策的总体均衡效应：对较小城市提供补贴的政策会产生负面总体影响。（JEL D22, D24, R11, R32）

abstract.text: We study the effects of asymmetric information and imperfect competition in the market for small business lines of credit. We estimate a structural model of credit demand, loan use, pricing, and firm default using matched firm-bank data from Italy. We find evidence of adverse selection in the form of a positive correlation between the unobserved determinants of demand for credit and default. Our counterfactual experiments show that while increases in adverse selection increase prices and defaults on average, reducing credit supply, banks’ market power can mitigate these negative effects. (JEL D22, D82, G21, G32, L13, L25)

10.1257/aer.20150487.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息不对称和市场竞争不完美对小型企业信贷市场的影响。我们利用来自意大利的匹配企业-银行数据，构建了一个关于信贷需求、贷款使用、定价和企业违约的结构模型。我们发现，信贷需求和违约之间存在正相关关系，这表明存在逆向选择现象。我们的反事实实验表明，虽然逆向选择的增加会导致价格和违约率上升，从而减少信贷供应，但银行的市场力量可以缓解这些负面效应。（JEL D22, D82, G21, G32, L13, L25）

abstract.text: This paper exploits a unique historical experiment to estimate how information frictions distort international trade: the establishment of the transatlantic telegraph in 1866. I use newly collected data on cotton prices, trade, and information flows from historical newspapers and find that the average and volatility of the transatlantic price difference fell after the telegraph, while average trade flows increased and became more volatile. Using a trade model in which exporters use the latest news about a foreign market to forecast expected prices, I estimate the efficiency gains of the telegraph to be equivalent to 8 percent of export value. (JEL D83, F12, F14, L96, N71, N73)

10.1257/aer.20150681.abstractZh: 本文利用一个独特的历史实验来估计信息摩擦如何扭曲国际贸易：1866年大西洋电报的建立。我使用了从历史报纸中收集到的关于棉花价格、贸易和信息流的新数据，发现电报开通后，大西洋两岸价格差异的平均值和波动性都下降了，而平均贸易流量则增加且变得更加不稳定。通过构建一个贸易模型，该模型中的出口商利用关于外国市场的最新消息来预测预期价格，我估计电报带来的效率提升相当于出口价值的8%。（JEL D83, F12, F14, L96, N71, N73）

abstract.text: We model the joint distribution of choice probabilities and decision times in binary decisions as the solution to a problem of optimal sequential sampling, where the agent is uncertain of the utility of each action and pays a constant cost per unit time for gathering information. We show that choices are more likely to be correct when the agent chooses to decide quickly, provided the agent’s prior beliefs are correct. This better matches the observed correlation between decision time and choice probability than does the classical drift-diffusion model (DDM), where the agent knows the utility difference between the choices. (JEL C41, D11, D12, D83)

10.1257/aer.20150742.abstractZh: 我们将二元决策中选择概率与决策时间的联合分布建模为最优序贯抽样问题的解。在这个问题中，代理人对每种行动的效用不确定，并且每单位时间都会支付固定的信息收集成本。我们表明，当代理人选择快速做出决策时，选择更有可能是正确的，前提是代理人的先验信念是正确的。这与观察到的决策时间与选择概率之间的相关性更为吻合，而传统的漂移扩散模型（DDM）则无法很好地解释这种相关性，因为在传统模型中，代理人知道各种选择之间的效用差异。（JEL C41, D11, D12, D83）

abstract.text: A quantitative model brings together theories linking international trade to quality, technology, and demand for skills. Standard effects of trade on importers and exporters are magnified through domestic input linkages. We estimate the model with data from Colombian manufacturing firms before the 1991 trade liberalization. A counterfactual trade liberalization is broadly consistent with post-liberalization data. It increases skill intensity from 12 to 16 percent, while decreasing sales. Imported inputs, estimated to be of higher quality, and domestic input linkages are quantitatively important. Economies of scale, export expansion, and reallocation of production are small and cannot explain post-liberalization data. (JEL F14, F16, J24, L60, O14, O19, O33)

10.1257/aer.20150796.abstractZh: 该定量模型整合了将国际贸易与质量、技术以及技能需求联系起来的理论。通过国内投入的关联，贸易对进口商和出口商的标准影响被放大。我们基于1991年贸易自由化之前哥伦比亚制造企业的数据对该模型进行了估计。假设没有进行贸易自由化的情况与自由化后的数据大体一致。贸易自由化使技能强度从12%增加到16%，同时销售额却有所下降。被估计为质量更高的进口投入以及国内投入的关联在定量上具有重要意义。规模经济、出口扩张以及生产的重新分配效应较小，无法解释自由化后的数据。（JEL F14, F16, J24, L60, O14, O19, O33）

abstract.text: Medical care represents an important component of workers' compensation benefits with the potential to improve health and post-injury labor outcomes, but little is known about the relationship between medical care spending and the labor outcomes of injured workers. We exploit the 2003--2004 California workers' compensation reforms which reduced medical spending disproportionately for workers incurring low back injuries. We link administrative claims data to earnings records for injured workers and their uninjured coworkers. We find that workers with low back injuries experienced a 7.6 percent post-reform decline in medical care, and an 8.1 percent drop in post-injury earnings relative to other injured workers.

10.1257/aer.20150912.abstractZh: 医疗护理是工人赔偿福利的重要组成部分，具有改善健康状况和受伤后劳动成果的潜力，但关于医疗支出与受伤工人劳动成果之间的关系，目前了解甚少。我们利用了2003-2004年加州工人赔偿改革的影响，该改革导致遭受腰痛的工人的医疗支出大幅减少。我们将行政索赔数据与受伤工人及其未受伤同事的收入记录进行了关联分析。研究发现，遭受腰痛的工人在接受改革后的医疗护理支出减少了7.6%，受伤后的收入也比其他受伤工人减少了8.1%。

abstract.text: In the US Senate, roll calls are held in alphabetical order. We document that senators early in the order are less likely to vote with the majority of their own party than those whose last name places them at the end of the alphabet. To speak to the mechanism behind this result, we develop a simple model of sequential voting, in which forward-looking senators rely on backward induction in order to free ride on their colleagues. Estimating our model structurally, we find that this form of strategic behavior is an important part of equilibrium play. We also consider, but ultimately dismiss, alternative explanations related to learning about common values and vote buying. (JEL D72, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20150993.abstractZh: 在美国参议院中，议员们的投票按照字母顺序进行。我们发现，排在字母表末尾的参议员比那些排在字母表前端的参议员更不可能与其所在政党的多数成员一起投票。为了探讨这一结果背后的机制，我们建立了一个简单的顺序投票模型，其中具有前瞻性意识的参议员依靠后向归纳来利用其他参议员的投票行为。从结构上看，我们发现这种策略性行为是均衡博弈的重要组成部分。我们还考虑了其他可能的解释，但最终认为这些解释并不成立，比如关于共同价值观的了解或投票贿赂等。 (JEL D72, D82, D83)

abstract.text: We investigate the link between real exchange rates and sectoral TFP for eurozone countries. We show that real exchange rate variation, both cross-country and time-series, closely accords with an amended Balassa-Samuelson interpretation, incorporating sectoral productivity shocks and a labor market wedge. We construct a DSGE model to generate a cross section and time series of real exchange rates to compare to data. Estimates from simulated regressions are very similar to estimates for eurozone data. Our findings contrast with previous studies that have found little relationship between productivity and real exchange rates among high-income countries that have floating nominal exchange rates. (JEL E12, E23, E24, F31, F33, F43)

10.1257/aer.20151045.abstractZh: 我们研究了欧元区国家实际汇率与部门全要素生产率之间的联系。我们发现，无论是跨国还是时间序列上的实际汇率变化，都与经过修正的Balassa-Samuelson理论解释非常吻合，该理论考虑了部门生产率冲击和劳动力市场差异的影响。我们构建了一个DSGE模型，生成实际汇率的横截面数据和时间序列数据，以便与实际情况进行比较。模拟回归的估计结果与欧元区数据的估计结果非常相似。我们的发现与以往的研究不同，以往的研究发现，在拥有浮动名义汇率的高收入国家中，生产率与实际汇率之间几乎没有关系。（JEL E12, E23, E24, F31, F33, F43）

abstract.text: More than one-half of all people living with HIV are women and 80 percent of all HIV-positive women in the world live in sub- Saharan Africa. This paper demonstrates that the legal origins of these formerly colonized countries significantly determine current-day female HIV rates. In particular, female HIV rates are significantly higher in common law sub- Saharan African countries compared to civil law ones. This paper explains this relationship by focusing on differences in female property rights under the two codes of law. In sub- Saharan Africa, common law is associated with weaker female marital property laws. As a result, women in these common law countries have lower bargaining power within the household and are less able to negotiate safe sex practices and are thus more vulnerable to HIV, compared to their civil law counterparts. Exploiting the fact that some ethnic groups in sub- Saharan Africa cross country borders with different legal systems, we are able to include ethnicity fixed effects into a regression discontinuity approach. This allows us to control for a large set of cultural, geographical, and environmental factors that could be confounding the estimates. The results of this paper are consistent with gender inequality (the "feminization" of AIDS), explaining much of its prevalence in sub- Saharan Africa.

10.1257/aer.20151047.abstractZh: 超过一半的HIV感染者是女性，而全球80%的HIV阳性女性生活在撒哈拉以南非洲地区。本文指出，这些曾经被殖民国家的法律制度对当前女性HIV感染率有着显著的影响。具体而言，与民法国家相比，撒哈拉以南非洲地区的普通法国家女性HIV感染率明显更高。本文通过对比两种法律体系下女性财产权的差异来解释这一关系。在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，普通法往往伴随着较弱的女性婚姻财产法律。因此，这些普通法国家中的女性在家庭内部议价能力较低，难以协商安全的性行为，从而更容易感染HIV。考虑到撒哈拉以南非洲某些民族跨越国界时仍遵循不同的法律体系，我们能够将民族因素纳入回归不连续模型中进行分析。这一方法有助于控制一系列可能干扰估计结果的文化、地理和环境因素。本文的研究结果与性别不平等现象相符，即“艾滋病女性化”现象，这也解释了为何HIV感染率在撒哈拉以南非洲地区如此普遍。

abstract.text: Governments are present-biased toward spending. Fiscal rules are deficit limits that trade off commitment to not overspend and flexibility to react to shocks. We compare coordinated rules, chosen jointly by a group of countries, to uncoordinated rules. If governments’ present bias is small, coordinated rules are tighter than uncoordinated rules: individual countries do not internalize the redistributive effect of interest rates. However, if the bias is large, coordinated rules are slacker: countries do not internalize the disciplining effect of interest rates. Surplus limits enhance welfare, and increased savings by some countries or outside economies can hurt the rest. (JEL D82, E43, E62, H62)

10.1257/aer.20151180.abstractZh: 政府存在支出偏向。财政规则是赤字限制，它平衡了不过度支出的承诺与应对冲击的灵活性。我们比较了由多个国家共同制定的协调规则与非协调规则。如果政府的支出偏向较小，协调规则比非协调规则更为严格：各个国家不会将利率的再分配效应内部化。然而，如果偏向较大，协调规则则较为宽松：各国不会将利率的约束效应内部化。赤字限制能够提升福利，但某些国家或外部经济体增加储蓄可能会损害其他国家的利益。（JEL D82, E43, E62, H62）

abstract.text: We establish the importance of team-specific capital in the typical inventor's career. Using administrative tax and patent data for the population of US patent inventors from 1996 to 2012, we find that an inventor's premature death causes a large and long-lasting decline in their co-inventor's earnings and citation-weighted patents (−4 percent and −15 percent after 8 years, respectively). After ruling out firm disruption, network effects, and top-down spillovers as main channels, we show that the effect is driven by close-knit teams and that team-specific capital largely results from an “experience” component increasing collaboration value over time. (JEL J24, J31, M54, O31, O34)

10.1257/aer.20151184.abstractZh: 我们强调了团队特定资本在典型发明人职业生涯中的重要性。通过利用1996至2012年间美国专利发明人的行政税务和专利数据，我们发现发明人的过早死亡会导致其共同发明人的收入以及引用加权专利数量出现较大且长期的下降（分别在8年后下降4%和15%）。在排除了企业中断、网络效应以及自上而下的溢出效应作为主要影响途径后，我们发现这种影响主要由紧密的团队所驱动，而团队特定资本在很大程度上源于“经验”成分随时间推移增加合作价值的作用。（JEL J24, J31, M54, O31, O34）

abstract.text: Employment and hours are more cyclical than dictated by productivity and consumption. This intratemporal labor wedge can arise from product or labor market distortions. Based on employee wages, the literature has attributed the intratemporal wedge almost entirely to labor market distortions. Because wages may be smoothed versions of labor's true cyclical price, we instead examine the self-employed and intermediate inputs, respectively. For recent decades in the United States, we find price markup movements are at least as cyclical as wage markup movements. Thus, countercyclical price markups deserve a central place in business-cycle research, alongside sticky wages and matching frictions. (JEL E24, E32, E63, J31, J41)

10.1257/aer.20151260.abstractZh: 就业和工时的变化比生产力和消费所决定的变化更为周期性。这种时间内的劳动力缺口可能源于产品或劳动力市场的扭曲。根据员工工资的数据，文献几乎将这种时间内的缺口完全归因于劳动力市场的扭曲。由于工资可能是劳动力真实周期性价格平滑后的结果，我们转而关注个体经营者和中间投入。在美国近几十年的数据中，我们发现价格加成的变化至少与工资加价的变化一样具有周期性。因此，反周期性的价格加成在商业周期研究中应占据重要地位，与粘性工资和匹配摩擦一起被重视。（JEL E24, E32, E63, J31, J41）

abstract.text: Between 1990 and 2008, air pollution emissions from US manufacturing fell by 60 percent despite a substantial increase in manufacturing output. We show that these emissions reductions are primarily driven by within-product changes in emissions intensity rather than changes in output or in the composition of products produced. We then develop and estimate a quantitative model linking trade with the environment to better understand the economic forces driving these changes. Our estimates suggest that the implicit pollution tax that manufacturers face doubled between 1990 and 2008. These changes in environmental regulation, rather than changes in productivity and trade, account for most of the emissions reductions. (JEL F18, H23, L60, Q52, Q53, Q56, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20151272.abstractZh: 在1990年至2008年间，尽管美国制造业产出大幅增长，但其空气污染排放量却减少了60%。我们发现，这些排放量的减少主要源于产品内部排放强度的变化，而非产出或产品构成的变化。随后，我们建立并估算了一个将贸易与环境联系起来的定量模型，以更好地理解推动这些变化的经济因素。我们的估计表明，制造商面临的隐性污染税在1990年至2008年间翻了一番。这些环境法规的变化，而非生产力和贸易的变化，才是导致排放量减少的主要原因。（JEL F18, H23, L60, Q52, Q53, Q56, Q58）

abstract.text: We survey New Zealand firms and document novel facts about their macroeconomic beliefs. There is widespread dispersion in beliefs about past and future macroeconomic conditions, especially inflation. This dispersion in beliefs is consistent with firms’ incentives to collect and process information. Using experimental methods, we find that firms update their beliefs in a Bayesian manner when presented with new information about the economy and that changes in their beliefs affect their decisions. Inflation is not generally perceived as being important to business decisions so firms devote few resources to collecting and processing information about inflation. (JEL D22, D83, D84, E31, E52)

10.1257/aer.20151299.abstractZh: 我们调查了新西兰的企业，并记录了关于它们宏观经济信念的一些新发现。关于过去和未来的宏观经济状况，尤其是通货膨胀的信念存在广泛的差异。这种信念的差异与企业在收集和处理信息方面的动机是一致的。通过实验方法，我们发现当企业获得有关经济的新信息时，会以贝叶斯的方式更新他们的信念，而且信念的变化会影响他们的决策。通货膨胀通常不被认为对商业决策很重要，因此企业很少投入资源来收集和处理有关通货膨胀的信息。（JEL D22, D83, D84, E31, E52）

abstract.text: A central question in the debate over privatized Medicare is whether increased government payments to private Medicare Advantage (MA) plans generate lower premiums for consumers or higher profits for producers. Using difference‑in‑differences variation brought about by a sharp legislative change, we find that MA insurers pass through 45 percent of increased payments in lower premiums and an additional 9 percent in more generous benefits. We show that advantageous selection into MA cannot explain this incomplete pass‑through. Instead, our evidence suggests that market power is important, with premium pass‑through rates of 13 percent in the least competitive markets and 74 percent in the most competitive.
