10.1257/aer.20151362.abstractZh: 在关于私有化Medicare的辩论中，一个核心问题是，政府增加对私人Medicare Advantage计划的支付，是否会降低消费者的保费或增加生产者的利润。通过一项重大立法变更所带来的差异分析，我们发现，Medicare保险公司将45%的增加支付转化为降低的保费，另外9%则转化为更优厚的福利。我们的研究表明，选择进入Medicare Advantage计划并不能解释这种不完全的传递效应。相反，我们的证据表明，市场力量起着重要作用，在竞争最不激烈的市场中，保费传递率仅为13%，而在竞争最激烈的市场中则高达74%。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of advertising as a channel for risk selection in Medicare Advantage. We provide evidence that insurer advertising is responsive to the gains from risk selection. Then we develop and estimate an equilibrium model of Medicare Advantage with advertising, allowing rich individual heterogeneity. Our estimates show that advertising is effective in attracting healthy individuals who are newly eligible for Medicare, contributing to advantageous selection into Medicare Advantage. Moreover, risk selection through advertising substantially lowers premiums by improving insurers' risk pools. The distributional implication is that unhealthy consumers may be better off through cross-subsidization from healthy individuals.

10.1257/aer.20151485.abstractZh: 本文研究了广告作为医疗保险 Advantage 风险选择渠道的影响。我们提供了证据，表明保险公司的广告活动能够响应风险选择所带来的收益。随后，我们建立并估计了一个包含广告的医疗保险 Advantage 均衡模型，该模型考虑了个体间的异质性。我们的估计结果显示，广告在吸引新符合医疗保险条件的健康个体方面具有有效性，从而有助于实现更有利的风险选择。此外，通过广告进行风险选择能够显著降低保费，因为广告改善了保险公司的风险池。从分配角度来看，不健康的消费者可能通过健康个体的交叉补贴而受益。

abstract.text: We provide theory and evidence that the elasticity of local employment to a labor demand shock is heterogeneous depending on the commuting openness of the local labor market. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model that incorporates spatial linkages in goods markets (trade) and factor markets (commuting and migration). We quantify this model to match the observed gravity equation relationships for trade and commuting. We find that empirically-observed reductions in commuting costs generate welfare gains of around 3.3 percent. We provide separate quasi-experimental evidence in support of the model’s predictions using the location decisions of million dollar plants. (JEL J23, J61, R23, R32, R41)

10.1257/aer.20151507.abstractZh: 我们提供了理论和证据，表明当地就业对劳动力需求冲击的弹性是异质的，这取决于当地劳动力市场的通勤开放性。我们开发了一个定量一般均衡模型，该模型将商品市场（贸易）和要素市场（通勤和迁移）的空间联系纳入其中。我们对该模型进行量化分析，以匹配观察到的贸易和通勤的引力方程关系。我们发现，实际观察到的通勤成本降低会带来约3.3%的福利收益。我们还提供了基于百万美元工厂选址决策的准实验证据，以支持该模型的预测。（JEL J23, J61, R23, R32, R41）

abstract.text: After World War II, international capital flowed into slow-growing Latin America rather than fast-growing Asia. This is surprising as, everything else equal, fast growth should imply high capital returns. This paper develops a capital flow accounting framework to quantify the role of different factor market distortions in producing these patterns. Surprisingly, we find that distortions in labor markets, rather than domestic or international capital markets, account for the bulk of these flows. Labor market distortions that indirectly depress investment incentives by lowering equilibrium labor supply explain two-thirds of observed flows, while improvement in these distortions over time accounts for much of Asia's rapid growth. (JEL E22, E24, E32, F21, F32, O16, O47)

10.1257/aer.20151510.abstractZh: 第二次世界大战后，国际资本流向了增长缓慢的拉丁美洲，而非快速增长的大亚洲地区。这令人惊讶，因为在其他条件相同的情况下，快速增长应该意味着较高的资本回报。本文提出了一个资本流动核算框架，以量化不同要素市场扭曲因素在这些流动模式中的作用。令人惊讶的是，我们发现，劳动力市场中的扭曲因素，而非国内或国际资本市场中的扭曲因素，才是这些流动的主要来源。通过降低均衡劳动力供应来间接抑制投资激励的劳动力市场扭曲因素，解释了观察到的流动中的三分之二，而随着时间的推移对这些扭曲因素的改善，则解释了亚洲快速增长的很大一部分原因。（JEL E22, E24, E32, F21, F32, O16, O47）

abstract.text: We study how the recent housing boom and bust affected college enrollment during the 2000s. We exploit cross-city variation in local housing booms, which improved labor market opportunities for young men and women. We find that the boom lowered college enrollment, with effects concentrated at two-year colleges. The decline in enrollment during the boom was generally reversed during the bust; however, attainment remains persistently low for particular cohorts, suggesting that reduced educational attainment is an enduring effect of the recent housing cycle. The housing boom can account for approximately 25 percent of the recent slowdown in college attainment. (JEL I23, I25, J24, J31, R21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20151604.abstractZh: 我们研究了近期的房地产繁荣与萧条在2000年代对大学入学率的影响。我们利用了不同城市在房地产繁荣方面的差异，这些差异为年轻男女提供了更好的就业机会。我们发现，房地产繁荣导致了大学入学率的下降，这一影响主要集中在两年制大学。在繁荣时期，入学率的下降在萧条时期得到了逆转；然而，某些群体的教育成就仍然持续偏低，这表明近期房地产周期对教育成就的影响是持久的。房地产繁荣可能解释了近期大学教育成就放缓的约25%。（JEL I23, I25, J24, J31, R21, R31）

abstract.text: We present a novel empirical benchmark for analyzing credit risk using “pseudo firms” that purchase traded assets financed with equity and zero-coupon bonds. By no-arbitrage, pseudo bonds are equivalent to Treasuries minus put options on pseudo firm assets. Empirically, like corporate spreads, pseudo bond spreads are large, countercyclical, and predict lower economic growth. Using this framework, we find that bond market illiquidity, investors' overestimation of default risks, and corporate frictions do not seem to explain excessive observed credit spreads but, instead, a risk premium for tail and idiosyncratic asset risks is the primary determinant of corporate spreads. (JEL E23, E32, E44, G13, G24, G32)

10.1257/aer.20151606.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新颖的实证基准方法，用于分析信用风险，该方法使用“伪公司”来购买由股权和零息债券融资的交易资产。由于无套利原则，伪债券相当于国债减去对伪公司资产的看跌期权。从实证角度来看，与企业利差一样，伪债券利差较大、具有反周期性，并且预示着较低的经济增长。利用这一框架，我们发现债券市场的流动性不足、投资者对违约风险的高估以及企业摩擦似乎并不能解释观察到的过高信用利差，相反，尾部风险和特定资产风险的风险溢价才是决定企业利差的主要因素。（JEL E23, E32, E44, G13, G24, G32）

abstract.text: Policy uncertainty reduces individual welfare when individuals have limited opportunities to mitigate or insure against the resulting consumption fluctuations. We field an original survey to measure the degree of perceived policy uncertainty in Social Security benefits and to estimate the impact of this uncertainty on individual welfare. Our central estimates show that on average individuals are willing to forgo 6 percent of the benefits they are supposed to get under current law to remove the policy uncertainty associated with their future Social Security benefits. This translates to a risk premium from policy uncertainty equal to 10 percent of expected benefits.

10.1257/aer.20151703.abstractZh: 政策的不确定性会降低个人的福利，因为个人在缓解或防范由此产生的消费波动方面的机会有限。我们开展了一项原创性调查，以衡量社会保障福利中感知到的政策不确定性的程度，并评估这种不确定性对个人福利的影响。我们的核心估计显示，平均而言，个人愿意放弃根据现行法律应获得的6%的福利，以消除未来社会保障福利所伴随的政策不确定性。这意味着政策不确定性的风险溢价相当于预期福利的10%。

abstract.text: This paper builds a new internationally comparable database of hours worked to measure how hours vary with income across and within countries. We document that average hours worked per adult are substantially higher in low-income countries than in high-income countries. The pattern of decreasing hours with aggregate income holds for both men and women, for adults of all ages and education levels, and along both the extensive and intensive margin. Within countries, hours worked per worker are also decreasing in the individual wage for most countries, though in the richest countries, hours worked are flat or increasing in the wage. One implication of our findings is that aggregate productivity and welfare differences across countries are larger than currently thought. (JEL E23, E24, J22, J31, O11, O15)

10.1257/aer.20151720.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个新的国际可比数据库，用于衡量不同国家之间以及同一国家内工作时间随收入变化的状况。我们发现，低收入国家成年人的平均工作时间显著高于高收入国家。工作时间随总收入减少的趋势适用于所有年龄和教育水平的成年人群体，无论是在广度还是强度方面都是如此。在同一国家内，大多数国家的劳动者每小时工作时间也在减少，但在最富裕的国家，工作时间在工资不变或有所增加。我们的研究结果表明，各国之间的总体生产力和福利差异比目前认为的要大。（JEL E23, E24, J22, J31, O11, O15）

abstract.text: This paper uses a natural experiment to estimate the causal effect of temporary trade protection on long-term economic development. I find that regions in the French Empire which became better protected from trade with the British for exogenous reasons during the Napoleonic Wars (1803–1815) increased capacity in mechanized cotton spinning to a larger extent than regions which remained more exposed to trade. In the long run, regions with exogenously higher spinning capacity had higher activity in mechanized cotton spinning. They also had higher value added per capita in industry up to the second half of the nineteenth century, but not later. (JEL F13, L67, N43, N63, N73)

10.1257/aer.20151730.abstractZh: 本文通过自然实验来估计临时贸易保护对长期经济发展的因果效应。研究发现，在拿破仑战争期间（1803–1815年），由于外部原因，法国帝国中那些对英国贸易保护程度较高的地区，其机械化棉纺产能的增长幅度大于那些贸易环境较为开放的地区。从长期来看，具有较高机械化棉纺产能的地区，其机械化棉纺活动也更为活跃。在19世纪下半叶之前，这些地区的工业人均附加值也高于其他地区，但之后则不再如此。（JEL F13, L67, N43, N63, N73）

abstract.text: We revisit the transmission mechanism from monetary policy to household consumption in a Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian (HANK) model. The model yields empirically realistic distributions of wealth and marginal propensities to consume because of two features: uninsurable income shocks and multiple assets with different degrees of liquidity and different returns. In this environment, the indirect effects of an unexpected cut in interest rates, which operate through a general equilibrium increase in labor demand, far outweigh direct effects such as intertemporal substitution. This finding is in stark contrast to small- and medium-scale Representative Agent New Keynesian (RANK) economies, where the substitution channel drives virtually all of the transmission from interest rates to consumption. Failure of Ricardian equivalence implies that, in HANK models, the fiscal reaction to the monetary expansion is a key determinant of the overall size of the macroeconomic response. (JEL D31, E12, E21, E24, E43, E52, E62)

10.1257/aer.20160042.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了货币政策对家庭消费的影响机制，使用的是异质代理人新凯恩斯模型。该模型能够给出符合实际数据的财富分布和边际消费倾向分布，这得益于两个特点：不可保值的收入冲击以及具有不同流动性和不同回报率的多种资产。在这种环境下，利率意外下降的间接效应通过一般均衡下劳动力需求的增加来发挥作用，其影响力远远超过诸如跨期替代等直接效应。这一发现与小型和中型代表性代理人新凯恩斯模型形成鲜明对比，在后者中，替代渠道几乎主导了从利率到消费的全部传导过程。 Ricardian等价假设的失效意味着，在异质代理人新凯恩斯模型中，财政对货币扩张的反应是决定宏观经济反应规模的关键因素。（JEL D31, E12, E21, E24, E43, E52, E62）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the role of individual firms in international business-cycle comovement using data covering the universe of French firm-level value added and international linkages over the period 1993–2007. At the micro level, trade and multinational linkages with a particular foreign country are associated with a significantly higher correlation between a firm and that foreign country. The impact of direct linkages on comovement at the micro level has significant macro implications. Without those linkages the correlation between France and foreign countries would fall by about 0.098, or one-third of the observed average correlation of 0.291 in our sample of partner countries. (JEL F14, F23, F44, F62, L14)

10.1257/aer.20160091.abstractZh: 本文利用1993至2007年期间法国企业增加值及国际联系的数据，探讨了个体企业在国际商业周期共动性中的作用。在微观层面上，与特定外国国家的贸易和多国联系显著提高了企业与该外国国家之间的相关性。直接联系对微观层面的共动性影响具有显著的宏观意义。如果没有这些联系，法国与外国国家之间的相关性将下降约0.098，即我们样本国家中观察到的平均相关性0.291的三分之一。（JEL F14, F23, F44, F62, L14）

abstract.text: This paper studies the business-cycle dynamics of secondary markets for physical capital and their effects on the macroeconomy. In the data, both capital reallocation and the price of used capital are procyclical. To rationalize these facts, I propose a model with endogenous partial irreversibility, where used investment goods are imperfect substitutes for new ones because of firm-level capital specificity. Equilibrium dynamics in the market for used capital induce countercyclical dispersion of marginal products of capital, propagate movements in aggregate TFP, and provide a microfoundation for state-dependent nonconvex capital adjustment costs. (JEL E22, E23, E32, G31)

10.1257/aer.20160131.abstractZh: 本文研究了实物资本次级市场的周期性动态及其对宏观经济的影响。数据显示，资本再分配和二手资本的价格都具有顺周期性。为了解释这些现象，我提出了一个具有内生部分不可逆性的模型，在该模型中，二手投资品由于企业层面的资本特性，与新投资品存在不完全替代关系。二手资本市场的均衡动态会导致资本边际产品的逆周期分散，进而推动总体技术效率的变化，并为依赖状态的非凸资本调整成本提供了微观基础。（JEL E22, E23, E32, G31）

abstract.text: We examine the effects of a quasi-experimental unconditional household income transfer on child emotional and behavioral health and personality traits. Using longitudinal data, we find that there are large beneficial effects on children's emotional and behavioral health and personality traits during adolescence. We find evidence that these effects are most pronounced for children who start out with the lowest initial endowments. The income intervention also results in improvements in parental relationships which we interpret as a potential mechanism behind our findings.

10.1257/aer.20160133.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种准实验性的无条件家庭收入转移对儿童情绪与行为健康以及人格特质的影响。通过纵向数据分析发现，这种收入转移在儿童青少年时期对情绪与行为健康以及人格特质有显著的正面影响。研究还发现，这种影响在那些初始条件最差的儿童身上最为明显。此外，收入转移还改善了亲子关系，我们认为这是解释研究结果的一个潜在机制。

abstract.text: We document substantial increases in agricultural productivity, industrial output, and peasants' nutrition in Imperial Russia as a result of the abolition of serfdom in 1861. Before the emancipation, provinces where serfs constituted the majority of agricultural laborers lagged behind provinces that primarily relied on free labor. The emancipation led to a significant but partial catch up. Better incentives of peasants resulting from the cessation of ratchet effect were a likely mechanism behind a relatively fast positive effect of reform on agricultural productivity. The land reform, which instituted communal land tenure after the emancipation, diminished growth in productivity in repartition communes. (JEL J47, N13, N33, N43, N53, Q11)

10.1257/aer.20160144.abstractZh: 我们记录了1861年废除农奴制后，俄罗斯帝国在农业生产力、工业产出以及农民营养状况方面的显著提升。在农奴制废除之前，以农奴为主的省份在农业劳动力方面落后于主要依靠自由劳动力的省份。废除农奴制后，虽然进步显著，但追赶速度有限。由于消除了棘轮效应带来的不利因素，农民获得了更好的激励，这可能是改革对农业生产力产生快速积极影响的一个可能机制。然而，废除农奴制后实行的集体土地所有制政策，反而降低了分配公社的生产力增长。（JEL J47, N13, N33, N43, N53, Q11）

abstract.text: We document the evolution of the new market for frequency response within the UK electricity system over a six-year period. Firms competed in price while facing considerable initial uncertainty about demand and rival behavior. We show that prices stabilized over time, converging to a rest point that is consistent with equilibrium play. We draw on models of fictitious play and adaptive learning to analyze how this convergence occurs and show that these models predict behavior better than an equilibrium model prior to convergence. (JEL D22, D83, L13, L94, L98)

10.1257/aer.20160177.abstractZh: 我们记录了英国电力系统中频率响应新市场的演变过程，时间跨度为六年。各企业通过价格竞争来争夺市场，同时初期面临需求与竞争对手行为的巨大不确定性。我们发现，随着时间的推移，价格逐渐稳定，最终达到了与均衡状态一致的价格点。我们运用虚拟博弈和适应性学习模型来分析这种收敛过程的发生机制，并表明这些模型对行为的预测效果优于均衡模型在收敛前的预测结果。（JEL D22, D83, L13, L94, L98）

abstract.text: National policies take varied approaches to encouraging university- based innovation. This paper studies a natural experiment: the end of the “professor's privilege” in Norway, where university researchers previously enjoyed full rights to their innovations. Upon the reform, Norway moved toward the typical US model, where the university holds majority rights. Using comprehensive data on Norwegian workers, firms, and patents, we find a 50 percent decline in both entrepreneurship and patenting rates by university researchers after the reform. Quality measures for university start-ups and patents also decline. Applications to literature on university technology transfer, innovation incentives, and taxes and entrepreneurship are considered. (JEL I23, L26, M13, O31, O33, O34)

10.1257/aer.20160284.abstractZh: 国家政策采取不同的方式来鼓励基于大学的创新。本文研究了一个自然实验：挪威“教授特权”的终结，此前大学研究人员对其创新享有完全的权利。改革后，挪威转向了典型的美国模式，即大学拥有大部分权利。通过关于挪威工人、企业和专利的全面数据，我们发现改革后大学研究人员的创业能力和专利申请率均下降了50%。大学初创企业的质量和专利数量也有所下降。本文还参考了关于大学技术转移、创新激励以及税收和创业方面的文献。（JEL I23, L26, M13, O31, O33, O34）

abstract.text: We present an infinite-horizon model of endogenous trading in the art auction market. Agents make purchase and sale decisions based on the relative magnitude of their private use value in each period. Our model generates endogenous cross-sectional and time-series patterns in investment outcomes. Average returns and buy-in probabilities are negatively correlated with the time between purchase and resale (attempt). Idiosyncratic risk does not converge to zero as the holding period shrinks. Prices and auction volume increase during expansions. Our model finds empirical support in auction data and has implications for selection biases in observed prices and transaction-based price indexes. (JEL C43, D44, E32, Z11)

10.1257/aer.20160522.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个无限期视角的内生交易模型，用于分析艺术拍卖市场。代理人根据每个时期其私人使用价值的相对大小来做出购买和出售决策。我们的模型在投资结果中产生了内生性的横截面和时间序列模式。平均回报率和买入概率与购买到转售之间的时间呈负相关。随着持有期的缩短，特异性风险不会趋于零。在市场繁荣时期，价格和拍卖量都会增加。我们的模型在拍卖数据中得到实证支持，并对观察到的价格以及基于交易的价格指数中的选择偏差具有启示意义。（JEL C43, D44, E32, Z11）

abstract.text: This paper provides the first estimate of the effect of door-to-door canvassing on actual electoral outcomes, via a countrywide experiment embedded in François Hollande's campaign in the 2012 French presidential election. While existing experiments randomized door-to-door visits at the individual level, the scale of this campaign (five million doors knocked) enabled randomization by precinct, the level at which vote shares are recorded administratively. Visits did not affect turnout, but increased Hollande's vote share in the first round and accounted for one-fourth of his victory margin in the second. Visits' impact persisted in later elections, suggesting a lasting persuasion effect. (JEL C93, D7, D83)

10.1257/aer.20160524.abstractZh: 本文首次通过2012年法国总统选举中弗朗索瓦·奥朗德竞选活动中的全国性实验，估算了挨家挨户游说对实际选举结果的影响。虽然现有的实验在个体层面进行了随机化的挨家挨户访问，但此次活动的规模（五百万户家庭访问）使得随机化能够精确到选区层面，即行政上记录投票比例的层级。访问并未影响投票率，但提高了奥朗德在第一轮选举中的得票率，并占其在第二轮选举中获胜优势的四分之一。这些访问的影响在后续的选举中持续存在，表明其具有持久的说服力。（JEL C93, D7, D83）

abstract.text: Differences in employment-population ratios across US commuting zones have persisted for many decades. We claim these disparities represent real gaps in economic opportunity for individuals of fixed characteristics. These gaps persist despite a strong migratory response, and we attribute this to high persistence in labor demand shocks. These trends generate a “race” between local employment and population: population always lags behind employment, yielding persistent deviations in employment rates. Methodologically, we argue the employment rate can serve as a sufficient statistic for local well-being; and we model population and employment dynamics using an error correction mechanism, which explicitly allows for disequilibrium. (JEL J21, J61, J64, R23)

10.1257/aer.20160575.abstractZh: 美国各通勤区域的就业人口比例差异已持续数十年。我们认为，这些差异代表了具有固定特征的个体在经济机会上的实际差距。尽管存在强烈的迁移行为，这些差距仍然存在，我们认为这是由于劳动力需求冲击的高持续性所致。这些趋势导致了当地就业与人口之间的“竞争”：人口总是落后于就业，从而导致就业率的持续偏差。在方法论上，我们认为就业率可以作为衡量当地福祉的充分指标；并且我们使用误差修正机制来模拟人口和就业动态，该机制明确允许出现失衡情况。（JEL J21, J61, J64, R23）

abstract.text: Many skilled professional occupations are characterized by an early period of intensive skill accumulation and career establishment. Examples include law firm associates, surgical residents, and untenured faculty at research-intensive universities. High female exit rates are sometimes blamed on the inability of new mothers to survive the sustained negative productivity shock associated with childbearing and early childrearing in these environments. Gender-neutral family policies have been adopted in some professions in an attempt to “level the playing field.” The gender-neutral tenure clock stopping policies adopted by the majority of research-intensive universities in the United States in recent decades are an excellent example. But to date, there is no empirical evidence showing that these policies help women. Using a unique dataset on the universe of assistant professor hires at top-50 economics departments from 1980–2005, we show that the adoption of gender-neutral tenure clock stopping policies substantially reduced female tenure rates while substantially increasing male tenure rates. However, these policies do not reduce the probability that either men or women eventually earn tenure in the profession. (JEL I23, J16, J24, J32, J44)

10.1257/aer.20160613.abstractZh: 许多技术密集型职业都具有早期技能积累和职业发展的特点。例如律师事务所的助理、外科住院医师以及研究型大学中无终身教职的教职人员。女性离职率较高有时被归因于新妈妈无法承受与生育和早期育儿相关的持续负面生产力冲击。一些职业采用了性别中立的家庭政策，试图“创造公平的竞争环境”。美国近几十年来大多数研究型大学采用的性别中立的任期终止政策就是一个很好的例子。但迄今为止，还没有实证证据表明这些政策对女性有帮助。我们利用1980年至2005年间顶尖经济系助理教授招聘数据的独特数据集，发现性别中立的任期终止政策显著降低了女性的任期比例，同时显著提高了男性的任期比例。然而，这些政策并没有减少男性或女性最终获得职业任期的可能性。（JEL I23, J16, J24, J32, J44）

abstract.text: We analyze bidding data from uniform price auctions of US Treasury bills and notes between July 2009 and October 2013. Primary dealers consistently bid higher yields compared to direct and indirect bidders. We estimate a structural model of bidding that takes into account informational asymmetries introduced by the bidding system employed by the US Treasury. While primary dealers' estimated willingness-to-pay is higher than direct and indirect bidders’, their ability to bid-shade is even higher, leading to higher yield/lower price bids. Total bidder surplus averaged to about three basis points across the sample period along with efficiency losses around two basis points. (JEL D44, E63, H63)

10.1257/aer.20160675.abstractZh: 我们分析了2009年7月至2013年10月期间美国国债和票据的统一价格拍卖中的竞标数据。主要交易商始终比直接和间接竞标者提供更高的收益率。我们建立了一个竞标结构模型，考虑了美国财政部采用的竞标系统所带来的信息不对称问题。虽然主要交易商估计的支付意愿高于直接和间接竞标者，但他们的竞标遮蔽能力更高，从而导致更高的收益率和更低的价格。在整个样本期间，总竞标者盈余平均约为三个基点，而效率损失约为两个基点。（JEL D44, E63, H63）

abstract.text: We examine the concerns that new technologies will render labor redundant in a framework in which tasks previously performed by labor can be automated and new versions of existing tasks, in which labor has a comparative advantage, can be created. In a static version where capital is fixed and technology is exogenous, automation reduces employment and the labor share, and may even reduce wages, while the creation of new tasks has the opposite effects. Our full model endogenizes capital accumulation and the direction of research toward automation and the creation of new tasks. If the long-run rental rate of capital relative to the wage is sufficiently low, the long-run equilibrium involves automation of all tasks. Otherwise, there exists a stable balanced growth path in which the two types of innovations go hand-in-hand. Stability is a consequence of the fact that automation reduces the cost of producing using labor, and thus discourages further automation and encourages the creation of new tasks. In an extension with heterogeneous skills, we show that inequality increases during transitions driven both by faster automation and the introduction of new tasks, and characterize the conditions under which inequality stabilizes in the long run. (JEL D63, E22, E23, E24, J24, O33, O41)

10.1257/aer.20160696.abstractZh: 我们探讨了新技术是否会使劳动力变得多余的问题，这一框架中，原本由劳动力完成的任务可以被自动化处理，而新的任务则可以在劳动力具有比较优势的情况下被创造出来。在资本固定且技术外生的静态模型中，自动化会减少就业和劳动力份额，甚至可能导致工资下降，而新任务的创造则会产生相反的效果。我们的完整模型将资本积累与自动化和新任务创造的方向联系起来。如果资本相对于工资的长期租赁率足够低，那么长期均衡将涉及所有任务的自动化。否则，将存在一个稳定的平衡增长路径，在这种路径下，这两种创新方式会相辅相成。这种稳定性是由于自动化降低了使用劳动力生产成本，从而抑制了进一步的自动化，并鼓励了新任务的创造。在考虑技能异质性的扩展模型中，我们表明，在由更快的自动化和新任务引入所驱动的转型过程中，不平等程度会增加，并描述了不平等在长期内趋于稳定的条件。（JEL D63, E22, E23, E24, J24, O33, O41）

abstract.text: A large and growing literature has documented the importance of peer effects in education. However, there is relatively little evidence on the long-run educational and labor market consequences of childhood peers. We examine this question by linking administrative data on elementary school students to subsequent test scores, college attendance and completion, and earnings. To distinguish the effect of peers from confounding factors, we exploit the population variation in the proportion of children from families linked to domestic violence, who have been shown to disrupt contemporaneous behavior and learning. Results show that exposure to a disruptive peer in classes of 25 during elementary school reduces earnings at age 24 to 28 by 3 percent. We estimate that differential exposure to children linked to domestic violence explains 5 percent of the rich-poor earnings gap in our data, and that each year of exposure to a disruptive peer reduces the present discounted value of classmates’ future earnings by $80,000. (JEL I21, I26, J13, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20160763.abstractZh: 大量且不断增长的文献已经证明了同伴效应在教育中的重要性。然而，关于童年同伴对长期教育及劳动力市场影响的证据相对较少。我们通过将小学学生的行政数据与后续的考试成绩、大学就读及毕业情况以及收入数据联系起来，来研究这个问题。为了区分同伴效应与混杂因素的影响，我们利用了家庭中存在家庭暴力经历的儿童比例的人口差异作为变量，因为这些儿童的行为和学习会受到干扰。研究结果显示，在小学阶段，每25名学生中有一个具有干扰性的同伴，会导致24至28岁时的收入减少3%。我们估计，与家庭暴力相关的儿童对收入的影响占我们数据中贫富收入差距的5%，并且，每年与干扰性同伴接触都会使同学未来的收入现值减少80,000美元。（JEL I21, I26, J13, J24, J31）

abstract.text: We provide a theory of rational stock price bubbles in production economies with infinitely-lived agents. Firms meet stochastic investment opportunities and face endogenous credit constraints. They are not fully committed to repaying debt. Credit constraints are derived from incentive constraints in optimal contracts which ensure default never occurs in equilibrium. Stock price bubbles can emerge through a positive feedback loop mechanism and cannot be ruled out by transversality conditions. These bubbles command a liquidity premium and raise investment by raising the debt limit. Their collapse leads to a recession and a stock market crash. (JEL D25, E22, E32, E44, G12, G14)

10.1257/aer.20160782.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于具有无限寿命代理人的生产经济中理性股价泡沫的理论。企业会面临随机的投资机会，并面临内生性的信用约束。它们并不完全致力于偿还债务。信用约束源自最优合约中的激励约束，这些约束确保在均衡状态下不会出现违约现象。股价泡沫可以通过正反馈机制产生，且不会被横向条件所排除。这些泡沫会获得流动性溢价，并通过提高债务限额来促进投资。它们的崩溃会导致经济衰退和股市崩盘。（JEL D25, E22, E32, E44, G12, G14）

abstract.text: This paper provides a simple, yet robust framework to evaluate the time profile of benefits paid during an unemployment spell. We derive sufficient-statistics formulae capturing the marginal insurance value and incentive costs of unemployment benefits paid at different times during a spell. Our approach allows us to revisit separate arguments for inclining or declining profiles put forward in the theoretical literature and to identify welfare-improving changes in the benefit profile that account for all relevant arguments jointly. For the empirical implementation, we use administrative data on unemployment, linked to data on consumption, income, and wealth in Sweden. First, we exploit duration-dependent kinks in the replacement rate and find that, if anything, the moral hazard cost of benefits is larger when paid earlier in the spell. Second, we find that the drop in consumption affecting the insurance value of benefits is large from the start of the spell, but further increases throughout the spell. In trading off insurance and incentives, our analysis suggests that the flat benefit profile in Sweden has been too generous overall. However, both from the insurance and the incentives side, we find no evidence to support the introduction of a declining tilt in the profile. (JEL D82, E21, E24, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20160816.abstractZh: 本文提供了一个简单但稳健的框架，用于评估失业期间所支付福利的时间变化。我们推导出了能够捕捉不同时间阶段失业福利的边际保险价值和激励成本的充分统计量公式。我们的方法使我们能够重新审视理论文献中提出的关于福利状况变化的不同观点，并识别出能够改善福利的福利改善措施，这些措施能够综合所有相关观点。在实证实施方面，我们使用了与瑞典的消费、收入和财富数据相关的失业行政数据。首先，我们发现了替代率中依赖于失业持续时间的突变，并发现如果福利在失业期间较早支付，则道德风险成本会更大。其次，我们发现从失业开始阶段起，影响福利保险价值的消费下降幅度较大，但整个失业期间这一下降幅度会进一步增加。在保险和激励因素之间的权衡中，我们的分析表明，瑞典目前采用的固定福利模式总体上过于慷慨。然而，无论是从保险还是激励的角度来看，我们都未能找到支持引入递减福利模式的证据。（JEL D82, E21, E24, J64, J65）

abstract.text: We examine the impact of mismatch on entry wages, separations, and wage growth using unique data on worker talents. We show that workers are sorted on comparative advantage across jobs within occupations. The starting wages of inexperienced workers are unrelated to mismatch. For experienced workers, on the other hand, mismatch is negatively priced into their starting wages. Separations and wage growth are more strongly related to mismatch among inexperienced workers than among experienced workers. These findings are consistent with models of information updating, where less information is available about the quality of matches involving inexperienced workers. (JEL D83, J24, J31, J41, J63, J64)

10.1257/aer.20160848.abstractZh: 我们研究了不匹配对入职工资、离职率和工资增长的影响，使用了关于工人才能的独特数据。我们发现，不同职业内的工人根据比较优势被分类。缺乏经验的工人的起始工资与不匹配无关。而对于有经验的工人来说，不匹配则会对他们的起始工资产生负面影响。与有经验的工人相比，缺乏经验的工人离职率和工资增长与不匹配的关系更为密切。这些发现与信息更新的模型一致，即关于缺乏经验的工人匹配质量的详细信息较少。（JEL D83, J24, J31, J41, J63, J64）

abstract.text: The entry and exit of products, rather than firms, serve as the main equilibrating force in many markets, so accurately predicting changes from a merger or bankruptcy should incorporate this behavior. This paper estimates a structural model of the US commercial vehicle market and demonstrates the importance of allowing for endogenous product offerings in the context of the $85 billion automotive industry bailout in 2009. Under alternate policies that facilitate an acquisition or liquidation of GM and Chrysler, product entry and exit moderate markup increases and output decreases by up to three-quarters. (JEL D22, G33, G34, H81, L13, L62)

10.1257/aer.20160863.abstractZh: 在许多市场中，产品的进出而非企业的进出，是主要的平衡力量。因此，准确预测合并或破产带来的变化时，必须考虑这种行为。本文对美国商用车辆市场进行了结构模型估计，并展示了在2009年850亿美元的汽车业救助计划中，允许产品供给内生化的重要性。在促进通用汽车和克莱斯勒收购或清算的替代政策下，产品的进出会使得加价幅度增加，而产量则减少多达四分之三。（JEL D22, G33, G34, H81, L13, L62）

abstract.text: Many government programs transfer resources to older people and implicitly or explicitly tax their labor. We shed new light on the labor supply and welfare effects of such programs by investigating the Old Age Assistance Program (OAA). Exploiting the large differences in OAA programs across states and Census data on the entire US population in 1940, we find that OAA reduced the labor force participation rate among men aged 65–74 by 8.5 percentage points, more than one-half of its 1930–1940 decline, but that OAA’s implicit taxation of earnings imposed only small welfare costs on recipients. (JEL H24, H55, H75, J14, J22)

10.1257/aer.20160921.abstractZh: 许多政府项目将资源转移给老年人，并直接或间接地对他们的劳动进行征税。我们通过研究老年援助计划（OAA），对这类项目的劳动力供应和福利影响进行了新的分析。利用各州之间OAA计划的巨大差异，以及1940年美国全国人口普查数据，我们发现OAA使65至74岁男性的人口参与率下降了8.5个百分点，这一数字超过了1930至1940年间下降幅度的一半。不过，OAA对收入进行的间接征税对受助者的福利影响很小。（JEL H24, H55, H75, J14, J22）

abstract.text: We consider inference in regression discontinuity designs when the running variable only takes a moderate number of distinct values. In particular, we study the common practice of using confidence intervals (CIs) based on standard errors that are clustered by the running variable as a means to make inference robust to model misspecification (Lee and Card 2008). We derive theoretical results and present simulation and empirical evidence showing that these CIs do not guard against model misspecification, and that they have poor coverage properties. We therefore recommend against using these CIs in practice. We instead propose two alternative CIs with guaranteed coverage properties under easily interpretable restrictions on the conditional expectation function. (JEL C13, C51, J13, J31, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20160945.abstractZh: 我们研究了在运行变量仅取少数几个不同值的情况下，回归不连续设计中如何进行推断。特别是，我们研究了基于标准误差的置信区间这一常见做法，这些置信区间因运行变量而聚集，以此来使推断在模型误设的情况下仍然具有稳健性（Lee和Card 2008）。我们推导出了理论结果，并通过模拟和实证证据表明，这些置信区间并不能有效防止模型误设，且其覆盖能力较差。因此，我们建议在实际中不要使用这些置信区间。相反，我们提出了两种替代的置信区间，这些区间在条件期望函数具有易于解释的限制条件下，能够保证良好的覆盖能力。（JEL C13, C51, J13, J31, J64, J65）

abstract.text: We study public policies designed to improve access and reduce costs for in vitro fertilization (IVF). High out-of-pocket prices can deter potential patients from IVF, while active patients have an incentive to risk costly high-order pregnancies to improve their odds of treatment success. We analyze IVF's rich choice structure by estimating a dynamic model of patients' choices within and across treatments. Policy simulations show that insurance mandates for treatment or hard limits on treatment aggressiveness can improve access or costs, but not both. Insurance plus price-based incentives against risky treatment, however, can together improve patient welfare and reduce medical costs.

10.1257/aer.20161014.abstractZh: 我们研究了旨在改善体外受精（IVF）服务可及性并降低相关成本的公共政策。高昂的自付费用可能会阻碍潜在患者的选择，而积极寻求治疗的患者则愿意承担高风险的高阶妊娠风险，以提高治疗成功的机会。我们通过建立动态模型来分析IVF服务的选择结构，该模型涵盖了患者在不同治疗方案之间的选择。政策模拟结果显示，对治疗实施保险强制或限制治疗强度可以分别改善服务可及性或降低成本，但无法同时实现两者。然而，保险机制与基于价格的激励措施相结合，能够共同提升患者福利并降低医疗费用。

abstract.text: We use an event study approach to examine the economic consequences of hospital admissions for adults in two datasets: survey data from the Health and Retirement Study, and hospitalization data linked to credit reports. For non-elderly adults with health insurance, hospital admissions increase out-of-pocket medical spending, unpaid medical bills, and bankruptcy, and reduce earnings, income, access to credit, and consumer borrowing. The earnings decline is substantial compared to the out-of-pocket spending increase, and is minimally insured prior to age-eligibility for Social Security Retirement Income. Relative to the insured non-elderly, the uninsured non-elderly experience much larger increases in unpaid medical bills and bankruptcy rates following a hospital admission. Hospital admissions trigger fewer than 5 percent of all bankruptcies in our sample.

10.1257/aer.20161038.abstractZh: 我们采用事件研究法，对成人住院对经济的后果进行了研究，研究数据来自“健康与退休研究”的调查数据，以及与信用报告相关的住院数据。对于拥有健康保险的非老年人来说，住院会导致自付医疗费用增加、未付医疗费用和破产，同时还会减少收入、信用获取能力和消费借贷能力。与自付费用的增加相比，收入下降幅度更为显著，尤其是在达到社会保障退休收入年龄资格之前，未投保的老年人所经历的未付医疗费用和破产率增加幅度更大。在我们的样本中，住院引发的破产案例不到5%。

abstract.text: We develop a general equilibrium model where entrepreneurs finance random investment opportunities using trade credit, bank-issued assets, or currency. They search for bank funding in over-the-counter markets where loan sizes, interest rates, and down payments are negotiated bilaterally. The theory generates pass-through from nominal interest rates to real lending rates depending on market microstructure, policy, and firm characteristics. Higher banks' bargaining power, for example, raises pass-through but weakens transmission to investment. Interest rate spreads arise from liquidity, regulatory, and intermediation premia and depend on policy described as money growth or open market operations. (JEL E43, E52, G21, G31, G32, L26)

10.1257/aer.20161048.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个一般均衡模型，其中企业家通过贸易信贷、银行发行的资产或货币来为随机投资机会提供资金。他们在场外市场上寻找银行融资，贷款规模、利率和首付金额由双方协商确定。该理论表明，名义利率对实际贷款利率的传递取决于市场微观结构、政策以及企业特征。例如，银行议价能力的提高会增强利率的传递效果，但会减弱其对投资的传导作用。利率差缘于流动性、监管因素以及中介费用，这些差异取决于被描述为货币增长或公开市场操作的政策。（JEL E43, E52, G21, G31, G32, L26）

abstract.text: A data buyer faces a decision problem under uncertainty. He can augment his initial private information with supplemental data from a data seller. His willingness to pay for supplemental data is determined by the quality of his initial private information. The data seller optimally offers a menu of statistical experiments. We establish the properties that any revenue-maximizing menu of experiments must satisfy. Every experiment is a non-dispersed stochastic matrix, and every menu contains a fully informative experiment. In the cases of binary states and actions, or binary types, we provide an explicit construction of the optimal menu of experiments. (JEL D42, D81, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20161079.abstractZh: 数据购买者面临一个不确定性下的决策问题。他可以通过从数据销售者处获取补充数据来补充其初始的私人信息。他愿意为补充数据支付的金额取决于其初始私人信息的质量。数据销售者会最优地提供一系列统计实验。我们确定了任何旨在实现收益最大化的实验组合必须满足的特性。每个实验都是一个非分散的随机矩阵，而每个实验组合中都包含一个具有充分信息量的实验。在二元状态和行动或二元类型的情况下，我们给出了最优实验组合的明确构造方法。（JEL D42, D81, D82, D83）

abstract.text: Recent decades have witnessed a surge of trade in intermediate goods and a proliferation of free trade agreements (FTAs). FTAs use rules of origin (RoO) to distinguish goods originating from member countries from those originating from third countries. We focus on the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), the world’s largest FTA, and construct a unique dataset that allows us to map the input-output linkages in its RoO. Exploiting cross-product and cross-country variation in treatment over time, we show that NAFTA RoO led to a sizable reduction in imports of intermediate goods from third countries relative to NAFTA partners. (JEL F13, F15, F23, L14, O19)

10.1257/aer.20161151.abstractZh: 近几十年来，中间商品的贸易量激增，自由贸易协定（FTA）的数量也不断增加。自由贸易协定通过原产地规则来区分来自成员国商品和来自第三国家的商品。我们重点关注世界上最大的自由贸易协定——北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA），并构建了一个独特的数据集，以便我们能够分析其原产地规则下的投入产出关系。通过利用不同产品及国家在不同时间处理规则的变化，我们发现NAFTA的原产地规则导致从第三国家进口的中间商品数量相对于NAFTA成员国有所减少。（JEL F13, F15, F23, L14, O19）

abstract.text: This paper provides new evidence on the effects of moving out of disadvantaged neighborhoods on the long-run outcomes of children. I study public housing demolitions in Chicago, which forced low-income households to relocate to less disadvantaged neighborhoods using housing vouchers. Specifically, I compare young adult outcomes of displaced children to their peers who lived in nearby public housing that was not demolished. Displaced children are more likely to be employed and earn more in young adulthood. I also find that displaced children have fewer violent crime arrests. Children displaced at young ages have lower high school dropout rates.

10.1257/aer.20161352.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于从弱势社区迁移对儿童长期结果影响的新证据。我研究了芝加哥的公共住房拆除情况，这些拆除迫使低收入家庭使用住房券迁移到较为不弱势的社区。具体来说，我比较了被迁移的儿童与那些仍居住在未被拆除的附近公共住房中的同龄人的情况。被迁移的儿童在青年时期更有可能就业，并且收入更高。我还发现，被迁移的儿童遭遇暴力犯罪逮捕的次数较少。在幼年时期被迁移的儿童，高中辍学率也较低。

abstract.text: A long-standing debate in political economy is whether voters are driven primarily by economic self-interest or by less pecuniary motives like ethnocentrism. Using newly available data, we reexamine one of the largest partisan shifts in a modern democracy: Southern whites' exodus from the Democratic Party. We show that defection among racially conservative whites explains the entire decline from 1958 to 1980. Racial attitudes also predict whites' earlier partisan shifts. Relative to recent work, we find a much larger role for racial views and essentially no role for income growth or (non-race-related) policy preferences in explaining why Democrats “lost” the South. (JEL D72, J15, N42)

10.1257/aer.20161413.abstractZh: 政治经济学领域一直存在一种长期争论，即选民的决策主要受到经济利益的驱动，还是受到诸如种族中心主义等非经济因素的驱动。利用新获得的数据，我们重新研究了现代民主国家中最大的党派转变之一：南方白人从民主党中退出的情况。我们发现，种族保守主义的白人选择退出民主党，解释了从1958年到1980年间南方白人比例的下降。种族态度也预示着白人更早的党派转变。与近期的研究相比，我们发现种族观念在解释民主党“失去”南方的原因中起着更为重要的作用，而经济增长或（非种族相关的）政策偏好则几乎没有作用。（JEL D72, J15, N42）

abstract.text: We develop an equilibrium model of firm dynamics with random search in the labor market where hiring firms exert recruiting effort by spending resources to fill vacancies faster. Consistent with microevidence, fast-growing firms invest more in recruiting activities and achieve higher job-filling rates. These hiring decisions of firms aggregate into an index of economy-wide recruiting intensity. We study how aggregate shocks transmit to recruiting intensity, and whether this channel can account for the dynamics of aggregate matching efficiency during the Great Recession. Productivity and financial shocks lead to sizable procyclical fluctuations in matching efficiency through recruiting effort. Quantitatively, the main mechanism is that firms attain their employment targets by adjusting their recruiting effort in response to movements in labor market slackness. (JEL D22, E24, E32, J23, J41, J63, M51)

10.1257/aer.20161420.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个关于劳动力市场中企业动态均衡的模型，其中招聘企业通过投入资源来更快地填补空缺，以此施加招聘努力。与微观证据一致，快速增长的企业在招聘活动上投入更多，并实现了更高的职位填补率。这些企业的招聘决策共同构成了整个经济体的招聘强度指标。我们研究了总体冲击如何传递至招聘强度，以及这一渠道是否能够解释大衰退期间总体匹配效率的动态变化。生产力和金融冲击通过招聘努力导致匹配效率出现显著的顺周期性波动。从数量上看，主要机制是企业在应对劳动力市场闲置状况时调整招聘努力，从而实现其就业目标。（JEL D22, E24, E32, J23, J41, J63, M51）

abstract.text: Alphabetical name order is the norm for joint publications in economics. However, alphabetical order confers greater benefits on the first author. In a two-author model, we introduce and study certified random order: the uniform randomization of names made universally known by a commonly understood symbol. Certified random order (i) distributes the gain from first authorship evenly over the alphabet; (ii) allows either author to signal when contributions are extremely unequal; (iii) will invade an environment where alphabetical order is dominant; (iv) is robust to deviations; (v) may be ex ante more efficient than alphabetical order; and (vi) is no more complex than the existing alphabetical system modified by occasional reversal of name order. (JEL A14, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20161492.abstractZh: 在经济学领域的联合出版物中，按字母顺序命名是常规做法。然而，这种顺序对第一作者更为有利。在双作者模型中，我们引入了“认证随机顺序”的概念：通过一种普遍理解的符号来统一随机排列姓名。认证随机顺序具有以下优点：(i) 将第一作者的收益均匀分配给字母顺序中的各个位置；(ii) 允许任一作者在贡献差异极大时做出提示；(iii) 能够改变以字母顺序为主的命名方式；(iv) 对偏差具有鲁棒性；(v) 在事前可能比字母顺序更高效；(vi) 其复杂性并不高于现有的字母顺序系统，只需偶尔对姓名顺序进行反转即可。(JEL A14, Z13)

abstract.text: I conducted a randomized field experiment in traditional public elementary schools in Houston, Texas designed to test the potential productivity benefits of teacher specialization. The average impact of encouraging schools to specialize their teachers on student achievement is −0.11 standard deviations per year on a combined index of math and reading test scores. I argue that the results are consistent with a model in which the benefits of specialization driven by sorting teachers into a subset of subjects based on comparative advantage is outweighed by inefficient pedagogy due to having fewer interactions with each student, though other mechanisms are possible. (JEL D31, E32, J22, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20161495.abstractZh: 我在德克萨斯州休斯顿的传统公立小学进行了一项随机实地实验，旨在测试教师专业化对生产力潜在影响的效益。鼓励学校进行教师专业化对学生学业成绩的平均影响为每年−0.11个标准差，体现在数学和阅读测试成绩的联合指数上。我认为，这些结果与一种模型相符，即基于比较优势将教师划分为不同学科领域的专业化所带来的效益，因与每个学生的互动减少而带来的低效教学所抵消，尽管可能存在其他机制。（JEL D31, E32, J22, J24, J31）

abstract.text: Over 20 percent of prison and jail inmates in the United States are currently awaiting trial, but little is known about the impact of pretrial detention on defendants. This paper uses the detention tendencies of quasi-randomly assigned bail judges to estimate the causal effects of pretrial detention on subsequent defendant outcomes. Using data from administrative court and tax records, we find that pretrial detention significantly increases the probability of conviction, primarily through an increase in guilty pleas. Pretrial detention has no net effect on future crime, but decreases formal sector employment and the receipt of employment- and tax-related government benefits. These results are consistent with (i) pretrial detention weakening defendants' bargaining positions during plea negotiations and (ii) a criminal conviction lowering defendants' prospects in the formal labor market. (JEL J23, J31, J65, K41, K42)

10.1257/aer.20161503.abstractZh: 在美国，超过20%的监狱和拘留所囚犯目前处于等待审判的状态，但关于审前拘留对被告的影响知之甚少。本文通过模拟随机分配的缓刑法官的拘留行为，来估算审前拘留对被告后续结果的因果效应。根据行政法庭和税务记录的数据，我们发现审前拘留显著增加了定罪的概率，主要是通过增加认罪的情况来实现的。审前拘留对未来犯罪没有净影响，但会减少正式部门的就业以及获得就业和税收相关政府福利的机会。这些结果与以下观点一致：(i) 审前拘留削弱了被告在认罪协商中的谈判地位；(ii) 刑事定罪降低了被告在正式劳动力市场的机会。 (JEL J23, J31, J65, K41, K42)

abstract.text: Lending cuts by banks directly affect the firms borrowing from them, but also indirectly depress economic activity in the regions in which they operate. This paper moves beyond firm-level studies by estimating the effects of an exogenous lending cut by a large German bank on firms and counties. I construct an instrument for regional exposure to the lending cut based on a historic, postwar breakup of the bank. I present evidence that the lending cut affected firms independently of their banking relationships, through lower aggregate demand and agglomeration spillovers in counties exposed to the lending cut. Output and employment remained persistently low even after bank lending had normalized. Innovation and productivity fell, consistent with the persistent effects. (JEL E32, E44, G01, G21, G32, R11, R23)

10.1257/aer.20161534.abstractZh: 银行减少贷款直接影响了从这些银行借款的企业，同时也间接抑制了它们所在地区的经济活动。本文超越了企业层面的研究，通过估算一家大型德国银行的外生贷款削减对企业和地区的效应来进一步分析这一问题。我基于该银行战后分拆的历史数据，构建了一个用于衡量地区受贷款削减影响的工具。研究结果表明，贷款削减通过降低总需求以及影响受影响的地区的集聚效应，独立地影响了企业。即使在银行贷款恢复正常后，产出和就业仍然持续低迷。创新和生产率也有所下降，这与持续的效应是一致的。（JEL E32, E44, G01, G21, G32, R11, R23）

abstract.text: This paper studies lying. An agent randomly picks a number from a known distribution. She can then report any number and receive a monetary payoff based only on her report. The paper presents a model of lying costs that generates hypotheses regarding behavior. In an experiment, we find that the highest fraction of lies is from reporting the maximal outcome, but some participants do not make the maximal lie. More participants lie partially when the experimenter cannot observe their outcomes than when the experimenter can verify the observed outcome. Partial lying increases when the prior probability of the highest outcome decreases. (JEL C91, D12, D90, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20161553.abstractZh: 本文研究了说谎行为。一个代理人从已知的分布中随机选择一个数字，然后她可以报告任何数字，并仅根据她的报告获得金钱报酬。本文提出了一个关于说谎成本的模型，该模型为行为分析提供了假设依据。在实验中，我们发现最高比例的谎言发生在报告最大结果时，但有些参与者并没有说出最大结果。当实验者无法观察到参与者的结果时，部分参与者的谎言行为比实验者能够验证观察到的结果时更为常见。当最高结果的前验概率降低时，部分说谎的行为会增加。（JEL C91, D12, D90, Z13）

abstract.text: We show that skill requirements in job vacancy postings differentially increased in MSAs that were hit hard by the Great Recession, relative to less hard-hit areas. These increases persist through at least the end of 2015 and are correlated with increases in capital investments, both at the MSA and firm levels. We also find that effects are most pronounced in routine-cognitive occupations, which exhibit relative wage growth as well. We argue that this evidence is consistent with the restructuring of production toward routine-biased technologies and the more-skilled workers that complement them, and that the Great Recession accelerated this process. (JEL E24, E32, J24, J31, J63, L23, O33)

10.1257/aer.20161570.abstractZh: 我们指出，在大衰退中遭受严重冲击的市级行政区，职位空缺中的技能要求相对于受影响较小的地区而言有所增加。这种增加至少持续到了2015年底，并且与市级行政区及企业层面的资本投资增加有关。我们还发现，这种效应在常规认知型职业中最为明显，这些职业的相对工资增长也呈现出上升趋势。我们认为，这一证据与生产结构的重组、向常规型技术的转变以及能够补充这些技术的更熟练工人有关，而大衰退加速了这一过程。（JEL E24, E32, J24, J31, J63, L23, O33）

abstract.text: Investors implement projects based on idiosyncratic signal observations, without knowing how signals and returns are jointly distributed. The following heuristic is studied: investors collect information on previously implemented projects with the same signal realization, and invest if the associated mean return exceeds the cost. The corresponding steady states result in suboptimal investments, due to selection bias and the heterogeneity of signals across investors. When higher signals are associated with higher returns, investors are overoptimistic, resulting in overinvestment. Rational investors increase the overoptimism of sampling investors, thereby illustrating a negative externality imposed by rational investors. (JEL D82, G11, G31, L26, M13)

10.1257/aer.20161696.abstractZh: 投资者基于特定的信号观察来实施项目，却不知道信号与回报是如何共同分布的。本文研究了以下启发式方法：投资者收集具有相同信号特征的先前项目的相关信息，并在相关平均回报超过成本时进行投资。然而，由于选择偏差以及不同投资者之间信号的异质性，相应的稳态结果会导致次优的投资决策。当较高的信号与较高的回报相关联时，投资者会过于乐观，从而导致过度投资。理性的投资者会加剧其他投资者的过度乐观情绪，从而揭示了理性投资者所施加的负面外部性。（JEL D82, G11, G31, L26, M13）

abstract.text: Building on the idea that accounting matters for corporate governance, this paper studies the equilibrium interaction between the measurement rules that firms find privately optimal, firms’ governance, and the liquidity in the secondary market for their assets. This equilibrium approach reveals an excessive use of market-value accounting: corporate performance measures rely excessively on the information generated by other firms’ asset sales and insufficiently on the realization of a firm’s own capital gains. This dries up market liquidity and reduces the informativeness of price signals, thereby making it more costly for firms to overcome their agency problems. (JEL D21, D82, G34, G38, M41, M48)

10.1257/aer.20161749.abstractZh: 本文基于会计对公司治理具有重要意义的观点，研究企业认为私心最优的测量规则、企业治理以及其资产在二级市场中的流动性之间的均衡互动关系。这种均衡分析揭示了市场价值会计的过度使用现象：企业绩效指标过度依赖于其他企业资产出售所产生的信息，而未能充分依赖企业自身资本收益的实现。这种状况会削弱市场流动性，降低价格信号的信息含量，从而使企业克服代理问题变得更加困难。（JEL D21, D82, G34, G38, M41, M48）

abstract.text: We identify structural vector autoregressions using narrative sign restrictions. Narrative sign restrictions constrain the structural shocks and/or the historical decomposition around key historical events, ensuring that they agree with the established narrative account of these episodes. Using models of the oil market and monetary policy, we show that narrative sign restrictions tend to be highly informative. Even a single narrative sign restriction may dramatically sharpen and even change the inference of SVARs originally identified via traditional sign restrictions. Our approach combines the appeal of narrative methods with the popularized usage of traditional sign restrictions. (JEL C32, E52, Q35, Q43)

10.1257/aer.20161852.abstractZh: 我们通过叙事符号限制来识别结构性向量自回归。叙事符号限制约束了结构性冲击和/或关键历史事件前后的历史分解，确保它们与这些事件既定的叙事描述一致。通过研究石油市场和货币政策的模型，我们发现叙事符号限制往往具有高度的信息性。即使是一个单独的叙事符号限制，也可能显著地改善甚至改变通过传统符号限制最初识别出的SVARs的推断结果。我们的方法结合了叙事方法的吸引力与传统符号限制的常见应用方式。（JEL C32, E52, Q35, Q43）

abstract.text: Before filing suit, a plaintiff can take a financial position in a defendant firm. A short position benefits the plaintiff by transforming a negative expected-value claim into a positive expected-value one and by enhancing the claim's settlement value. If the capital market is less than strong-form efficient, the plaintiff also benefits directly from the decline in the defendant's stock price. When the defendant is privately informed about the case's merits, bargaining failures can arise. While aggressive short-selling benefits the plaintiff at the expense of the defendant, moderate levels of short-selling can benefit the defendant and raise the settlement rate. (JEL D82, G14, K41)

10.1257/aer.20161863.abstractZh: 在提起诉讼之前，原告可以在被告公司中持有金融头寸。持有空头头寸可以使原告的预期价值索赔从负数转变为正数，并提升索赔的解决价值。如果资本市场未达到强形式效率，原告还可以直接受益于被告股票价格的下跌。当被告私下了解案件的实质情况时，可能会出现谈判失败的情况。虽然激进的卖空行为会损害被告的利益，但适度的卖空行为则可能对被告有利，并提高解决率。（JEL D82, G14, K41）

abstract.text: In many developing countries, the average firm is small, does not grow, and has low productivity. Lack of market integration and limited information on non-local products often leave consumers unaware of the prices and quality of non-local firms. They therefore mostly buy locally, limiting firms’ potential market size (and competition). We explore this hypothesis using a natural experiment in the Kerala boat-building industry. As consumers learn more about non-local builders, high-quality builders gain market share and grow, while low-quality firms exit. Aggregate quality increases, as does labor specialization, and average production costs decrease. Finally, quality-adjusted consumer prices decline. (JEL D22, D83, L15, L25, L62, O12, O14)

10.1257/aer.20161965.abstractZh: 在许多发展中国家，平均而言，企业规模较小，难以成长，生产效率也较低。由于市场整合不足以及关于非本地产品的信息有限，消费者往往无法了解非本地企业的价格和质量。因此，他们大多选择购买本地产品，这限制了企业的潜在市场规模（以及竞争）。我们通过喀拉拉邦造船业的自然实验来验证这一假设。随着消费者更多地了解非本地造船企业，高质量的企业市场份额增加并得以成长，而低质量的企业则逐渐退出市场。整体质量得到了提升，劳动力专业化程度也有所提高，平均生产成本下降。最终，经过质量调整后的消费者价格也降低了。（JEL D22, D83, L15, L25, L62, O12, O14）

abstract.text: How does the economy respond to news about future policies or future fundamentals? Standard practice assumes that agents have common knowledge of such news and face no uncertainty about how others will respond. Relaxing this assumption attenuates the general equilibrium effects of news and rationalizes a form of myopia at the aggregate level. We establish these insights within a class of games which nests, but is not limited to, the New Keynesian model. Our results help resolve the forward-guidance puzzle, offer a rationale for the front-loading of fiscal stimuli, and illustrate more broadly the fragility of predictions that rest on long series of forward-looking feedback loops. (JEL D82, D83, D84, E12, E23, E52, E62)

10.1257/aer.20161996.abstractZh: 经济如何对关于未来政策或未来基本面的新闻作出反应？传统观点认为，相关主体对这些新闻有共同了解，并且对他人的反应不存在不确定性。放宽这一假设会减弱新闻对一般均衡的影响，并解释了在总体层面上存在的某种“近视性”。我们在一类游戏中建立了这些见解，这类游戏包含但不局限于新凯恩斯模型。我们的研究结果有助于解决“前瞻性指导之谜”，为财政刺激的前置实施提供了理论依据，并更广泛地说明了基于长期前瞻性反馈循环的预测存在的脆弱性。（JEL D82, D83, D84, E12, E23, E52, E62）

abstract.text: Using new cross-country survey and experimental data, we investigate how beliefs about intergenerational mobility affect preferences for redistribution in France, Italy, Sweden, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Americans are more optimistic than Europeans about social mobility. Our randomized treatment shows pessimistic information about mobility and increases support for redistribution, mostly for “equality of opportunity” policies. We find strong political polarization. Left-wing respondents are more pessimistic about mobility: their preferences for redistribution are correlated with their mobility perceptions; and they support more redistribution after seeing pessimistic information. None of this is true for right-wing respondents, possibly because they see the government as a “problem” and not as the “solution.” (JEL D63, D72, H23, H24, J31, J62)

10.1257/aer.20162015.abstractZh: 通过新的跨国调查和实验数据，我们研究了关于代际流动性的信念如何影响法国、意大利、瑞典、英国和美国的民众对再分配的偏好。与欧洲人相比，美国人对于社会流动性的看法更为乐观。我们的随机实验表明，关于流动性的悲观信息会增加人们对再分配的支持，尤其是那些支持“机会平等”政策的支持。我们发现政治两极分化现象较为明显。左翼受访者对流动性的看法更为悲观：他们对再分配的偏好与他们对流动性的认知相关；而在听到关于流动性的悲观信息后，他们更加支持再分配。而右翼受访者则没有这种现象，可能是因为他们将政府视为“问题”而非“解决方案”。(JEL D63, D72, H23, H24, J31, J62)

abstract.text: Medicare's prospective payment system for long-term acute-care hospitals (LTCHs) provides modest reimbursements at the beginning of a patient's stay before jumping discontinuously to a large lump-sum payment after a prespecified number of days. We show that LTCHs respond to the financial incentives of this system by disproportionately discharging patients after they cross the large-payment threshold. We find this occurs more often at for-profit facilities, facilities acquired by leading LTCH chains, and facilities colocated with other hospitals. Using a dynamic structural model, we evaluate counterfactual payment policies that would provide substantial savings for Medicare.

10.1257/aer.20170092.abstractZh: Medicare对长期急性护理医院（LTCHs）的预期支付系统，在患者住院初期提供适度的报销金额，之后在达到预设的天数后，会突然转换为大额一次性支付。我们发现，LTCHs通过这种支付系统提供的经济激励，在患者超过大额支付门槛后，会过度地安排患者出院。我们发现在营利性机构、由主要LTCH连锁企业收购的机构，以及与其他医院同址的机构中，这种情况更为常见。通过动态结构模型，我们评估了能够给Medicare带来显著节省的反事实支付政策。

abstract.text: We study how monetary policy in China influences banks’ shadow banking activities. We develop and estimate the endogenously switching monetary policy rule that is based on institutional facts and at the same time tractable in the spirit of Taylor (1993). This development, along with two newly constructed micro banking datasets, enables us to establish the following empirical evidence. Contractionary monetary policy during 2009–2015 caused shadow banking loans to rise rapidly, offsetting the expected decline of traditional bank loans and hampering the effectiveness of monetary policy on total bank credit. We advance a theoretical explanation of our empirical findings. (JEL E32, E52, G21, O16, O23, P24, P34)

10.1257/aer.20170133.abstractZh: 我们研究了中国货币政策如何影响银行的影子银行活动。我们开发并估计了一个基于制度事实且符合泰勒（1993）理论精神的内生性货币政策规则。这一发展，加上两个新构建的微观银行数据集，使我们能够得出以下实证证据：2009-2015年的紧缩货币政策导致影子银行贷款迅速增加，抵消了传统银行贷款预期中的下降，并削弱了货币政策对总银行信贷的影响。我们提出了对实证发现的理论解释。（JEL E32, E52, G21, O16, O23, P24, P34）

abstract.text: Motivated by the question of how one should evaluate professional election forecasters, we study a novel dynamic mechanism design problem without transfers. A principal who wishes to hire only high-quality forecasters is faced with an agent of unknown quality. The agent privately observes signals about a publicly observable future event, and may strategically misrepresent information to inflate the principal’s perception of his quality. We show that the optimal deterministic mechanism is simple and easy to implement in practice: it evaluates a single, optimally timed prediction. We study the generality of this result and its robustness to randomization and noncommitment. (JEL C53, D72, D82)

10.1257/aer.20170299.abstractZh: 本文基于如何评估专业选举预测师的问题，研究了一个没有转移效应的新型动态机制设计问题。一个希望只雇佣高质量预测师的委托人面临着一个质量未知的代理人。代理人私下观察关于公开可观测的未来事件的信号，并可能策略性地歪曲信息以夸大委托人对其质量的认知。我们证明，最优的确定性机制非常简单且易于在实践中实施：它仅评估一个最优时机的预测。我们研究了这一结果的普遍性及其对随机化和非承诺的鲁棒性。（JEL C53, D72, D82）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of polling station administrator diversity on elections in India, using a natural experiment: the random assignment of government officials to teams managing stations on election day, together with surveys conducted with voters and election officers. I demonstrate that changes in the religious and caste composition of officer teams impact voting at the polling station level, causing shifts in coalition vote shares large enough to influence election outcomes. Effects are strongest when officers have greater discretion over the voting process. I also provide evidence suggesting own-group favoritism by election personnel as one relevant mechanism. (JEL C93, D72, D73, J15, O17, Z12)

10.1257/aer.20170404.abstractZh: 本文通过一项自然实验，研究了印度选举中投票站管理人员多样性对选举结果的影响。实验通过将政府官员随机分配到负责选举日投票站的团队中，并结合对选民和选举官员的调查，来观察这一现象。研究发现，官员团队中宗教和种姓构成的变化会影响投票站层面的投票结果，从而导致联盟投票份额发生足以影响选举结果的变动。当官员在投票过程中拥有更大的自主权时，这种影响更为显著。此外，研究还发现，选举人员存在自我群体偏好现象，这是影响选举结果的一个相关机制。（JEL C93, D72, D73, J15, O17, Z12）

abstract.text: Competitive elections are essential to establishing the political legitimacy of democratizing regimes. We argue that insurgents undermine the state’s mandate through electoral violence. We study insurgent violence during elections using newly declassified microdata on the conflict in Afghanistan. Our data track insurgent activity by hour to within meters of attack locations. Our results suggest that insurgents carefully calibrate their production of violence during elections to avoid harming civilians. Leveraging a novel instrumental variables approach, we find that violence depresses voting. Collectively, the results suggest insurgents try to depress turnout while avoiding backlash from harming civilians. Counterfactual exercises provide potentially actionable insights for safeguarding at-risk elections and enhancing electoral legitimacy in emerging democracies. (JEL D72, D74, O17)

10.1257/aer.20170416.abstractZh: 竞争性选举对于确立民主化政权的政治合法性至关重要。我们认为，叛乱分子通过选举暴力手段破坏国家的合法性。我们利用新公开的阿富汗冲突微观数据，研究选举期间的叛乱暴力行为。我们的数据按小时记录叛乱活动，精确到攻击地点的几米范围内。研究结果表明，叛乱分子在选举期间会精心调整暴力行为的强度，以避免伤害平民。通过采用一种新的工具变量方法，我们发现暴力行为会抑制投票率。总体而言，这些结果表明叛乱分子试图降低投票率，同时避免因伤害平民而引发负面反应。反事实分析为保护处于风险中的选举以及提升新兴民主国家的选举合法性提供了潜在的行动建议。（JEL D72, D74, O17）

abstract.text: Following mid-twentieth century predictions of Malthusian catastrophe, fertility in the developing world more than halved, while living standards more than doubled. We analyze how fertility change related to economic growth during this episode, using data on 2.3 million women from 255 household surveys. We find different responses to fluctuations and long-run growth, both heterogeneous over the life cycle. Fertility was procyclical but declined and delayed with long-run growth; fluctuations late (but not early) in the reproductive period affected lifetime fertility. The results are consistent with models of the escape from the Malthusian trap, extended with a life cycle and liquidity constraints.

10.1257/aer.20170748.abstractZh: 根据20世纪中叶对马尔萨斯式灾难的预测，发展中国家的生育率下降了一半以上，而生活水平则翻了一番以上。我们利用来自255项家庭调查中的230万女性的数据，分析了这一时期生育率变化与经济增长之间的关系。我们发现，对波动和长期增长的响应存在差异，且这种差异在生命周期内也各不相同。生育率具有顺周期性，但在长期增长过程中会下降并延迟；生育期的后期波动（而非早期）会影响一生的生育率。这些结果与“摆脱马尔萨斯陷阱”的模型一致，该模型还考虑了生命周期和流动性约束。

abstract.text: An important class of active labor market policy has received little impact evaluation: immigration barriers intended to raise wages and employment by shrinking labor supply. Theories of endogenous technical advance raise the possibility of limited or even perverse impact. We study a natural policy experiment: the exclusion of almost half a million Mexican ' bracero ' farm workers from the United States to improve farm labor market conditions. With novel archival data we measure state-level exposure to exclusion, and model the labor-market effect in the absence of technical change. We reject such an effect and fail to reject a null effect.

10.1257/aer.20170765.abstractZh: 一类重要的积极劳动力市场政策几乎没有受到影响评估：旨在通过减少劳动力供应来提高工资和就业水平的移民限制措施。内生技术进步理论提出了这种政策可能只产生有限或甚至负面影响的假设。我们研究了一个自然政策实验：将近50万墨西哥“bracero”农场工人排除在美国之外，以改善农场劳动力市场的状况。利用新颖的档案数据，我们测量了各州因这一政策而受到的冲击，并模拟了在没有技术进步的情况下劳动力市场的效应。我们否定了这种效应的存在，同时也未能排除零效应的可能性。

abstract.text: The literature on belief-driven business cycles treats news and noise as distinct representations of agents' beliefs. We prove they are empirically the same. Our result lets us isolate the importance of purely belief-driven fluctuations. Using three prominent estimated models, we show that existing research understates the importance of pure beliefs. We also explain how differences in both economic environment and information structure affect the estimated importance of pure beliefs. (JEL D83, D84, E12, E23, E32)

10.1257/aer.20170792.abstractZh: 关于信念驱动商业周期的文献将新闻和噪音视为不同形式的代理人信念表达。我们证明它们在实证上是相同的。我们的研究结果使我们能够分离出纯粹信念驱动波动的重要性。通过对比三个著名的估计模型，我们发现现有研究低估了纯粹信念的重要性。我们还解释了经济环境和信息结构差异如何影响纯粹信念估计的重要性。（JEL D83, D84, E12, E23, E32）

abstract.text: We use a novel retail panel with detailed transaction records to study the effect of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) on household spending. We use administrative data to motivate three approaches to causal inference. The marginal propensity to consume SNAP-eligible food (MPCF) out of SNAP benefits is 0.5 to 0.6. The MPCF out of cash is much smaller. These patterns obtain even for households for whom SNAP benefits are economically equivalent to cash because their benefits are below their food spending. Using a semiparametric framework, we reject the hypothesis that households respect the fungibility of money. A model with mental accounting can match the facts. (JEL D12, H75, I12, I18, I38)

10.1257/aer.20170866.abstractZh: 我们采用一个包含详细交易记录的新型零售面板数据，来研究补充营养援助计划（SNAP）对家庭支出的影响。我们利用行政数据来推动三种因果推断方法的应用。对于符合SNAP条件的食品，消费者消费这些食品的边际倾向为0.5到0.6；而对于现金，这一边际倾向要小得多。即使对于那些SNAP福利在经济学上等同于现金的家庭来说，这种模式仍然成立，因为它们的福利水平低于他们的食品支出。通过采用半参数框架，我们否定了家庭会尊重货币可替代性的假设。一个包含心理账户效应的模型能够解释这些现象。（JEL D12, H75, I12, I18, I38）

abstract.text: I develop a simple model of social learning in which players observe others’ outcomes but not their actions. A continuum of players arrives continuously over time, and each player chooses once-and-for-all between a safe action (which succeeds with known probability) and a risky action (which succeeds with fixed but unknown probability, depending on the state of the world). The actions also differ in their costs. Before choosing, a player observes the outcomes of K earlier players. There is always an equilibrium in which success is more likely in the good state, and this alignment property holds whenever the initial generation of players is not well informed about the state. In the case of an outcome-improving innovation (where the risky action may yield a higher probability of success), players take the correct action as K → ∞. In the case of a cost-saving innovation (where the risky action involves saving a cost but accepting a lower probability of success), inefficiency persists as K → ∞ in any aligned equilibrium. Whether inefficiency takes the form of under-adoption or over-adoption also depends on the nature of the innovation. Convergence of the population to equilibrium may be nonmonotone. (JEL D81, D83, O32, Q12, Q16)

10.1257/aer.20170914.abstractZh: 我提出了一个简单的社会学习模型，其中参与者观察他人的结果，但不了解他们的行为。随着时间的推移，一系列参与者不断出现，每个参与者都会一次性在安全行动（以已知概率成功）和冒险行动（以固定但未知的概率成功，取决于世界状态）之间做出选择。这些行动的成本也有所不同。在做出选择之前，参与者会观察K个早期参与者的结果。总存在一个均衡状态，在这种状态下，处于良好状态时成功的可能性更高，这一对齐性质在初始的参与者对状态了解不足的情况下仍然成立。在能够改善结果的新创举措中（即冒险行动可能带来更高的成功概率），当K趋向于无穷大时，参与者会采取正确的行动。而在能够节省成本的新创举措中（即冒险行动涉及节省成本但接受较低的成功概率），无论何时，只要K趋向于无穷大，任何对齐的均衡状态中都会存在低效率。低效率的具体形式，即低采纳或高采纳，也取决于创新的性质。人口向均衡状态的收敛可能是非单调的。（JEL D81, D83, O32, Q12, Q16）

abstract.text: This paper examines whether and how market competition affected the political bias of government-owned newspapers in China from 1981 to 2011. We measure media bias based on coverage of government mouthpiece content ( propaganda) relative to commercial content. We first find that a reform that forced newspaper exits (reduced competition) affected media bias by increasing product specialization, with some papers focusing on propaganda and others on commercial content. Second, lower-level governments produce less-biased content and launch commercial newspapers earlier, eroding higher-level governments’ political goals. Third, bottom-up competition intensifies the politico-economic trade-off, leading to product proliferation and less audience exposure to propaganda. (JEL D72, L31, L82, O14, O17, P26, P31)

10.1257/aer.20170947.abstractZh: 本文探讨了1981年至2011年间市场竞争是否以及如何影响了中国政府拥有报纸的政治倾向。我们通过报纸对政府宣传内容的报道与商业内容的报道比例来衡量媒体偏见。首先发现，一项强制报纸关闭的改革（减少竞争）通过促进产品专业化来影响媒体偏见，部分报纸专注于宣传内容，而其他报纸则专注于商业内容。其次，较低级别的政府产生的内容偏见较低，并且更早推出商业报纸，从而侵蚀了较高级别政府的政治目标。第三，自下而上的竞争加剧了政治与经济之间的权衡，导致产品数量增加，而受众接触宣传内容的机会减少。（JEL D72, L31, L82, O14, O17, P26, P31）

abstract.text: The platform design, the process that helps potential buyers on the internet navigate toward products they may purchase, plays a critical role in reducing search frictions and determining market outcomes. We study a key trade-off associated with two important roles of efficient platform design: guiding consumers to their most desired product while also strengthening seller incentives to lower prices. We use simple theory to illustrate this, and then combine detailed browsing data from eBay and an equilibrium model of consumer search and price competition to quantitatively assess this trade-off in the particular context of a change in eBay's marketplace design. (JEL D12, D44, D83, L81, L86)

10.1257/aer.20171218.abstractZh: 平台设计这一帮助潜在买家在互联网上找到他们可能购买的产品的过程，在减少搜索摩擦和决定市场结果方面起着至关重要的作用。我们研究了一个与高效平台设计的两个重要功能相关的关键权衡：一方面引导消费者找到他们最想要的产品，另一方面加强卖家的降价动机。我们通过简单的理论来说明这一点，然后结合eBay的详细浏览数据以及消费者搜索和价格竞争的均衡模型，来定量评估在eBay市场设计发生变化这一特定情境下的这种权衡。（JEL D12, D44, D83, L81, L86）

abstract.text: We propose a technique for assessing robustness to demand effects of findings from experiments and surveys. The core idea is that by deliberately inducing demand in a structured way we can bound its influence. We present a model in which participants respond to their beliefs about the researcher’s objectives. Bounds are obtained by manipulating those beliefs with “demand treatments.” We apply the method to 11 classic tasks, and estimate bounds averaging 0.13 standard deviations, suggesting that typical demand effects are probably modest. We also show how to compute demand-robust treatment effects and how to structurally estimate the model. (JEL C83, C90, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20171330.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种评估实验和调查结果对需求效应鲁棒性的技术。其核心思想是，通过有目的的方式引导需求，我们可以限制其影响范围。我们提出了一个模型，其中参与者会根据他们对研究者目标的看法做出反应。通过“需求处理”来操纵这些信念，从而获得界限。我们将该方法应用于11个经典任务，并估计出平均0.13个标准差的界限，这表明典型的需求效应可能较为温和。我们还展示了如何计算对需求的鲁棒性处理效应，以及如何结构性地估计模型。（JEL C83, C90, D83, D91）

abstract.text: I combine newly digitized personnel and public finance data from the British colonial administration for the period 1854–1966 to study how patronage affects the promotion and incentives of governors. Governors are more likely to be promoted to higher salaried colonies when connected to their superior during the period of patronage. Once allocated, they provide more tax exemptions, raise less revenue, and invest less. The promotion and performance gaps disappear after the abolition of patronage appointments. Patronage therefore distorts the allocation of public sector positions and reduces the incentives of favored bureaucrats to perform. (JEL D73, F54, H83, J45, M51, N43, N44)

10.1257/aer.20171339.abstractZh: 我结合了对1854年至1966年期间英国殖民政府的新数字化人事和公共财政数据，研究庇护制度如何影响总督的晋升和激励。在庇护制度实施期间，与上级有联系的总督更有可能被晋升到更高薪水的殖民地。一旦获得庇护，他们提供的税收减免减少，税收收入降低，投资也减少。在废除庇护制度任命后，晋升和绩效差距消失。因此，庇护制度扭曲了公共部门职位的分配，并降低了受庇护官员的履职动力。（JEL D73, F54, H83, J45, M51, N43, N44）

abstract.text: The gains from insurance arise from the transfer of income across states. Yet, by requiring that the premium be paid up front, standard insurance products also transfer income across time. We show that this intertemporal transfer can help explain low insurance demand, especially among the poor, and in a randomized control trial in Kenya we test a crop insurance product which removes it. The product is interlinked with a contract farming scheme: as with other inputs, the buyer of the crop offers the insurance and deducts the premium from farmer revenues at harvest time. The take-up rate for pay-at-harvest insurance is 72 percent, compared to 5 percent for the standard pay-up-front contract, and the difference is largest among poorer farmers. Additional experiments and outcomes provide evidence on the role of liquidity constraints, present bias, and counterparty risk, and find that enabling farmers to commit to pay the premium just 1 month later increases demand by 21 percentage points. (JEL G22, I32, O13, O16, Q12, Q14)

10.1257/aer.20171526.abstractZh: 保险带来的收益源于收入在不同州之间的转移。然而，由于标准要求保费需提前支付，标准保险产品也会造成收入的时间转移。我们发现，这种时间间的转移有助于解释保险需求的低水平，尤其是在贫困人群中。在肯尼亚的一项随机对照试验中，我们测试了一种去除这种时间转移特性的农作物保险产品。该保险产品与合同农业计划相结合：与采用其他投入方式类似，购买农作物的买家负责提供保险，并在收获时从农民的收入中扣除保费。采用“收获时支付”保险方式的覆盖率达到了72%，而采用标准“提前支付”保险方式的覆盖率仅为5%，且这种差异在贫困农民中最为明显。进一步的实验和结果表明，流动性限制、当前偏见和交易对手风险等因素对保险需求有显著影响。研究发现，允许农民在仅一个月后支付保费，可使保险需求增加21个百分点。（JEL G22, I32, O13, O16, Q12, Q14）

abstract.text: We report on an experiment examining why default options impact behavior. By randomly assigning employees to different varieties of a salary-linked savings account, we find that default enrollment increases participation by 40 percentage points—an effect equivalent to providing a 50 percent matching incentive. We then use a series of experimental interventions to differentiate between explanations for the default effect, which we conclude is driven largely by present-biased preferences and the cognitive cost of thinking through different savings scenarios. Default assignment also changes employees’ attitudes toward saving, and makes them more likely to actively decide to save after the study concludes. (JEL C93, D14, D91, O12)

10.1257/aer.20171676.abstractZh: 我们报告了一项实验，旨在探讨为什么默认选项会影响行为。通过随机将员工分配到不同类型的薪资挂钩储蓄账户中，我们发现默认注册会使参与率提高40个百分点——这一效果相当于提供50%的匹配激励。随后，我们通过一系列实验干预措施来区分默认选项效应的不同解释，我们认为这种效应主要受到当前偏好驱动以及思考不同储蓄方案所带来的认知成本的影响。默认分配还会改变员工对储蓄的态度，并使他们在研究结束后更有可能主动决定储蓄行为。（JEL C93, D14, D91, O12）

abstract.text: Medicaid programs increasingly finance competing, capitated managed care plans rather than administering fee-for-service (FFS) programs. We study how the transition from FFS to managed care affects high- and low-cost infants (blacks and Hispanics, respectively). We find that black-Hispanic disparities widen—e.g., black mortality and preterm birth rates increase by 15 percent and 7 percent, respectively, while Hispanic mortality and preterm birth rates decrease by 22 percent and 7 percent, respectively. Our results are consistent with a risk-selection model whereby capitation incentivizes competing plans to offer better (worse) care to low- (high-) cost clients to retain (avoid) them in the future. (JEL H75, I12, I18, I38, J13, J15)

10.1257/pol.20150262.abstractZh: 医疗补助计划越来越多地资助相互竞争的分摊费用管理式护理计划，而非实施按服务收费的项目。我们研究了从按服务收费模式向管理式护理模式的转变对高成本和低成本婴儿（分别指黑人和西班牙裔）的影响。研究发现，黑人和西班牙裔之间的差距进一步扩大——例如，黑人的死亡率和早产率分别增加了15%和7%，而西班牙裔的死亡率和早产率则分别下降了22%和7%。我们的研究结果与风险选择模型一致，该模型认为，分摊费用机制促使竞争性护理计划为低（高）成本客户提供更优质（较差）的护理，以在未来留住这些客户。（JEL H75, I12, I18, I38, J13, J15）

abstract.text: The design of Medicare Part D causes most beneficiaries to receive fragmented health insurance, with drug and medical coverage separated. Fragmentation is potentially inefficient since separate insurers optimize over only one component of healthcare spending, despite complementarities and substitutabilities between healthcare types. Fragmentation of only some plans can also lead to market distortions due to differential adverse selection, as integrated plans may use drug formularies to induce enrollment by patients that are profitable in the medical insurance market. We study the design of insurance plans in Medicare Part D, and find that formularies reflects these two differences in incentives.

10.1257/pol.20160248.abstractZh: Medicare Part D的设计导致大多数受益人获得的是碎片化的健康保险，药品和医疗服务是分开的。这种碎片化可能效率低下，因为不同的保险公司只关注医疗支出的一个方面，而忽视了医疗类型之间的互补性和替代性。仅某些计划的碎片化还可能导致市场扭曲，因为整合的计划可能会使用药品目录来诱导患者参保，而这些做法在医疗保险市场中是有利的。我们对Medicare Part D的保险计划设计进行了研究，发现药品目录反映了这两种激励差异。

abstract.text: The study analyzed the expansion of Social Healthcare Organizations (OSS in Portuguese) in Brazil from 2009 to 2014. The ten largest OSS were measured according to their budget funding and their qualifications as non-profit organizations were explored, considering evidence of their expansion and consolidation in the management and provision of health services via strategies proper to for-profit private enterprises. The study is descriptive and exploratory and was based on public-domain documents. In their relations with government, the OSS have benefited from legal loopholes and incentives and have expanded accordingly. There has been a recent trend for these organizations to simultaneously apply for status as charitable organizations, thereby ensuring multiple opportunities for fundraising and additional tax incentives, permission to invest financial surpluses in the capital market, and remunerate their boards of directors. These organizations tend to concentrate in technology-dense hospital services, with clauses concerning increasing financial transfers to the detriment of other regulatory clauses, and special contract modalities for enabling services that are absolutely strategic for the overall functioning of the Brazilian Unified National Health System. Thus, in this study, the OSS are one component of the Health Economic and Industrial Complex, acting in management, provision, and regulation of services in a scenario of intensive commodification of health and the transfer of public funds to the private sector.

10.1590/0102-311x00194916.abstractZh: 本研究分析了2009至2014年间巴西社会医疗保健组织（葡萄牙语中称为OSS）的扩张情况。研究以预算资金为衡量标准，考察了十大规模最大的OSS，并探讨了它们作为非营利组织的资格，同时考虑了它们在管理和提供医疗服务方面的扩张与整合，以及它们采用与营利性私营企业相同的策略。该研究属于描述性和探索性研究，基于公开文献进行。在与政府的关系方面，这些组织利用了法律漏洞和激励措施，从而实现了扩张。最近的趋势是，这些组织同时申请成为慈善组织，从而获得了更多的筹款机会、额外的税收优惠、在资本市场投资财务盈余的权利，以及向董事会支付报酬的资格。这些组织倾向于集中在技术密集型医院服务领域，其中有关增加财务转移的条款优先于其他监管条款，并且有特殊合同模式，以支持对巴西统一国家卫生系统整体运作至关重要的服务。因此，在本研究中，OSS是健康经济与工业复合体的一部分，在健康服务的管理、提供和监管方面发挥着重要作用，而健康服务正面临激烈的商品化趋势，公共资金正被转移到私营部门。

abstract.text: Children starting school older consistently exhibit better educational outcomes. In this paper, we underscore child development as a mechanism driving this effect. Using unique administrative data on health examinations, we study the causal effect of school starting age (SSA) on a child's probability of being diagnosed with special educational needs in early grades. Results show that children with higher SSA are less likely to develop behavioral problems and speech impediments, whereas learning disabilities, ADHD, and dyslexia/dyscalculia remain unaffected. Importantly, these effects only arise after primary school entry and are not due to preexisting health conditions. We also find that teachers tend to over-refer relatively young children to special needs services, but this over-referring behavior is not driving the results, which are based on psychologists' diagnoses. The SSA effect persists throughout compulsory schooling, resulting in higher test scores and better quality vocational training contracts. However, SSA does not affect employment, earnings, or disability insurance benefits at labor market entry.

10.2139/ssrn.3130000.abstractZh: 较早开始上学的儿童通常会有更好的教育成果。在本文中，我们强调儿童发展作为推动这一效应的机制。利用关于健康检查的独特行政数据，我们研究了入学年龄对儿童在小学阶段被诊断出有特殊教育需求的概率的影响。结果显示，入学年龄较高的儿童出现行为问题和言语障碍的可能性较低，而学习障碍、注意力缺陷多动障碍以及阅读障碍/计算障碍则不受影响。重要的是，这些效应仅在进入小学之后才出现，并非由先前的健康状况引起。我们还发现，教师倾向于将相对年幼的儿童过度推荐给特殊需求服务，但这种过度推荐行为并不是导致这些结果的因素，这些结果基于心理学家的诊断。入学年龄的效应在整个义务教育期间持续存在，导致测试成绩更高，职业培训合同的质量也更好。然而，入学年龄并不会影响劳动力市场的就业、收入或残疾保险福利。

abstract.text: Understanding how health care utilization responds to cost-sharing is of central importance for providing high quality care and limiting the growth of costs. We study whether the framing of cost-sharing incentives has an effect on health care utilization. For this we make use of a policy change in the Netherlands. Until 2007, patients received a refund if they consumed little or no health care; the refund was the lower the more care they had consumed. From 2008 onward, there was a deductible. This means that very similar economic incentives were first framed in terms of smaller gains and later as losses. We find that patients react to incentives much more strongly when they are framed in terms of losses. The effect on yearly spending is 8.6 percent. This suggests that discussions on the optimal design of cost-sharing incentives should also revolve around the question how these are presented to patients.

10.2139/ssrn.3177384.abstractZh: 了解医疗保健利用对费用分摊的反应对于提供高质量的医疗服务和限制成本增长至关重要。我们研究了费用分摊激励机制的设定方式是否会对医疗保健利用产生影响。为此，我们选取了荷兰的一项政策变化作为研究案例。在2007年之前，如果患者消耗的医疗服务很少或没有消耗任何医疗服务，他们可以获得退款；退款金额随着他们消耗的医疗服务数量的增加而减少。从2008年开始，引入了免赔额制度。这意味着，原本类似的经济激励机制最初是以较小的收益来设定的，后来则被转化为损失的形式。我们发现，当激励机制以损失的形式呈现时，患者对激励的反应更为强烈。这一变化对年度支出的影响为8.6%。这表明，关于费用分摊激励机制的最佳设计，还需要考虑这些机制如何向患者传达。

abstract.text: The United States is in the midst of a fatal drug epidemic. This study uses data from the Multiple Cause of Death Files to examine the extent to which increases in county-level drug mortality rates from 1999-2015 are due to “deaths of despair”, measured here by deterioration in medium-run economic conditions, or if they instead are more likely to reflect changes in the “drug environment” in ways that present differential risks to population subgroups. A primary finding is that counties experiencing relative economic decline did experience higher growth in drug mortality than those with more robust growth, but the relationship is weak and mostly explained by confounding factors. In the preferred estimates, changes in economic conditions account for less than one-tenth of the rise in drug and opioid-involved mortality rates. The contribution of economic factors is even less when accounting for plausible selection on unobservables, with even a small amount of remaining confounding factors being sufficient to entirely eliminate the relationship. These results suggest that the “deaths of despair” framing, while provocative, is unlikely to explain the main sources of the fatal drug epidemic and that efforts to improve economic conditions in distressed locations, while desirable for other reasons, are not likely to yield significant reductions in drug mortality. Conversely, the risk of drug deaths varies systematically over time across population subgroups in ways that are consistent with an important role for the public health environment related to the availability and cost of drugs. Put succinctly, the fatal overdose epidemic is likely to primarily reflect drug problems rather than deaths of despair.

10.3386/w24188.abstractZh: 美国正面临一场致命的毒品流行病。本研究利用多死因死亡文件的数据，探讨1999年至2015年间县级毒品死亡率上升在多大程度上是由于“绝望之死”导致的，这里通过经济状况的恶化来衡量“绝望之死”，或者它们更可能反映了“毒品环境”的变化，这些变化对不同的群体带来了不同的风险。主要发现是，经历相对经济衰退的县确实比经济增长较为强劲的县有更高的毒品死亡率，但这种关系较弱，主要由混杂因素解释。在最优估计中，经济状况的变化对毒品和阿片类药物相关死亡率的上升贡献不到十分之一。当考虑到对不可观测变量的合理选择时，经济因素的贡献甚至更小，即使有少量的混杂因素也足以完全消除这种关系。这些结果表明，“绝望之死”这一框架虽然具有挑衅性，但不太可能解释致命毒品流行病的主要来源，而改善经济状况的努力虽然出于其他原因，但不太可能显著减少毒品死亡率。相反，不同群体之间的毒品死亡风险随时间系统性地变化，这与公共卫生环境在毒品可获得性和成本方面的重要作用相一致。简而言之，致命过量死亡流行病主要反映了毒品问题，而非“绝望之死”。

abstract.text: Kremer and Snyder (2015) show that demand curves for a preventive and treatment may have different shapes though they target the same disease, biasing the pharmaceutical manufacturer toward developing the lucrative rather than the socially desirable product. This paper tightens the theoretical bounds on the potential deadweight loss from such biases. Using a calibration of the global demand for HIV pharmaceuticals, we demonstrate the dramatically sharper analysis achievable with the new bounds, allowing us to pinpoint potential deadweight loss at 62% of the global gain from curing HIV. We use the calibration to perform policy counterfactuals, assessing welfare effects of government policies such as a subsidy, reference pricing, and price-discrimination ban. The fit of our calibration is good: we find that a hypothetical drug monopolist would price an HIV drug so high that only 4% of the infected population worldwide would purchase, matching actual drug prices and quantities in the early 2000s before subsidies in low-income countries ramped up.
