10.3386/w24206.abstractZh: Kremer和Snyder（2015）指出，尽管预防性和治疗性产品的需求曲线可能相同，但它们的形状可能会有所不同，这会使制药公司倾向于开发利润丰厚的产品，而非社会期望的产品。本文进一步明确了这种偏见可能导致的潜在无谓损失的理论界限。通过对全球HIV药物需求的校准，我们证明了使用新的界限可以得出更为精确的分析结果，从而确定潜在的无谓损失占治愈HIV所带来的全球收益的62%。我们利用这一校准结果进行政策反事实分析，评估政府政策如补贴、参考定价和价格歧视禁令对福利的影响。我们的校准结果表明，假设存在药物垄断者，HIV药物的定价会非常高，以至于全球只有4%的感染者能够购买，这与2000年代初在没有低收入国家提供补贴之前的药物价格和销量情况相符。

abstract.text: The prescription drug component of the Consumer Price Index (CPI measures recent and past drug price changes, and provides the basis for projecting future price trends and health care expenditures. However, there are concerns about the adequacy of the price data because of recent changes in the structure of the market for prescription drugs. We compare the prescription drug data of the CPI with a large alternative data set from the IQVIA Institute for Human Data Science. We analyze the overall consistency if the data from the two sources, and examine the influence of the large shift from brand to generic drug sales and the increased reliance on third party insurance plans that are excluded from the CPI sampling frame.

10.3386/w24210.abstractZh: 消费者价格指数中的处方药成分能够反映近期和过去的药物价格变化，为预测未来价格趋势和医疗保健支出提供了依据。然而，由于处方药市场结构的最新变化，人们对这些价格数据的准确性提出了质疑。我们将消费者价格指数中的处方药数据与IQVIA人类数据科学研究所提供的大量替代数据集进行了对比。我们分析了这两种数据来源的数据整体一致性，并探讨了从品牌药品转向仿制药销售所带来的巨大变化，以及因依赖第三方保险计划而减少的数据，这些因素并未被纳入消费者价格指数的抽样框架中，对数据产生了影响。

abstract.text: Over the past few years, adult use of e-cigs has been increasing while adult smoking has been declining. Although there is a negative time correlation, it is important to determine if there is a causal effect of e-cig use on smoking. This is important because of the known health hazards associated with smoking. A key concern with most prior studies of e-cigs and smoking is that causality between e-cig use and cigarette use is ignored. One contribution of this paper is to estimate structural and reduced form equations that replace e-cig use with e-cig price in order to avoid this endogeneity problem. The data employed to estimate the empirical models come from the Tobacco Use Supplements (TUS). These data are from the combined July 2014, January 2015 and May 2015 waves of the TUS. The results show that e-cig use increases the probability of a quit attempt, the probability of a quit failure, the number of quit failures and the probability of a quit success. It is also estimated that a 10% federal excise tax on e-cigs would reduce the number of quitters in the US by more than 250,000 per year.

10.3386/w24212.abstractZh: 在过去的几年中，成年人使用电子香烟的人数不断增加，而成年人吸烟的人数则有所下降。尽管存在负的时间相关性，但确定电子香烟的使用是否对吸烟有因果影响仍然很重要。这一点非常重要，因为众所周知吸烟会带来健康风险。大多数关于电子香烟和吸烟的研究都忽略了电子香烟使用与香烟使用之间的因果关系。本文的一个贡献是建立了结构和简化形式的方程，用电子香烟的价格来替代电子香烟的使用，以避免这种内生性问题。用于估计实证模型的数据来自烟草使用补充数据。这些数据来自2014年7月、2015年1月和2015年5月的烟草使用补充数据。研究结果显示，使用电子香烟会增加尝试戒烟的概率、戒烟失败的概率、戒烟失败的次数以及戒烟成功的概率。此外，估计对电子香烟征收10%的联邦消费税每年可以将美国的戒烟人数减少超过250,000人。

abstract.text: Education is strongly associated with better health and longer lives. However, the extent to which education causes health and longevity is widely debated. We develop a human capital framework to structure the interpretation of the empirical evidence. We then review evidence on the causal effects of education on mortality and its two most common preventable causes: smoking and obesity. We focus attention on evidence from Randomized Controlled Trials, twin studies, and quasi-experiments. There is no convincing evidence of an effect of education on obesity, and the effects on smoking are only apparent when schooling reforms affect individuals’ track or their peer group, but not when they simply increase the duration of schooling. An effect of education on mortality exists in some contexts but not in others, and seems to depend on (i) gender; (ii) the labor market returns to education; (iii) the quality of education; and (iv) whether education affects the quality of individuals’ peers.

10.3386/w24225.abstractZh: 教育与更好的健康和更长的寿命密切相关。然而，教育在多大程度上能够影响健康和寿命，这一话题存在广泛争议。我们采用人力资本框架来整理相关实证证据。随后，我们回顾了关于教育对死亡率及其两个最常见可预防原因——吸烟和肥胖——的因果效应的研究。我们的研究重点关注随机对照试验、双胞胎研究和准实验研究中的证据。目前没有令人信服的证据表明教育对肥胖有积极影响，而教育对吸烟的影响仅在学校教育改革影响到个体自身或同伴群体时才显现，而当学校教育改革仅仅增加受教育时间时则不会如此。教育对死亡率的影响在某些情境下确实存在，但在其他情境下则不存在，这种影响似乎取决于以下因素：(i) 性别；(ii) 劳动力市场对教育的回报；(iii) 教育质量；(iv) 教育是否影响个体同伴的质量。

abstract.text: Workplace wellness programs cover over 50 million workers and are intended to reduce medical spending, increase productivity, and improve well-being. Yet, limited evidence exists to support these claims. We designed and implemented a comprehensive workplace wellness program for a large employer with over 12,000 employees, and randomly assigned program eligibility and financial incentives at the individual level. Over 56 percent of eligible (treatment group) employees participated in the program. We find strong patterns of selection: during the year prior to the intervention, program participants had lower medical expenditures and healthier behaviors than non-participants. However, we do not find significant causal effects of treatment on total medical expenditures, health behaviors, employee productivity, or self-reported health status in the first year. Our 95% confidence intervals rule out 83 percent of previous estimates on medical spending and absenteeism. Our selection results suggest these programs may act as a screening mechanism: even in the absence of any direct savings, differential recruitment or retention of lower-cost participants could result in net savings for employers.

10.3386/w24229.abstractZh: 工作场所的健康计划覆盖了超过5000万名员工，旨在减少医疗支出、提高生产力并改善员工福祉。然而，目前缺乏足够的证据来支持这些主张。我们为一家拥有超过12,000名员工的大型企业设计并实施了一项全面的工作场所健康计划，并在个体层面随机分配了参与资格和财务激励措施。超过56%的符合条件的员工参与了该计划。我们发现了一个明显的选择模式：在干预措施实施前的那一年，参与计划的员工在医疗支出和健康行为方面都优于未参与计划的员工。然而，我们并未发现治疗对总医疗支出、健康行为、员工生产力或自我报告的健康状况有显著的因果效应。我们的95%置信区间排除了83%之前关于医疗支出和缺勤率的估计结果。我们的选择结果表明，这些计划可能起到筛查机制的作用：即使没有直接节省成本，通过选择性招募或保留成本较低的员工，也能为雇主带来净节省。

abstract.text: While economists have posited that health investments increase earnings, isolating the causal effect of health is challenging due both to reverse causality and unobserved heterogeneity. We examine the labor market effects of a randomized controlled trial, the Multiple Risk Factor Intervention Trial (MRFIT), which monitored nearly 13,000 men for over six years. We find that this intervention, which provided a bundle of treatments to reduce coronary heart disease mortality, increased earnings and family income. We find few differences in estimated gains by baseline health and occupation characteristics. Reductions in serious illnesses and work-limiting disabilities likely contributed to the observed gains.

10.3386/w24231.abstractZh: 经济学家认为健康投资能够增加收入，但要确定健康投资的因果效应却颇具挑战性，这主要是由于逆向因果关系以及未观察到的异质性所致。我们研究了随机对照试验“多重风险因素干预试验”（MRFIT）在劳动力市场中的效果，该试验对近13,000名男性进行了超过六年的监测。我们发现，这项旨在减少冠心病死亡率的干预措施，确实增加了收入和家庭收入。我们发现在基线健康状况和职业特征方面的收益差异不大。减少严重疾病和工作限制性的残疾可能正是这些收益得以实现的原因。

abstract.text: Many applications involve a censored dependent variable and an endogenous independent variable. Chernozhukov, Fernandez-Val, and Kowalski (2015) introduced a censored quantile instrumental variable estimator (CQIV) for use in those applications, which has been applied by Kowalski (2016), among others. In this article, we introduce a Stata command, cqiv, that simplifes application of the CQIV estimator in Stata. We summarize the CQIV estimator and algorithm, we describe the use of the cqiv command, and we provide empirical examples.

10.3386/w24232.abstractZh: 许多应用涉及被审查的因变量和内生自变量。Chernozhukov、Fernandez-Val和Kowalski在2015年提出了一种被审查的分位数工具变量估计方法（CQIV），该方法已被Kowalski在2016年的研究以及其他学者所应用。在本文中，我们介绍了一种名为cqiv的Stata命令，该命令简化了在Stata中应用CQIV估计方法的过程。我们总结了CQIV估计方法和算法，描述了如何使用cqiv命令，并提供了实证案例。

abstract.text: Drug pricing in the U.S. is a persistently vexing policy problem. While there is agreement among many policy analysts that supra competitive prices are necessary to promote innovation; significant disagreements arise over how much pricing discretion prescription drug manufacturers should be permitted, and what portion of the sum of producer plus consumer surplus in the prescription drug market should be claimed by manufacturers relative to consumers and other payers. This paper focuses on an extremely costly component of the Medicare Part D program the region of coverage that kicks in once a consumer has spent $4,950 on drugs in a calendar year (roughly $8,100 in total drug spending). At that point there are high levels of insurance for the consumer and reinsurance for the prescription drug plan. Consumers pay 5% of costs; plans pay 15% and the government 80%. That design generates serious inefficiencies. The significant subsidies to plans in the reinsurance region combined with the launch of unique high cost prescription drugs could be expected to lead to and has led to substantial departures from cost-effective outcomes in treatments delivered. We investigate two, possibly complementary, strategies for reducing these inefficiencies. The first follows on the MedPac recommendation that the government reduce its share of risk bearing for the Part D reinsurance benefit. The second focuses on curbing price inefficiencies. It has two components: eliminating monopolistic overpricing, and rewarding the quality of drugs brought to market. It is grounded in the economics of two part tariffs, research on innovation prizes, performance-based contracts, and draws on the mechanism design literature.

10.3386/w24240.abstractZh: 美国的药品定价一直是一个令人困扰的政策问题。尽管许多政策分析人士认为，过高的价格对于促进创新是必要的，但在药品制造商应被允许有多少定价自主权，以及药品市场中生产者与消费者总收益中的哪一部分应由制造商相对于消费者和其他支付者来承担的问题上，存在重大分歧。本文重点关注Medicare Part D计划中的一个极其昂贵的组成部分——即消费者在一年内花费4,950美元购买药品后，保险覆盖开始生效的额度（总计约8,100美元）。此时，消费者的保险费用较高，而药品计划的再保险费用也较高。消费者承担5%的成本；计划承担15%，政府承担80%。这种设计导致了严重的效率低下。对计划的再保险部分的巨额补贴，加上新型高成本药品的出现，可能导致并已经导致治疗方式的成本效益严重下降。我们探讨了两种可能互补的策略来减少这些效率低下问题。第一种策略是遵循MedPac的建议，即政府减少其在Part D再保险福利中的风险承担份额。第二种策略则侧重于遏制价格效率低下问题，它包括两个方面：消除垄断性过度定价，以及奖励进入市场的优质药品。这一策略基于两部分关税的经济学原理、关于创新奖励的研究、基于绩效的合同，并借鉴了机制设计领域的理论。

abstract.text: Making a transfer in kind reduces its value to recipients but can improve targeting. We develop an approach to quantifying this tradeoff and apply it to home care. Using randomized experiments by Medicaid, we find that in-kind provision significantly reduces the value of the transfer to recipients while targeting a small fraction of the eligible population that is sicker and has fewer informal caregivers than the average eligible. Under a wide range of assumptions within a standard model, the targeting benefit exceeds the distortion cost. This highlights an important cost of recent reforms toward more flexible benefits.

10.3386/w24267.abstractZh: 实物转移会降低转移对象的价值，但可以提高目标定位的准确性。我们提出了一种量化这种权衡的方法，并将其应用于家庭护理领域。通过Medicaid的随机实验，我们发现实物转移显著降低了转移对象的价值，同时只针对一小部分符合条件但病情更严重、非正式护理人员较少的群体。在标准模型的广泛假设下，目标定位带来的好处超过了扭曲成本。这凸显了近期改革在引入更灵活福利机制时所面临的一个重要成本。

abstract.text: Only recently introduced into the U.S. market, e-cigarettes have been aggressively promoted, and use is increasing rapidly among both adults and youths. At the heart of the regulatory debate are fundamental questions regarding whether e-cigarettes will draw cigarette smokers away from a dangerous habit or lure new initiates into tobacco use. We provide some of the first causal evidence on whether e-cigarette advertising on television and in magazines (which comprise about 90% of total media spending on e-cigarettes) encourage adult smokers to quit. We find that the answer to this question is a yes for TV advertising but no for magazine advertising. Our results indicate that a policy to ban TV advertising of e-cigarettes would have reduced the number of smokers who quit in the recent past by approximately 3%, resulting in roughly 105,000 fewer quitters in that period. On the other hand, if the FDA were not considering regulations and mandates that would likely eliminate many e-cigarette producers during our sample period, e-cigarette ads might have reached the number of nicotine replacement therapy TV ads during that period. That would have increased the number of smokers who quit by around 10%, resulting in an additional 350,000 quitters.

10.3386/w24277.abstractZh: 电子香烟最近才被引入美国市场，但受到了大力推广，其在成人和青少年中的使用率正在迅速上升。关于电子香烟是否会让吸烟者远离这一危险习惯，或者是否会吸引新的使用者开始使用烟草，这是监管讨论的核心问题。我们提供了一些关于电视和杂志上电子香烟广告是否鼓励成年吸烟者戒烟的初步因果证据。研究发现，对于电视广告来说，答案是肯定的；而对于杂志广告来说，答案是否定的。我们的结果表明，如果禁止电视上电子香烟广告，那么近期戒烟的吸烟者数量将减少约3%，即减少了约105,000名戒烟者。另一方面，如果美国食品药品监督管理局不采取可能使许多电子香烟生产商在样本期间消失的法规和政策，那么电子香烟广告的数量可能会与尼古丁替代疗法的广告相当。这将使戒烟的吸烟者数量增加约10%，即增加了350,000名戒烟者。

abstract.text: We study the causal impact of religiosity through a randomized evaluation of an evangelical Protestant Christian values and theology education program delivered to thousands of ultra-poor Filipino households. Six months after the program ended, treated households have higher religiosity and income; no statistically significant differences in total labor supply, consumption, food security, or life satisfaction; and lower perceived relative economic status. Exploratory analysis suggests that the income treatment effect may operate through increasing grit. Thirty months after the program ended, significant differences in the intensity of religiosity disappear, but those in the treatment group are less likely to be Catholic and more likely to be Protestant, and there is some mixed evidence that their consumption and perceived relative economic status are higher.

10.3386/w24278.abstractZh: 我们通过对数千个菲律宾极端贫困家庭实施的福音派新教价值观和神学教育项目的随机评估，研究宗教性对因果影响的效应。项目结束后六个月，接受教育的家庭表现出更高的宗教性和收入水平；但在劳动力供应、消费、粮食安全或生活满意度方面，没有统计学上的显著差异；同时，他们感知到的相对经济地位也有所下降。探索性分析表明，收入处理效应可能通过提升韧性来实现。项目结束后三十个月，宗教性的强度差异消失，但接受教育的群体更可能信仰新教，而非天主教；此外，他们的消费水平和感知到的相对经济地位有所提升，但证据并不一致。

abstract.text: We ascertain the degree of service-level selection in Medicare Advantage (MA) using individual level data on the 100 most frequent HCC’s or combination of HCC’s from two national insurers in 2012-2013. We find differences in the distribution of beneficiaries across HCC’s between TM and MA, principally in the smaller share of MA enrollees with no coded HCC, consistent with greater coding intensity in MA. Among those with an HCC code, absolute differences between MA and TM shares of beneficiaries are small, consistent with little service-level selection. Variation in HCC margins does not predict differences between an HCC’s share of MA and TM enrollees, although one cannot a priori sign a relationship between margin and service-level selection. Margins are negatively associated with the importance of post-acute care in the HCC. Margins among common chronic disease classes amenable to medical management and typically managed by primary care physicians are larger than among diseases typically managed by specialists. These margin differences by disease are robust against a test for coding effects and suggest that the average technical efficiency of MA relative to TM may vary by diagnosis. If so, service-level selection on the basis of relative technical efficiency could be welfare enhancing.

10.3386/w24289.abstractZh: 我们利用2012-2013年间两家全国性保险公司100种最常见慢性病（HCC）或慢性病组合的个体数据，研究了Medicare Advantage（MA）中的服务水平选择程度。研究发现，在TM和MA之间，受益人的分布存在差异，主要体现在没有编码慢性病的MA参保人的比例较低，这与MA中编码强度较高的现象一致。在有慢性病史编码的参保人中，MA和TM在受益人比例上的绝对差异较小，这表明服务水平选择程度较低。慢性病利润的变化并不能预测不同慢性病在MA和TM参保人中的比例差异，尽管无法预先断定利润与服务水平选择之间的关系。利润与慢性病在患者中的重要性呈负相关。对于可以通过医疗管理且通常由初级保健医生管理的常见慢性病类别，其利润通常高于通常由专科医生管理的疾病。这些基于疾病类型的利润差异在检验编码效应后仍然保持稳定，这表明MA相对于TM的平均技术效率可能因诊断而异。如果真是这样，那么基于相对技术效率的服务水平选择可能会提升福利水平。

abstract.text: The Hospital Readmission Reduction Program (HRRP) and the Hospital Value Based Purchasing Program (HVBP), two components of the Affordable Care Act's cost containment measures, introduced potentially sizeable penalties to underperforming hospitals across a variety of metrics. To the extent that penalized hospitals subsequently changed their processes of care, such changes may translate into higher payments from commercial insurance patients. In this paper, we estimate the effects of these pay-for-performance programs on private hospital payments using data on commercial insurance payments from a large, multi-payer database. We find that nearly 70% of the costs of the HRRP and HVBP penalties are borne by private insurance patients in the form of higher private insurance payments to hospitals. Specifically, we show that HRRP and HVBP led to increases in private payments of 1.4%, or approximately $183,700 per hospital based on an average relative penalty of $271,000. We find very limited evidence that these effects are driven by quality improvements, changes in treatment intensity, or changes in service mix.

10.3386/w24304.abstractZh: 《医院再入院减少计划》（HRRP）和《医院价值采购计划》（HVBP）是《平价医疗法案》中成本控制措施的两个组成部分，这些计划对表现不佳的医院在多个指标上实施了潜在的重大处罚。由于受到处罚的医院随后改变了其护理流程，这些改变可能导致商业保险患者的支付金额增加。在本文中，我们利用一个大型多保险数据库中的商业保险支付数据，估算了这些绩效支付计划对私立医院支付的影响。我们发现，近70%的HRRP和HVBP处罚成本由私立保险患者承担，表现为私立保险公司向医院支付的金额增加。具体来说，根据平均相对处罚金额为271,000美元，我们观察到HRRP和HVBP导致私立支付金额增加了1.4%，即每家医院增加了约183,700美元。我们发现，这些影响几乎没有任何证据表明是由质量改进、治疗强度变化或服务组合变化所驱动的。

abstract.text: Using police accident reports for Tippecanoe County, Indiana, and exploiting the introduction of the augmented reality game Pokémon GO as a natural experiment, we document a disproportionate increase in crashes and associated vehicular damage, injuries, and fatalities in the vicinity of locations where users can play the game while driving. We estimate the incremental county-wide cost of users playing Pokémon GO while driving to be in the range of $5.2 to $25.5 million over the 148 days following the introduction of the game. Extrapolating these estimates to nation-wide levels yields a total ranging from $2.0 to $7.3 billion.

10.3386/w24308.abstractZh: 通过利用印第安纳州蒂佩卡诺县的道路事故报告，并借助增强现实游戏《精灵宝可梦GO》作为自然实验，我们发现在使用该游戏时发生交通事故的情况显著增加，相关车辆损坏、人员伤亡和死亡人数也相应上升。我们估计，在《精灵宝可梦GO》游戏推出的148天内，该游戏导致全县因驾驶时使用而产生的额外成本在520万至2550万美元之间。将这些估计值推广到全国范围，总成本则介于20亿至73亿美元之间。

abstract.text: In 2004, France introduced a national program of organized breast cancer screening. The national program built on pre-existing local programs in some, but not all, départements. Using data from multiple waves of a nationally representative biennial survey of the French population, we estimate the effect of organized screening on the percentage of women obtaining a mammogram. The analysis uses difference-in-differences methods to exploit the fact that the program was targeted at women in a specific age group: 50 to 74 years old. We find that organized screening significantly raised mammography rates among women in the target age range. Just above the lower age threshold, the percentage of women reporting that they had a mammogram in the past two years increased by over 10 percentage points after the national program went into effect. Mammography rates increased even more among women in their sixties. Estimated effects are particularly large for women with less education and lower incomes, suggesting that France's organized screening program has reduced socioeconomic disparities in access to mammography.

10.3386/w24316.abstractZh: 2004年，法国启动了一项全国性的乳腺癌筛查计划。该计划基于一些省份已有的地方性筛查项目，但并非所有省份都实施了该计划。我们利用一项具有全国代表性的双年度调查数据，估算了有组织筛查对女性接受乳腺X光检查比例的影响。分析采用差异-差异方法，利用该计划针对特定年龄组——50至74岁女性这一特点进行建模。研究发现，有组织筛查显著提高了目标年龄组女性的乳腺X光检查率。在年龄门槛略高于50岁之后，该计划实施后的两年内，有乳腺X光检查记录的女性比例增加了10个百分点以上。对于60岁以上的女性来说，乳腺X光检查率的增长更为显著。对于教育程度较低和收入较低的女性来说，这种影响尤为明显，这表明法国的有组织筛查计划有效减少了女性在乳腺X光检查方面的社会经济差异。

abstract.text: How does team-specific capital affect productivity? We examine the teams that primary care physicians (PCPs) assemble when referring patients to specialists. Our theoretical model finds that team-specific capital is greater when PCPs concentrate their referrals within a smaller set of specialists. Empirically, we find patients of PCPs with concentrated referrals have lower healthcare costs, with no discernable reduction in quality. This effect exists for commercially insured and Medicare populations; is statistically and economically significant; and holds under identification strategies that account for unobserved patient and physician characteristics.

10.3386/w24338.abstractZh: 团队特定的资本如何影响生产力？我们研究了初级保健医生在转诊患者给专科医生时组建的团队。我们的理论模型发现，当初级保健医生将转诊集中在较少的专科医生范围内时，团队特定的资本会更高。从经验数据来看，我们发现这些医生转诊集中的患者医疗费用较低，而医疗质量并没有明显的下降。这种效应在商业保险和Medicare人群中都存在；并且在统计和经济上都是显著的；而且这种效应在考虑了未观察到的患者和医生特征的情况下仍然成立。

abstract.text: Recent medical literature suggests that vitamin D supplementation protects against acute respiratory tract infection. Humans exposed to sunlight produce vitamin D directly. This paper investigates how differences in sunlight, as measured over several years across states and during the same calendar week, affect influenza incidence. We find that sunlight strongly protects against getting influenza. This relationship is driven almost entirely by the severe H1N1 epidemic in fall 2009. A 10% increase in relative sunlight decreases the influenza index in September or October by 1.1 points on a 10-point scale. A second, complementary study employs a separate data set to study flu incidence in counties in New York State. The results are strongly in accord.

10.3386/w24340.abstractZh: 最近的医学文献表明，维生素D的补充有助于预防急性呼吸道感染。人类通过接触阳光可以直接产生维生素D。本文研究了多年间不同州在同一日历周内阳光强度的变化对流感发病率的影响。研究发现，阳光对预防流感具有显著的保护作用。这种保护作用几乎完全是由2009年秋季严重的H1N1疫情所驱动的。相对阳光强度增加10%，在9月或10月时，流感指数会在10分制中降低1.1分。另一项补充研究则使用不同的数据集来研究纽约州各县的流感发病率，其研究结果与前者高度一致。

abstract.text: This paper examines a schooling expansion in Romania which increased educational attainment for successive cohorts born between 1945 and 1950. We use a regression discontinuity design at the day level based on school entry cutoff dates to estimate impacts on mortality with 1994-2016 Vital Statistics data and self-reported health with 2011 Census data. We find that the schooling reform led to significant increases in years of schooling and changes in labor market outcomes but did not affect mortality or self-reported health. These estimates provide new evidence for the causal relationship between education and mortality outside of high-income countries and at lower margins of educational attainment.

10.3386/w24341.abstractZh: 本文研究了罗马尼亚的学校教育扩张对1945年至1950年间出生的几代人的教育成就的影响。我们采用基于入学截止日期的日级回归不连续设计，利用1994-2016年的生命统计数据和2011年人口普查数据，来估算其对死亡率的影响以及对个人健康状况的影响。研究发现，学校教育改革显著增加了受教育年限，并改变了劳动力市场的结果，但并未影响死亡率或个人健康状况。这些估计结果为教育与死亡率之间的因果关系提供了新的证据，尤其是在高收入国家之外以及教育水平较低的情况下。

abstract.text: Screening interventions can produce very different treatment outcomes, depending on the reasons why patients had been unscreened in the first place. Economists have paid scant attention to these complexities and their implications for evaluating screening programs. In this paper, we propose a simple economic framework to guide policy-makers and analysts in designing and evaluating the impact of screening on treatment uptake. We apply these insights to several salient empirical examples that illustrate the different kinds of effects screening programs might produce. Our empirical examples focus on contexts relevant to the top cause of death in the United States, heart disease. We find that currently undiagnosed patients differ from currently diagnosed patients in important ways, leading to lower predicted uptake of recommended treatment if these patients were diagnosed. Additionally, changes in the composition of diagnosed patients can produce misleading conclusions during policy analysis, such as spurious reductions in measured health system performance as screening expands.

10.3386/w24347.abstractZh: 筛查干预措施的效果可能会因患者最初未被筛查的原因而有所不同。经济学家对这些复杂情况及其对评估筛查项目的影响的关注甚微。在本文中，我们提出了一个简单经济框架，以指导政策制定者和分析师设计和评估筛查对治疗接受度的影响。我们将这些见解应用于几个典型的实证案例，以说明筛查项目可能产生的不同效果。我们的实证案例重点关注与美国主要死因——心脏病相关的情境。我们发现，目前未被诊断的患者与已被诊断的患者在重要方面存在差异，如果这些患者被诊断出来，预计接受推荐治疗的比例将会降低。此外，被诊断患者的构成变化可能会在政策分析中产生误导性的结论，例如，随着筛查的扩大，健康系统绩效的测量结果可能会出现虚假的下降。

abstract.text: In setting prices for physician services, Medicare solicits input from a committee that evaluates proposals from industry. We investigate whether this arrangement leads to prices biased toward the interests of committee members. We find that increasing a measure of affiliation between the committee and proposers by one standard deviation increases prices by 10%, demonstrating a pathway for regulatory capture. We then evaluate the effect of affiliation on the quality of information used in price-setting. More affiliated proposals produce less hard information, measured as lower quality survey data. However, affiliation results in prices that are more closely followed by private insurers, suggesting that affiliation may increase the total information used in price-setting.

10.3386/w24354.abstractZh: 在设定医生服务价格时，医疗保险机构会邀请一个委员会来评估各行业的提案。我们研究了这种安排是否会导致价格偏向委员会成员的利益。研究发现，当委员会与提案者之间的关联程度增加一个标准差时，价格会上涨10%，这表明存在监管俘获的可能性。接着，我们评估了关联程度对价格设定中使用的信息质量的影响。关联程度较高的提案产生的信息质量较低，即调查数据的质量较差。然而，关联程度较高的提案会导致价格更受私人保险公司的关注，这表明关联程度可能会增加价格设定中使用的总信息量。

abstract.text: I respond to Atkinson's plea to revive welfare economics, and to considering alternative ethical frameworks when making policy recommendations. I examine a measure of self-reported evaluative wellbeing, the Cantril Ladder, and use data from Gallup to examine wellbeing over the life-cycle. I assess the validity of the measure, and show that it is hard to reconcile with familiar theories of intertemporal choice. I find a worldwide optimism about the future; in spite of repeated evidence to the contrary, people consistently but irrationally predict they will be better off five years from now. The gap between future and current wellbeing diminishes with age, and in rich countries, is negative among the elderly. I also use the measure to think about income transfers by age and sex. Policies that give priority those with low incomes favor the young and the old, while utilitarian policies favor the middle aged, and men over women.

10.3386/w24369.abstractZh: 我回应了阿特金森关于复兴福利经济学的呼吁，以及在提出政策建议时考虑其他伦理框架的提议。我研究了一种自我评估幸福感的测量方法——坎特雷尔梯子法，并利用盖洛普的数据来考察生命周期中的幸福感。我评估了这种测量方法的有效性，并发现它难以与常见的跨时期选择理论相调和。我发现全球范围内人们对未来持乐观态度；尽管有相反的证据，人们仍然一贯且不合逻辑地预测未来五年自己的生活会更好。未来与当前幸福感之间的差距随着年龄的增长而缩小，在富裕国家中，老年人的这一差距是负值。我还利用这一测量方法来思考不同年龄和性别之间的收入转移问题。优先考虑低收入群体的政策会有利于年轻人和老年人，而功利主义政策则更偏向中年人和男性。

abstract.text: Ban-the-box (BTB) laws, which prevent employers from asking prospective employees about their criminal histories at initial job screenings, are intended to increase employment opportunities and reduce economic incentives for crime. This study is the first to comprehensively explore the relationship between state and local BTB laws and criminal arrests among racial/ethnic minorities. Using agency-by-month data from the National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS), we find that BTB laws are associated with a 10 percent increase in criminal incidents involving Hispanic male arrestees. This finding is supported by parallel analysis using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 (NLSY97) and is consistent with BTB law-induced job loss due to employer-based statistical discrimination. We find no evidence that BTB laws increase property crime among African American men despite their also facing statistical discrimination. Supplemental analyses from the American Community Survey (ACS) suggest that barriers to welfare participation among Hispanic men may explain this result. Our estimates suggest that BTB laws generate $401 million in annual crime costs.

10.3386/w24381.abstractZh: “禁箱法”旨在禁止雇主在初次就业筛选时询问潜在员工的犯罪记录，其目的是增加就业机会并减少犯罪的经济诱因。本研究首次全面探讨了州级和地方级“禁箱法”与少数族裔群体犯罪逮捕之间的关系。通过利用全国基于事件的报告系统（NIBRS）的月度数据，我们发现“禁箱法”与西班牙裔男性被捕案件数量增加10%有关。这一发现得到了1997年青年纵向调查（NLSY97）数据的支持，并与因雇主基于统计数据的歧视而导致的“禁箱法”引发的失业现象一致。尽管非裔美国男性同样面临统计性歧视，但研究并未发现“禁箱法”会增加他们的财产犯罪率。来自美国社区调查（ACS）的补充分析表明，西班牙裔男性参与福利计划的障碍可能解释了这一结果。我们的估计显示，“禁箱法”每年导致4.01亿美元的犯罪成本。

abstract.text: Economic literature has extensively studied how prices for incumbent pharmaceutical drugs respond to generic competition after entry. However, less attention has been paid to pricing behavior in anticipation of brand-to-brand competition. We contribute to this gap in the literature by both developing a model of pricing strategies for incumbent drug manufacturers under tiered-insurance anticipating branded competition. Our model predicts rising prices for incumbent drugs for a range of elasticities as the likelihood of entry increases from competitors with horizontally-differentiated products. Using the insulin market as a natural experiment, we exploit exogenous variation in a potential entrant's completion of clinical trials to identify the effect of drug pipeline pressure on the prices of incumbent drugs. Results suggest that pipeline pressure significantly increases the prices of incumbent drugs. We expect that similar pricing effects will be prevalent with potential biosimilar entry.

10.3386/w24387.abstractZh: 经济学文献广泛研究了在位药品在仿制药进入市场后价格的变化情况。然而，对于品牌间竞争预期下的定价行为研究相对较少。我们通过开发一种针对在位药品制造商在分层保险机制下应对品牌竞争的策略模型，填补了这一研究空白。我们的模型预测，随着来自产品差异化程度较低的竞争对手的进入可能性增加，在位药品的价格将随着弹性系数的提高而上升。以胰岛素市场作为自然实验，我们利用潜在进入者完成临床试验这一外生变量，来研究药品研发压力对在位药品价格的影响。研究结果表明，研发压力显著提高了在位药品的价格。我们预计，类似的价格效应在生物仿制药进入市场时也会普遍存在。

abstract.text: Recent studies have found that many people select into health plans with higher coverage (e.g., lower deductibles) even when those plans are financially dominated by other options. We explore whether having dominated options is common by analyzing data on plan designs from the Kaiser Family Foundation Employer Health Benefits Survey for firms that offered employees both a high-deductible (HD) health plan and a lower-deductible (LD) option. In 65% of firms the high-deductible option would result in lower maximum possible health spending for the employee for the year. We estimate that the HD plan financially dominates the LD plan at roughly half of firms across a wide range of possible health spending needs employees might anticipate. The expected savings from selecting the HD plan are typically over $500 per year, often with no increase in financial risk. We present evidence that these patterns may arise naturally from employers passing through large average-cost differences between HD and LD plans to their employees. We discuss the implications of those dynamics for the nature of transfers between employees and the efficiency of health spending.

10.3386/w24392.abstractZh: 最近的研究发现，许多人即使其他选项在财务上更具优势，仍会选择覆盖范围更广的健康计划（例如，较低的免赔额）。我们通过分析凯撒家庭基金会雇主健康福利调查中的数据，来探讨这种主导选项现象是否普遍存在。该调查涵盖了那些为员工提供高免赔额健康计划和低免赔额健康计划的公司。在65%的公司中，高免赔额计划会使员工一年的最大健康支出减少。我们估计，在大约一半的公司中，高免赔额计划在广泛的健康支出需求范围内，从财务上占据主导地位。选择高免赔额计划通常可以每年节省超过500美元，而且通常不会增加财务风险。我们有证据表明，这些模式可能是由雇主将高免赔额和低免赔额计划之间的平均成本差异传递给员工所导致的。我们讨论了这些动态对员工间转移支付性质以及健康支出效率的影响。

abstract.text: We test whether state malpractice reforms differentially attract new physicians along dimensions of medical human capital plausibly related to malpractice exposure and patient outcomes. Using an exit survey of physicians completing residencies between 1998 and 2016, we estimate physicians’ willingness-to-pay (WTP) to locate their first practice in a reform state. We find physicians are willing to forego, on average, about $11 per hour in wages to locate in a reform state. International medical school graduates (IMGs) and physicians trained outside high-ranked teaching hospitals exhibit approximately $27–$28 higher relative WTP to locate in a reform state, relative to U.S. medical graduates and physicians trained in high-ranked hospitals, respectively. As an illustrative exercise, we map these estimated entry-margin compositional shifts into first-year spending scenarios for reforming states under additional assumptions, using Texas as an example. These results suggest that human-capital–biased sorting at the entry margin in response to litigation reform may contribute to geographic variation in healthcare utilization and spending.

10.3386/w24401.abstractZh: 我们测试了州级医疗事故改革是否会在与医疗事故风险及患者预后相关的医疗人力资本维度上，对不同类型的医生产生不同的吸引力。通过1998至2016年间完成住院医师培训的医生的退出调查，我们估算了医生愿意在改革州设立第一诊所的支付意愿。研究发现，医生平均愿意放弃约每小时11美元的工资，以在改革州设立诊所。国际医学毕业生和在高排名教学医院外接受培训的医生，在设立诊所的支付意愿上分别比美国医学毕业生和高排名医院培养的医生高出约27至28美元。作为示例，我们使用德克萨斯州作为案例，将这些估算的进入门槛变化映射到改革州的第一年支出情景中。这些结果表明，由于诉讼改革导致的医疗人力资本方面的差异，可能会导致医疗使用和支出的地理差异。

abstract.text: This study examines the effects of a congestion tax in central Stockholm on ambient air pollution and the health of local children. We demonstrate that the tax reduced ambient air pollution by 5–15 percent and the rate of acute asthma attacks among young children. We do not see corresponding changes in accidents or hospitalizations for nonrespiratory conditions. As the change in health was more gradual than the change in pollution, it may take time for the full health effects of changes in pollution to materialize if the mechanism is pollution. Hence, short-run estimates of pollution reduction programs may understate long-run health benefits.

10.3386/w24410.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了在斯德哥尔摩市中心征收拥堵税对空气污染以及当地儿童健康的影响。研究表明，该税收使空气污染减少了5%至15%，同时减少了幼儿急性哮喘的发作率。然而，我们并未观察到与呼吸系统相关疾病的事故或住院率出现相应的变化。由于健康方面的改善比污染减少更为缓慢，因此如果污染是导致健康问题的原因，那么需要一段时间才能完全显现出污染减少带来的健康效益。因此，对污染减少计划的短期评估可能会低估其长期健康效益。

abstract.text: Administrative data are considered the “gold standard” when measuring program participation, but little evidence exists on the potential problems with administrative records or their implications for econometric estimates. We explore issues with administrative data using the FoodAPS, a unique dataset that contains two different administrative measures of Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) participation as well as a survey-based measure. We first document substantial ambiguity in the two administrative participation variables and show that they disagree with each other almost as often as they disagree with self-reported participation. Estimated participation and misreporting rates can be meaningfully sensitive to choices made to resolve this ambiguity and disagreement. We then document similar sensitivity in regression estimates of the associations between SNAP and food insecurity, obesity, and the Healthy Eating Index. These results serve as a cautionary tale about uncritically relying on linked administrative records when conducting program evaluation research.

10.3386/w24412.abstractZh: 行政数据被认为是衡量项目参与度的“黄金标准”，但关于行政记录可能存在的问题及其对计量经济学估计的影响，目前缺乏足够的证据。我们通过使用FoodAPS这一独特的数据集来探讨行政数据的问题。该数据集包含了两种不同的行政测量方法，用于衡量补充营养援助计划（SNAP）的参与情况，同时还包含了基于调查的测量方法。我们首先发现这两种行政参与变量存在显著的模糊性，并且它们之间的不一致程度几乎与自我报告参与情况的不一致程度相当。估计的参与率和误报率可能会受到为解决这种模糊性和不一致性而做出的选择的影响。随后，我们发现SNAP与粮食不安全、肥胖和健康饮食指数之间的关联在回归估计中也表现出类似的敏感性。这些结果提醒我们在进行项目评估研究时，不应盲目依赖关联的行政记录。

abstract.text: Over the last few years, marijuana has become legally available for recreational use to roughly a quarter of Americans. Policy makers have long expressed concerns about the substantial external costs of alcohol, and similar costs could come with the liberalization of marijuana policy. Indeed, the fraction of fatal accidents in which at least one driver tested positive for THC has increased nationwide by an average of 10 percent from 2013 to 2016. For Colorado and Washington, both of which legalized marijuana in 2014, these increases were 92 percent and 28 percent, respectively. However, identifying a causal effect is difficult due to the presence of significant confounding factors. We test for a causal effect of marijuana legalization on traffic fatalities in Colorado and Washington with a synthetic control approach using records on fatal traffic accidents from 2000-2016. We find the synthetic control groups saw similar changes in marijuana-related, alcohol-related and overall traffic fatality rates despite not legalizing recreational marijuana.

10.3386/w24417.abstractZh: 在过去的几年里，大麻已合法地供大约四分之一的美国人用于娱乐用途。政策制定者长期以来一直对酒精带来的巨大外部成本表示担忧，类似的成本也可能伴随着大麻政策的放开而出现。事实上，从2013年到2016年，全国范围内因至少一名司机检测出THC阳性的致命事故比例平均增加了10%。在2014年分别将大麻合法化的科罗拉多州和华盛顿州，这一比例分别增加了92%和28%。然而，由于存在显著的混杂因素，确定因果效应是相当困难的。我们采用合成控制法，利用2000年至2016年的致命交通事故记录，来检验大麻合法化对科罗拉多州和华盛顿州交通事故死亡人数的影响。研究发现，尽管这两个州没有将娱乐性大麻合法化，但合成控制组的大麻相关、酒精相关以及整体交通事故死亡率的变化情况相似。

abstract.text: This paper uses quarterly county-level data from 2006–2014 to examine the direction of causality in the relationship between per capita opioid prescription rates and employment-to-population ratios. We first estimate models of the effect of per capita opioid prescription rates on employment-to-population ratios, instrumenting opioid prescriptions for younger ages using opioid prescriptions to the elderly. We find that the estimated effect of opioids on employment-to-population ratios is positive but small for women, while there is no relationship for men. We then estimate models of the effect of employment-to-population ratios on opioid prescription rates using a shift-share instrument, and find ambiguous results. Overall, our findings suggest that there is no simple causal relationship between economic conditions and the abuse of opioids. Therefore, while improving economic conditions in depressed areas is desirable for many reasons, it is unlikely on its own to curb the opioid epidemic.

10.3386/w24440.abstractZh: 本文利用2006至2014年的县级季度数据，研究人均阿片类药物处方率与就业人口比例之间关系的因果关系方向。我们首先建立了模型，以分析人均阿片类药物处方率对就业人口比例的影响，并通过使用针对老年人的阿片类药物处方数据来代理年轻人群的年龄因素。研究发现，阿片类药物对女性就业人口比例的影响为正但较小，而男性则没有这种影响。随后，我们通过使用转移分享工具模型，进一步分析了就业人口比例对阿片类药物处方率的影响，但结果并不明确。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，经济条件与阿片类药物滥用之间并不存在简单的因果关系。因此，虽然改善贫困地区的经济条件具有诸多积极意义，但单凭这一措施不太可能有效遏制阿片类药物危机。

abstract.text: The emergency department (ED) is a complex node of healthcare delivery that is facing market and regulatory pressure across developed economies to reduce wait times. In this paper we study how ED doctors respond to such incentives, by focussing on a landmark policy in England that imposed strong incentives to treat ED patients within four hours. Using bunching techniques, we estimate that the policy reduced affected patients’ wait times by 19 minutes, yet distorted a number of medical decisions. In response to the policy, doctors increased the intensity of ED treatment and admitted more patients for costly inpatient care. We also find a striking 14% reduction in mortality. To determine the mechanism behind these health improvements, we exploit heterogeneity in patient severity and hospital crowding, and find strongly suggestive evidence that it is the reduced wait times, rather than the additional admits, that saves lives. Overall we conclude that, despite distorting medical decisions, constraining ED doctors can induce cost-effective reductions in mortality.

10.3386/w24445.abstractZh: 急诊科是医疗服务的复杂节点，在发达经济体中面临着减少等待时间的市场和监管压力。本文研究急诊医生如何应对这些激励措施，重点关注英国一项具有里程碑意义的政策，该政策要求医生在四小时内为急诊患者提供治疗。通过捆绑技术分析，我们发现该政策使受影响患者的等待时间减少了19分钟，但同时也扭曲了多项医疗决策。作为对该政策的响应，医生增加了急诊治疗的强度，并收治了更多需要昂贵住院治疗的病人。我们还发现死亡率降低了14%。为了确定这些健康改善背后的机制，我们利用了患者病情严重程度和医院拥挤程度的异质性，发现减少等待时间而非增加收治人数才是真正挽救生命的关键。总体而言，尽管该政策扭曲了医疗决策，但限制急诊医生的操作确实能够带来具有成本效益的死亡率降低。

abstract.text: Infant formula use has been implicated in tens of millions of infant deaths in low and middle-income countries over the past several decades, but causal evidence of its link with mortality remains elusive. We combine birth record data from over 2.6 million infants across 38 countries in the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) with reconstructed historical data from annual investor reports on the timing of Nestlé entrance into infant formula country markets. Consistent with the hypothesis that formula mixed with unclean water could act as a disease vector, we find that infant mortality increased in households with unclean water sources by 19.4 per thousand births following Nestlé market entrance, but had no effect among other households. This rate is equivalent to a 27% increase in mortality in the population using unclean water and amounts to about 212,000 excess deaths per year at the peak of the Nestlé controversy in 1981.

10.3386/w24452.abstractZh: 过去几十年间，婴儿配方奶粉的使用在低收入和中等收入国家导致了数千万婴儿的死亡，但其与死亡之间的因果关系仍不明确。我们结合了来自38个国家、超过260万婴儿的出生记录数据，以及雀巢公司年度投资者报告中关于其进入婴儿配方奶粉市场时间的重建历史数据。与假设一致，即与不洁水混合的配方奶粉可能成为疾病的传播媒介，我们发现，在雀巢进入市场后，使用不洁水源的家庭中，婴儿死亡率增加了19.4例/千出生，而在其他家庭中则没有这种影响。这一比率相当于使用不洁水的人群中死亡率增加了27%，在雀巢争议最严重的一年1981年，每年额外导致的死亡人数约为212,000人。

abstract.text: This study explores how a major public policy change—the implementation of welfare reform in the U.S. in the 1990s—shaped the age gradient in female crime. We used FBI arrest data to investigate the age-patterning of the effects of welfare reform on women’s arrests for property crime, the type of crime women are most likely to commit and that welfare reform has been shown to affect. We found that women’s property crime arrest rates declined over the age span; that welfare reform led to an overall reduction in adult women’s property crime arrests of about 4%, with the strongest effects for women ages 25–29 and in their 40s; that the effects were slightly stronger in states with stricter work incentives; and that the effects were much stronger in states with high criminal justice expenditures and staffing. The key contributions of this study are the focus on a broad and relevant policy-based “turning point” (change in circumstances that can lead people to launch or desist from criminal careers), addressing the general question of how a turning point shapes age gradients in criminal behavior, and the focus on women in the context of the age patterning of crime.

10.3386/w24464.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了1990年代美国实施福利改革这一重大公共政策变化如何影响了女性犯罪的年龄梯度。我们利用联邦调查局的逮捕数据，调查了福利改革对女性财产犯罪逮捕次数的影响，以及女性最有可能实施的犯罪类型，这些犯罪类型已被证明受到福利改革的影响。研究发现，女性财产犯罪的逮捕率随年龄增长而下降；福利改革导致成年女性财产犯罪逮捕次数总体减少了约4%，其中25至29岁和40多岁的女性受影响的程度最为显著；在工作激励措施更为严格的州，这种影响更为明显；而在刑事司法支出和人员配置较高的州，这种影响则更为强烈。本研究的主要贡献在于：关注一个广泛且相关的基于政策的“转折点”（即能够促使人们开始或停止犯罪生涯的环境变化），探讨这一转折点如何塑造犯罪行为的年龄梯度，并重点关注女性在犯罪年龄分布中的情况。

abstract.text: The willingness to pay for insurance captures the value of insurance against only the risk that remains when choices are observed. This paper develops tools to measure the ex-ante expected utility impact of insurance subsidies and mandates when choices are observed after some insurable information is revealed. The approach retains the transparency of using reduced-form willingness to pay and cost curves, but it adds one additional sufficient statistic: the difference in marginal utilities between insured and uninsured. I provide an approach to estimate this statistic that uses only reduced-form willingness to pay and cost curves, combined with either a measure of risk aversion. I compare the approach to structural approaches that require fully specifying the choice environment and information sets of individuals. I apply the approach using existing willingness to pay and cost curve estimates from the low-income health insurance exchange in Massachusetts. Ex-ante optimal insurance prices are roughly 30% lower than prices that maximize market surplus. While mandates would increase deadweight loss, the results suggest they would actually increase ex-ante expected utility.

10.3386/w24470.abstractZh: 支付保险费用的意愿仅反映了在选择被观察到时剩余风险所带来的保险价值。本文开发了工具，用于衡量在部分可保险信息被揭示后，保险补贴和强制要求对事前预期效用的影响。该方法保留了使用简化形式的支付意愿和成本曲线的透明性，但增加了另一个充分统计量：被保险者与未被保险者之间的边际效用差异。我提供了一种仅使用简化形式的支付意愿和成本曲线，并结合风险厌恶度量来估计这一统计量的方法。我将该方法与需要完全指定个体选择环境和信息集的结构性方法进行了比较。我使用马萨诸塞州低收入健康保险交易所现有的支付意愿和成本曲线估计值来应用该方法。事前最优保险价格比最大化市场剩余的价格低约30%。虽然强制要求会增加无谓损失，但结果表明它们实际上会增加事前预期效用。

abstract.text: We attribute the recent quadrupling of heroin death rates to the August, 2010 reformulation of an oft-abused prescription opioid, OxyContin. The new abuse-deterrent formulation led many consumers to substitute to an inexpensive alternative, heroin. Using structural break techniques and variation in substitution risk, we find that opioid consumption stops rising in August, 2010, heroin deaths begin climbing the following month, and growth in heroin deaths was greater in areas with greater pre-reformulation access to heroin and opioids. The reformulation did not generate a reduction in combined heroin and opioid mortality—each prevented opioid death was replaced with a heroin death.

10.3386/w24475.abstractZh: 我们将近期海洛因死亡人数激增四倍的现象归因于2010年8月对一种常被滥用的处方阿片类药物——奥施康定进行重新配方。这种新的防滥用配方促使许多消费者转而使用价格低廉的海洛因作为替代品。通过结构突变技术和替代风险的变化分析，我们发现奥施康定的配方改革使得阿片类药物的消费在2010年8月停止增长，而海洛因死亡人数则在次月开始上升。在改革前更容易获得海洛因和阿片类药物的地区，海洛因死亡人数的增长更为显著。这种重新配方并没有减少海洛因和阿片类药物的死亡总数——因为每减少一次阿片类药物的死亡，就会增加一次海洛因的死亡。

abstract.text: Structural econometric methods are often criticized for being sensitive to functional form assumptions. We study parametric estimators of the local average treatment effect (LATE) derived from a widely used class of latent threshold crossing models and show they yield LATE estimates algebraically equivalent to the instrumental variables (IV) estimator. Our leading example is Heckman’s (1979) two-step (“Heckit”) control function estimator which, with two-sided non-compliance, can be used to compute estimates of a variety of causal parameters. Equivalence with IV is established for a semi-parametric family of control function estimators and shown to hold at interior solutions for a class of maximum likelihood estimators. Our results suggest differences between structural and IV estimates often stem from disagreements about the target parameter rather than from functional form assumptions per se. In cases where equivalence fails, reporting structural estimates of LATE alongside IV provides a simple means of assessing the credibility of structural extrapolation exercises.

10.3386/w24477.abstractZh: 结构计量经济学方法常常因对函数形式假设过于敏感而受到批评。我们研究了从一类广泛使用的潜在阈值穿越模型中推导出的局部平均处理效应（LATE）的参数估计量，并证明这些估计量得出的LATE结果与使用工具变量（IV）估计量得出的结果在代数上是等价的。我们的主要例子是Heckman在1979年提出的两步控制函数估计方法，该方法结合双侧非遵从性，可以用来计算多种因果参数的估计值。对于一类半参数控制函数估计量，我们证明了其与IV估计量的等价性，并且这种等价性在最大似然估计量的内部解中同样成立。我们的研究结果表明，结构估计与IV估计之间的差异通常源于对目标参数的不同理解，而非函数形式假设本身的问题。在等价性不成立的情况下，同时报告LATE的结构估计和IV估计是一种简单的方法，可以用来评估结构推断的可信度。

abstract.text: Expanding insurance coverage could, by insulating patients from having to pay full cost, encourage the utilization of arguably unnecessary medical services. It could also eliminate (or at least diminish) the need for emergency services through increasing access to preventive care. Using publicly available data from New York City for the period 2013-2016, we explore the effect of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) on the volume and composition of ambulance dispatches. Consistent with the argument that expanding insurance coverage encourages the utilization of unnecessary medical services, we find that, as compared to dispatches for more severe injuries, dispatches for minor injuries rose sharply after the implementation of the ACA. By contrast, dispatches for pre-labor pregnancy complications decreased as compared to dispatches for women in labor.

10.3386/w24480.abstractZh: 扩大保险覆盖范围可以通过免除患者全额费用来鼓励使用一些可能并不必要的医疗服务。同时，通过增加预防性护理的获取机会，也可以减少（或至少降低）对紧急服务的需求。我们利用2013-2016年期间纽约市公开的数据，探讨了《平价医疗法案》对救护车派遣数量和构成的影响。与“扩大保险覆盖范围会鼓励使用不必要的医疗服务”这一论点一致，我们发现，与因更严重伤害而进行的派遣相比，因轻微伤害而进行的派遣在《平价医疗法案》实施后显著增加。相比之下，与分娩期间的孕妇并发症相关的派遣数量则有所下降。

abstract.text: Many industries, including health insurance, are characterized by a handful of large firms competing against each other in multiple markets. Such overlap across markets, defined as multimarket contact (MMC), may facilitate tacit collusion and thus reduce the intensity of competition. We examine the effects of MMC on health insurance prices and quality using comprehensive data on the Medicare Advantage (MA) market from 2008 through 2015. Our identification strategy exploits two plausibly exogenous changes to MMC: 1) out-of-market consolidations, which affect MMC but are not likely driven by local market heterogeneity; and 2) reimbursement policy changes in a subset of markets, which encourage additional entry and therefore affect MMC even in markets otherwise unaffected by the policy itself. Across a range of estimates and alternative measures of MMC, our results consistently support the mutual forbearance hypothesis, where we find that prices are significantly higher and hiqh-quality plans become less pervasive as MMC increases. These results suggest MMC as one potential channel through which cross-market consolidations and regulatory policies could alter competitiveness in local markets otherwise unaffected by the merger or policy.

10.3386/w24486.abstractZh: 许多行业，包括健康保险行业，都呈现出少数大型企业在多个市场中相互竞争的特点。这种市场间的重叠现象，被称为多市场接触，可能会促进默契勾结，从而降低竞争强度。我们利用2008年至2015年医疗保险优势市场的相关数据，研究了多市场接触对健康保险价格和质量的影响。我们的识别策略利用了两个可能由外部因素引起的多市场接触变化：1）市场外的合并行为，这会影响多市场接触，但不太可能是由当地市场异质性所驱动的；2）部分市场中的报销政策变化，这些变化会促进更多企业的进入，因此即使在没有政策影响的市场中，也会对多市场接触产生影响。通过一系列不同的估计方法和多市场接触的衡量标准，我们的研究结果一致支持“相互克制假说”，即随着多市场接触的增加，价格会显著上升，高质量计划也会变得不那么普遍。这些结果表明，多市场接触可能是跨市场合并和监管政策改变当地市场竞争力的一个潜在渠道。

abstract.text: We study the effect of two local immigration enforcement policies – Section 287(g) of the Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act and the Secure Communities Program (SC) – that have escalated fear and risk of deportation among the undocumented on the health and mental health outcomes of Latino immigrants living in the United States. We use the restricted-use National Health Interview Survey for 2000-2012 and adopt a difference-in-difference research design. Estimates suggest that SC increased the proportion of Latino immigrants with mental health distress by 2.2 percentage points (14.7 percent); Task Force Enforcement under Section 287(g) worsened their mental health distress scores by 15 percent (0.08 standard deviation); Jail Enforcement under Section 287(g) increased the proportion of Latino immigrants reporting fair or poor health by 1 percentage point (11.1 percent) and lowered the proportion reporting very good or excellent health by 4.8 to 7.0 percentage points (7.8 to 10.9 percent). These findings are robust across various sensitivity checks.

10.3386/w24487.abstractZh: 我们研究了两项地方移民执法政策对在美国生活的拉丁裔移民的健康和心理健康状况的影响。这两项政策分别是《非法移民改革与移民责任法案》中的第287(g)条以及安全社区计划。研究发现，这两项政策加剧了无证移民的恐惧和驱逐风险，导致拉丁裔移民出现心理健康问题。我们采用了2000-2012年的全国健康访谈调查数据，并采用了差异分解研究设计。研究结果表明，安全社区计划使拉丁裔移民中患有心理健康问题的比例增加了2.2个百分点（14.7%）；第287(g)条下的执法措施使他们的心理健康问题得分降低了15%（0.08个标准差）；第287(g)条下的监狱执法措施则使报告健康状况良好或较差的拉丁裔移民比例增加了1个百分点（11.1%），而报告健康状况非常好或极好的比例则下降了4.8至7.0个百分点（7.8至10.9%）。这些发现在不同敏感性检验中均具有稳健性。

abstract.text: The conventional method for developing health care plan payment systems uses existing data to study alternative algorithms with the purpose of creating incentives for an efficient and fair health care system. In this paper, we take a different approach and modify the input data rather than the algorithm, so that the data used for calibration reflect the desired levels of spending rather than the observed spending levels typically used for setting health plan payments. We refer to our proposed method as “intervening on the data.” We first present a general economic model that incorporates the previously overlooked two-way relationship between health plan payment and insurer actions. We then demonstrate our approach in two applications in Medicare: an inefficiency example focused on underprovision of care for individuals with chronic illnesses, and an unfairness example addressing health care disparities by geographic income levels. We empirically compare intervening on the data to two other methods commonly used to address inefficiencies and disparities: adding risk adjustor variables, and introducing constraints on the risk adjustment coefficients to redirect revenues. Adding risk adjustors, while the most common policy approach, is the least effective method in our applications. Intervening on the data and constrained regression are both effective. The “side effects” of these approaches, though generally positive, vary according to the empirical context. Intervening on the data is an easy-to-use, intuitive approach for addressing economic efficiency and fairness misallocations in individual health insurance markets.

10.3386/w24491.abstractZh: 传统的医疗保健计划支付系统开发方法利用现有数据来研究不同的算法，目的是为高效且公平的医疗保健系统创造激励机制。在本文中，我们采取了不同的方法，对输入数据进行了修改，而不是算法本身，使得用于校准的数据能够反映期望的支出水平，而不是通常用于设定医疗计划支付的观察支出水平。我们将我们提出的方法称为“对数据进行干预”。首先，我们提出了一个包含先前被忽视的医疗保健计划支付与保险公司行为之间双向关系的通用经济模型。然后，我们在两个医疗保险应用中展示了我们的方法：一个关于慢性病患者护理不足的低效案例，以及一个解决因地理收入水平导致的医疗保健差异的不公平案例。我们通过实证比较了对数据进行干预与其他两种常用方法来解决低效和差异问题：增加风险调整变量，以及引入对风险调整系数的约束以重新分配收入。虽然增加风险调整变量是最常见的政策方法，但在我们的应用中效果最差。对数据进行干预和约束回归都是有效的。这些方法的“副作用”虽然通常是有益的，但会根据实证情况而有所不同。对数据进行干预是一种易于使用、直观的方法，适用于解决个人医疗保险市场中经济效率和公平分配的问题。

abstract.text: Cesarean delivery for low-risk pregnancies is generally associated with worse health outcomes for infants and mothers. The interpretation of this correlation, however, is confounded by potential selectivity in the choice of birth mode. We use birth records from California, merged with hospital and emergency department (ED) visits for infants and mothers in the year after birth, to study the causal health effects of cesarean delivery for low-risk first births. Building on McClellan, McNeil, and Newhouse (1994), we use the relative distance from a mother’s home to hospitals with high and low c-section rates as an instrument for c-section. We show that relative distance is a strong predictor of c-section but is orthogonal to many observed risk factors, including birth weight and indicators of prenatal care. Our IV estimates imply that cesarean delivery causes a relatively large increase in ED visits of the infant, mainly due to acute respiratory conditions. We find no significant effects on mothers’ hospitalizations or ED use after birth, or on subsequent fertility, but we find a ripple effect on second birth outcomes arising from the high likelihood of repeat c-section. Offsetting these morbidity effects, we find that delivery at a high c-section hospital leads to a significant reduction in infant mortality, driven by lower death rates for newborns with high rates of pre-determined risk factors.

10.3386/w24493.abstractZh: 低风险妊娠的剖宫产通常与婴儿和母亲的不良健康结果相关。然而，这种关联的解释受到选择分娩方式可能性的干扰。我们利用加利福尼亚州的出生记录，结合婴儿和母亲在出生后的医院和急诊就诊记录，来研究剖宫产对首次分娩的婴儿的健康影响。基于McClellan、McNeil和Newhouse（1994）的研究，我们将母亲家与剖宫产率高低不同的医院之间的相对距离作为剖宫产的一个指标。我们发现，相对距离是剖宫产的一个强预测因子，但与许多观察到的风险因素呈正交关系，包括出生体重和产前护理指标。我们的IV估计表明，剖宫产会导致婴儿急诊就诊次数显著增加，主要是由于急性呼吸系统疾病。我们发现，剖宫产对母亲在产后的住院次数或急诊使用次数，以及后续生育能力没有显著影响，但我们发现，由于重复剖宫产的高可能性，这对第二次分娩的结果产生了连锁效应。尽管存在这些健康影响，我们发现，在剖宫产率较高的医院分娩，可以显著降低婴儿死亡率，这主要是由于具有预定风险因素的新生儿死亡率较低。

abstract.text: Performance-raising practices tend to diffuse slowly in the health care sector. To understand how incentives drive adoption, I study a practice that generates revenue for hospitals: submitting detailed documentation about patients. After a 2008 reform, hospitals could raise their Medicare revenue over 2% by always specifying a patient’s type of heart failure. Hospitals only captured around half of this revenue, indicating that large frictions impeded takeup. Exploiting the fact that many doctors practice at multiple hospitals, I find that four-fifths of the dispersion in adoption reflects differences in the ability of hospitals to extract documentation from physicians. Hospital adoption is robustly correlated with generating survival for heart attack patients and using inexpensive survival-raising standards of care. Hospital-physician integration and electronic medical records also influence adoption. These findings highlight the potential for institution-level frictions, including agency conflicts, to explain variations in health care performance across providers.

10.3386/w24497.abstractZh: 提高绩效的做法在医疗保健领域往往传播缓慢。为了了解激励机制如何推动采用，我研究了一种能为医院带来收入的做法：提交关于患者的详细资料。在2008年的改革之后，医院通过始终明确患者的心力衰竭类型，可以将Medicare收入提高2%以上。然而，医院仅获得了大约一半的收入，这表明存在较大的阻碍因素。考虑到许多医生在多家医院执业，我发现采用率的差异中有五分之四反映了医院从医生那里获取资料的能力差异。医院采用率与提高心脏病患者生存率和使用低成本的标准护理措施密切相关。医院与医生的合作以及电子病历也影响着采用率。这些发现强调了机构层面的摩擦因素，包括代理冲突，对于解释不同医疗服务提供者的绩效差异具有潜在意义。

abstract.text: We provide the first evidence on the effects of expansions to private and public insurance programs on children’s use of specialty substance use disorder (SUD) treatment. We combine administrative government data over the period 1996 to 2017 with quasi-experimental differences-in-differences methods to study this question. Expansions of the private market – laws that compel insurers to cover SUD treatment services as parity with general healthcare – increase admissions by 21%. Increases in admissions are driven by patients with private coverage and receiving outpatient care. The number of admissions of patients with no insurance also increases following parity law adoption. There is mixed evidence on changes in admissions following a public insurance expansion that increases the income eligibility thresholds for Medicaid and the Children’s Health Insurance Program.

10.3386/w24499.abstractZh: 我们首次提供了关于私人保险和公共保险扩展对儿童使用特殊物质使用障碍治疗影响的研究证据。我们结合了1996至2017年的政府行政数据，并采用准实验性的差异-差异方法来研究这一问题。私人市场的扩展——即法律要求保险公司提供与常规医疗保健同等的特殊物质使用障碍治疗服务——使就诊人数增加了21%。就诊人数的增加主要来自于接受私人保险覆盖的患者。在采用平等法后，无保险患者的就诊人数也有所增加。关于公共保险扩展后就诊人数变化的情况，研究结果并不一致，这可能与Medicaid和儿童健康保险计划中的收入资格门槛提高有关。

abstract.text: The number of disability beneficiaries doubled in the past two decades. It is difficult to determine how much is explained by changes in health, as we lack a counterfactual. We use undocumented immigrants to form the counterfactual, as they cannot claim benefits. Using NHIS data, we show that the relationship between health and disability is stronger for the legal population than for the undocumented. Much of the difference in disability rates between the populations is due to different labor supply responses to underlying health impairments and demographic differences, rather than to differences in the impairments or demographic variables themselves.

10.3386/w24504.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，残疾福利的领取者数量翻了一番。要确定其中有多少是由健康状况的变化所导致的，我们缺乏一个反事实的基准。我们利用无证移民作为反事实的参照群体，因为他们无法申请福利。通过NHIS数据，我们发现健康状况与残疾之间的关系在合法人口中比在无证人口中更为紧密。这两个群体之间残疾率的差异，很大程度上是由于他们对潜在健康问题的劳动力供应反应以及人口统计差异所致，而非疾病本身或人口统计变量本身的差异。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impacts of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) – which substantially increased insurance coverage through regulations, mandates, subsidies, and Medicaid expansions – on behaviors related to future health risks after three years. Using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and an identification strategy that leverages variation in pre-ACA uninsured rates and state Medicaid expansion decisions, we show that the ACA increased preventive care utilization along several dimensions, but also increased risky drinking. These results are driven by the private portions of the law, as opposed to the Medicaid expansion. We also conduct subsample analyses by income and age.

10.3386/w24511.abstractZh: 本文探讨了《平价医疗法案》实施三年后，该法案通过法规、强制规定、补贴以及医疗补助扩展措施大幅增加了保险覆盖范围，对与未来健康风险相关行为的影响。利用行为风险因素监测系统的数据，并结合利用《平价医疗法案》实施前无保险人群比例差异及各州医疗补助扩展决策的数据分析策略，我们发现《平价医疗法案》在多个层面上增加了预防性护理的利用，但同时也增加了高风险饮酒行为。这些结果主要源于法律的私人部分条款，而非医疗补助扩展措施。我们还通过收入和年龄进行了子样本分析。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of opioid prescriptions on the duration of temporary disability benefits among workers with work-related low back injuries. We use local opioid prescribing patterns to construct an instrumental variable that generates variation in opioid prescriptions but is arguably unrelated to injury severity or other factors directly affecting disability duration. Local prescribing patterns have a strong relationship with whether injured workers receive opioid prescriptions, including longer-term prescriptions. We find that more longer-term opioid prescribing leads to considerably longer duration of temporary disability, but there is little effect of a small number of opioid prescriptions over a short period of time.

10.3386/w24528.abstractZh: 我们估计了阿片类药物处方对患有工作相关腰痛的工人临时残疾福利持续时间的影响。我们利用当地的阿片类药物处方模式构建了一个工具变量，该变量虽然会导致阿片类药物处方的变化，但显然与伤害严重程度或其他直接影响残疾持续时间的因素无关。当地的处方模式与受伤工人是否获得阿片类药物处方之间存在密切关系，包括长期处方的情况。我们发现，更多的长期阿片类药物处方会导致临时残疾的持续时间显著延长，但短期内少量阿片类药物处方的影响很小。

abstract.text: This study employs a two-way fixed effects research design to measure the mortality impact and cost-effectiveness of cancer drugs: it analyzes the correlation across 36 countries between relative mortality from 19 types of cancer in 2015 and the relative number of drugs previously launched in that country to treat that type of cancer, controlling for relative incidence. One additional drug for a cancer site launched during 2006-2010 is estimated to have reduced the number of 2015 disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) lost due to cancer at that site by 5.8%. The estimated cost per life-year gained at all ages in 2015 from cancer drugs launched during 2006-2010 is $1635. We estimate that drugs launched during the entire 1982-2010 period reduced the number of cancer DALYs lost in 2015 by about 23%. In the absence of new drug launches during 1982-2010, there would have been 26.3 million additional DALYs lost in 2015.

10.3386/w24536.abstractZh: 本研究使用双向固定效应设计，考察癌症药物对死亡率的影响及其成本效果。研究比较了 36 个国家 19 种癌症在 2015 年的相对死亡率与此前各国上市的相应药物相对数量之间的关系，并控制了相对发病率。估计表明，2006—2010 年间，针对某一癌症部位每多上市一种药物，2015 年该部位癌症造成的伤残调整寿命年（DALY）损失就减少 5.8%。按所有年龄组计算，2006—2010 年上市的癌症药物在 2015 年每多挽回一个寿命年，估计成本为 1,635 美元。研究估计，1982—2010 年上市的药物使 2015 年癌症造成的 DALY 损失减少约 23%。如果这段时期没有新药上市，2015 年将额外损失 2,630 万个伤残调整寿命年。

abstract.text: A growing number of surveys elicit respondents’ expectations for future events on a 0-100 scale of percent chance. These data reveal substantial heaping at multiples of 10 and 5 percent, suggesting that respondents round their reports. This paper studies the nature of rounding by analyzing response patterns across expectations questions and waves of the Health and Retirement Study. We discover a tendency by about half of the respondents to provide more refined responses in the tails of the scale than the center. Only about five percent provide more refined responses in the center than the tails. We find that rounding varies across question domains, which range from personal health to personal finances to macroeconomic events. We develop a two-stage framework to characterize person-specific rounding. The first stage uses observed responses to infer respondents’ rounding practice in each question domain and scale segment. The second stage replaces each original point response with an interval, representing the range of possible values of the respondent’s true latent belief implied by the degree of rounding inferred in the first stage. We study how the inferred rounding types in the first stage vary with respondent characteristics, including age and cognitive abilities.

10.3386/w24559.abstractZh: 越来越多的调查采用0-100百分比的尺度来询问受访者对未来事件的预期。这些数据显示，受访者对10%和5%的整数倍有较高的预期，这表明受访者会进行四舍五入处理。本文通过分析“健康与退休研究”中各预期问题中的回答模式，探讨了四舍五入的本质。我们发现，大约一半的受访者在预期范围的高端区域会给出更精细的回答，而在中间区域则较少如此。只有约5%的受访者在中间区域给出的回答比高端区域的回答更精细。我们发现，四舍五入在不同问题领域之间存在差异，这些领域包括个人健康、个人财务以及宏观经济事件。我们提出了一个两阶段框架来描述个人特定的四舍五入行为。第一阶段利用观察到的回答来推断受访者在每个问题领域和尺度段中的四舍五入习惯。第二阶段将每个原始的点回答替换为区间，表示受访者真实潜在信念的可能值范围，这些范围由第一阶段推断出的四舍五入程度决定。我们研究了第一阶段推断出的四舍五入类型如何随受访者特征（包括年龄和认知能力）而变化。

abstract.text: Home health care has experienced significant growth as an industry and is viewed as one of the avenues for achieving reductions in the cost and utilization of expensive downstream health care services. Using a novel dataset on home health care visits, this study quantifies the effects of reduced time spent with patients during a post-acute home health visit on hospital readmissions. We focus in particular on the subset of patients with conditions that are subject to penalty under the Hospital Readmission Reduction Program. Since both visit length and readmission risk are likely to be correlated with unobserved illness severity, we use the daily sequence of provider visits and deviation from the provider’s average daily workload as instruments for visit length. We find that patients who are visited later in the provider’s day as well as those who are visited by a provider who has a higher than usual workload experience home health visits that are shorter than usual. Using our instruments and controlling for patient, visit, and provider characteristics, we find that home health visits that are longer than usual by one minute reduce the risk of hospital readmission by approximately 8 percent. These effects seem to be driven by providers with higher levels of discretion in their time management and care provision. We suggest several approaches that managers could take to attain reductions in readmissions without incurring significant additional costs.

10.3386/w24566.abstractZh: 家庭医疗保健作为一门行业经历了显著的增长，被视为降低昂贵下游医疗服务成本和利用率的途径之一。本研究利用关于家庭医疗保健访问的新颖数据集，量化了在急性病后家庭医疗保健访问中减少与患者相处时间对医院再入院的影响。我们特别关注那些在医院再入院减少计划中会受到处罚的患者群体。由于访问时间和再入院风险可能与未观察到的疾病严重程度相关，我们采用医生每日访问序列以及医生平均每日工作负荷的偏差作为访问时间的工具变量。我们发现，在医生一天中的较晚时间进行访问的患者，以及由工作负荷高于平常的医生进行访问的患者，其家庭医疗保健访问时间通常比平常短。通过利用我们的工具变量并控制患者、访问时间和医生特征，我们发现，比平常多一分钟的家庭医疗保健访问可以将医院再入院的风险降低约8%。这些效应似乎是由在时间管理和护理提供方面具有更高自主权的医生所驱动的。我们提出了一些方法，管理者可以通过这些方法来减少再入院，而不会造成显著的额外成本。

abstract.text: The growing demand for plasma, especially for the manufacture of therapeutic products, prompts discussions on the merits of different procurement systems. We conducted a randomized survey experiment with a representative sample of 826 Canadian residents to assess attitudes toward legalizing payments to plasma donors, a practice that is illegal in several Canadian provinces. We found no evidence of widespread societal opposition to payments to plasma donors. On the contrary, over 70% of respondents reported that they would support compensation. Our Canadian respondents were more in favor of paying plasma donors elsewhere than in Canada, but the differences were small, suggesting a weak role for moral “NIMBY-ism” or relativism. Moral concerns were the respondents’ main reason for opposing payments, together with concerns for the safety of plasma from compensated donors, although most of the plasma in Canada does come from paid U.S. donors. Among those in favor of legalizing payments to donors, the main rationale was to guarantee a higher domestic supply. Finally, roughly half of those who declared to be against payments reported that they would reconsider their position if domestic supply plus imports did not cover domestic demand. Most Canadians, therefore, seem to espouse a consequentialist view on issues related to the procurement of plasma.

10.3386/w24572.abstractZh: 对血浆的需求不断增加，尤其是用于制造治疗产品的需求，这促使人们讨论不同采购系统的优劣。我们进行了一项随机调查实验，选取了826名加拿大居民作为样本，以评估他们对向血浆捐赠者支付报酬的合法化态度。在加拿大的一些省份，这种行为是非法的。我们发现，并没有广泛的社会反对向血浆捐赠者支付报酬的现象。相反，超过70%的受访者表示支持这种补偿措施。我们的加拿大受访者更倾向于在其他国家而非加拿大向血浆捐赠者支付报酬，但差异不大，这表明道德上的“邻避主义”或相对主义的作用较弱。道德方面的担忧是受访者反对支付报酬的主要原因，此外还有对有偿捐赠者提供的血浆安全性的担忧，尽管加拿大的大部分血浆实际上来自美国有偿捐赠者。在支持向捐赠者支付报酬的人中，主要理由是保障国内血浆供应。最后，大约一半表示反对支付报酬的人表示，如果国内供应加上进口量无法满足国内需求，他们可能会重新考虑自己的立场。因此，大多数加拿大人似乎在血浆采购问题上持后果主义观点。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the causal effect of high school curriculum on various student outcomes including academic performance at the university, happiness, physical and mental health, self-confidence, confidence in academic ability, and attitudes towards studying and learning. We exploit a curriculum reform in China, the implementation of which started in 2004. The reform covered all provinces and municipal cities, and was rolled out in different years in different provinces. The new curriculum pivoted away from the old lock-step course structure where all students took the same courses and only those subject that were covered in the national university entrance exam were considered important. In contrast, the new curriculum introduced a course credit system, changed textbooks, and provided flexibility in course selection. It also introduced elective courses and made such courses as arts and physical education mandatory, and a graduation requirement. Using survey data on university students and employing a difference-in-difference approach, we find that the students who were exposed to the new curriculum in high school have better academic performance in university. They are happier, and their physical and mental well-being is better. These students are more likely to have positive attitudes towards themselves and they are more involved in student clubs. They have more confidence in their academic ability, they have more positive attitudes towards studying, and they have more general self-confidence. These results indicate that the reform had a significant impact on students’ academic success and well-being by allowing them to focus on subject matters in which they are interested, and by reducing undue stress of a regimented curriculum.

10.3386/w24573.abstractZh: 本文研究了高中课程对多种学生结果的因果效应，包括大学的学术表现、幸福感、身体与心理健康、自信心、对学术能力的信心，以及对待学习和学习的态度。我们选取了中国的一项课程改革作为研究对象，该改革始于2004年，覆盖了所有省份和市级城市，并且在不同省份的推进时间也有所不同。新课程摒弃了旧课程结构中所有学生必须修读相同课程的做法，仅将那些被纳入国家大学入学考试的重要科目作为重点。新课程引入了学分制度，更换了教材，并提供了课程选择的灵活性。此外，新课程还引入了选修课，并将艺术和体育课程设为必修，并设定了毕业要求。通过利用关于大学生的调查数据，并采用差异分解方法进行分析，我们发现，在高中阶段接触新课程的学生在大学中表现出更好的学术表现。他们的幸福感更高，身体与心理健康状况也更好。这些学生更有可能对自己持有积极的态度，并且更积极参与学生社团活动。他们对自己的学术能力更有信心，对学习的态度更加积极，整体自信心也更强。这些结果表明，该改革通过让学生专注于自己感兴趣的科目，并减少严格课程安排带来的压力，对学生的学术成就和幸福感产生了显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper develops and estimates a dynamic structural model of demand for a multi-attribute product. The demand side equilibrium supports a product spectrum, the characteristics of which evolve over time in response to supply innovations induced by the composition and extent of aggregate demand. The direction and speed of innovation is inefficient because individuals create an externality by not accounting for their influence on the discovery process. We apply the model to drugs invented to combat the HIV epidemic, during which frequent, incremental innovations in medication were punctuated by sporadic breakthroughs. In this application products differ in their efficacy and their propensity to cause side effects. Our biennial data on four American cities track a replenished panel of individuals for over twenty years, from when drugs were not only ineffective but also created debilitating side effects, to when the market matured. We find that the externalities are quantitatively important and that even a temporary subsidy would have improved average social welfare and been more equitable.

10.3386/w24577.abstractZh: 本文发展并估计了一个关于多属性产品需求的动态结构模型。需求方的均衡支持一个产品谱系，这些产品的特性会随着总需求构成和规模的变化而随时间演变，以应对供应方面的创新。创新的方向和速度存在效率问题，因为个体在考虑其对发现过程的影响时，会产生外部性。我们将该模型应用于抗击HIV流行病的药物研究，在此期间，药物的创新是渐进式的，但偶尔也会出现突破性进展。在这种应用中，不同产品在疗效和副作用产生倾向方面存在差异。我们对四个美国城市进行了为期二十多年的追踪研究，从药物不仅无效且还会产生严重副作用的时期，到市场成熟时期，我们发现了这些外部性在数量上具有重要意义，甚至临时性的补贴也能改善平均社会福利，并使其更加公平。

abstract.text: This paper provides evidence that risk aversion leads pharmaceutical firms to underinvest in radical innovation. We define a drug candidate as novel if it is molecularly distinct from prior candidates. Using our measure, we show that firms face a risk-reward tradeoff when investing in novel drugs: while novel drug candidates are less likely to be approved by the FDA, they are based on patents with higher indicators of value. We show that–counter to the predictions of frictionless models–firms respond to a plausibly exogenous positive shock to their net worth by developing more of these riskier novel candidates. This pattern suggests that financial market imperfections may lead even large public firms to behave as though they are risk averse, therefore hindering their willingness to invest in potentially valuable novel drugs.

10.3386/w24595.abstractZh: 本文提供了证据，表明风险厌恶导致制药公司不愿在激进创新上投入资金。我们将一种候选药物定义为与先前候选药物在分子结构上有所区别的新药。根据我们的衡量标准，我们发现制药公司在投资新型药物时面临风险与回报之间的权衡：虽然新型药物获得FDA批准的可能性较低，但它们所基于的专利具有更高的价值指标。与无摩擦模型的预测相反，制药公司会对其净资产的合理外生正冲击作出反应，从而开发更多这类风险较高的新型药物。这一模式表明，金融市场的不完善可能导致即使是大型公共企业也表现出风险厌恶的行为，从而阻碍它们对潜在有价值的新型药物的投资意愿。

abstract.text: Using dynamic models of health, mortality, and out-of-pocket medical spending (both inclusive and net of Medicaid payments), we estimate the distribution of lifetime medical spending that retired U.S. households face over the remainder of their lives. We find that households who turned 70 in 1992 will on average incur $122,000 in medical spending, including Medicaid payments, over their remaining lives. At the top tail, 5 percent of households will incur more than $300,000, and 1 percent of households will incur over $600,000 in medical spending inclusive of Medicaid. The level and the dispersion of this spending diminish only slowly with age. Although permanent income, initial health, and initial marital status have large effects on this spending, much of the dispersion in lifetime spending is due to events realized later in life. Medicaid covers the majority of the lifetime costs of the poorest households and significantly reduces their risk.

10.3386/w24599.abstractZh: 通过运用健康、死亡率以及自付医疗支出的动态模型（包括包含 Medicaid 支付的情况和不含 Medicaid 支付的情况），我们估算了退休美国家庭在其余生中面临的终身医疗支出分布。研究发现，1992 年达到 70 岁的家庭在余生中平均将产生 122,000 美元的医疗支出，其中包括 Medicaid 支付。在最高端，5% 的家庭将产生超过 300,000 美元的医疗支出，而 1% 的家庭将产生超过 600,000 美元的医疗支出（包含 Medicaid 支付）。这种支出的水平和分布随着年龄的增长而缓慢下降。尽管永久收入、初始健康状况和初始婚姻状况对医疗支出有显著影响，但终身支出的差异很大程度上是由晚年发生的事件造成的。Medicaid 覆盖了最贫困家庭的大部分终身医疗成本，并显著降低了他们的风险。

abstract.text: Using U.S county level data on lead in air for 1978-1988, this paper provides the first causal evidence on the effects of airborne lead exposure on the general fertility rate and the completed fertility rate in the broad population. Instrumental variable estimates show the increase in completed fertility implied by the average observed decrease in airborne lead is 0.14 children per woman, which is 6.4 percent of mean fertility. To explore the current relevance of our findings, we estimate the effect of lead historically accumulated in topsoil on fertility in the 2000s. The results suggest that lead may continue to impair fertility today, both in the United States and in other countries that have significant amounts of lead in topsoil.

10.3386/w24607.abstractZh: 本文利用1978-1988年美国县级空气铅含量数据，首次提供了关于空气铅暴露对整体生育率和完成生育率影响的因果证据。工具变量估计结果显示，平均空气铅含量下降所导致的完成生育率增加为每妇女0.14个孩子，占平均生育率的6.4%。为了探讨我们发现的当前相关性，我们估算了历史上累积在表土中的铅对2000年代生育率的影响。结果表明，铅可能至今仍在损害生育率，无论是在美国还是其他表土中含有大量铅的国家。

abstract.text: Social Security faces a major financing shortfall. One policy option for addressing this shortfall would be to raise the earliest age at which individuals can claim their retirement benefits. A welfare analysis of such a policy change depends critically on how it affects living standards. This paper estimates the impact of the Social Security early entitlement age on later-life elderly living standards by tracing birth cohorts of men who had access to different potential claiming ages. The focus is on the Social Security Amendments of 1961, which introduced age 62 as the early entitlement age (EEA) for retired-worker benefits for men. Based on data from the Social Security Administration and March 1968-2001 Current Population Surveys, reductions in the EEA in the long-run lowered the average claiming age by 1.4 years, which lowered Social Security income for male-headed families in retirement by 1.5% at the mean, 3% at the median, and 4% at the 25th percentile of the Social Security income distribution. The increase in early claiming was associated with a decrease in total income, but only at the bottom of the income distribution. There was a large associated rise in elderly poverty and income inequality; the introduction of early claiming raised the elderly poverty rate by about one percentage point. Finally, for the 1885-1916 cohorts, the implied elasticity of poverty with respect to Social Security income for male-headed families is 1.6−. Overall, we find that the introduction of early claiming was associated with a reduction in income and an increase in the poverty rate in old age for male-headed households.

10.3386/w24609.abstractZh: 社会保障面临严重的资金短缺问题。解决这一短缺的一个政策选择是提高个人领取退休福利的最早年龄。对这类政策变化的福利分析，关键在于其如何影响生活水平。本文通过追踪那些能够享受不同潜在领取年龄的男性出生队列，来估算社会保障提前领取年龄对老年人生活水平的影响。研究重点在于1961年的社会保障修正案，该修正案将62岁定为男性退休工人福利的提前领取年龄。根据社会保障管理局的数据以及1968年3月至2001年的当前人口调查数据，长期降低提前领取年龄的平均领取年龄减少了1.4年，这使得以男性为户主的家庭的社会保障收入在平均值下降了1.5%，在中位数下降了3%，在社会保障收入分布的25%区间下降了4%。提前领取福利的增加与总收入下降有关，但仅限于收入分布的最低层。同时，老年人贫困率和收入不平等也显著增加；提前领取福利使老年人贫困率上升了约1个百分点。最后，对于1885年至1916年的出生队列，社会保障收入对以男性为户主的家庭贫困率的弹性为1.6−。总体而言，我们发现提前领取福利与以男性为户主的家庭在老年时的收入减少和贫困率上升有关。

abstract.text: In this article we develop a model of the demand for cigarettes that incorporates forward-looking behavior related to the adverse health consequences of smoking and the addictive nature of cigarettes. The model results in several testable hypotheses that we use to examine the extent to which smokers exhibit forward-looking behavior. Results of our study are generally supportive of the notion that smokers behave in a forward-looking manner.

10.3386/w24620.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们建立了一个关于香烟需求的模型，该模型考虑了与吸烟带来的不良健康后果以及香烟的成瘾性相关的前瞻性行为。该模型得出了若干可检验的假设，我们利用这些假设来研究吸烟者表现出前瞻性行为的程度。我们的研究结果总体上支持吸烟者具有前瞻性行为的观点。

abstract.text: We develop a method to compare levels and trends in inequality in mortality in the United States and France in a similar framework. The comparison shows that while income inequality has increased in both the United States and France, inequality in mortality in France remained remarkably low and stable. In the United States, inequality in mortality increased for older groups (especially women) while it decreased for children and young adults. These patterns highlight the fact that despite the strong cross-sectional relationship between income and health, there is no necessary connection between changes in income inequality and changes in health inequality.

10.3386/w24623.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种方法，以类似的框架比较美国和法国在死亡率不平等方面的水平和趋势。比较结果显示，尽管美国和法国的收入不平等都有所增加，但法国的死亡率不平等仍然保持较低且稳定的水平。在美国，老年人的死亡率不平等有所增加（尤其是女性），而儿童和年轻人的死亡率不平等则有所减少。这些现象表明，尽管收入与健康之间存在强烈的横向关联，但收入不平等的变化并不一定会导致健康不平等的变化。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of access to convenience stores and competition between convenience store chains on medical care use and expenditures in Taiwan; the country with the highest density of convenience stores in the world. Our study makes use of insurance claims from 0.85 million individuals enrolled in Taiwan’s national health insurance program from 2002-2012 and administrative data on convenience store chain sales. While we find that both greater store accessibility and higher levels of inter-brand competition reduce the use and cost of outpatient medical services and prescription drugs, healthcare utilization is more responsive to changes in competition. Since convenience stores in Taiwan are typically the healthier option for ready-to-eat food, we postulate that the decline in medical care utilization is driven by a reduction in convenience store prices and increase in service quality relative to other food outlets. This is supported by findings from survey data indicating that convenience store competition is associated with greater consumption of more healthy foods, lower consumption of less healthy foods, and decreases in obesity rates. While the effects we find are precisely estimated, they are small in magnitude, with the increase in convenience store competition experienced by Taiwan over a 10-year period reducing medical expenditures on outpatient services and on prescription drugs by around one half of one percent.

10.3386/w24628.abstractZh: 我们研究了在台湾这种拥有全球最高便利店密度的国家，便利店的普及程度以及不同便利店连锁店之间的竞争对医疗服务的使用率和支出的影响。本研究利用了2002年至2012年间台湾国家健康保险计划中的85万人的保险理赔数据，以及关于便利店连锁店销售情况的行政数据。研究发现，便利店的普及程度更高以及不同品牌之间的竞争更激烈，都会降低门诊医疗服务和处方药的使用率及成本，而医疗服务的利用对竞争变化的反应更为敏感。由于台湾的便利店通常是更健康的即食食品选择，我们推测医疗服务的减少是由便利店价格的下降以及相对于其他食品销售点而言的服务质量的提升所驱动的。调查数据也表明，便利店的竞争与更健康的食品消费增加、不太健康的食品消费减少以及肥胖率的下降有关。虽然我们发现的效应被精确估计，但其影响幅度很小，台湾在10年期间便利店竞争的增加仅使门诊服务和处方药的支出减少了大约0.5%。

abstract.text: This paper explores the relationship between the minimum wage, the structure of employee compensation, and worker welfare. We advance a conceptual framework that describes the conditions under which a minimum wage increase will alter the provision of fringe benefits, alter employment outcomes, and either increase or decrease worker welfare. Using American Community Survey data from 2011-2016, we find robust evidence that state-level minimum wage changes decreased the likelihood that individuals report having employer-sponsored health insurance. Effects are largest among workers in very low-paying occupations, for whom coverage declines offset 9 percent of the wage gains associated with minimum wage hikes. We find evidence that both insurance coverage and wage effects exhibit spillovers into occupations moderately higher up the wage distribution. For these groups, reductions in coverage offset a more substantial share of the wage gains we estimate.

10.3386/w24635.abstractZh: 本文探讨了最低工资、员工薪酬结构以及工人福利之间的关系。我们提出了一个概念框架，描述了在何种条件下，最低工资的提高会改变附加福利的提供、影响就业结果，并进而影响工人福利。利用2011-2016年的美国社区调查数据，我们发现州级最低工资的变化降低了个人拥有雇主提供健康保险的可能性。这种影响在低薪职业的工人中最为明显，对于他们来说，保险覆盖率的下降抵消了与最低工资提高相关的9%的工资增长。我们还发现，保险覆盖率和工资效应会波及工资分布中较高层次的职业。对于这些群体而言，保险覆盖率的减少抵消了我们所估计的更大比例的工资增长。
