abstract.text: Twenty-one states and the District of Columbia require youths to wear helmets when riding a bicycle, and there has been a push to extend such laws to adults. We provide new evidence on helmet laws by studying Canada using difference-in-differences models and restricted area-identified public health survey data with information on cycling and helmet use for nearly 800,000 individuals from 1994-2014. We first confirm prior patterns from the US that laws requiring youths to wear helmets significantly increased youth helmet use. We then provide the literature’s first comprehensive evidence that ‘all-age’ bicycle helmet laws significantly increased both adult and youth helmet use by 50 to 190 percent relative to pre-reform levels, with larger effects for younger adults, and less-educated adults. All-age helmet laws had modest effects at reducing cycling and increasing in-home exercise during winter months among adults but did not meaningfully affect weight. Finally, we find larger effects of helmet laws at increasing helmet use for adults with children in the household, consistent with role-modeling behavior. Overall our findings confirm that all-age helmet laws can be effective at increasing population helmet use without significant unintended adverse health consequences.

10.3386/w24644.abstractZh: 二十一个州和哥伦比亚特区要求青少年骑自行车时必须佩戴头盔，并且有人推动将此类法律扩展到成年人。我们通过使用差异-差异模型以及基于公共健康调查数据的研究，对加拿大头盔法律进行了新的分析。这些调查数据包含了1994年至2014年间近80万人的骑行和头盔使用情况。我们首先确认了美国先前的研究结果，即要求青少年佩戴头盔的法律显著增加了青少年的头盔使用率。随后，我们首次提供了全面的证据，表明“全年龄”自行车头盔法律使成人和青少年的头盔使用率分别增加了50%到190%，其中年轻成年人和受教育程度较低的成年人受到的影响更大。全年龄头盔法律在减少冬季成人骑行次数和增加家庭锻炼方面有一定效果，但并未对体重产生显著影响。最后，我们发现，对于有儿童在家的成年人来说，头盔法律在增加头盔使用率方面效果更为显著，这与榜样行为的作用一致。总体而言，我们的研究结果证实，全年龄头盔法律可以在不造成重大健康不良后果的情况下，有效提高人群中的头盔使用率。

abstract.text: A headline result from the Oregon Health Insurance Experiment is that emergency room (ER) utilization increased. A seemingly contradictory result from the Massachusetts health reform is that ER utilization decreased. I reconcile both results by identifying treatment effect heterogeneity within the Oregon experiment and extrapolating it to Massachusetts. Even though Oregon compliers increased their ER utilization, they were adversely selected relative to Oregon never takers, who would have decreased their ER utilization. Massachusetts expanded coverage from a higher level to healthier compliers. Therefore, Massachusetts compliers are comparable to a subset of Oregon never takers, which can reconcile the results.

10.3386/w24647.abstractZh: 俄勒冈健康保险实验的一个主要结果是急诊室使用率上升。而马萨诸塞州医疗改革的一个看似矛盾的结果是急诊室使用率下降。我通过识别俄勒冈实验中的治疗效果异质性，并将其推广到马萨诸塞州，从而调和了这两个结果。尽管俄勒冈州的参与者增加了急诊室使用率，但与从未参与该计划的参与者相比，他们的急诊室使用率反而有所下降。马萨诸塞州则将保险覆盖范围扩展到了更健康的参与者。因此，马萨诸塞州的参与者与俄勒冈州中那些从未参与该计划的参与者相当，这能够解释这两个结果之间的差异。

abstract.text: We exploit variation in access to legal same-sex marriage (SSM) across states and time to provide novel evidence of its effects on marriage and health using data from the CDC BRFSS from 2000-2016, a period spanning the entire rollout of legal SSM across the United States. Our main approach is to relate changes in outcomes for individuals in same-sex households (SSH) [i.e., households with exactly two same-sex adults], which we show includes a substantial share of gay and lesbian couples, coincident with adoption of legal SSM in two-way fixed effects models. We find robust evidence that access to legal SSM significantly increased marriage take-up among men and women in SSH. We also find that legal SSM was associated with significant increases in health insurance, access to care, and utilization for men in SSH. Our results provide the first evidence that legal access to SSM improved health for adult gay men.

10.3386/w24651.abstractZh: 我们利用各州和不同时间阶段关于同性婚姻法律获取情况的差异，通过2000至2016年CDC BRFSS的数据，揭示了同性婚姻对婚姻状况和健康的影响。我们的主要方法是分析同性家庭（即由两名同性成年人组成的家庭）中个体状况的变化，我们发现其中包含了大量同性恋伴侣。同时，在双向固定效应模型中，我们发现同性婚姻法律的实施显著增加了同性家庭中的男女参与婚姻的比例。此外，我们还发现同性婚姻法律实施与同性家庭中的男性在健康保险、医疗服务获取以及医疗利用方面的显著增长有关。我们的研究结果首次证明了同性婚姻法律获取对成年同性男性健康的改善作用。

abstract.text: This paper develops a framework for evaluating the welfare impact of various interventions designed to increase take-up of social safety net programs in the presence of potential behavioral biases. We calibrate the key parameters using a randomized field experiment in which 30,000 elderly individuals not enrolled in – but likely eligible for – the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) are either provided with information that they are likely eligible, provided with this information and also offered assistance in applying, or are in a “status quo” control group. Only 6 percent of the control group enrolls in SNAP over the next 9 months, compared to 11 percent of the Information Only group and 18 percent of the Information Plus Assistance group. The individuals who apply or enroll in response to either intervention receive lower benefits and are less sick than the average enrollee in the control group. The results are consistent with the existence of optimization frictions that are greater for needier individuals, suggesting that the poor targeting properties of the interventions reduce their welfare gains.

10.3386/w24652.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于评估在存在潜在行为偏差的情况下，各种旨在增加社会安全网项目参与度的干预措施对福利影响的评价。我们通过一项随机实地实验来校准关键参数，该实验中，30,000名未注册但可能符合补充营养援助计划（SNAP）资格的老年人被分为三组：一组仅获得信息，知道他们可能符合资格；一组除了获得信息外还获得了申请援助的帮助；另一组则处于“现状”对照组。结果显示，在接下来的9个月里，对照组中只有6%的人注册了SNAP，而仅获得信息的组为11%，获得信息并同时获得援助的组为18%。接受干预措施的人获得的福利较低，且健康状况也低于对照组的平均水平。这些结果支持了存在优化摩擦的观点，即对于更需要帮助的人来说，这种摩擦更为显著，这表明这些干预措施的目标定位特性降低了它们的福利收益。

abstract.text: We evaluate health insurance reclassification risk in the Small Group Market from a period before ACA community rating regulations. Reclassification risk in this setting is of key policy relevance and also a matter of debate. We use detailed claims and premiums data from a large insurance company and control non-parametrically for selection. We find a pass-through of 16% from changes in health risk to changes in premiums, with a stronger equilibrium relationship between premiums and risk. This pattern is consistent with the insurer implicitly offering “guaranteed renewability” contracts with one-sided pricing commitment. We further find that groups whose health risk decreases have premiums that are more responsive to risk, which the guaranteed renewability model attributes to ex-post renegotiation. The observed pricing policy adds 55% of the consumer welfare gain from community rating relative to experience rating. The welfare gains are limited because employers and employees switch coverage frequently.

10.3386/w24663.abstractZh: 我们评估了在《平价医疗法案》社区评级规定实施前的时期，小型团体市场中健康保险重新分类的风险。在这种情境下，重新分类风险具有重要的政策意义，同时也存在争议。我们利用了一家大型保险公司的详细索赔和保费数据，并通过非参数方法控制了选择效应。研究发现，健康风险的变化会导致保费变化16%，且保费与风险之间的均衡关系更为紧密。这一模式与保险公司隐含地提供具有单边定价承诺的“保证续保”合同相一致。进一步研究发现，健康风险下降的团体，其保费对风险变化的反应更为敏感，而保证续保模型将这一现象归因于事后重新谈判。观察到的定价政策使得消费者从社区评级中获得的福利增益比经验评级高出55%。然而，这种福利增益是有限的，因为雇主和雇员经常更换保险覆盖对象。

abstract.text: We surveyed a large sample of Swedish lottery players about their psychological well-being and analyzed the data following pre-registered procedures. Relative to matched controls, large-prize winners experience sustained increases in overall life satisfaction that persist for over a decade and show no evidence of dissipating with time. The estimated treatment effects on happiness and mental health are significantly smaller, suggesting that wealth has greater long-run effects on evaluative measures of well-being than on affective ones. Follow-up analyses of domain-specific aspects of life satisfaction clearly implicate financial life satisfaction as an important mediator for the long-run increase in overall life satisfaction.

10.3386/w24667.abstractZh: 我们对大量瑞典彩票玩家进行了关于其心理健康的调查，并采用预先注册的程序对数据进行了分析。与对照组相比，大奖得主的整体生活满意度持续增加，这种状况会持续超过十年，且随着时间的推移并未消失。对幸福感和心理健康的影响估计值明显较小，这表明财富对幸福感评估指标的长期影响大于对情感层面的影响。对生活满意度中特定领域的后续分析表明，财务方面的满意度是整体生活满意度长期提升的重要中介因素。

abstract.text: We study the dynamics of participation and health care consumption in the Affordable Care Act’s health insurance marketplaces. Unlike other health insurance contexts, we find individuals commonly drop coverage midyear–roughly 30% of enrollees exit within nine months of sign-up. While covered, dropouts spend more on health care than in the months before sign-up or after exit. We model the consequences of drop-out on equilibrium premiums and consumer welfare. While dropouts generate a type of adverse selection, the welfare effect from their participation is ambiguous and depends on the relative costs per month of part-year vs. full-year enrollees. In our empirical setting, we find that imposing a penalty that incentivizes participation for at least 3.5 months would lower premium levels and improve overall consumer welfare.

10.3386/w24668.abstractZh: 我们研究了《平价医疗法案》下健康保险市场中的参与度和医疗消费动态。与其他健康保险环境不同，我们发现个人通常会在年中退出保险——大约30%的参保者在注册后的九个月内退出。在参保期间，退出的个体在医疗上的支出比注册前或退出后的月份要高。我们模拟了退出对均衡保费和消费者福利的影响。虽然退出会产生一种逆向选择效应，但他们的参与对福利的影响并不明确，这取决于部分年度参保者与全年度参保者每月的相对成本。在我们的实证研究中，我们发现实施一种激励措施，促使参保者至少持续3.5个月，可以降低保费水平并改善整体消费者福利。

abstract.text: A large body of literature estimates the effect of air pollution on health. However, most of these studies have focused on physical health, while the effect on mental health is limited. Using the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) covering 12,615 urban residents during 2014 – 2015, we find significantly positive effect of air pollution – instrumented by thermal inversions – on mental illness. Specifically, a one-standard-deviation (18.04 μg/m3) increase in average PM2.5 concentrations in the past month increases the probability of having a score that is associated with severe mental illness by 6.67 percentage points, or 0.33 standard deviations. Based on average health expenditures associated with mental illness and rates of treatment among those with symptoms, we calculate that these effects induce a total annual cost of USD 22.88 billion in health expenditures only. This cost is on a similar scale to pollution costs stemming from mortality, labor productivity, and dementia.

10.3386/w24686.abstractZh: 大量文献研究了空气污染对健康的影响。然而，这些研究大多集中在身体健康方面，对心理健康的影响研究较为有限。我们利用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）的数据，该调查涵盖了2014年至2015年间12,615名城市居民，发现空气污染——尤其是热逆温现象——对精神疾病有显著的正面影响。具体而言，过去一个月内PM2.5浓度增加一个标准差（18.04微克/立方米）时，患有与严重精神疾病相关的症状的概率会增加6.67个百分点，或0.33个标准差。根据与精神疾病相关的平均医疗支出以及症状患者的治疗率，我们计算出这些影响导致的年度医疗支出总成本为222.8亿美元。这一成本与因污染导致的死亡、劳动生产力和痴呆症相关的成本相当。

abstract.text: Large literatures document positive effects of WIC on birth outcomes, and separately connect health at birth and future outcomes. But little research investigates the link between prenatal WIC participation and childhood outcomes. We explore this question using a unique data set from South Carolina which links administrative birth, Medicaid, and education records. We find that relative to their siblings, prenatal WIC participants have a lower incidence of ADHD and other common childhood mental health conditions and of grade repetition. These findings demonstrate that a “WIC start” results in persistent improvements in child outcomes across a range of domains.

10.3386/w24691.abstractZh: 大量文献证实了WIC对出生结果有积极影响，并且分别探讨了出生时的健康状况与未来结果之间的关系。但很少有研究探讨产前参与WIC与儿童结果之间的联系。我们利用南卡罗来纳州的一个独特数据集来探讨这个问题，该数据集将出生登记、医疗补助和教育记录联系起来。研究发现，与兄弟姐妹相比，产前参与WIC的儿童患注意力缺陷多动障碍以及其他常见的儿童心理健康问题的几率较低，同时留级的几率也较低。这些发现表明，“WIC起点”能够持续改善儿童在多个领域的表现。

abstract.text: We show that personal experiences of economic shocks can “scar'” consumer behavior in the long run. We first illustrate the effects of experience-based learning in a simple stochastic life-cycle consumption model with time-varying financial constraints. We then use data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID), the Nielsen Homescan Panel, and the Consumer Expenditure Survey (CEX) to estimate the long-term effects of lifetime experiences on consumption. We show that households who have lived through times of high local and national unemployment, or who have experienced more personal unemployment, spend significantly less on food and total consumption, after controlling for income, wealth, employment, demographics, and macro-economic factors, such as the current unemployment rate. The reverse holds for past experiences of low unemployment. We also estimate significant experience-based variation in consumption within household, i. e., after including household fixed effects. At the same time, lifetime experiences do not predict individuals' future income. The Nielsen data reveals that households who have lived through times of high unemployment are particularly likely to use coupons and to purchase sale items or lower-end products. As predicted by the experience-based learning model, the effects of a given macro shock are stronger for younger than for older cohorts. Finally, past experiences predict beliefs about future economic conditions in the Michigan Survey of Consumers (MSC), implying a beliefs-based channel. Our results suggest a novel micro-foundation of fluctuations of aggregate demand, and explain long-run effects of macroeconomic shocks.

10.3386/w24696.abstractZh: 我们表明，个人经历的经济冲击可能会在长期内“留下疤痕”，影响消费者的行为。我们首先在一个具有时变财务约束的简单随机生命周期消费模型中，展示了基于经验的学习效应。然后，我们利用收入动态面板研究（PSID）、尼尔森家庭调查面板以及消费者支出调查（CEX）的数据，来估计 lifetime 经历对消费的长期影响。我们发现，那些经历过高地方和国家失业率，或经历过更多个人失业的家庭，在控制收入、财富、就业、人口统计以及宏观经济因素（如当前失业率）后，食品和总消费支出显著减少。相反，过去经历低失业率的情况则不会产生类似的效应。我们还发现，在包含家庭固定效应后，家庭内部的消费存在显著的基于经验的变化。同时，lifetime 经历并不能预测个人未来的收入。尼尔森的数据表明，经历过高失业率的家庭更有可能使用优惠券，并购买打折商品或低端产品。正如基于经验的学习模型所预测的那样，特定宏观经济冲击对年轻群体的影响比对年长群体更为显著。最后，过去经历可以预测消费者对未来经济状况的看法，这一发现来自密歇根消费者调查（MSC），表明存在基于信念的渠道。我们的研究结果提出了总需求波动的新微观基础，并解释了宏观经济冲击的长期影响。

abstract.text: Almond (2006) argues that in-utero exposure to the 1918 inﬂuenza pandemic lowered socioeconomic status in adulthood, whereas subsequent work has argued that exposed cohorts may have been selected. We bring new evidence on the lasting impact of in-utero exposure to the pandemic. Linking census microdata to WWII enlistment records and city-level inﬂuenza data allows us to adopt an empirical approach that exploits pandemic intensity as a source of identifying variation. We show that pandemic intensity is less related to parental characteristics, suggesting this approach can more credibly be interpreted as causal. Our results indicate that in-utero exposure to the pandemic lowered high school graduation rates.

10.3386/w24725.abstractZh: Almond（2006）认为，1918年流感大流行在子宫内的暴露会降低成年后的社会经济地位，而后续的研究则认为，可能有一些特定群体在怀孕期间暴露于该疫情中，从而被选中受到影响。我们提供了关于子宫内暴露于该疫情所带来的长期影响的新证据。通过将人口普查微观数据与二战征兵记录以及城市级别的流感数据相结合，我们采用了一种利用疫情强度作为识别变量来源的实证方法。我们的研究表明，疫情强度与父母特征的关系较小，这表明这种方法可以更有说服力地被解释为因果关系。我们的结果还表明，子宫内暴露于该疫情会降低高中毕业率。

abstract.text: We estimate the potential gains of life-extending treatments to life insurance companies and apply it to immunotherapy. These treatments promise to dramatically raise durable survival rates for a growing number of cancer patients but are often prohibitively expensive for patients and governments alike. Our main insight is that life insurance companies have a direct benefit from such treatments as they lower the insurer’s liabilities by pushing the death benefit further into the future and raise future premium income. Using detailed survival data from clinical studies, we quantify the insurers’ benefit from immunotherapy for melanoma patients. Extrapolating to 17 other cancer sites, we estimate the insurance sector’s benefit to equal $6.8 billion a year. We discuss various financing mechanisms that exploit this value creation, which depend on the relative bargaining power of insurers and consumers. Moreover, the potential gains for life insurers, which could only accrue if health insurers cover the cost of the treatments and households finance the out-of-pocket expenditure, may warrant some exploration of new boundaries between life and health insurance. We discuss the broader implications for medical innovation and long-term care insurance markets.

10.3386/w24730.abstractZh: 我们估算了延长寿命的治疗措施对人寿保险公司的潜在收益，并将这一估算应用于免疫疗法。这些治疗有望大幅提高越来越多癌症患者的长期生存率，但往往对病人和政府来说成本过高。我们的主要发现是，人寿保险公司可以从这类治疗中直接获益，因为它们通过将死亡赔偿金的支付时间推迟，从而减轻保险公司的责任，同时增加未来的保费收入。通过利用临床研究的详细生存数据，我们量化了保险公司从黑色素瘤患者的免疫疗法中获得的收益。将这一估算扩展到其他17种癌症类型，我们发现保险行业的收益每年可达68亿美元。我们讨论了各种利用这种价值创造机制的融资方式，这些机制取决于保险公司和消费者的相对议价能力。此外，如果健康保险公司承担治疗费用，而家庭自行承担实际支出，人寿保险公司可能获得的潜在收益值得进一步探索。我们还讨论了这对医疗创新和长期护理保险市场的更广泛影响。

abstract.text: We study how changes in the distribution of occupations have affected the aggregate non-pecuniary costs and benefits of working. The physical toll of work is smaller now than in 1950, with workers shifting away from occupations in which people report experiencing tiredness and pain. The emotional consequences of the changing occupation distribution vary substantially across demographic groups. Work has become happier and more meaningful for women, but more stressful and less meaningful for men. These changes appear to be concentrated at lower education levels.

10.3386/w24738.abstractZh: 我们研究了职业分布的变化如何影响工作的非金钱成本和收益。与1950年相比，工作的身体负担现在较小，工人逐渐远离那些让人感到疲劳和疼痛的职业。职业分布变化带来的情感后果在不同人口群体中存在显著差异。对于女性来说，工作变得更加愉快和有意义，而对于男性来说，工作则更加紧张且意义较小。这些变化似乎集中在较低教育水平的人群中。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of Walmart Supercenters, which lower food prices and expand food availability, on household and child food insecurity. Our food insecurity-related outcomes come from the 2001-2012 waves of the December Current Population Study Food Security Supplement. Using narrow geographic identifiers available in the restricted version of these data, we compute the distance between each household’s census tract of residence and the nearest Walmart Supercenter. We estimate instrumental variables models that leverage the predictable geographic expansion patterns of Walmart Supercenters outward from Walmart’s corporate headquarters. Results suggest that closer proximity to a Walmart Supercenter improves the food security of households and children, as measured by number of affirmative responses to a food insecurity questionnaire and an indicator for food insecurity. The effects are largest among low-income households and children, but are also sizeable for middle-income children.

10.3386/w24750.abstractZh: 本文探讨了沃尔玛超级中心通过降低食品价格并扩大食品供应对家庭及儿童食品不安全状况的影响。我们关于食品不安全的相关数据来源于2001-2012年的《当前人口研究》食品安全补充调查。利用这些数据中的有限地理标识符，我们计算了每个家庭居住区与最近的沃尔玛超级中心之间的距离。我们通过利用沃尔玛超级中心从公司总部向外扩展的可预测地理模式，建立了工具变量模型。研究结果表明，靠近沃尔玛超级中心能够提升家庭及儿童的食品安全状况，具体表现为对食品不安全问卷的肯定回答数量以及食品不安全指标的改善。这种影响在低收入家庭和儿童中最为显著，但在中等收入儿童中也有显著的效果。

abstract.text: A large literature documents that childhood health shocks have lasting negative consequences for adult outcomes. This paper demonstrates that the adversity of childhood physical disability can be mediated by individuals' educational and occupational choices, which reflect their comparative advantage. We merge records on children hospitalized with poliomyelitis during the 1952 Danish epidemic to census and administrative data, and exploit quasi-random variation in paralysis incidence. While childhood disability increases the likelihood of early retirement and disability pension receipt at age 50, paralytic polio survivors obtain higher education and are more likely to work in white-collar and computer-demanding jobs than their non-paralytic counterparts.

10.3386/w24753.abstractZh: 大量文献表明，儿童时期的健康冲击会对成年后的结果产生长期的负面影响。本文指出，儿童时期的身体残疾所带来的逆境可以通过个体的教育和职业选择来缓解，这些选择反映了个体的比较优势。我们将1952年丹麦脊髓灰质炎疫情期间因脊髓灰质炎住院的儿童记录与人口普查及行政数据相结合，并利用麻痹症发病率的准随机变化进行分析。研究发现，儿童时期的残疾会增加50岁时提前退休和领取残疾养老金的可能性，而患有脊髓灰质炎的幸存者则更有可能接受高等教育，并且更可能从事白领工作或需要计算机技能的工作。

abstract.text: Using 100 percent Medicare Part B fee-for-service (FFS) claims in 2012 for people under age 65, I examine office and outpatient services by state and primary diagnosis for the service. The number of services per Medicare-eligible beneficiary in the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program was about 32 in 2012, or 2.7 per month, comparable to services for the 65+ Medicare population. The number of services for SSDI beneficiaries ranged from almost 48 per capita in Minnesota to 23 in Arkansas. Services for musculoskeletal impairments averaged 4.6 per capita, ranging from 6.7 in Minnesota to 2.5 in Hawaii. The greatest variation occurred in services for mental disorders, averaging 3.2 for the U.S. but ranging from 9.1 in Massachusetts to 1.4 in Alabama. Factors such as the number of health care professionals or hospital beds per capita, the share enrolled in Medicare Advantage, and demographic factors are associated with health care utilization across states. Knowledge of health care utilization could inform policy choices for programs such as early intervention efforts both at the federal level and tailored to particular needs at the state level.

10.3386/w24759.abstractZh: 以2012年65岁以下人群使用100%的Medicare Part B按服务收费（FFS）索赔数据为基础，我分析了各州按主要诊断分类的门诊和住院服务情况。2012年，美国社会保障残疾保险计划中的每位符合条件的Medicare受益人每月大约接受32项服务，这一数字与65岁以上Medicare人群的服務量相当。各州的服務量差异较大：明尼苏达州的人均服务量接近48项，而阿肯色州则仅为23项。肌肉骨骼损伤相关的服务平均每人4.6项，其中明尼苏达州为6.7项，夏威夷州则降至2.5项。精神障碍相关服务的差异最为显著，美国全国的平均值为3.2项，但马萨诸塞州高达9.1项，阿拉巴马州则仅为1.4项。诸如医疗专业人员的数量、人均医院床位数、参加Medicare Advantage计划的比例以及人口统计因素等变量，都与各州的医疗利用情况有关。了解医疗利用情况有助于为联邦层面的早期干预计划以及针对特定需求的州级计划做出政策决策。

abstract.text: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP, formerly food stamps) is one of the most important elements of the social safety net. Unlike most other safety net programs, SNAP varies little across states and over time, which creates challenges for quasi-experimental evaluation. Notably, SNAP benefits are fixed across 48 states; but local food prices vary, leading to geographic variation in the real value – or purchasing power – of SNAP benefits. In this study, we provide the first estimates that leverage variation in SNAP purchasing power across markets to examine effects of SNAP on child health. We link panel data on regional food prices to National Health Interview Survey data and use a fixed effects framework to estimate the relationship between local purchasing power of SNAP and children’s health and health care utilization. We find that lower SNAP purchasing power leads to lower utilization of preventive health care and more days of school missed due to illness. We find no effect on reported health status.

10.3386/w24762.abstractZh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP，以前称为食品券）是社会安全网中最重要的组成部分之一。与大多数其他安全网计划不同，SNAP在各州以及时间上的变化幅度很小，这给准实验评估带来了挑战。值得注意的是，SNAP福利在48个州都是固定的；但当地食品价格会有所不同，导致SNAP福利的实际价值——或购买力——存在地域差异。在这项研究中，我们首次利用SNAP购买力在不同市场中的差异来研究SNAP对儿童健康的影响。我们将区域食品价格的数据与国家健康访谈调查数据联系起来，并使用固定效应框架来估计SNAP的当地购买力与儿童健康和医疗利用之间的关系。我们发现，较低的SNAP购买力会导致预防性医疗保健的利用减少，以及因疾病而缺课的天数增加。我们没有发现其对报告的健康状况有影响。

abstract.text: While the Unemployment Insurance (UI) program is one of the largest safety net program in the U.S., research on its benefits is limited. This paper exploits plausibly exogenous changes in state UI laws to empirically estimate whether UI generosity mitigates any of the previously documented negative health effects of job loss. The results show higher UI generosity increases health insurance coverage and utilization, and leads to improved self-reported health. Moreover, these effects are stronger during periods of high unemployment rates. Finally, I find no effects on risky behaviors nor on health conditions.

10.3386/w24766.abstractZh: 虽然失业保险是美国最大的社会保障计划之一，但对其福利的研究却十分有限。本文利用假设性的州失业保险法律变化，实证分析失业保险的慷慨程度是否能够减轻因失业而引发的负面健康影响。研究结果表明，较高的失业保险慷慨程度能够增加健康保险的覆盖率和利用率，并改善自我报告的健康状况。此外，这些效应在失业率较高的时期更为明显。最后，研究发现失业保险对危险行为或健康状况并无影响。

abstract.text: We show that kidney exchange markets suffer from market failures whose remedy could increase transplants by 30%–63%. First, we document that the market is fragmented and inefficient: most transplants are arranged by hospitals instead of national platforms. Second, we propose a model to show two sources of inefficiency: hospitals only partly internalize their patients' benefits from exchange, and current platforms suboptimally reward hospitals for submitting patients and donors. Third, we calibrate a production function and show that individual hospitals operate below efficient scale. Eliminating this inefficiency requires either a mandate or a combination of new mechanisms and reimbursement reforms.

10.3386/w24775.abstractZh: 我们指出，肾脏交换市场存在市场失灵问题，通过相应的措施可以将移植手术数量增加30%至63%。首先，我们发现市场存在分割且效率低下的情况：大多数移植手术是由医院而非国家平台来安排的。其次，我们提出了一个模型，揭示了两种导致效率低下的原因：医院仅部分内部化了患者通过交换获得的利益，而当前的平台对医院提交患者和捐赠者的行为奖励不够合理。第三，我们通过校准生产函数发现，单个医院的运营规模低于最优水平。要消除这种效率低下现象，需要制定强制性规定，或者结合新的机制和报销改革措施。

abstract.text: We study the effect of physician workforce diversity on the demand for preventive care among African-American men. In an experiment in Oakland, California, we randomize black men to black or non-black male medical doctors. We use a two-stage design, measuring decisions before (pre-consultation) and after (post-consultation) meeting their assigned doctor. Subjects select a similar number of preventives in the preconsultation stage, but are much more likely to select every preventive service, particularly invasive services, once meeting with a racially concordant doctor. Our findings suggest black doctors could reduce the black-white male gap in cardiovascular mortality by 19%.

10.3386/w24787.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生队伍多样性对非洲裔美国男性预防保健需求的影响。在加利福尼亚州奥克兰进行的一项实验中，我们将黑人男性随机分配到黑人医生或非黑人男性医生那里。我们采用了两阶段设计，在咨询前和咨询后分别测量他们的决策情况。在咨询前阶段，受试者选择的预防保健项目数量相似，但一旦与种族一致的医生会面，他们更有可能选择所有预防保健服务，尤其是侵入性服务。我们的研究结果表明，黑人医生可以将黑人男性与白人男性之间的心血管死亡率差距缩小19%。

abstract.text: What is the role of structural estimation in behavioral economics? I discuss advantages, and limitations, of the work in Structural Behavioral Economics. I also cover common modeling choices and how to get started. Among the advantages, I argue that structural estimation builds on, and expands, a classical behavioral tool, simple calibrations, and that it benefits from the presence of a few parsimonious behavioral models which can be taken to the data. Estimation is also well suited for experimental work, common in behavioral economics, as it can lead to improvements in the experimental design. In addition, at a time where policy implications of behavioral work are increasingly discussed, it is important to ground these policy implications in (estimated) models. Structural work, however, has important limitations, which are relevant to its behavioral applications. Estimation takes much longer and the extra degree of complexity can make it difficult to know which of a series of assumptions is driving the results. For related reasons, it is also easy to over-reach with the welfare implications. Taking this into account, I provide a partial how-to guide to structural behavioral economics, covering: (i) the choice of estimation method; (ii) the modeling of heterogeneity; (iii) identification and sensitivity. Finally, I discuss common issues for the estimation of leading behavioral models. I illustrate this discussion with selected coverage of existing work in the literature.

10.3386/w24797.abstractZh: 结构估计在行为经济学中扮演什么角色？我讨论了结构行为经济学研究的优势与局限性。我还介绍了常见的建模方法以及如何开始这项工作。我认为，结构估计建立在经典行为工具的基础上，并对其进行扩展；同时，它还能利用一些简洁的行为模型来指导实际研究。估计方法也非常适合行为经济学中的实验研究，因为它能够改善实验设计。此外，在行为研究的政策意义日益受到重视的今天，将这些政策意义建立在（估计的）模型之上显得尤为重要。然而，结构研究也存在一些重要局限性，这些局限性与其行为应用相关。估计过程需要花费更多时间，而且额外的复杂性可能导致难以判断一系列假设中哪一个是影响结果的因素。出于这些原因，在讨论福利影响时也容易过度分析。考虑到这些因素，我提供了一个关于结构行为经济学的部分操作指南，包括：(i) 估计方法的选择；(ii) 异质性的建模；(iii) 识别与敏感性分析。最后，我讨论了主导行为模型估计中常见的问题。我通过文献中一些现有研究的案例来说明这些讨论。

abstract.text: We study the effects of prenatal exposure to violent crime on infant health, using New York City crime records linked to mothers’ addresses in birth records data. We address endogeneity of assault exposure with three strategies and find that in utero assault exposure significantly increases the incidence of adverse birth outcomes. We calculate that the annual social cost of assault during pregnancy in the US is more than $3.8 billion. Since infant health predicts long-term wellbeing and disadvantaged women are disproportionately likely to be domestic abuse victims, violence in utero may be an important channel for intergenerational transmission of inequality.

10.3386/w24802.abstractZh: 我们研究了产前接触暴力犯罪对婴儿健康的影响，使用了与母亲住址相关的纽约市犯罪记录与出生记录数据。我们通过三种策略探讨了暴力暴露的内生性问题，发现子宫内的暴力暴露显著增加了不良出生结果的发生率。我们计算出美国孕期遭受暴力的年度社会成本超过38亿美元。由于婴儿健康与长期福祉密切相关，而处于弱势地位的女性更有可能成为家庭暴力的受害者，因此子宫内的暴力可能是代际不平等传递的重要渠道。

abstract.text: We study spillover effects from the largest increase in Medicaid reimbursement rates in the history of the program for primary care services to behavioral health and healthcare outcomes; mental illness, substance use disorders, and tobacco product use. Much of the variation in Medicaid reimbursement rates we leverage is attributable to a large federally mandated increase between 2013 and 2014. We apply differences-in-differences models to survey data specifically designed to measure behavioral health outcomes over the period 2010 to 2016. We find that higher primary care Medicaid reimbursement rates improve behavioral health outcomes among enrollees. We find no evidence that behavioral healthcare service use is altered. Previous economic research shows that the mandated boost increased office visits. Thus our results suggest that primary care providers are efficient in improving behavioral health outcomes among Medicaid enrollees. Given established shortages of behavioral health providers, these findings are important from a healthcare workforce and policy perspective.

10.3386/w24805.abstractZh: 我们研究了历史上最大规模的医疗补助报销费率提升对初级保健服务以及行为健康与医疗结果的影响，涉及精神疾病、物质使用障碍和烟草产品使用等方面。医疗补助报销费率变化的差异很大程度上归因于2013年至2014年间联邦政府实施的重大调整。我们采用差异-差异模型，利用专门设计的调查数据来衡量2010至2016年期间的行为健康结果。研究发现，较高的初级保健医疗补助报销费率确实改善了参保者的行为健康状况，但并未发现行为健康服务使用量发生变化的证据。以往的经济研究表明，这一强制性调整增加了门诊就诊次数。因此，我们的研究结果表明，初级保健提供者能够在改善医疗补助参保者的行为健康状况方面发挥重要作用。鉴于行为健康服务提供者普遍短缺的情况，这些发现对于医疗劳动力和政策制定具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Crack cocaine markets were associated with substantial increases in violence in the U.S. during the 1980s and 1990s. Using cross-city variation in the emergence of these markets, we show that the resulting violence has important long-term implications for understanding current levels of murder rates by age, sex and race. We estimate that the murder rate of young black males doubled soon after crack’s entrance into a city, and that these rates were still 70 percent higher 17 years after crack’s arrival. We document the role of increased gun possession as a mechanism for this increase. Following previous work, we show that the fraction of suicides by firearms is a good proxy for gun availability and that this variable among young black males follows a similar trajectory to murder rates. Access to guns by young black males explains their elevated murder rates today compared to older cohorts. The long run effects of this increase in violence are large. We attribute nearly eight percent of the murders in 2000 to the long-run effects of the emergence of crack markets. Elevated murder rates for younger black males continue through to today and can explain approximately one tenth of the gap in life expectancy between black and white males.

10.3386/w24819.abstractZh: 在20世纪80年代和90年代，可卡因市场与美国暴力事件的显著增加有关。通过研究这些市场在不同城市中的出现情况，我们发现由此引发的暴力行为对理解当前不同年龄、性别和种族的谋杀率具有重要意义。我们估计，在可卡因进入某个城市后不久，年轻黑人的谋杀率就翻了一番，而在可卡因出现17年后，这一比率仍高出70%。我们发现，枪支持有量的增加是导致这一增长的一个机制。与之前的研究一致，我们发现通过枪支自杀的比例可以作为枪支可用性的良好指标，而这一变量在年轻黑人中与谋杀率的变化轨迹相似。年轻黑人对枪支的获取权解释了他们今天的较高谋杀率，与较年长的群体相比。这种暴力行为的长期影响是巨大的。我们估计，2000年的谋杀案中，有近8%是由于可卡因市场出现的长期影响所致。年轻黑人的高谋杀率一直持续到今天，并且可以解释黑人与白人男性之间预期寿命差距的约十分之一。

abstract.text: We study the impact of expert reviews on the demand for HIV treatments. A novel feature of our study is that we observe two reviews for each HIV drug and focus attention on consumer responses when experts disagree. Reviews are provided by both a doctor and an activist in the HIV lifestyle magazine Positively Aware, which we merge with detailed panel data on HIV-positive men’s treatment consumption and health outcomes. To establish a causal relationship between reviews and demand, we exploit the arrival of new drugs over time, which provides arguably random variation in reviews of existing drugs. We find that when doctors and activists agree, positive reviews increase demand for HIV drugs. However, doctors and activists frequently disagree, most often over treatments that are effective, but have harsh side effects, in which case they are given low ratings by the activist, but not by the doctor. In such cases, relatively healthy consumers favor drugs with higher activist reviews, which is consistent with a distaste for side effects. This pattern reverses for individuals who are in worse health and thus face stronger incentives to choose more effective medication despite side effects. Findings suggest that consumers demand information from experts whose review is more aligned to their preferences over health versus side effects, which can vary by health status.

10.3386/w24820.abstractZh: 我们研究了专家评审对HIV治疗需求的影响。我们研究的一个新颖之处在于，我们对每种HIV药物进行了两次评审，并重点关注专家意见不一致时的消费者反应。评审由医生和HIV生活方式杂志《Positively Aware》的活跃人士共同提供，我们将这些评审与关于HIV阳性男性治疗消费和健康结果的详细面板数据相结合。为了建立评审与需求之间的因果关系，我们利用了新药物随时间推出的情况，这导致了现有药物评审的随机变化。我们发现，当医生和活跃人士意见一致时，积极的评审会增加HIV药物的需求。然而，医生和活跃人士经常意见不一，尤其是在那些既有效但副作用严重的治疗方面，在这种情况下，活跃人士会给予较低的评分，而医生则不会。在这种情况下，相对健康的消费者更倾向于选择活跃人士评审较高的药物，这与他们对副作用的厌恶是一致的。对于健康状况较差的人来说，尽管存在副作用，他们仍然更倾向于选择更有效的药物。研究结果表明，消费者更希望从那些在健康效果与副作用之间做出更符合他们偏好的专家那里获得信息，而这两种偏好可能因健康状况而异。

abstract.text: We provide the first nation-wide estimates on temperature effects on high-stakes cognitive performance in a developing country using data from the National College Entrance Examination (NCEE) in China. The NCEE is one of the most important institutions in China and affects hundreds of millions of families. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in temperature (3.29° C) decreases the total test score by 1.12% (9.62% of a standard deviation) and decreases the probability of getting into first-tier universities by 1.97% (4.38% of a standard deviation). This suggests that temperature plays an important role in high-stakes cognitive performance and has potentially far-reaching impacts for the careers and lifetime earnings of students.

10.3386/w24821.abstractZh: 我们首次利用中国的全国高考数据，对发展中国家高温对高难度认知表现的影响进行了全国性评估。高考是中国最重要的考试之一，影响着数亿家庭。研究发现，温度上升一个标准差（3.29°C）会导致总测试分数下降1.12%（相当于一个标准差的9.62%），同时降低进入一流大学的概率1.97%（相当于一个标准差的4.38%）。这表明温度对高难度认知表现具有重要影响，并且可能对学生的职业生涯和终身收入产生深远影响。

abstract.text: We follow Medicare cohorts to estimate Hurricane Katrina's long-run mortality effects on victims initially living in New Orleans. Including the initial shock, the hurricane improved eight-year survival by 2.07 percentage points. Migration to lower-mortality regions explains most of this survival increase. Those migrating to low- versus high-mortality regions look similar at baseline, but their subsequent mortality is 0.83–1.01 percentage points lower per percentage-point reduction in local mortality, quantifying causal effects of place on mortality among this population. Migrants' mortality is also lower in destinations with healthier behaviors and higher incomes but is unrelated to local medical spending and quality.

10.3386/w24822.abstractZh: 我们通过追踪Medicare队列的数据，来估算飓风卡特里娜对最初居住在新奥尔良的灾民的长期死亡影响。考虑到最初的冲击，飓风使八年的生存率提高了2.07个百分点。迁移到死亡率较低的地区解释了这一生存率提升的大部分原因。那些迁移到低死亡率地区与高死亡率地区的灾民在基线时情况相似，但随着当地死亡率每降低一个百分点，他们的后续死亡率则降低0.83至1.01个百分点，这量化了地点对这类人群死亡率的因果效应。迁移到目的地地区的灾民，其死亡率也较低，这些地区的人们有更健康的行为习惯和更高的收入，但这与当地的医疗支出和医疗质量无关。

abstract.text: A fundamental concern for researchers who analyze and design experiments is that the estimate obtained from the experiment might not be externally valid for other policies of interest. Researchers often attempt to assess external validity by comparing data from an experiment to external data. In this paper, I discuss approaches from the treatment effects literature that researchers can use to begin the examination of external validity internally, within the data from a single experiment. I focus on presenting the approaches simply using stylized examples.

10.3386/w24834.abstractZh: 对于分析和设计实验的研究人员来说，一个基本的担忧是，从实验中获得的估计结果可能不适用于其他相关政策。研究人员通常尝试通过将实验数据与外部数据进行比较来评估外部有效性。在本文中，我讨论了来自处理效应文献中的方法，这些方法可以帮助研究人员在单个实验的数据内部开始对外部有效性进行考察。我重点是通过一些简化的例子来介绍这些方法。

abstract.text: In this paper we build on our earlier work on underemployment using data from the UK. In particular, we explore their well-being based on hours preferences rather than on involuntary part-time work used in the prior literature. We make use of five main measures of well-being: happiness; life satisfaction; whether life is worthwhile; anxiety and depression. The underemployed have higher levels of well-being than the unemployed and disabled but lower levels than any other group of workers, full or part-time. The more that actual hours differ from preferred hours the lower is a worker's well-being. This is true for those who say they want more hours (the underemployed) and those who say they want less (the over employed). We find strong evidence of a rise in depression and anxiety (negative affect) in the years since the onset of austerity in 2010 that is not matched by declines in happiness measures (positive affect). The fear of unemployment obtained from monthly surveys from the EU has also been on the rise since 2015. We find evidence of an especially large rise in anxiety and depression among workers in general and the underemployed in particular. The underemployed don't want to be underemployed.

10.3386/w24840.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们基于之前关于英国失业人口的研究，进一步探讨了他们的福祉状况。我们关注的是基于工作时间偏好而非非自愿兼职工作的福祉评估。我们采用了五个主要的福祉指标：幸福感、生活满意度、对生活的价值感、焦虑与抑郁。与失业者和残疾人相比，失业人口的整体福祉水平较高，但低于其他任何全职或兼职劳动者。实际工作时间与期望工作时间的差异越大，劳动者的福祉水平就越低。这一结论适用于那些希望工作更多时间的人（失业人口）以及那些希望工作更少时间的人（过度就业者）。我们发现，自2010年紧缩政策实施以来，抑郁和焦虑（负面情绪）的发生率有所上升，而幸福感（正面情绪）则没有相应下降。自2015年以来，欧盟月度调查中的失业恐惧感也持续上升。我们发现，劳动者尤其是失业人口的焦虑和抑郁情绪出现了特别明显的上升。失业人口本身并不希望处于失业状态。

abstract.text: Many consumer behaviors are both addictive and social. Understanding how these two phenomena interact informs basic models of human behavior, and matters for policymakers when the behavior is regulated. I develop a new model of demand that incorporates both addiction and social interactions and show that, under certain conditions, social interactions reinforce the effects of addiction. I also show how the dynamics introduced by addiction can solve the pernicious problem of identifying the causal effects of social interactions. I then use the model to illustrate a new and important identification problem for studies of social interactions: existing estimates cannot be used to draw welfare conclusions or even to deduce whether social interactions increase aggregate demand. Finally, I develop a method that allows researchers to distinguish between two common forms of social interactions and draw welfare conclusions.

10.3386/w24842.abstractZh: 许多消费者行为既具有成瘾性，又具有社会性。了解这两种现象之间的相互作用有助于构建人类行为的基本模型，对于政策制定者来说也具有重要意义，尤其是在行为需要被规范的情况下。我提出了一个新的需求模型，该模型同时考虑了成瘾性和社会性互动的影响，并表明在某些条件下，社会性互动会强化成瘾性的效应。我还展示了成瘾性带来的动态变化如何解决识别社会性互动的因果效应这一棘手问题。随后，我利用该模型阐述了一个关于社会性互动研究中的重要识别问题：现有的估计结果无法用于得出福利结论，甚至无法判断社会性互动是否会增加总需求。最后，我提出了一种方法，使研究人员能够区分两种常见的社会性互动形式，并据此得出福利结论。

abstract.text: We estimate the extent of defensive medicine by physicians, embracing the no-liability counterfactual made possible by the structure of liability rules in the Military Heath System. Active-duty patients seeking treatment from military facilities cannot sue for harms resulting from negligent care, while protections are provided to dependents treated at military facilities and to all patients—active-duty or not—that receive care from civilian facilities. Drawing on this variation and exploiting exogenous shocks to care location choices stemming from base-hospital closures, we find suggestive evidence that liability immunity reduces inpatient spending by 5% with no measurable negative effect on patient outcomes.

10.3386/w24846.abstractZh: 我们通过分析军事健康体系中的责任规则结构，来估算医生进行防御性医疗的行为程度。现役患者从军事医疗机构接受治疗时，无法因疏忽造成的伤害而提起诉讼，而依赖军事医疗机构治疗的患者以及所有从民用医疗机构接受治疗的病人——无论是否现役——都享有相应的保护。基于这种差异，并考虑因医院关闭导致的医疗地点选择的外生冲击，我们发现责任豁免可使住院费用减少5%，且对患者治疗结果没有明显的负面影响。

abstract.text: We analyze the financial value of insurance when individuals have access to credit markets. Loans allow consumers to smooth shocks across time, decreasing the value of the smoothing (across states of the world) provided by insurance. We derive a simple formula for the incremental value of insurance and show how it depends on individual age, health, and income and on the features of available loans. Our central contribution is to derive formulas for aggregate welfare that can be taken to data from typical studies of health insurance. We provide both exact formulas that can be taken to data on the distribution of medical expenditures and income and an approximate formula for aggregate data on medical expenditure. Using the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey we illustrate how the incremental value of insurance is decreasing with access to loans. For consumers in the sickest decile, access to a five-year loan decreases the incremental value of insurance by $338 (6%) on average and $3,433 (36%) for the poorest consumers. We also find that our approximate formula is a reasonable proxy for the exact one in our data.

10.3386/w24851.abstractZh: 我们分析了个人能够接触信贷市场时保险的经济价值。贷款使消费者能够平滑不同时期的冲击，从而降低了保险所提供的平滑效果（在不同的状态下）。我们推导出了一个简单的公式，用于计算保险的增量价值，并展示了该价值如何取决于个人的年龄、健康状况和收入，以及可用贷款的特点。我们的主要贡献是推导出可以应用于典型健康保险研究数据的综合福利公式。我们提供了两种公式：一种可以应用于医疗支出和收入分布的数据，另一种则适用于医疗支出的综合数据。通过《医疗支出调查》，我们展示了随着贷款机会的增加，保险的增量价值是如何下降的。对于最健康的消费者群体，五年期贷款的获取会使保险的增量价值平均减少338美元（6%），而对于最贫困的消费者来说，这一减少幅度则达到了3,433美元（36%）。我们还发现，我们的近似公式在我们的数据中可以合理地替代精确公式。

abstract.text: Since 2011, when the landmark “Dear Colleague” letter declared that the Department of Education (DoE) would use equal-access requirements of federal law to remediate sexual assault on college campuses, 458 investigations have been opened. This letter was withdrawn in 2017 and it remains uncertain how the DoE will handle the issue in the future. We examine the effects of the investigations arising from the 2011 policy change on university outcomes. We find that applications and enrollment increase in response to Title IX investigations, for both males and females. We find little evidence of effects on degree completion or donations.

10.3386/w24852.abstractZh: 自2011年，教育部发布具有里程碑意义的“亲爱的同事”函件，宣布将运用联邦法律中的平等访问要求来整治大学校园内的性侵犯问题以来，已有458起调查被展开。该函件于2017年被撤回，目前尚不清楚教育部未来将如何处理这一问题。我们研究了2011年政策变更引发的调查对大学教育成果的影响。研究发现，针对《第九条修正案》的调查，无论是男性还是女性的申请和入学人数都有所增加。然而，关于对学位完成率或捐赠额的影响，我们发现几乎没有证据支持。

abstract.text: Evaluating policy changes that occur everywhere at the same time is difficult because of the lack of a clear counterfactual. Hoping to address this problem, researchers often proxy for differential exposure using some observed characteristic in the pre-treatment period. As a cautionary tale of how difficult identification is in such settings, we re-examine the results of an influential paper by Melissa Kearney and Phillip Levine, who found that the MTV program 16 and Pregnant had a substantial impact on teen birth rates. In what amounts to a difference-in-differences approach, they use the pre-treatment levels of MTV viewership across media markets as an instrument. We show that controlling for differential time trends in birth rates by a market’s pre-treatment racial/ethnic composition or unemployment rate causes Kearney and Levine’s results to disappear, invalidating the parallel trends assumption necessary for a causal interpretation. Extending the pre-treatment period and estimating placebo tests, we find evidence of an “effect” long before 16 and Pregnant started broadcasting. Our results highlight the difficulty of drawing causal inferences from national point-in-time policy changes.

10.3386/w24856.abstractZh: 评估同时发生在各地的政策变化是困难的，因为缺乏明确的可逆情况。为了解决这个问题，研究人员通常会使用治疗前时期的一些观测特征来替代差异暴露。作为一个警示案例，我们重新审视了Melissa Kearney和Phillip Levine的一项有影响力的研究，他们发现《MTV节目16 and Pregnant》对青少年生育率产生了显著影响。在这项研究中，他们使用了不同媒体市场治疗前的MTV收视率作为工具变量。我们发现，通过控制市场治疗前的种族/族裔构成或失业率对生育率的影响，Kearney和Levine的研究结果就不成立了，这 invalidates 因果解释所需的平行趋势假设。通过延长治疗前时期并估计安慰剂测试，我们发现“效应”早在《16 and Pregnant》开始播出之前就已经存在。我们的研究结果突显了从全国性的时间点政策变化中得出因果推断的困难。

abstract.text: The National Institutes of Health (NIH) plays a critical role in funding scientific endeavors in biomedicine that would be difficult to finance via private sources. One important mandate of the NIH is to fund innovative science that tries out new ideas, but many have questioned the NIH’s ability to fulfill this aim. We examine whether the NIH succeeds in funding work that tries out novel ideas. We find that novel science is more often NIH funded than is less innovative science but this positive result comes with several caveats. First, despite the implementation of initiatives to support edge science, the preference for funding novel science is mostly limited to work that builds on novel basic science ideas; projects that build on novel clinical ideas are not favored by the NIH over projects that build on well-established clinical knowledge. Second, NIH’s general preference for funding work that builds on basic science ideas, regardless of its novelty or application area, is a large contributor to the overall positive link between novelty and NIH funding. If funding rates for work that builds on basic science ideas and work that builds on clinical ideas had been equal, NIH’s funding rates for novel and traditional science would have been the same. Third, NIH’s propensity to fund projects that build on the most recent advances has declined over the last several decades. Thus, in this regard NIH funding has become more conservative despite initiatives to increase funding for innovative projects.

10.3386/w24860.abstractZh: 美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）在资助生物医学领域的科学研究方面发挥着关键作用，这些研究如果由私人来源资助可能会面临困难。NIH的一个重要职责是资助那些尝试新想法的创新科学研究，但许多人质疑NIH实现这一目标的能力。我们研究了NIH是否成功资助了那些尝试新想法的研究。研究发现，与创新性较低的研究相比，新颖性较高的研究更常被NIH资助，但这一积极结果也存在一些限制。首先，尽管实施了支持前沿科学的研究计划，但NIH对新颖性研究的资助主要局限于基于基础科学新想法的研究；而基于临床新想法的项目并不比基于成熟临床知识的项目更受NIH青睐。其次，NIH普遍倾向于资助基于基础科学想法的研究，而不考虑其新颖性或应用领域，这一倾向是新颖性与NIH资助之间积极关联的一个重要因素。如果基于基础科学想法的研究与基于临床想法的研究的资助比例相同，那么NIH对新颖性和传统性研究的资助比例应该是相同的。第三，过去几十年里，NIH对基于最新进展的研究的资助倾向有所降低。因此，尽管有增加创新项目资助的举措，NIH的资助方式已经变得更加保守。

abstract.text: Selective contracting is an increasingly popular tool for reducing health care costs, but these savings must be weighed against consumer surplus losses from restricted access. In both public and private prescription drug insurance plans, issuers utilize preferred pharmacy networks to reduce drug prices. We show that, in the Medicare Part D program, drug plans with more restrictive preferred pharmacy networks, and plans with fewer enrollees who are insensitive to preferred pharmacy discounts on copays, pay lower retail drug prices. We then use estimates of plan and pharmacy demand to estimate the first-order costs and benefits of selective contracting in the presence of enrollees with heterogeneous sensitivity to preferred supplier incentives.

10.3386/w24862.abstractZh: 选择性签约是降低医疗成本的一种越来越受欢迎的方法，但这些节省必须与因限制就医而带来的消费者剩余损失进行权衡。在公共和私人处方药保险计划中，保险公司都利用优先药房网络来降低药品价格。我们的研究表明，在Medicare Part D计划中，那些对优先药房网络有更严格要求的保险计划，以及那些对优先药房折扣不敏感、参保人数较少的保险计划，其零售药品价格更低。接着，我们利用计划和药房需求的估计数据，来估算在参保人对优先供应商激励措施敏感度存在差异的情况下，选择性签约的一阶成本和收益。

abstract.text: We study how firms target and influence expert intermediaries. In our empirical context, pharmaceutical manufacturers provide payments to physicians during promotional interactions. We develop an identification strategy based on plausibly exogenous variation in payments driven by differential exposure to spillovers from academic medical centers’ conflict-of-interest policies. Using a detailed case study of an important class of cardiovascular drugs, we estimate heterogeneous effects of payments on prescribing, with firms targeting highly responsive physicians. Our model of supply and demand allows us to quantify how oligopoly prices reduce drug prescribing, and how payments move prescribing closer to the optimal level, but at great financial cost to patients and payers. In our estimated model, consumers are worse off with payments, unless there is substantial underprescribing due to behavioral or other frictions. In a final exercise, we calibrate such frictions using clinical data. We estimate that, in this case study, payments benefit consumers.

10.3386/w24864.abstractZh: 我们研究了企业如何针对并影响专家中间商。在我们的实证研究中，制药公司在与医生的互动过程中提供支付。我们提出了一种识别策略，该策略基于支付的可解释性变化，这种变化是由对学术医疗中心利益冲突政策影响的差异所驱动的。通过对一类重要的心血管药物的详细案例研究，我们估计了支付对处方行为的不同影响，其中企业主要针对反应迅速的医生。我们的供需模型使我们能够量化寡头价格如何降低药物处方量，以及支付如何使处方量接近最优水平，但给患者和支付者带来了巨大的财务成本。在我们估计的模型中，除非存在由于行为或其他因素导致的严重处方不足，否则支付会使消费者处于更糟糕的境地。在最后的练习中，我们使用临床数据来校准这些因素。我们估计，在这个案例研究中，支付对消费者是有益的。

abstract.text: We systematically review the literature linking health to economic activity, particularly education and labor market outcomes, over the lifecycle. In the first part, we review studies that link childhood health to later-life outcomes. The main themes we focus on are in-utero exposures, birthweight, physical health and nutrition, mental health, and the environment. In the second part, we review studies of the impact of health on labor market success for adults. The main themes we focus on are the environment, disability, physical health shocks, within-household spillovers, cancer, and mental health.

10.3386/w24865.abstractZh: 我们系统地回顾了将健康与经济活动联系起来的文献，特别是教育与劳动力市场结果在生命周期中的关系。在第一部分中，我们回顾了将儿童健康与后期生活结果联系起来的研究。我们重点关注的主题包括子宫内暴露、出生体重、身体健康与营养、心理健康以及环境因素。在第二部分中，我们回顾了健康对成年人劳动力市场成功影响的研究。我们重点关注的主题包括环境、残疾、身体健康冲击、家庭内部的溢出效应、癌症以及心理健康。

abstract.text: We study how privately insured individuals choose lower-limb MRI scan providers. Despite significant out-of-pocket costs and little variation in quality, patients often received care in high-priced locations when lower priced options were available. The choice of provider is such that, on average, patients bypassed 6 lower-priced providers between their homes and treatment locations. We show that referring physicians heavily influence where patients receive care. The influence of referring physicians is dramatically greater than the influence of patient cost-sharing or patients’ home zip code fixed effects. Patients with vertically integrated referring physicians are also more likely to receive costlier hospital-based scans.

10.3386/w24869.abstractZh: 我们研究了私人保险客户如何选择低成本的下肢MRI扫描机构。尽管实际支出较高且服务质量差异不大，但患者在有更低价格选择的情况下，仍常常选择价格较高的机构接受治疗。平均而言，患者在从家中到治疗地点的过程中，会跳过6个价格较低的机构。研究表明，转诊医生对患者的治疗地点有着显著的影响，其影响程度远超患者自身费用分担情况或家庭邮政编码的固定效应。拥有垂直整合转诊医生的患者，也更有可能接受价格较高的医院级扫描服务。

abstract.text: We study how extreme temperature exposure impacts infant survival in the developing world. Our analysis overcomes the absence of vital registration systems in many poor countries, which has been a limiting factor in the temperature-mortality literature, by extracting birth histories from household surveys. Studying 53 developing countries that span the globe, we find impacts of hot days on infant mortality that are an order of magnitude larger than estimates from rich country studies, with humidity playing an important role. The size and implied geographic distribution of harms documented here have the potential to significantly alter assessments of optimal climate policy.

10.3386/w24870.abstractZh: 我们研究了极端温度暴露对发展中国家婴儿存活率的影响。我们的分析克服了许多贫困国家缺乏重要登记制度这一限制因素，通过从家庭调查中提取出生记录来弥补这一不足。通过对全球53个发展中国家的研究，我们发现炎热天气对婴儿死亡率的影响比富裕国家的研究结果要大一个数量级，而湿度在其中起着重要作用。这里记录的伤害规模和地理分布有可能显著改变对最佳气候政策的评估。

abstract.text: The canonical consumer demand model predicts that as the price of a substitute decreases, quantity demanded for a good decreases. In the case of demand for sexual activity and availability of alternative leisure activities, popular culture expresses this prediction as “television kills your sex life.” This paper examines the association between television ownership and coital frequency using data from nearly 4 million individuals in national household surveys in 80 countries from 5 continents. The results suggest that while television may not kill your sex life, it is associated with some sex life morbidity. Under our most conservative estimate, we find that television ownership is associated with approximately a 6% reduction in the likelihood of having had sex in the past week, consistent with a small degree of substitutability between television viewing and sexual activity. Household wealth and reproductive health knowledge do not appear to be driving this association.

10.3386/w24882.abstractZh: 经典的消费者需求模型预测，当替代品的价格下降时，对某种商品的需求量也会减少。在性活动的需求以及替代休闲活动的可用性方面，流行文化将这一预测表述为“电视毁掉了你的性生活”。本文利用来自五大洲80个国家近400万人的全国家庭调查数据，研究了电视拥有量与性行为频率之间的关联。研究结果表明，虽然电视可能不会完全毁掉你的性生活，但它确实与一些性生活的健康问题有关。根据我们最保守的估计，我们发现电视拥有量与过去一周发生性行为的可能性减少了约6%，这与电视观看与性活动之间存在一定程度的可替代性是一致的。家庭财富和生殖健康知识似乎并未推动这种关联。

abstract.text: Research on the effects of prenatal care on birth outcomes has produced a patchwork of findings that are not easily summarized. Studies have used varying definitions of prenatal care, leading to estimates that are difficult to compare. The identification of causal effects is particularly challenging in this literature because women enter pregnancy with varying states of health, resources and the desire to have a child and it is not feasible to conduct randomized controlled trials that deny care. The content and quality of prenatal care can vary, even across individuals initiating care at the same point in their pregnancies and with similar medical and psychosocial issues. In this chapter, we review the literature on the effects of prenatal care on birth outcomes, highlighting studies with strong research designs and plausible effect sizes. We reconcile the findings to the extent possible, summarize what is known to date, and point to potentially fruitful research directions going forward.

10.3386/w24885.abstractZh: 关于产前护理对分娩结果影响的研究结果参差不齐，难以进行总结。不同研究采用了不同的产前护理定义，导致评估结果难以比较。在这种文献中，确定因果效应尤其具有挑战性，因为女性在怀孕时所处的健康状况、资源状况以及生育意愿各不相同，因此进行排除护理的随机对照试验是不可行的。即使是在同一孕期的不同个体中，产前护理的内容和质量也可能存在差异，而且这些个体可能面临相似的医疗和心理社会问题。在本章中，我们回顾了关于产前护理对分娩结果影响的相关研究，重点介绍了那些研究设计严谨且效应量可信的研究。我们尽可能地将研究结果进行整合，总结目前已知的信息，并指出未来可能具有研究前景的方向。

abstract.text: The impact of information on consumer behavior is a classic topic in economics, and there has recently been particular interest in whether providing nutritional information leads consumers to choose healthier diets. For example, a nationwide requirement of calorie counts on the menus of chain restaurants took effect in the U.S. in May, 2018, and the results of such information disclosure are not well known. To estimate the impact of menu labeling, we conducted a randomized controlled field experiment in two full-service restaurants, in which the control group received the usual menus and the treatment group received the same menus but with calorie counts. We estimate that the labels resulted in a 3.0% reduction in calories ordered, with the reduction occurring in appetizers and entrees but not drinks or desserts. Exposure to the information also increases consumers’ support for requiring calorie labels by 9.6%. These results are informative about the impact of the new nationwide menu label requirement, and more generally contribute to the literature on the impact of information disclosure on consumer behavior.

10.3386/w24889.abstractZh: 信息对消费者行为的影响是经济学中的一个经典话题，最近人们特别关注提供营养信息是否会让消费者选择更健康的饮食。例如，美国于2018年5月开始实施连锁餐厅菜单上必须标注卡路里含量的规定，而此类信息公开的效果尚未得到充分研究。为了评估菜单标签的影响，我们在两家全服务餐厅进行了随机对照实地实验，其中对照组收到的是常规菜单，而实验组则收到同样但带有卡路里信息的菜单。我们的估计显示，这些标签使得顾客点的卡路里减少了3.0%，这一减少主要体现在开胃菜和主餐上，而饮料和甜点则没有变化。此外，接触这些信息还使消费者对要求标注卡路里含量的支持增加了9.6%。这些结果有助于了解新的全国性菜单标签要求的影响，并且总体上为关于信息公开对消费者行为影响的研究提供了有价值的参考。

abstract.text: We use grocery purchase data to analyze dietary changes. We show that households – including those with more income or education - do not improve diet in response to disease diagnosis or changes in household circumstances. We then identify households who show large improvements in diet quality. We use machine learning to predict these households and find (1) concentration of baseline diet in a small number of foods is a predictor of improvement and (2) dietary changes are concentrated in a small number of foods. We argue these patterns may be well fit by a model which incorporates attention costs.

10.3386/w24892.abstractZh: 我们利用食品购买数据来分析饮食变化。我们发现，包括那些收入或教育水平较高的家庭在内，它们在面对疾病诊断或家庭环境变化时并未改善饮食。随后，我们识别出那些饮食质量有显著改善的家庭。我们利用机器学习来预测这些家庭，并发现：（1）基础饮食中少数几种食物的集中摄入是饮食改善的一个预测因素；（2）饮食变化主要集中在少数几种食物上。我们认为，这些模式可能更适合由一个包含注意力成本的模型来拟合。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of a Medicaid disenrollment on employment, sources of health insurance coverage, health, and health care utilization of childless adults using longitudinal data from the 2004 Panel of the Survey of Income and Program Participation. From July through September 2005, TennCare, the Tennessee Medicaid program, disenrolled approximately 170,000 adults following a change in eligibility rules. Following this eligibility change, the fraction of adults in Tennessee covered by Medicaid fell by over 5 percentage points while uninsured rates increased by almost 5 percentage points relative to adults in other Southern states. There is no evidence of an increase in employment rates in Tennessee following the disenrollment. Self-reported health and access to medical care worsened as hospitalization rates, doctor visits, and dentist visits all declined while the use of free or public clinics increased. The Tennessee experience suggests that undoing the expansion of Medicaid eligibility to adults that occurred under the Affordable Care Act likely would reduce health insurance coverage, reduce health care access, and worsen health but would not lead to increases in employment.

10.3386/w24899.abstractZh: 本研究利用2004年收入与项目参与调查的纵向数据，探讨了 Medicaid 退出对无子女成年人就业、健康保险来源、健康状况以及医疗利用的影响。2005年7月至9月期间，根据资格规则变更，田纳西州 Medicaid 计划中的约17万成年人被排除在外。此次资格变更后，田纳西州接受 Medicaid 覆盖的成年人比例下降了5个百分点以上，而无保险率则相对于其他南方州上升了近5个百分点。没有证据表明退出 Medicaid 后田纳西州的就业率有所提高。自我报告的健康状况和医疗获取能力恶化，住院率、医生就诊次数和牙医就诊次数均下降，而免费或公共诊所的使用率则上升。田纳西州的案例表明，在《平价医疗法案》下对成年人扩大 Medicaid 资格的做法，很可能会减少健康保险覆盖，降低医疗获取能力，并恶化健康状况，但不会导致就业率的上升。

abstract.text: This paper examines the application of quasi-experimental methods in environmental economics. We begin with two observations: i) standard quasi-experimental methods, first applied in other microeconomic fields, typically assume unit-level treatments that do not spill over across units; (ii) because public goods, such as environmental attributes, exhibit externalities, treatment of one unit often affects other units. To explore the implications of applying standard quasi-experimental methods to public good problems, we extend the potential outcomes framework to explicitly distinguish between unit-level source and the resulting group-level exposure of a public good. This new framework serves as a foundation for reviewing and interpreting key papers from the recent empirical literature. We formally demonstrate that two common quasi-experimental estimators of the marginal social benefit of a public good can be biased due to externality spillovers, even when the source of the public good itself is quasi-randomly assigned. We propose an unbiased estimator for the valuation of local public goods and discuss how it can be implemented in future studies. Finally, we consider how to preserve the advantages of the quasi-experimental approach when valuing global public goods, such as climate change mitigation, for which no control units are available.

10.3386/w24903.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在环境经济学中应用准实验方法的情况。我们首先提出两个观察结果：i) 标准的准实验方法最初应用于其他微观经济领域时，通常假设的是不跨单位传播的处理方式；(ii) 由于公共物品（如环境属性）具有外部性，一个单位的处理往往会影响其他单位。为了探讨将标准准实验方法应用于公共物品问题所带来的影响，我们扩展了潜在结果框架，明确区分了单位层面的来源与群体层面的暴露情况。这一新框架为回顾和解释近期实证文献中的关键论文提供了基础。我们正式证明了，即使公共物品的来源是准随机分配的，两种常见的准实验方法估计公共物品边际社会利益时仍可能存在偏差。我们提出了一种无偏估计方法，用于评估本地公共物品的价值，并讨论了如何在未来的研究中实施该方法。最后，我们考虑了在评估全球公共物品（如气候变化缓解）时如何保留准实验方法的优势，因为在这些情况下没有可供控制的单位。

abstract.text: The Greek crisis was the most severe in postwar Europe; its budget cuts were the deepest. Among the components of the budget, health spending was hit particularly hard, declining by more than one third in just five years. This paper has two goals: establish the facts about health inputs, outputs and outcomes during the Greek crisis, and explore the connection between budget cuts and health outcomes. Health spending and inputs were very high in Greece before the crisis: in several dimensions, even after the budget cuts were implemented health spending and inputs were still at or near the top of the European countries; in other cases they merely went back to the European average. Nevertheless, budget cuts so deep and so sudden are unlikely to merely cut into inefficiencies and overcapacities. I highlight several areas in which a comparative quantitative analysis suggests that budget cuts might have had an appreciable effects on the health of the population.

10.3386/w24909.abstractZh: 希腊危机是战后欧洲最严重的危机之一，其预算削减幅度也是最深的。在预算的各个组成部分中，医疗支出受到的影响尤为严重，在短短五年时间里减少了三分之一以上。本文有两个目标：一是梳理希腊危机期间医疗投入、产出和成果的相关事实；二是探讨预算削减与医疗成果之间的联系。在危机之前，希腊的医疗支出和投入水平一直很高：即使在实施预算削减之后，这些指标在多个维度上仍然处于欧洲国家的前列；而在其他方面，则仅回到了欧洲的平均水平。然而，如此深度且突然的预算削减，不太可能仅仅是解决效率低下和产能过剩问题。本文重点分析了几个领域，通过比较性定量分析，认为预算削减可能对民众的健康产生了显著影响。

abstract.text: Low birth weight infants born to mothers with low educational attainment have a double hurdle to overcome in the production of human capital. We examine whether income transfers in the form of Supplemental Security Income (SSI) payments for children with disabilities can help close the gap in outcomes due to this initial health and environmental disadvantage. We exploit a discontinuity in SSI eligibility at 1200 grams and use a regression discontinuity approach to produce causal estimates of the effects of SSI eligibility. We find that eligibility increases disability benefit participation, improves child outcomes and parenting behaviors, and shifts maternal labor supply from full to part time.

10.3386/w24913.abstractZh: 教育程度较低的母亲所生的低出生体重婴儿在人力资本积累过程中面临双重障碍。我们研究以残疾儿童补充保障金形式提供的收入转移是否能够帮助弥补因初始健康和环境劣势所导致的成果差距。我们利用1200克体重作为补充保障金资格认定的断点，并采用回归断点分析法来估算补充保障金资格对影响的因果效应。研究发现，获得资格会增加残疾儿童的福利参与率，改善儿童成长状况及育儿行为，同时使母亲的劳动力供给从全职转变为兼职。

abstract.text: Using meta-analysis we find that, on average, sought-after schools do not improve student test scores. A potential explanation for this result is that parents value schools that improve outcomes not well-measured by test scores. We explore this notion using both administrative and survey data from Barbados. Using a regression discontinuity design, preferred schools have better peers but do not improve short-run test scores. Consistent with the proposed explanation, the same students at the same schools have more post-secondary school completion and improved adult well-being (based on an index of educational attainment, occupational rank, earnings, and health). These long-run benefits are larger for females who also experience reduced teen motherhood. Mechanisms are explored.

10.3386/w24920.abstractZh: 通过元分析我们发现，平均而言，受欢迎的学校并不会提升学生的考试成绩。这一结果的潜在解释是，家长更看重那些能通过考试成绩难以衡量的学校所带来的积极影响。我们利用巴巴多斯的行政数据和调查数据来探讨这一现象。采用回归不连续设计后发现，受欢迎的学校在同学中表现较好，但短期内并未提升学生的考试成绩。与提出的解释一致的是，同一所学校中的学生，在高等教育完成率以及成人福祉方面表现更好（这些指标包括教育水平、职业地位、收入和健康状况）。对于女性学生来说，这些长期收益更为显著，同时她们也减少了成为单亲母亲的风险。我们进一步探讨了这些影响的机制。

abstract.text: We estimate the effects of horizontal mergers on marginal cost efficiencies – an ubiquitous merger justification – using data containing supply purchase orders from a large sample of US hospitals 2009-2015. The data provide a level of detail that has been difficult to observe previously, and a variety of product categories that allows us to examine economic mechanisms underlying “buyer power.” We find that merger target hospitals save on average $176 thousand (or 1.5 percent) annually, driven by geographically local efficiencies in price negotiations for high-tech “physician preference items.” We find only mixed evidence on savings by acquirers.

10.3386/w24926.abstractZh: 我们利用2009-2015年间来自大量美国医院的数据，估算了横向合并对边际成本效率的影响——这是合并的常见理由。这些数据提供了以前难以观察到的详细程度，以及多种产品类别的信息，使我们能够研究“买方力量”背后的经济机制。我们发现，合并目标医院平均每年可节省17.6万美元（或1.5%）的成本，这主要得益于在价格谈判中获得的地理本地化优势，尤其是在高科技“医生偏好项目”上。关于收购方节省成本的情况，我们的研究结果则较为混合。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the effects of trade in foods on obesity in Mexico. To do so, we match data on Mexican food imports from the U.S. with anthropometric and food expenditure data. Our findings suggest that exposure to food imports from the U.S. explains about ten percent of the rise in obesity prevalence among Mexican women between 1988 and 2012. Pro-obesity effects are driven by areas more exposed to unhealthy food imports. We also find evidence in favour of a price mechanism. By linking trade flows to obesity, the paper sheds light on an important channel through which globalisation may affect health.

10.3386/w24942.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了食品贸易对墨西哥肥胖问题的影响。为此，我们将墨西哥从美国进口的食品数据与人体测量数据和食品支出数据进行了对比。研究发现，1988年至2012年间，墨西哥女性肥胖率上升的约10%可归因于接触来自美国的食品进口。导致肥胖效应的因素主要集中在那些更容易接触到不健康食品进口的地区。我们还发现了支持价格机制的证据。通过将贸易流动与肥胖问题联系起来，本文揭示了全球化可能影响健康的一个重要渠道。

abstract.text: There is substantial waste in U.S. healthcare, but little consensus on how to identify or combat it. We identify one specific source of waste: long-term care hospitals (LTCHs). These post-acute care facilities began as a regulatory carve-out for a few dozen specialty hospitals, but have expanded into an industry with over 400 hospitals and $5.4 billion in annual Medicare spending in 2014. We use the entry of LTCHs into local hospital markets and an event study design to estimate LTCHs’ impact. We find that most LTCH patients would have counterfactually received care at Skilled Nursing Facilities – post-acute care facilities that provide medically similar care to LTCHs but are paid significantly less – and that substitution to LTCHs leaves patients unaffected or worse off on all dimensions we can objectively measure. Our results imply that Medicare could save about $4.6 billion per year – with no harm to patients – by not allowing for discharge to LTCHs.

10.3386/w24946.abstractZh: 美国的医疗保健存在大量浪费现象，但关于如何识别或解决这一问题尚无共识。我们发现了一种特定的浪费来源：长期护理医院。这些后期护理设施最初是作为少数几家专科医院的监管豁免而设立的，但后来发展成为一个拥有400多家医院、2014年年度Medicare支出达54亿美元的行业。我们通过分析长期护理医院进入当地医院市场的现象，并采用事件研究设计来估算其影响。研究发现，大多数长期护理医院的患者在实际情况下本应接受专业护理设施的护理——这些设施提供的医疗服务与长期护理医院相似，但收费却低得多——而转向专业护理设施后，患者在我们能够客观衡量的所有方面都会受到不利影响。我们的研究结果表明，如果Medicare不允许患者出院到长期护理医院，每年可以节省约46亿美元，同时不会对患者造成任何伤害。

abstract.text: States, which have the primary legal role in regulating the prescribing and dispensing of prescription medications, have created Prescription Drug Monitoring Programs (PDMP) to try to reduce inappropriate prescribing, dispensing, and related harm. Research assessing whether these interventions are effective has produced inconclusive and contradictory results. Here we examine whether different data sources may have contributed to the varying results. Specifically, we: 1) identify the decisions inherent in creating such a dataset; 2) discuss the public data sources used by researchers in previous work; 3) develop and apply a detailed research protocol to create a novel PDMP law dataset; and 4) to illustrate potential consequences of data choice, apply various data sources to analyze the relationship between PDMP laws and prescribing and dispensing of opioids among disabled Medicare beneficiaries. We find that our dates differ from those in existing datasets, sometimes by many years. The regression analyses generated a twofold difference in point estimates, as well as different signed estimates, depending on the data used. We conclude that the lack of transparency about data assembly in existing datasets, differences among dates by source, and the regression results raise concerns for PDMP researchers and policymakers.

10.3386/w24947.abstractZh: 各州在监管处方药的开具和分发方面具有主要的法律职责，因此建立了处方药监测计划（PDMP），以试图减少不适当的处方、分发及相关危害。关于这些干预措施是否有效的研究结果并不一致且存在矛盾。本文探讨了不同的数据来源是否导致了这些结果的差异。具体来说，我们：1）明确了创建此类数据集所涉及的决策过程；2）讨论了以往研究中研究人员使用的公共数据来源；3）开发并应用了详细的研究方案来创建新的PDMP法律数据集；4）通过应用不同的数据来源来分析PDMP法律与残疾Medicare受益人阿片类药物处方和分发之间的关系，从而说明数据选择的潜在后果。我们发现，我们的数据日期与现有数据集中的日期存在差异，有时相差多年。回归分析显示，根据所使用的数据，点估计值存在两倍的差异，以及不同的符号估计值。我们得出结论，现有数据集中关于数据组装的透明度不足、数据来源之间的日期差异以及回归结果都引发了PDMP研究人员和政策制定者的担忧。

abstract.text: While the relationship between adverse health shocks and health care utilization has been studied extensively, next to nothing is known about the effect of health shocks on religiosity, which may serve as an alternative to secular psychological services and interventions. Filling this gap in knowledge is important given that religious-based psychological counseling services have grown substantially in recent decades, and the relative mental health benefits of religion as compared to secular counseling services are not well-known. This study uses the setting of war to study the impact of health trauma on religiosity. Exploiting the administrative procedures by which U.S. Armed Forces senior commanders conditionally randomly assign active-duty servicemen to war deployments as a natural experiment, we find that post-9/11 combat exposure substantially increases the probability that a serviceman subsequently attends religious services and engages in private prayer. Estimated effects are largest for enlisted servicemen, those under age 25, and servicemen wounded in combat. The physical and psychological health effects of war, as well as the presence of military chaplains in combat zones, emerge as partial mechanisms to explain increases in religiosity. We find only weak evidence that combat service differentially affects servicemen’s demand for religious counseling as compared to secular psychological services.

10.3386/w24954.abstractZh: 虽然关于健康冲击与医疗利用之间的关系已经进行了大量研究，但关于健康冲击对宗教虔诚度的影响却知之甚少。宗教虔诚度可以作为替代世俗心理服务和干预措施的一种选择。鉴于基于宗教的心理咨询服务在最近几十年中有了显著增长，而宗教与世俗咨询服务在相对心理健康方面的益处尚未得到充分认识，填补这一知识空白显得尤为重要。本研究以战争为背景，探讨健康创伤对宗教虔诚度的影响。通过利用美国武装部队高级指挥官有条件地随机将现役军人分配到战争地区的行政程序，我们发现9/11事件后的战斗经历显著增加了军人随后参加宗教活动和个人祈祷的可能性。估计效果在士兵、25岁以下的人以及在战斗中受伤的军人身上最为明显。战争的身体和心理健康影响，以及军事牧师在战区中的存在，被认为是解释宗教虔诚度增加的部分机制。我们发现，战斗经历对军人对宗教咨询服务的需求与世俗心理服务的需求的影响差异不大，但证据较为薄弱。

abstract.text: Treatment for depression is complex, requiring decisions that may involve tradeoffs between exploiting treatments with the highest expected value or experimenting with treatments with higher possible payoffs. Using patient claims data, we show that among skilled doctors, using a broader portfolio of drugs predicts better patient outcomes, except in cases where doctor’s decisions violate loose professional guidelines. We introduce a behavioral model of decision making guided by our empirical observations. The model’s novel feature is that the tradeoff between exploitation and experimentation depends on the doctor’s diagnostic skill. The model predicts that higher diagnostic skill leads to greater diversity in drug choice and better matching of drugs to patients even among doctors with the same initial beliefs regarding drug effectiveness. Consistent with the finding that guideline violations predict poorer patient outcomes, simulations of the model suggest that increasing the number of possible drug choices can lower performance.

10.3386/w24955.abstractZh: 抑郁症的治疗过程非常复杂，需要做出一些权衡：是在利用预期价值最高的治疗方法，还是尝试那些可能带来更高回报的治疗方法。通过患者索赔数据，我们发现，在熟练的医生中，使用更多种类的药物能够带来更好的患者治疗效果，除非医生的决策违反了宽松的专业准则。我们引入了一个基于实证观察的行为决策模型。该模型的一个创新之处在于，利用与诊断技能相关的权衡来决定是采用现有方法还是尝试新方法。模型预测，更高的诊断技能会导致药物选择的多样性增加，并且即使是在对药物效果持有相同信念的医生之间，也能实现更好的药物匹配。与“违反指南会导致患者治疗效果较差”这一发现一致，模型模拟表明，增加可能的药物选择数量可能会降低治疗效果。

abstract.text: We provide causal evidence that regulation induced product shocks significantly impact aggregate demand and firm performance in pharmaceutical markets. Event study results suggest an average loss between $569 million and $882 million. Affected products lose, on average, $186 million over their remaining effective patent life. This leaves a loss of between $383 million and $696 million attributable to declines in future innovation. Our findings complement research that shows drugs receiving expedited review are more likely to suffer from regulation induced product shocks. Thus, it appears we may be trading off quicker access to drugs today for less innovation tomorrow. Results remain robust to variation across types of relabeling, market sizes, and levels of competition.

10.3386/w24957.abstractZh: 我们提供了因果证据，表明监管导致的产品冲击对药品市场的整体需求和企业绩效产生了显著影响。事件研究结果显示，平均损失在5.69亿至8.82亿美元之间。受影响的产品在其剩余有效专利期内平均损失1.86亿美元。此外，由于未来创新的减少，还造成了3.83亿至6.96亿美元的损失。我们的研究结果补充了那些表明接受快速审查的药物更容易受到监管导致的产品冲击影响的研究。因此，看起来我们可能是在牺牲今天更快获得药物的机会，以换取明天的较少创新。研究结果在不同类型的重新标签、市场规模和竞争水平方面仍然具有稳健性。

abstract.text: Recent large-scale randomized experiments find that helping people form implementation intentions by asking when and where they plan to act increases one-time actions, such as vaccinations, preventative screenings and voting. We investigate the effect of a simple scalable planning intervention on a repeated behavior using a randomized design involving 877 subjects at a private gym. Subjects were randomized into i) a treatment group who selected the days and times they intended to attend the gym over the next two weeks or ii) a control group who instead recorded their days of exercise in the prior two weeks. In contrast to recent studies, we find that the planning intervention did not have a positive effect on behavior and observe a tightly estimated null effect. This lack of effect is despite the fact that the majority of subjects believe that planning is helpful and despite clear evidence that they engaged with the planning process.

10.3386/w24959.abstractZh: 最近的大规模随机实验发现，通过询问人们计划何时何地采取行动来帮助他们形成实施意图，能够增加一次性行为的发生，例如接种疫苗、预防性筛查和投票。我们采用随机设计，对877名私人健身房会员进行了研究，探讨一种简单且可扩展的规划干预措施对重复行为的影响。参与者被随机分配到两个组：一组选择接下来两周内打算去健身房的时间；另一组则记录过去两周内的锻炼日期。与最近的研究不同，我们发现规划干预措施并未对行为产生积极影响，且零效应估计值非常稳定。尽管大多数参与者认为规划是有帮助的，并且有证据表明他们确实参与了规划过程，但这一干预措施并未带来积极效果。

abstract.text: Economic growth and development have improved human health in many regions, while sub-Saharan Africa continues to lag behind. Economic theory and the existing empirical evidence suggest that development may not generate large reductions in the leading cause of adult mortality in the region, HIV/AIDS, and may increase risky sexual behavior. We examine the association between schooling/material standard of living and HIV risk using data from more than 500,000 respondents in 32 sub-Saharan African countries. The results of our descriptive analysis suggest that the rapid increase in primary school completion without improvements in living standards or secondary school completion might not mitigate HIV transmission.

10.3386/w24962.abstractZh: 经济增长和发展在许多地区改善了人类健康，而撒哈拉以南非洲地区则仍然落后。经济理论和现有的实证证据表明，发展可能无法大幅减少该地区成人死亡的主要原因——艾滋病，反而可能会增加危险性行为。我们利用来自32个撒哈拉以南非洲国家超过50万受访者的数据，研究了教育程度与生活水平与艾滋病风险之间的关联。我们的描述性分析结果表明，小学教育的迅速普及，如果没有伴随着生活水平的提高或中学教育的普及，可能无法有效减少艾滋病的传播。

abstract.text: We study whether long-term cumulative exposure to airborne small particulate matter (PM₂.₅) affects the probability that an individual receives a new diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias. We track the health, residential location, and PM₂.₅ exposures of Americans aged 65 and above from 2001 through 2013. The expansion of Clean Air Act regulations led to quasi-random variation in individuals’ subsequent exposures to PM₂.₅. We leverage these regulations to construct instrumental variables for individual-level decadal PM₂.₅ that we use within flexible probit models that also account for any potential sample selection based on survival. We find that a 1 μg/m3 increase in decadal PM₂.₅ increases the probability of a new dementia diagnosis by an average of 2.15 percentage points. All else equal, we find larger effects for women, older people, and people with more clinical risk factors for dementia. These effects persist below current regulatory thresholds.

10.3386/w24970.abstractZh: 我们研究了长期累积接触空气中的微小颗粒物（PM₂.₅）是否会影响个体被诊断出阿尔茨海默病或相关痴呆症的概率。我们跟踪了2001年至2013年间65岁及以上美国人的健康状况、居住地点以及PM₂.₅的暴露情况。清洁空气法案规定的扩大实施导致个体后续接触PM₂.₅的情况出现近似随机变化。我们利用这些法规构建了个体级别的十年PM₂.₅的工具变量，并将其用于灵活probit模型中，同时考虑了基于生存分析的潜在样本选择问题。研究发现，十年PM₂.₅浓度每增加1微克/立方米，新诊断出痴呆症的概率平均增加2.15个百分点。在其他条件相同的情况下，我们发现女性、老年人以及具有更多痴呆症临床风险因素的人群受到的影响更大。这些效应在当前的监管阈值以下仍然持续存在。

abstract.text: We asked 97 cigarette smokers to make a series of 12 binary choices between experimental cigarette packages with varying warnings and background colors. Each smoker had to decide which of the two packages contained cigarettes less risky for his health. We tested whether the smokers, confronted with warnings that were repugnant and threatening to many of them, could still make choices that adhered to the standard axioms of rational choice. We supplemented our observations on smokers’ choices with data on their eye movements. We find that participants universally made choices consistent with a complete, transitive preference ordering. We find little evidence of inconsistent choices violating the weak axiom of revealed preference. In a majority of smokers, we find strong evidence of the use of a lexicographic decision rule to assess the riskiness of a cigarette package. These smokers first ranked the two packages solely on the basis of their warnings. Only when the two packages had the same warning did they rank the packages on the basis of their color. The data on eye tracking strongly confirmed the lexicographic nature of the underlying decision rule. Our study represents an entirely different angle of inquiry into the question of rational addiction.

10.3386/w24974.abstractZh: 我们邀请了97名吸烟者在实验设计的香烟包装中进行一系列12个二元选择，这些包装在警告信息和背景颜色上有所不同。每位参与者都需要判断哪一款包装中的香烟对健康的风险更低。我们测试了这些吸烟者在面对许多人认为令人反感且具有威胁性的警告时，是否能够做出符合理性选择标准公理的选择。我们通过观察参与者的眼球运动数据来补充我们的观察结果。我们发现，参与者普遍做出了与完整、传递性偏好排序一致的选择。我们没有发现任何违反揭示偏好弱公理的不一致选择。在大多数吸烟者中，我们发现他们使用了词典式决策规则来评估香烟包装的风险性。这些参与者首先仅根据警告信息对两个包装进行排名，只有当两个包装的警告信息相同的情况下，他们才会根据颜色对包装进行排名。眼球跟踪数据强烈证实了这种决策规则具有词典式特征。我们的研究从一个全新的角度探讨了理性成瘾的问题。

abstract.text: We study the spillover effects of prescription drug monitoring programs (PDMPs) on crime, and in the process inform how policies that restrict access to Rx opioids per se within the healthcare system would impact broader non-health domains. In response to the substantial increase in opioid use and misuse in the United States, PDMPs have been implemented in virtually all states to collect, monitor, and analyze prescription opioid data with the goal of preventing misuse and the diversion of controlled substances. Using information on offenses known to law enforcement and arrests from the Uniform Crime Reports (UCR), combined with a difference-in-differences empirical strategy, we find that PDMPs reduced overall crime by 5%. These reductions in crime are associated with both violent and property crimes. This decrease in crime is also reflected by a decrease in crime-related arrests as well as drug-related arrests. Overall, these results provide additional evidence that PDMPs are an effective social policy tool to mitigate some of the negative consequences of opioid misuse, and more broadly indicate that opioid policies can have important spillover effects into other non-health related domains such as crime.

10.3386/w24975.abstractZh: 我们研究了处方药物监测计划对犯罪行为的溢出效应，并在此过程中探讨了限制医疗系统中处方阿片类药物获取的政策如何对更广泛的非健康领域产生影响。鉴于美国阿片类药物使用与滥用现象的显著增加，几乎所有州都实施了处方药物监测计划，以收集、监测和分析处方阿片类药物数据，旨在防止滥用和管制药物的转移。通过利用《统一犯罪报告》中已知的犯罪和逮捕信息，并结合差异-差异实证策略，我们发现处方药物监测计划使整体犯罪率降低了5%。这些犯罪率的下降与暴力犯罪和财产犯罪均有关。犯罪率的下降也体现在与犯罪相关的逮捕次数以及与毒品相关的逮捕次数上。总体而言，这些结果进一步证明了处方药物监测计划是一种有效的社会政策工具，能够减轻阿片类药物滥用带来的一些负面影响，并表明阿片类药物政策对其他非健康领域，如犯罪，也可能产生重要的溢出效应。

abstract.text: In recent years, numerous cities in the U.S. have enacted taxes on beverages to promote health and raise revenue. This paper examines the impact of Philadelphia’s beverage tax, enacted in 2017, on the prices and availability of taxed beverages and untaxed beverages that may be substitutes for consumers. Using original data we collected in late 2016 and again one year later, we estimate a difference-in-differences regression of the change over time in beverage prices and product availability in stores in Philadelphia relative to stores in nearby counties. We find that, on average, distributors and retailers fully pass the tax through to consumers, but there is heterogeneity in the pass-through rate among stores. Pass-through is greater among stores in higher-poverty neighborhoods, stores located farther from untaxed stores outside Philadelphia, stores that are independent as opposed to part of national chains, and for individual servings than for larger sizes. We also find a reduction in the availability of taxed beverages and an increase in the availability of untaxed beverages, particularly bottled water, in Philadelphia stores.
