10.3386/w24990.abstractZh: 近年来，美国许多城市都实施了饮料税，旨在促进健康并增加税收收入。本文研究了2017年费城实施的饮料税对饮料价格及商店中应税饮料与未应税饮料的供应情况的影响，这些未应税饮料可能是消费者的替代品。我们基于2016年末及一年后的原始数据，通过差异回归模型分析了费城与邻近县商店中饮料价格及产品供应随时间的变化情况。研究发现，平均而言，经销商和零售商将税收完全转嫁给了消费者，但不同商店之间的转嫁率存在差异。在贫困程度较高的社区、距离费城外未应税商店较远的商店、独立商店而非连锁店，以及小份量饮料的供应情况，转嫁率高于大份量饮料。此外，费城商店中应税饮料的供应减少，而未应税饮料，尤其是瓶装水的供应增加。

abstract.text: Liquidity constraints create preferences over how insurance contracts move money across both time and states because insurance can have a consumption-smoothing benefit. We incorporate liquidity constraints into a model in which insurance contracts span multiple consumption periods. We show that the insurance demand of rational liquidity-constrained individuals will differ qualitatively and quantitatively from the standard model’s normative benchmarks: they will not fully insure at actuarially fair prices when premiums are paid upfront, they may purchase insurance even when premiums are so high that insurance is dominated in the standard model, and they may pay to insure against events that are certain to happen. We provide simulations showing that liquidity constrained individuals will systematically violate normative benchmarks in ways that have been previously documented and interpreted as mistakes. We also provide new survey evidence that liquidity-constrained individuals are more likely to express a preference for dominated insurance plans, even when the standard rationale for avoiding such plans is explained. We discuss how liquidity constraints can affect the optimal design of partial insurance and highlight the need to account for liquidity when evaluating insurance demand.

10.3386/w24993.abstractZh: 流动性约束会导致人们倾向于选择能够跨越时间和空间转移资金的保险合同，因为保险具有平滑消费支出的作用。我们将流动性约束纳入了一个模型，该模型中的保险合同覆盖多个消费周期。研究表明，受流动性约束的理性个体对保险的需求与标准模型中的规范基准存在质和量的差异：当保费一次性支付时，他们不会选择完全保险；即使保费过高以至于在标准模型中保险变得不具优势，他们仍可能购买保险；他们还可能支付费用来防范那些必然发生的事件。我们的模拟结果显示，受流动性约束的个体会系统性地违反规范基准，而这些行为之前已被记录并被视为错误。此外，新的调查证据表明，即使解释了避免某些保险计划的标准理由，受流动性约束的个体仍更可能偏好那些不具优势的保险计划。我们讨论了流动性约束如何影响部分保险的最优设计，并强调了在评估保险需求时需要考虑流动性的重要性。

abstract.text: Using data on 25 major American cities for the period 1900-1940, we explore the effects of municipal-level public health efforts that were viewed as critical in the fight against food- and water-borne diseases. In addition to studying interventions such as treating sewage and setting strict bacteriological standards for milk, which have received little attention in the literature, we provide new evidence on the effects of water filtration and chlorination, extending the work of previous scholars. Contrary to the consensus view, we find that none of the interventions under study contributed substantially to the observed declines in total and infant mortality.

10.3386/w25027.abstractZh: 我们基于1900至1940年间25个美国主要城市的数据，探讨了市政层面公共卫生措施对预防食源性和水源性疾病的积极作用。除了研究诸如处理污水和制定严格的牛奶细菌学标准等干预措施外，这些研究在文献中鲜有提及，我们还提供了关于水过滤和氯化处理效果的新证据，进一步扩展了前人研究的范围。与普遍观点相反，我们发现这些干预措施并未对总死亡率和婴儿死亡率的下降产生显著影响。

abstract.text: Evidence of regional variation in health care utilization has been well-documented over the past 40 years. Yet uncertainty persists about whether this variation is primarily the result of supply-side or demand-side forces, and the difference matters for both theory and policy. In this article, we provide new evidence as to the cause of geographic variation in health care utilization. We do so by examining changes in health care use by the near-elderly as they transition from being uninsured into Medicare. Results provide support for a causal supply-side explanation of regional variation. Estimates indicate that gaining Medicare coverage in above-median spending regions increases the probability of at least one hospital visit by 36% and the probability of having more than five doctor visits by 25% relative to similar individuals in below-median spending regions.

10.3386/w25037.abstractZh: 过去40年来，关于医疗保健利用的区域差异已有大量研究记录。然而，关于这种差异主要是由供应端还是需求端因素造成的，仍存在不确定性，而这一差异对理论和政策都有重要影响。在本文中，我们提供了关于医疗保健利用地理差异成因的新证据。我们通过研究近老年人在从无保险状态过渡到获得医疗保险时医疗保健使用情况的变化来得出这一结论。研究结果表明，获得医疗保险在支出高于平均水平的地区，至少一次住院的概率增加了36%，而接受五次以上医生诊疗的概率增加了25%，这一差异与支出低于平均水平地区的类似人群相比更为显著。

abstract.text: Mammography guidelines have weakened in response to evidence that mammograms diagnose breast cancers that would never eventually cause symptoms, a phenomenon called “overdiagnosis.” Given concerns about overdiagnosis, instead of recommending mammograms, US guidelines encourage women aged 40-49 to get them as they see fit. To assess whether these guidelines target women effectively, I propose an approach that examines mammography behavior within an influential clinical trial that followed participants long enough to find overdiagnosis. I find that women who are more likely to receive mammograms are healthier and have higher socioeconomic status. More importantly, I find that the 20-year level of overdiagnosis is at least 3.5 times higher among women who are most likely to receive mammograms. At least 36% of their cancers are overdiagnosed. These findings imply that US guidelines encourage mammograms among healthier women who are more likely to be overdiagnosed by them. Guidelines in other countries do not.

10.3386/w25049.abstractZh: 根据证据显示，乳腺X光检查能够诊断出最终不会引发症状的乳腺癌，这种现象被称为“过度诊断”。鉴于对过度诊断的担忧，美国的指南建议40-49岁的女性可以根据自身情况决定是否进行乳腺X光检查。为了评估这些指南是否能够有效引导女性进行乳腺X光检查，我提出了一个方法，通过一项长期跟踪的临床试验来研究乳腺X光检查的行为。研究发现，更有可能接受乳腺X光检查的女性的健康状况更好，且社会经济地位较高。更重要的是，我发现，在最有可能接受乳腺X光检查的女性中，20年的过度诊断率至少高出3.5倍。至少有36%的乳腺癌被过度诊断。这些发现表明，美国的指南鼓励那些健康状况较好且更容易被过度诊断的女性进行乳腺X光检查，而其他国家则没有这样的指南。

abstract.text: We estimate the incidence of a relatively new type of excise tax, a tax on sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs). We examine the largest such tax to date, which is two cents per ounce, in Boulder, CO. Using data that were hand-collected from stores and restaurants in both Boulder and two control communities, as well as internet data of restaurant menus, we find that the tax was largely, but not completely, passed through to consumers 5-7 weeks after implementation. Some retailers add the tax only at the register, indicating that estimates solely from posted prices would result in an underestimate of pass-through.

10.3386/w25050.abstractZh: 我们估算了一种相对较新的消费税的征收情况，这种税是对含糖饮料征收的。我们研究了迄今为止规模最大的此类税收，该税收为每盎司两美分，征收地点在科罗拉多州的博尔德市。通过从博尔德市及两个对照社区的商店和餐馆手工收集的数据，以及餐厅菜单的互联网数据，我们发现该税收在实施后的5到7周内，大部分但并未完全传递给了消费者。一些零售商仅在收银台时加收税收，这表明仅从标价来估算税收传递情况会导致低估实际传递效果。

abstract.text: In recent years, numerous U.S. cities have enacted taxes on sweetened beverages, but there is relatively little evidence about the effects of these taxes on purchases and consumption. In this paper, we examine the effects of the beverage tax of 1.5 cents per ounce that was implemented in Philadelphia starting January 1, 2017. We surveyed individuals in Philadelphia and nearby comparison communities before the tax and nearly one year after implementation of the tax about their purchases and consumption of beverages. We find that purchases of taxed beverages fell by 8.9 ounces per shopping trip in Philadelphia stores relative to comparison stores outside of the city and that Philadelphia residents increased purchases of taxed beverages outside of the city. The tax reduced adults’ frequency of regular soda consumption by 10.4 times per month, and there is some evidence of a slight reduction in adults’ overall sugar consumption from sweetened beverages, with larger reductions for African-American adults. The tax did not have a substantial effect on the frequency of adults’ consumption of other beverages. We generally do not find detectable effects of the tax on children’s consumption of beverages, although we find a substantial reduction in consumption of added sugars from sweetened beverages among children who had high pre-tax consumption levels.

10.3386/w25052.abstractZh: 近年来，许多美国城市对含糖饮料征收了税收，但关于这些税收对购买和消费的影响，相关的研究相对较少。本文研究了2017年1月1日在费城实施的每盎司1.5美分的饮料税的影响。我们在税收实施前以及实施近一年后，对费城及附近地区的居民进行了调查，了解他们购买和消费饮料的情况。研究发现，与城市外的比较商店相比，费城商店内含糖饮料的购买量每次减少了8.9盎司，而费城居民在城外地区的含糖饮料购买量有所增加。该税收使成年人的常规苏打水消费频率每月减少了10.4次，并且有证据表明成年人从含糖饮料中摄入的总糖分有所减少，其中非裔美国成年人的减少幅度更大。该税收对其他饮料的消费频率并没有显著影响。总体而言，我们并未发现该税收对儿童饮料消费产生明显影响，不过我们发现，在税收实施前含糖饮料消费水平较高的儿童，其含糖饮料的摄入量减少明显。

abstract.text: This article examines how the financial health changes following an individual’s enrollment in Michigan’s Medicaid program (Healthy Michigan Program, HMP). We use unique data that links credit reports of HMP enrollees to Medicaid administrative data on enrollment and use of health care services. We find that Medicaid enrollment is associated with large improvements in several measures of financial health, including reductions in unpaid bills, medical bills, over limit credit card spending, and public records (such as evictions, judgments, and bankruptcies). These improvements are apparent across several subgroups, although individuals with greater medical need, such as those with chronic illnesses, experience the largest benefits.

10.3386/w25053.abstractZh: 本文探讨了个人在密歇根州Medicaid计划（Healthy Michigan Program, HMP）中注册后，其财务健康状况如何发生变化。我们使用了独特的数据，将HMP注册用户的信用报告与Medicaid的注册和使用医疗服务的行政数据联系起来。研究发现，注册Medicaid与多个财务健康指标的显著改善相关，包括未付账单、医疗费用、信用卡消费超支以及公共记录（如驱逐、判决和破产）的减少。这些改善在多个子群体中都有体现，不过那些医疗需求较高的个体，如患有慢性疾病的人，所享受到的好处最为显著。

abstract.text: We develop a new framework for valuing health and longevity improvements that departs from conventional but unrealistic assumptions of full annuitization and deterministic health. Our framework can value the prevention of mortality and of illness, and it can quantify the effects of retirement policies on the value of life. We apply the framework to life-cycle data and generate new insights absent from the conventional approach. First, treatment is up to five times more valuable than prevention, even when both extend life equally. This asymmetry helps explain low observed investment in preventive care. Second, severe illness can significantly increase the value of statistical life, helping to reconcile theory with empirical findings that consumers value life-extension more in bleaker health states. Third, retirement annuities boost aggregate demand for life-extension. We calculate that Social Security adds $10.6 trillion (11 percent) to the value of post-1940 longevity gains and would add $127 billion to the value of a one percent decline in future mortality.

10.3386/w25055.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个新的框架，用于评估健康与寿命延长的改善效果，该框架摒弃了传统但不切实际的假设，如完全年金化和确定性健康假设。我们的框架能够评估预防死亡和疾病的效果，并能量化退休政策对生命价值的影响。我们将该框架应用于生命周期数据，得出了传统方法无法获得的新见解。首先，即使两种措施都能同样延长寿命，治疗的价值也是预防的五倍。这种不对称现象有助于解释为何在预防性护理方面的投资相对较低。其次，严重疾病可以显著提高统计寿命的价值，这有助于将理论研究与实证发现相结合——即消费者更重视在较为糟糕的健康状态下延长寿命。第三，退休年金会增加对寿命延长的总需求。我们计算出，社会保障制度为1940年之后的寿命延长价值增加了10.6万亿美元（占11%），并且未来死亡率下降1%会使价值增加1270亿美元。

abstract.text: The increasing demand for empirical rigor has led to the growing use of auxiliary tests (balance, specification, over-identification, placebo, etc.) in assessing the credibility of a paper’s main results. We dub these “sniff tests” because rejection is bad news for the author and standards for passing are informal. Using a sample of nearly 30,000 published sniff tests collected from scores of economics journals, we study the use of sniff tests as a screen in the publication process. For the subsample of balance tests in randomized controlled trials, our structural estimates suggest that the publication process removes 46% of significant sniff tests, yet only one in ten of these is actually misspecified. For other tests, we estimate more latent misspecifiation and less removal. Surprisingly, more authors would be justified in attributing significant sniff tests to random bad luck.

10.3386/w25058.abstractZh: 对实证严谨性的需求不断增加，导致辅助检验（如平衡性检验、规格设定检验、过识别检验、安慰剂检验等）在评估论文主要结果的可信度时被越来越多地使用。我们将这些检验称为“嗅探测试”，因为被拒绝对作者来说是个坏消息，而通过标准则没有严格规定。通过对近30,000项从众多经济学期刊中收集到的辅助检验样本进行研究，我们探讨了这些检验在出版过程中的应用情况。对于随机对照试验中的平衡性检验子样本，我们的结构估计表明，出版过程会剔除46%的显著辅助检验，但其中只有十分之一实际上存在规格设定错误。对于其他检验，我们估计存在更多的潜在规格设定错误，而剔除的比例则较低。令人惊讶的是，更多作者认为将显著辅助检验归因于随机的偶然性更为合理。

abstract.text: We present a theoretical framework which explains the optimizing behavior of individuals who are exposed to many latent stimuli but prone to experience only the most salient one. We show that individuals with such preferences may find it optimal to engage in seemingly dysfunctional behavior such as self-harm. Our model also explains the behavior of individuals experiencing depression or trapped by multiple competing problems. We present experimental evidence suggesting such preferences explain the behavior of more than two thirds of subjects exposed to single and multiple painful stimuli.

10.3386/w25060.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个理论框架，用以解释那些面临众多潜在刺激但只倾向于体验最显著刺激的个体的优化行为。我们发现，具有这种偏好的个体可能会选择看似功能失调的行为，如自伤。我们的模型还解释了经历抑郁或陷入多重竞争问题中的个体的行为。实验证据表明，这种偏好可以解释超过三分之二的受试者在面对单一或多重痛苦刺激时的行为。

abstract.text: This paper provides new empirical evidence on the employment and earning effects of the recent Medicaid expansion. Unlike most existing studies that use a conventional state and year fixed effects approach, our main identification strategy is based on the comparison of employment and wages in contiguous county-pairs in neighboring states (i.e. border counties) with different Medicaid expansion status. Using the 2008-2016 Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages, we estimate a set of distributed lag models in order to examine the dynamic effects of Medicaid expansion. Results from our preferred specification suggest a small but statistically significant decrease in employment of 1.3 percent one year after the Medicaid expansion. This disemployment effect is transitory and appears to primarily occur in low-wage sectors. In particular, employment returns to pre-expansion levels within two years. We also do not find any statistically significant effect of the Medicaid expansion on wages at any point.

10.3386/w25105.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于近期医疗补助扩展对就业和收入影响的新的实证证据。与大多数采用传统州和年份固定效应方法的研究不同，我们的主要识别策略是基于对邻近州（即边界县）中医疗补助扩展状况不同的相邻县对之间的就业和工资进行比较。利用2008-2016年的《就业与工资季度普查数据》，我们建立了一系列分布式滞后模型，以研究医疗补助扩展的动态影响。我们首选的模型结果显示，在医疗补助扩展后一年，就业率下降了1.3%，这一下降幅度虽小但具有统计学意义。这种就业减少效应是暂时的，且主要出现在低工资部门。具体而言，就业率在两年内回到了扩展前的水平。此外，我们并未发现医疗补助扩展对工资有任何显著的统计影响。

abstract.text: In November 2017, Maine became the first state in the nation to vote on a key provision of the Affordable Care Act: the expansion of Medicaid. We analyze local voting results to identify characteristics of areas that support Medicaid expansion. Support is strongly correlated with voter education. Places with more bachelor’s degree holders more often vote in favor, whereas those with more associate’s degree graduates vote against. Other patterns are consistent with economic self-interest. Conditional on education rates, areas with more uninsured individuals who would qualify for expanded coverage tend to vote in favor, while those with more high-income individuals vote against. Also conditional on education rates, greater hospitals employment is associated with support for expansion, but the presence of other health professionals, whose incomes might decrease from expansion, is associated with less support. Extrapolating from Maine to other states, our model predicts that hypothetical referendums on Medicaid expansion would pass in five of the 18 states that had not yet expanded Medicaid coverage.

10.3386/w25109.abstractZh: 2017年11月，缅因州成为全国第一个就《平价医疗法案》的一项关键条款进行投票的州：医疗补助的扩展。我们通过分析当地投票结果，识别出支持医疗补助扩展的地区特征。支持率与选民教育程度有很强的相关性。拥有更多学士学位的地区的选民更可能支持扩展，而拥有更多副学士学位的地区的选民则更可能反对。其他模式也与经济利益相关。根据教育水平，那些有较多未参保且符合扩展覆盖条件的个人所在的地区往往支持扩展，而拥有较多高收入个人的地区则反对扩展。同样，根据教育水平，更多的医院就业与对扩展的支持相关，但其他健康专业人员的存在可能会因扩展而导致收入下降，这则意味着他们对扩展的支持较少。从缅因州的情况推断到其他州，我们的模型预测，在18个尚未扩展医疗补助覆盖的州中，有5个州的医疗补助扩展提案可能会通过。

abstract.text: This paper uses a variety of individual-level survey data from several countries to test for interactions between subjective well-being at different ages and variables measuring the nature and quality of the social context at work, at home, and in the community. While earlier studies have found important age patterns (often U-shaped) and social context effects, these two sets of variables have generally been treated as mutually independent. We test for and find several large and highly significant interactions. Results are presented for life evaluations and (in some surveys) for happiness yesterday, in models with and without other control variables. The U-shape in age is found to be significantly flatter, and well-being in the middle of the age range higher, for those who are in workplaces with partner-like superiors, for those living as couples, and for those who have lived for longer in their communities. A strong sense of community belonging is associated with greater life satisfaction at all ages, but especially so at ages 60 and above, in some samples deepening the U-shape in age by increasing the size of the life satisfaction gains following the mid-life low.

10.3386/w25121.abstractZh: 本文利用来自多个国家的多种个体层面的调查数据，来检验不同年龄段的主观幸福感与衡量工作、家庭及社区社会环境性质与质量的各种变量之间的相互作用。虽然早期的研究发现了重要的年龄模式（通常是U形分布）以及社会环境对幸福感的影响，但这两组变量通常被视为相互独立的。我们进行了研究并发现了多个显著且重要的相互作用关系。研究结果针对生活满意度进行了分析，在某些调查中还针对“昨日幸福感”进行了分析，无论是否包含其他控制变量，结果均显示：对于那些在具有类似伴侣上级的工作环境中工作的人、以夫妻形式生活的人，以及在其社区中生活时间较长的群体来说，年龄的U形分布明显更加平缓，且处于年龄范围中间的人的幸福感更高。强烈的社区归属感与所有年龄段的更高生活满意度相关，但在60岁及以上的人群中尤为明显，某些样本还发现，这种归属感使得中年后的幸福感下降幅度得以缓解。

abstract.text: Prior to the famous One Child Policy, China’s total fertility rate declined by more than 50% during the 1970s - one of the most rapid sustained fertility declines documented in modern history. Coinciding with this transition was China’s ﬁrst national population policy, Wan Xi Shao, also known as the Longer, Later Fewer (LLF) campaign. Studying LLF’s contribution to fertility and fertility strategies favoring sons, we ﬁnd that the campaign i) reduced China’s total fertility rate by 0.88 births per woman (explaining 27% of China’s modern fertility decline), ii) doubled the use of male-biased fertility stopping rules, and iii) promoted postnatal selection (implying 200,000 previously unrecognized missing girls). Considering Chinese population policy to be extreme in global experience, our paper demonstrates the limits of population policy in explaining demographic transitions— and its potential human costs.

10.3386/w25130.abstractZh: 在著名的独生子女政策实施之前，中国的总生育率在20世纪70年代下降了50%以上——这是现代历史上记录中最快速的持续生育率下降之一。与这一转变同时发生的，是中国首个全国人口政策，即“ Longer, Later Fewer (LLF) 运动”。通过研究LLF对生育率的影响以及鼓励生育男孩的策略，我们发现该运动：i) 使中国的总生育率每妇女生育子女数减少了0.88个（占现代中国生育率下降的27%）；ii) 使偏向男性的生育限制措施的使用翻倍；iii) 促进了产后性别选择（意味着有20万此前未被发现的失踪女孩）。鉴于中国的人口政策在全球范围内属于极端案例，我们的论文揭示了人口政策在解释人口转变方面的局限性，以及其可能带来的人类成本。

abstract.text: Evidence shows that the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) is underutilized. WIC enrolls only sixty percent of eligible persons. Participants claim only a fraction of available benefits. Researchers suggest that people underutilize WIC because of the time needed to enroll in and use WIC and because participants may believe that, if others notice them participating in WIC, community members will stigmatize them. Recently enacted policies may reduce both time costs and potential for stigma associated with WIC. Congress mandated that, by 2020, all states disburse WIC benefits through an Electronic Benefits Transfer (eWIC) system. The eWIC potentially reduces the time required for each transaction and makes it more difficult to identify beneficiaries. We analyze data on grocery expenditures of 11,887 WIC-participating households in one state over the period it implemented eWIC. We find that, after beneficiaries began redeeming WIC benefits through eWIC, spending on non-WIC eligible foods did not change but redemptions of WIC benefits increased.

10.3386/w25131.abstractZh: 有证据表明，针对妇女、婴儿和儿童的特别补充营养计划（WIC）的利用率较低。只有60%的符合条件人员参与了该计划。参与者声称只享受了部分可用福利。研究人员指出，人们不充分利用WIC的原因包括参与和使用该计划所需的时间较长，以及参与者可能认为，如果其他人注意到他们参与WIC，社区成员会对其产生污名。最近颁布的政策可能会减少与WIC相关的时间和污名风险。国会要求到2020年，所有州都通过电子福利转移系统（eWIC）发放WIC福利。eWIC可能减少了每次交易所需的时间，并使得识别受益人变得更加困难。我们分析了该州11,887个参与WIC的家庭在采用eWIC期间的食品支出数据。研究发现，在受益人开始通过eWIC领取WIC福利后，非WIC合格食品的支出没有变化，但WIC福利的兑换次数增加了。

abstract.text: In structural dynamic discrete choice models, unobserved and mis-measured state variables may lead to biased parameter estimates and misleading inference. In this paper, we show that instrumental variables can address such measurement problems when they relate to state variables that evolve exogenously from the perspective of individual agents (i.e., market-level states). We define a class of linear instrumental variables estimators that rely on Euler equations expressed in terms of conditional choice probabilities (ECCP estimators). These estimators do not require observing or modeling the agent's entire information set, nor solving or simulating a dynamic program. As such, they are simple to implement and computation- ally light. We provide constructive arguments for the identification of model primitives, and establish the estimator's consistency and asymptotic normality. Four applied examples serve to illustrate the ECCP approach's implementation, advantages, and limitations: dynamic demand for durable goods, agricultural land use change, technology adoption, and dynamic labor supply. We illustrate the estimator's good finite-sample performance in a Monte Carlo study, and we estimate a labor supply model empirically for taxi drivers in New York City.

10.3386/w25134.abstractZh: 在结构动态离散选择模型中，未观测和测量不准确的状态变量可能导致参数估计偏差和误导性推断。本文指出，当工具变量与从个体代理视角外生演变的状态变量相关时，可以解决此类测量问题。我们定义了一类基于条件选择概率表达的线性工具变量估计器，这类估计器无需观测或建模代理的全部信息集，也无需求解或模拟动态规划。因此，这些估计器易于实施且计算量小。我们为模型原语的识别提供了建设性论证，并证明了估计器的一致性和渐近正态性。通过四个应用实例，我们展示了ECCP方法的实施、优势及局限性：耐用商品的动态需求、农业用地变化、技术采纳以及动态劳动力供应。在蒙特卡洛研究中，我们证明了该估计器在有限样本下的良好性能，并实证估计了纽约市出租车司机的劳动力供应模型。

abstract.text: Accurately measuring government benefit receipt in household surveys is necessary when studying disadvantaged populations and the programs that serve them. The Food Stamp Program is especially important given its size and recent growth. To validate survey reports, we use administrative data on participation in two states linked to the American Community Survey (ACS), the Current Population Survey (CPS), and the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP). We find that 23 percent of true food stamp recipient households do not report receipt in the SIPP, 35 percent in the ACS, and fully 50 percent in the CPS. A substantial number of true non-recipients are also recorded as recipients, especially in the SIPP. We examine reasons for these errors including imputation, an important source of error. Both false negative and false positive reports vary with household characteristics, implying complicated biases in multivariate analyses, such as regressions. We then directly examine biases in common survey-based estimates of program receipt by comparing them to estimates from our combined administrative and survey data. We find that the survey estimates understate participation among single parents, non-whites, and low-income households, and also lead to errors in multiple program receipt, and time and age patterns of receipt.

10.3386/w25143.abstractZh: 在研究弱势人群及其所接受的项目时，准确测量家庭中的政府福利领取情况是必要的。鉴于食品券计划的重要性及其近年来的增长，对其进行验证尤为重要。为了验证调查报告的准确性，我们使用了两个州的行政数据，这些数据与美国社区调查、当前人口调查以及收入与项目参与调查相关联。我们发现，有23%的真实食品券领取家庭在SIPP中未报告领取情况，35%在ACS中未报告，而高达50%在CPS中未报告。此外，还有相当数量的真实非领取者被记录为领取者，尤其是在SIPP中。我们研究了这些错误的原因，包括估算误差，这是重要的误差来源。假阴性和假阳性报告都随家庭特征而变化，这意味着在多元分析中，如回归分析，存在复杂的偏差。然后，我们通过将调查估计值与我们的综合行政和调查数据进行比较，直接检验了项目领取情况的估计偏差。我们发现，调查估计值低估了单亲家庭、非白人家庭和低收入家庭的参与情况，同时也导致了多个项目领取情况的错误，以及领取时间和年龄模式的错误。

abstract.text: Some states have not adopted the Affordable Care Act (ACA) Medicaid expansions due to concerns that the expansions may impair access to care and utilization for those who are already insured. We investigate such negative spillovers using a large panel of Medicare beneficiaries. Across many subgroups and outcomes, we find no evidence that the expansions reduced utilization among Medicare beneficiaries, and can rule out all but very small changes in utilization or spending. These results indicate that the expansions in Medicaid did not impair access to care or utilization for the Medicare population.

10.3386/w25153.abstractZh: 一些州由于担心医疗补助扩展会妨碍已有保险患者的就医机会和医疗使用，因此没有采纳《平价医疗法案》中的医疗补助扩展措施。我们利用庞大的医疗保险受益人数据组来研究这种负面影响。在多个子群体和结果指标上，我们没有发现医疗补助扩展导致医疗保险受益人医疗使用减少的证据，并且可以排除除非常小的使用或支出变化之外的所有影响。这些结果表明，医疗补助的扩展并未影响医疗保险人群的就医机会和医疗使用。

abstract.text: In the health insurance marketplaces established by the Affordable Care Act (ACA), each state is divided into a set number of geographic ``rating areas." The ACA mandates that an insurer price its health insurance plan uniformly in all counties within the same rating area, conditional on insurees' age and smoking status. However, the ACA does \\textit{not} require that an insurer sell its plan in all counties in a rating area. Using the federal marketplace data, we quantify the prevalence of a phenomenon, which we refer to as partial rating area offering, where insurers enter some but not all of the counties in a rating area. To understand why insurers selectively enter a subset of the counties in a rating area, we develop a simple model of insurer competition. The model implies that if common county characteristics, such as the county's risk distribution, market size and provider availability, are the primary drivers for the partial rating area offering phenomenon, then there would be a positive correlation among insurers' entry decisions. In contrast, if the partial rating area offering phenomenon is driven by market segmentation, then there would be a negative correlation. We develop a novel nonparametric correlation test and apply it to the federal marketplace data. We find strong evidence for a positive correlation of insurers' entry decisions, suggesting that common cost factors are the main driver for the partial rating area offering phenomenon. To the extent that it is a concern that many counties now have few insurers, our result suggests that it is important to offer insurers subsidies that are tied to county characteristics.

10.3386/w25154.abstractZh: 在《平价医疗法案》所建立的医疗保险市场中，每个州被划分为若干地理上的“评级区域”。该法案要求保险公司在同一评级区域内的所有县中统一定价其医疗保险计划，前提是参保人的年龄和吸烟状况相同。然而，该法案并未要求保险公司在所有评级区域的县中销售其计划。利用联邦市场数据，我们量化了一种现象的存在情况，我们将其称为“部分评级区域提供”，即保险公司只进入部分而非所有评级区域的县。为了理解为什么保险公司会选择性地进入评级区域中的部分县，我们建立了一个简单的保险公司竞争模型。该模型表明，如果常见的县特征，如县的风险分布、市场规模和医疗服务提供者的可用性，是部分评级区域提供现象的主要驱动因素，那么保险公司进入决策之间会存在正相关性。相反，如果部分评级区域提供现象是由市场细分驱动的，那么它们之间会存在负相关性。我们开发了一种新的非参数相关性检验方法，并将其应用于联邦市场数据。我们发现保险公司进入决策之间存在强烈的正相关性，这表明常见的成本因素是部分评级区域提供现象的主要驱动因素。鉴于许多县目前几乎没有保险公司，我们的研究结果表明，向保险公司提供与县特征相关的补贴是非常重要的。

abstract.text: Research has shown that higher cost-sharing lowers health care spending levels but less is known about whether cost-sharing also affects spending growth. From 2002 to 2016, private insurance deductibles more than tripled in magnitude. We use data from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services and the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality to estimate whether areas with relatively higher deductibles experienced lower spending growth during this period. We leverage panel variation in private deductibles across states and over time and address the potential endogeneity of deductibles using instrumental variables. We find that spending growth is significantly lower in states with higher average deductibles and observe this relationship with regard to both private insurance benefits and total spending (including Medicare and Medicaid), suggestive of potential spillovers. We hypothesize that the impact on spending growth happens because deductibles affect the diffusion of costly new technology.

10.3386/w25156.abstractZh: 研究表明，较高的费用分担可以降低医疗保健支出水平，但关于费用分担是否也会影响支出增长，目前了解较少。从2002年到2016年，私人保险的免赔额增加了两倍多。我们利用医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心以及医疗保健研究与质量局的数据，来估计在这段时间内，免赔额相对较高的地区是否经历了较低的支出增长。我们利用了各州以及不同时期私人保险免赔额的变化情况，并通过工具变量法解决了免赔额潜在的内生性问题。我们发现，平均免赔额较高的州，支出增长明显较低。这一关系在私人保险福利和总支出（包括医疗保险和医疗补助）方面都有体现，表明可能存在溢出效应。我们假设，免赔额对支出增长的影响是因为它们影响了昂贵新技术的扩散。

abstract.text: Women who give birth as teens have worse subsequent educational and labor market outcomes than women who have first births at older ages. However, previous research has attributed much of these effects to selection rather than a causal effect of teen childbearing. Despite this, there are still reasons to believe that children of teen mothers may do worse as their mothers may be less mature, have fewer financial resources when the child is young, and may partner with fathers of lower quality. Using Norwegian register data, we compare outcomes of children of sisters who have first births at different ages. Our evidence suggests that the causal effect of being a child of a teen mother is much smaller than that implied by the cross-sectional differences but that there are still significant long-term, adverse consequences, especially for children born to the youngest teen mothers. Unlike previous research, we have information on fathers and find that negative selection of fathers of children born to teen mothers plays an important role in producing inferior child outcomes. These effects are particularly large for mothers from higher socio-economic groups.

10.3386/w25165.abstractZh: 在青少年时期生育的女性，其后续的教育和劳动力市场表现比那些在更年长时首次生育的女性要差。然而，先前的研究将这种效应主要归因于选择因素，而非青少年生育的因果效应。尽管如此，仍有理由相信，青少年母亲所生的孩子可能会面临更糟糕的情况，因为这些母亲可能不够成熟，在孩子年幼时经济资源较少，且可能与质量较低的父亲生育子女。利用挪威的登记数据，我们比较了不同年龄首次生育的姐妹所生子女的结果。我们的证据表明，作为青少年母亲所生子女的因果效应远小于横断面差异所暗示的效应，但仍然存在显著的长期负面影响，尤其是对最年轻的青少年母亲所生的孩子而言。与以往的研究不同，我们掌握了关于父亲的信息，并发现，青少年母亲所生子女的父亲选择中的负面因素在导致孩子表现不佳方面起着重要作用。这些效应在来自较高社会经济群体的母亲身上尤为明显。

abstract.text: We develop a novel cross-sectional research design to identify causal effects in the presence of unobservable heterogeneity without instruments. When units are dense in physical space, such as in geocoded administrative data or gridded datasets, it may be sufficient to regress the “spatial first differences” (SFD) of the outcome on the treatment and omit all covariates. SFD aligns the identifying assumptions for simple cross-sectional samples with the assumptions of other quasi-experimental designs, in terms of mathematical structure and plausibility. We demonstrate SFD in simulation and by estimating the returns to schooling. We then use SFD to obtain new estimates for the effects of time-invariant geographic factors, soil and climate, on long-run agricultural productivities — relationships crucial for economic decisions, such as land management and climate policy, but notoriously confounded by unobservables. We also demonstrate three empirical tests that can suggest whether SFD is likely to be successful at identifying causal effects in new contexts.

10.3386/w25177.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种新的横截面研究设计，用于在缺乏可观测异质性和工具变量的情况下识别因果效应。当单位在物理空间上密集分布时，例如在地理编码的行政数据或网格化数据集中，可能只需对结果的“空间一阶差分”进行回归分析，并忽略所有协变量。空间一阶差分在数学结构和合理性方面，能够与其他准实验设计的假设相契合，从而简化横截面样本的识别过程。我们通过模拟和估计教育回报来验证空间一阶差分的有效性。随后，我们利用空间一阶差分获得了关于时间不变的地理因素、土壤和气候对长期农业生产率影响的新的估计值——这些关系对于经济决策至关重要，例如土地管理和气候政策，但往往受到不可观测变量的干扰。我们还通过三个实证测试，来探讨空间一阶差分是否能够在新的情境下成功识别因果效应。

abstract.text: How do patient and provider incentives affect the provision of long-term care? Our analysis of 551 thousand nursing home stays yields three main insights. First, Medicaid-covered residents prolong their stays instead of transitioning to community-based care due to limited cost-sharing. Second, when facility capacity binds, nursing homes shorten Medicaid stays to admit more profitable out-of-pocket private payers. Third, providers react more elastically to financial incentives than patients. Thus, targeting provider incentives through alternative payment models, such as episode-based reimbursement, is more effective than increasing patient cost-sharing in facilitating transitions to community-based care and generating long-term care savings.

10.3386/w25178.abstractZh: 患者和提供者的激励措施如何影响长期护理的提供？我们对55.1万次养老院住院情况的分析得出了三个主要发现。首先，由于费用分担的限制，接受医疗补助的居民更倾向于延长住院时间，而不是转向社区护理。其次，当养老院的容量有限时，它们会缩短医疗补助患者的住院时间，以接纳更多盈利性强的自费患者。第三，提供者对财务激励的反应比患者更为灵活。因此，通过替代支付模式，如基于病例的报销，来针对提供者的激励措施，比增加患者的费用分担更为有效，有助于促进向社区护理的过渡，并节省长期护理成本。

abstract.text: When firms span related product categories, spillovers across categories become central to firm strategy and industrial policy, due to their potential to foreclose competition and affect innovation incentives. We exploit major new product innovations in one medical device category, and detailed sales data across related categories, to develop a causal research design for spillovers at the customer level. We find evidence of spillovers, primarily associated with complementarities in usage. These spillovers imply large benefits to multi- vs. single-category firms, accounting for nearly one quarter of sales in the complimentary category (equivalent to four percent of revenue in the focal category).

10.3386/w25183.abstractZh: 当企业涉及相关产品类别时，跨类别的溢出效应成为企业战略和产业政策的核心问题，因为这些效应有可能排除竞争并影响创新动机。我们利用某一医疗器械类别中的重大新产品创新，以及相关类别的详细销售数据，开发了一种基于客户层面的溢出效应因果研究设计。我们发现存在溢出效应，主要与使用的互补性有关。这些溢出效应意味着多类别企业比单类别企业获得更大的收益，在互补类别中，这一收益几乎占该类别销售额的四分之一（相当于目标类别收入的百分之四）。

abstract.text: Climate change management is a global challenge that requires social science as much as it requires natural science. We provide a brief introduction to the physical science of climate change, written to provide essential background for economists and other social scientists. We also highlight some key areas in which economists—including those studying macroeconomics, political economy, and development—are in a unique position to help climate science advance.

10.3386/w25189.abstractZh: 气候变化管理是一项全球性挑战，它既需要自然科学的研究，也需要社会科学的研究。我们简要介绍了气候变化相关的物理科学知识，旨在为经济学家和其他社会科学学者提供必要的背景知识。同时，我们也强调了一些关键领域，在这些领域里，经济学家——包括那些研究宏观经济学、政治经济学和发展问题的学者——能够发挥独特的作用，推动气候科学的发展。

abstract.text: Prices negotiated between payers and providers affect a health insurance contract's value via enrollees' cost-sharing and self-insured employers' costs. However, price variation across payers is hard to observe. We measure negotiated prices for hospital-payer pairs in Massachusetts and characterize price variation. Between-payer price variation is similar in magnitude to between-hospital price variation. Administrative-services-only contracts, in which insurers do not bear risk, have higher prices. We model negotiation incentives and show that contractual form and demand responsiveness to negotiated prices are important determinants of negotiated prices.

10.3386/w25190.abstractZh: 支付方与提供方之间协商的价格会通过参保人的费用分摊以及自保雇主的成本来影响健康保险合同的价值。然而，不同支付方之间的价格差异很难观察到。我们测量了马萨诸塞州医院与支付方之间协商的价格，并分析了价格差异的情况。不同支付方之间的价格差异与不同医院之间的价格差异在幅度上相似。仅包含行政服务的合同，即保险公司不承担风险的合同，其价格较高。我们对协商激励进行了建模，并表明合同形式以及对协商价格的响应程度是决定协商价格的重要因素。

abstract.text: Errors in probabilistic reasoning have been the focus of much psychology research and are among the original topics of modern behavioral economics. This chapter reviews theory and evidence on this topic, with the goal of facilitating more systematic study of belief biases and their integration into economics. The chapter discusses biases in beliefs about random processes, biases in belief updating, the representativeness heuristic as a possible unifying theory, and interactions between biased belief updating and other features of the updating situation. Throughout, I aim to convey how much evidence there is for (and against) each putative bias, and I highlight when and how different biases may be related to each other. The chapter ends by drawing general lessons for when people update too much or too little, reflecting on modeling challenges, pointing to areas of economics to which the biases are relevant, and highlighting some possible directions for future work.

10.3386/w25200.abstractZh: 概率推理中的错误一直是心理学研究的重点，也是现代行为经济学的原始研究主题之一。本章回顾了这一主题的理论与证据，旨在促进对信念偏差及其在经济学中的整合进行更系统的研究。文章讨论了关于随机过程的信念偏差、信念更新的偏差、代表性启发式作为可能的统一理论，以及有偏信念更新与更新情境其他特征之间的相互作用。在整篇文章中，我试图说明支持或反对每种假定偏差的证据有多少，并强调不同偏差何时以及如何相互关联。最后，本章总结了人们在更新时过多或过少的情况，反思了建模面临的挑战，指出了这些偏差在经济学中的相关领域，并提出了未来研究的一些方向。

abstract.text: We study the behavioral changes due to marijuana consumption on fertility and its key mechanisms, as opposed to physiological changes. We can employ several large proprietary data sets, including the 1997 National Longitudinal Survey of Youth, Nielsen Retail Scanner database, as well as the Vital Statistics Natality files and apply a differences-in-differences approach by exploiting the timing of the introduction of medical marijuana laws among states. We first replicate the earlier literature by showing that marijuana use increases after the passage of medical marijuana laws. Our novel results reveal that birth rates increased after the passage of a law corresponding to increased frequency of sexual intercourse, decreased purchase of condoms and suggestive evidence on decreased condom use during sex. More sex and less contraceptive use may be attributed to behavioral responses such as increased attention to the immediate hedonic effects of sexual contact, delayed discounting and ignoring costs associated with risky sex. These findings are consistent with a large observational literature linking marijuana use with increased sexual activity and multiple partners. Our findings are robust to a broad set of tests.

10.3386/w25208.abstractZh: 我们研究了大麻消费对生育能力的行为影响及其关键机制，而非生理变化。我们可以利用多个大型专有数据集，包括1997年《全国青年纵向调查》、Nielsen零售扫描数据库，以及人口统计生育数据文件。通过利用各州医疗大麻法律实施的时机，我们采用了差异差异法进行分析。我们首先验证了早期文献的结论，即医疗大麻法律通过后，大麻使用量会增加。我们的新发现表明，在医疗大麻法律通过后，出生率上升，这与性行为频率增加、避孕套购买量减少以及性行为中避孕套使用减少有关。性行为增多和避孕使用减少可能归因于行为反应，如对性接触即时享乐效应的关注增加、延迟折现以及忽视与高风险性行为相关的成本。这些发现与大量观察性文献一致，这些文献将大麻使用与性活动增加和多个伴侣关系联系起来。我们的研究结果经广泛检验后依然稳健。

abstract.text: Debate over safe-storage gun regulations has captured public attention in the aftermath of several high-profile shootings committed by minors. Whether these laws actually decrease youth gun violence, however, is an unanswered question. Using data from the FBI’s Supplementary Homicide Reports for the period 1985-2013, this study is the first to estimate the relationship between child access prevention (CAP) laws and firearm-related homicides committed by juveniles. Our results suggest that CAP laws are associated with a 19 percent reduction in juvenile firearm-related homicides. The estimated effect is stronger among whites than blacks and is driven by states enforcing the strictest safe-storage standard. We find no evidence that CAP laws are associated with firearm-related homicides committed by adults or with non-firearm-related homicides committed by juveniles, suggesting that the observed relationship between CAP laws and juvenile firearm-related homicides is causal.

10.3386/w25209.abstractZh: 在几起由未成年人实施的严重枪击事件之后，关于安全储存枪支法规的争论引起了公众的关注。然而，这些法律是否真的能减少青少年枪支暴力行为，仍然是一个未解的问题。本研究利用联邦调查局1985-2013年的补充杀人报告数据，首次估算了儿童访问预防法律与青少年实施的枪支相关杀人行为之间的关系。研究结果表明，儿童访问预防法律与青少年实施的枪支相关杀人行为减少了19%。这一效应在白人中更为明显，且主要出现在执行最严格安全储存标准的州。我们没有发现儿童访问预防法律与成人实施的枪支相关杀人行为或青少年实施的非枪支相关杀人行为之间存在关联，这表明儿童访问预防法律与青少年实施的枪支相关杀人行为之间存在因果关系。

abstract.text: In many health domains, we are concerned that observed links - for example, between “healthy” behaviors and good outcomes - are driven by selection into behavior. This paper considers the additional factor that these selection patterns may vary over time. When a particular health behavior becomes more recommended, the take-up of the behavior may be larger among people with other positive health behaviors. Such changes in selection would make it even more difficult to learn about causal effects. I formalize this change in selection in a simple model. I test for evidence of these patterns in the context of diet and vitamin supplementation. Using both microdata and evidence from published results I show that selection varies over time with recommendations about behavior and that estimates of the relationship between health outcomes and health behaviors vary over time in the same way. I show that adjustment for selection on observables is insufficient to address the bias. I suggest a possible robustness approach relying on assumptions about proportional selection of observed and unobserved variables.

10.3386/w25225.abstractZh: 在许多健康领域，我们关注到观察到的关联——例如，“健康”行为与良好结果之间的关联——是由行为选择所驱动的。本文探讨了另一个因素，即这些选择模式可能会随时间变化。当某种健康行为被更多地推荐时，具有其他积极健康行为的人可能会更频繁地采用该行为。这种选择模式的变化会使了解因果效应变得更加困难。我在一个简单的模型中形式化了这种选择变化。我通过饮食和维生素补充的实例来检验这些模式的存在。利用微观数据和已发表的研究结果，我发现选择模式会随着对行为的推荐而随时间变化，而且健康结果与健康行为之间的关系估计值也会以相同的方式随时间变化。我指出，仅对可观测变量进行选择调整不足以消除偏差。我提出了一种可能的稳健性方法，该方法依赖于关于可观测和不可观测变量比例选择的假设。

abstract.text: Partitioning medical spending into conditions is essential to understanding the cost burden of medical care. Two broad strategies have been used to measure disease-specific spending. The first attributes each medical claim to the condition listed as its cause. The second decomposes total spending for a person over a year to the cumulative set of conditions they have. Traditionally, this has been done through regression analysis. This paper makes two contributions. First, we develop a new method to attribute spending to conditions using propensity score models. Second, we compare the claims attribution approach to the regression approach and our propensity score stratification method in a common set of beneficiaries age 65 and over drawn from the 2009 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey. Our estimates show that the three methods have important differences in spending allocation and that the propensity score model likely offers the best theoretical and empirical combination.

10.3386/w25233.abstractZh: 将医疗支出按疾病类型进行划分，对于理解医疗服务的成本负担至关重要。目前有两种主要的方法用于衡量特定疾病的支出。第一种方法是将每项医疗报销与所列为病因的疾病进行关联。第二种方法则是将一个人在一年内的总支出，按照其所患疾病的累积数量进行分解。传统上，这种分析是通过回归分析来完成的。本文提出了两项创新：首先，我们开发了一种新的方法，利用倾向得分模型将支出与疾病类型进行关联；其次，我们在2009年Medicare当前受益人调查中选取了65岁及以上的共同受益人群体，将倾向得分分层方法与回归分析方法进行了比较。我们的估计结果显示，这三种方法在支出分配上存在显著差异，而倾向得分模型可能提供了最佳的理論和實證結合方案。

abstract.text: In 2008, a group of uninsured low-income adults in Oregon was selected by lottery for the chance to apply for Medicaid. Using this randomized design and state administrative data on voter behavior, we analyze how a Medicaid expansion affected voter turnout and registration. We find that Medicaid increased voter turnout in the November 2008 Presidential election by about 7 percent overall, with the effects concentrated in men (18 percent increase) and in residents of democratic counties (10 percent increase); there is suggestive evidence that the increase in voting reflected new voter registrations, rather than increased turnout among pre-existing registrants. There is no evidence of an increase in voter turnout in subsequent elections, up to and including the November 2010 midterm election.

10.3386/w25244.abstractZh: 2008年，俄勒冈州的一群无保险的低收入成年人通过抽签获得了申请医疗补助的机会。利用这种随机设计和州级选民行为数据，我们分析了医疗补助扩展对选民投票率和登记情况的影响。研究发现，医疗补助使2008年11月总统选举中的选民投票率总体上升了约7%，这一影响主要集中在男性（增加了18%）和民主党的县居民（增加了10%）。有迹象表明，投票率的上升反映了新的选民登记，而不是现有登记选民的投票率增加。在随后的选举中，包括2010年11月的中期选举在内，没有证据表明选民投票率有所上升。

abstract.text: We investigate two-way causality between health and the hourly wage by employing insights from the human capital and compensating wage differential models, a panel formed from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997, and dynamic panel estimation methods in this investigation. We uncover a causal relationship between two of five measures of health and the wage in which a reduction in health leads to an increase in the wage rate but find no evidence of a causal relationship running from the wage rate to health. The former result is consistent with a framework in which a large amount of effort in one period is required to obtain promotions and the wage increases that accompany them in subsequent periods. That effort may cause reductions in health and result in a negative effect of health in the previous period on the current period wage. The finding also is consistent with a model in which investments in career advancement compete with investments in health for time—the ultimate scarce resource. The lack of a causal effect of the wage on health may suggest that forces that go in opposite directions in the human capital and compensating wage differential models offset each other.

10.3386/w25264.abstractZh: 我们通过运用人力资本模型和补偿工资差异模型的见解，以及来自1997年青年纵向调查的数据，并结合动态面板估计方法，研究了健康与小时工资之间的双向因果关系。研究发现，在五个健康指标中，有两个指标与健康工资之间存在因果关系：健康状况的下降会导致工资率的上升，但并未发现工资率对健康有影响的证据。这一结果与一种框架相符，即在一个时期需要付出大量努力才能获得晋升以及随之而来的工资增长，这种努力可能导致健康状况的下降，从而在前期对当期工资产生负面影响。这一发现也与一种模型相符，即职业发展投资与健康投资在时间上的竞争——时间是最终稀缺资源。工资对健康缺乏因果效应可能表明，在人力资本和补偿工资差异模型中，相反方向的力相互抵消了。

abstract.text: In 1973, the Indonesian government began one of the largest school construction programs ever. We use 2016 nationally representative data to examine the long-term and intergenerational effects of additional schooling as a child. We use a difference-in-differences identification strategy exploiting variation across birth cohorts and regions in the number of schools built. Men and women exposed to the program attain more education, although women’s effects are concentrated in primary school. As adults, men exposed to the program are more likely to be formal workers, work outside agriculture, and migrate. Households with parents exposed to the program have improved living standards and pay more government taxes. Education benefits are transmitted to the next generation. Increased parental education has larger impacts for daughters, particularly if mothers are exposed to school construction. Intergenerational results are driven by changes in the marriage partner’s characteristics, with spouses having more education and improved labor market outcomes.

10.3386/w25265.abstractZh: 1973年，印度尼西亚政府启动了有史以来规模最大的学校建设计划之一。我们利用2016年的全国代表性数据，研究儿童时期接受更多教育所带来的长期影响以及代际效应。我们采用差异-差异识别策略，利用不同出生队列和地区在学校建设数量上的差异进行研究。参与该计划的男女都获得了更高的教育水平，不过女性的教育收益主要集中在小学阶段。作为成年人，参与该计划的男性更有可能从事正式工作，离开农业领域，并选择移民。父母参与该计划的家庭，其生活水平有所提高，并且缴纳的政府税收也更多。教育带来的好处会传递给下一代。父母的教育程度越高，对女儿的影响越大，尤其是当母亲也参与学校建设计划时。代际效应主要由配偶特征的变化所驱动，受教育程度较高的配偶往往能拥有更好的劳动力市场状况。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes statistical issues arising from networks based on non-representative samples of the population. We first characterize the biases in both network statistics and estimates of network effects under non-random sampling analytically and numerically. Sampled network data systematically bias the properties of population networks and suffer from non-classical measurement-error problems when applied as regressors. Apart from the sampling rate and the elicitation procedure, these biases depend in a nontrivial way on which subpopulations are missing with higher probability. We propose a methodology, adapting post-stratification weighting approaches to networked contexts, which enables researchers to recover several network-level statistics and reduce the biases in the estimated network effects. The advantages of the proposed methodology are that it can be applied to network data collected via both designed and non-designed sampling procedures, does not require one to assume any network formation model, and is straightforward to implement. We apply our approach to two widely used network data sets and show that accounting for the non-representativeness of the sample dramatically changes the results of regression analysis.

10.3386/w25270.abstractZh: 本文分析了基于非代表性样本的网络中出现的统计问题。我们首先从分析和数值上描述了在非随机抽样情况下，网络统计数据和网络效应估计中的偏差。抽样网络数据会系统性地影响人口网络的特性，并在作为回归变量使用时出现非经典的测量误差问题。除了抽样率和抽样程序之外，这些偏差还取决于哪些子群体更有可能缺失。我们提出了一种方法，将事后分层加权方法应用于网络环境，使研究人员能够恢复多个网络层面的统计数据，并减少估计出的网络效应中的偏差。该方法的好处是，它可以应用于通过设计或非设计抽样程序收集的网络数据，不需要假设任何网络形成模型，并且实施起来非常简便。我们将该方法应用于两个常用的网络数据集，并发现考虑到样本的非代表性可以显著改变回归分析的结果。

abstract.text: We study whether and how peer referrals increase screening, testing, and identification of patients with tuberculosis, an infectious disease responsible for over one million deaths annually. In an experiment with 3,176 patients at 122 tuberculosis treatment centers in India, we find that small financial incentives raise the probability that existing patients refer prospective patients for screening and testing, resulting in cost-effective identification of new cases. Incentivized referrals operate through two mechanisms: peers have private information about individuals in their social networks to target for outreach, and they are more effective than health workers in inducing these individuals to get tested.

10.3386/w25279.abstractZh: 我们研究了同伴推荐是否以及如何增加结核病患者的筛查、检测和识别工作。结核病是一种每年导致超过一百万人死亡的传染病。在印度122个结核病治疗中心对3,176名患者进行的实验中，我们发现小型经济激励措施能够增加现有患者推荐潜在患者接受筛查和检测的概率，从而实现对新病例的高效识别。同伴推荐机制通过两种方式发挥作用：同伴拥有其社交网络中个体的私人信息，可以针对性地进行推荐；此外，同伴在促使这些个体接受检测方面比卫生工作者更有效。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) on the quality of household food purchases using the National Household Food Acquisition and Purchase Survey (FoodAPS) and propensity score matching. A healthy purchasing index (HPI) is used to measure nutritional quality of household food purchases. WIC foods explain the improvement in quality of food purchases, not self-selection of more nutrition-conscious households into the program. The improvement in purchase quality was driven entirely by WIC participating households who redeemed WIC foods during the interview week. There was no significant difference between WIC-participants who did not redeem WIC foods and eligible non-participants. In this sample, there is no evidence that lack of access to clinics has adverse effects on participation nor is there evidence that HPI depends on supermarket access. A supervised machine learning process supports our main conclusion on the importance of WIC foods.

10.3386/w25291.abstractZh: 我们研究了妇女、婴儿和儿童特别补充营养计划对家庭食品购买质量的影响，使用了全国家庭食品采购调查（FoodAPS）和倾向得分匹配方法。健康购买指数被用来衡量家庭食品采购的营养质量。WIC食品解释了食品购买质量的提升，而不是更有营养意识的家庭自愿选择加入该计划。购买质量的提升完全是由在访谈周内使用WIC食品的参与家庭所驱动的。没有证据表明使用WIC食品的参与者与未使用WIC食品的合格非参与者之间存在显著差异。在这个样本中，没有证据表明无法获得诊所服务会对参与计划产生负面影响，也没有证据表明HPI取决于超市的访问权限。经过监督的机器学习过程支持了我们的主要结论，即WIC食品的重要性。

abstract.text: We explore whether the 2008 economic collapse in Iceland and subsequent economic crisis affected the probability of ischemic heart disease (IHD) events, independent of regular cyclical effects attributed to typical economic conditions. We estimate linear probability models using administrative data on IHD events, earnings and balance-sheet status, as well as unemployment for all Icelanders aged 16 and older in 2000-2014. We find that the sharp change in economic conditions in 2008 had a positive long-term effect on the probability of cardiovascular events in both males and females. In absolute terms these effects were small but often statistically significant and contrast with the finding that general business-cycle fluctuations operated in the opposite direction. Several potential mediators were correlated with the probability of IHD events, but their inclusion had little effect on the estimated economic crisis coefficients. A statistically significant business-cycle effect is found for both genders indicating. Thus the general business cycle and the economic collapse in 2008 and subsequent crisis can be thought of as separate phenomena with differing effects on IHD. This research contributes to the literature by exploiting a unique circumstance affecting a whole population to explore its effects on individuals, using exceptional register data.

10.3386/w25301.abstractZh: 我们探讨了2008年冰岛的经济崩溃及其后续经济危机是否影响了缺血性心脏病事件的发生率，这种影响与典型经济条件下的周期性效应无关。我们使用关于缺血性心脏病事件、收入及资产负债表状况的行政数据，以及2000至2014年间所有16岁及以上冰岛人的失业数据，建立了线性概率模型。研究发现，2008年经济条件的急剧变化对男性和女性的心血管事件发生率产生了长期积极影响。从绝对值来看，这些影响虽然较小，但通常在统计上显著，这与一般商业周期波动方向相反。一些潜在的中介变量与缺血性心脏病事件的发生率相关，但它们的加入对估计出的经济危机系数影响甚微。研究发现，男女两性的商业周期效应均具有统计学意义。因此，一般商业周期以及2008年的经济崩溃及其后续危机可以被视为两种不同的现象，它们对缺血性心脏病的影响各不相同。本研究通过利用独特的登记数据，探索了整体人口状况对其个体影响的研究，为相关文献做出了贡献。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the economic returns to parental health. To account for potential endogeneity between parental health and child outcomes, we leverage longitudinal microdata from Indonesia to estimate individual fixed effects models. Our results show that the economic returns to parental health are high. We show that maternal health not only significantly affects her children’s health, but is also intrinsically linked to her spouse’s labor market status and earnings. Paternal health appears to be more linked to child schooling outcomes, especially for girls. When both parents are in poor health, the negative effects on their children are compounded. Additionally, the consequences of poor parental health are enduring. Longer-run effects of poor parental health manifest in a lower likelihood of high school completion, fewer years of schooling, and poorer adult health.

10.3386/w25304.abstractZh: 本文研究了父母健康对经济的回报。为了考虑父母健康与子女结果之间的潜在内生性，我们利用了印度尼西亚的纵向微观数据来估计个体固定效应模型。研究结果表明，父母健康的经济回报很高。我们发现，母亲的健康不仅显著影响子女的健康状况，还与配偶的劳动力市场状况及收入密切相关。父亲的健康则更多地与子女的教育成果相关，尤其是女孩。当父母双方健康状况不佳时，对子女的影响会进一步加剧。此外，父母健康不佳的后果是长期的，表现为高中毕业的可能性降低、受教育年限减少以及成年后的健康状况较差。

abstract.text: This study exploits over 5,000 variations in subsidy generosity across ages and municipalities in Japan to examine how children respond to healthcare prices. We find that free care significantly increases outpatient spending, with price elasticities considerably smaller than for adults. Price responses are substantially larger when small copayments are introduced, indicating more elastic demand around a zero price. We also find that increased utilization primarily reflects low-value and costly care: increased outpatient spending neither reduces subsequent hospitalization by “avoidable” conditions nor improves short- or medium-term health outcomes. By contrast, inappropriate use of antibiotics and costly after-hours visits increase.

10.3386/w25306.abstractZh: 本研究利用日本超过5,000种不同年龄段和地区补贴政策的差异，来研究儿童对医疗价格的反应。研究发现，免费医疗显著增加了门诊支出，其价格弹性远低于成人。当引入小额自付费用时，价格反应显著增强，表明在零价格附近的需求更为弹性。此外，研究还发现，医疗服务的增加主要反映了低价值和高成本的治疗：门诊支出的增加既没有减少“可避免”疾病的后续住院情况，也没有改善短期或中期的健康结果。相反，不恰当的抗生素使用以及昂贵的非工作时间就诊则会增加医疗成本。

abstract.text: This paper proposes strategies for defining, identifying, and estimating features of treatment-effect distributions in contexts where multiple outcomes are of interest. After describing existing empirical approaches used in such settings, the paper develops a notion of treatment preference that is shown to be a feature of standard treatment-effect analysis in the single-outcome case. Focusing largely on binary outcomes, treatment-preference probability treatment effects (PTEs) are defined and are seen to correspond to familiar average treatment effects in the single-outcome case. The paper suggests seven possible characterizations of treatment preference appropriate to multiple-outcome contexts. Under standard assumptions about unconfoundedness of treatment assignment, the PTEs are shown to be point identified for three of the seven characterizations and set identified for the other four. Probability bounds are derived and empirical approaches to estimating the bounds—or the PTEs themselves in the point-identified cases—are suggested. These empirical approaches are straightforward, involving in most instances little more than estimation of binary-outcome probability models of what are commonly known as composite outcomes. The results are illustrated with simulated data and in analyses of two microdata samples. Finally, the main results are extended to situations where the component outcomes are ordered or categorical.

10.3386/w25307.abstractZh: 本文提出了在多个结果值得关注的情况下，定义、识别并估计处理效应分布特征的策略。在描述了现有用于此类情形的实证方法之后，本文提出了一种处理偏好概念，该概念被证明是单一结果情况下标准处理效应分析的一个特征。主要关注二元结果，定义了处理偏好概率处理效应（PTEs），并发现它们与单一结果情况下的平均处理效应相对应。本文提出了七种适用于多结果情境的处理偏好表征方式。在关于处理分配无混杂性的标准假设下，对于七种表征方式中的三种，PTEs被证明是可以点识别的，而对于另外四种则可以被设定为集合识别的。文中还推导出了概率界限，并提出了估计这些界限或点识别情况下的PTEs本身的实证方法。这些实证方法非常直接，在大多数情况下，只需对二元结果的概率模型进行估计即可。结果通过模拟数据和两个微观数据样本的分析得到了验证。最后，主要结果被扩展到组件结果具有顺序性或分类性的情况。

abstract.text: This paper examines potential tradeoffs between research methods in answering important questions versus providing more cleanly identified estimates on problems that are potentially of lesser interest. The strengths and limitations of experimental and quasi-experimental methods are discussed and it is postulated that confidence in the results obtained may sometimes be overvalued compared to the importance of the topics addressed. The consequences of this are modeled and several suggestions are provided regarding possible steps to encourage greater focus on questions of fundamental importance.

10.3386/w25320.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在回答重要问题时，不同研究方法之间可能存在的权衡，以及对于潜在兴趣较低的问题，是否能提供更清晰、更明确的估计结果。文章讨论了实验法和准实验法的优势与局限性，并认为，与所研究问题的的重要性相比，对所得结果的信心有时可能被高估了。文章还模拟了这种后果，并提出了一些建议，以鼓励人们更加关注那些具有根本重要性的问题。

abstract.text: Despite a vast literature on the determinants of prescription opioid use, the role of health insurance plans has received little attention. We study how the form of Medicare beneficiaries’ drug coverage affects the volume of opioids they consume. We find that enrollment in Medicare Advantage, which integrates drug coverage with other medical benefits, significantly reduces beneficiaries’ likelihood of filling an opioid prescription, as compared to enrollment in a stand-alone drug plan. Approximately half of this effect was due to fewer fills from prescribers who write a very large number of opioid prescriptions.

10.3386/w25327.abstractZh: 尽管关于处方阿片类药物使用决定因素的文献众多，但健康保险计划的作用却鲜被关注。我们研究了Medicare受益人的药物覆盖形式对其阿片类药物消费量的影响。研究发现，与单独的药物计划相比，参加Medicare Advantage计划（该计划将药物覆盖与其他医疗福利相结合）显著降低了受益人填写阿片类药物处方的可能性。这一效果大约有一半是由于开具大量阿片类处方的医生减少了受益人的处方数量所致。

abstract.text: I investigate whether the types of cancer (breast, colon, lung, etc.) subject to greater penetration of new ideas had larger subsequent survival gains and mortality reductions, controlling for changing incidence. I use the MEDLINE/PubMED database, which contains more than 23 million references to journal articles published in 5400 leading biomedical journals, to construct longitudinal measures of the penetration of new medical ideas. The 5-year survival rate is strongly positively related to the novelty of ideas in articles published 12-24 years earlier. This finding is consistent with evidence from case studies that it takes a long time for research evidence to reach clinical practice. The estimates suggest that about 70% of the 1994-2008 increase in the 5-year observed survival rate for all cancer sites combined may have been due to the increase in the novelty of medical ideas 12-24 years earlier. The number of years of potential life lost from cancer before ages 80 and 70 are inversely related to the novelty of ideas in articles published 12-24 years earlier, conditional on incidence. The increase in medical idea novelty was estimated to have caused a 38% decline in the premature (before age 80) cancer mortality rate 12-24 years later.

10.3386/w25328.abstractZh: 我研究的是哪些类型的癌症（如乳腺癌、结肠癌、肺癌等）对新思想的接受程度更高，并且在控制了发病率变化的情况下，这些癌症在后续的生存率和死亡率降低方面表现更为显著。我使用了MEDLINE/PubMED数据库，该数据库包含了5400种主流生物医学期刊中发表的2300多万篇参考文献，以此来构建新医学思想普及程度的纵向指标。5年生存率与12-24年前文章中新思想的创新性有着强烈的正相关关系。这一发现与案例研究的证据一致，即研究证据转化为临床实践需要很长时间。估计结果显示，1994-2008年间所有癌症类型5年生存率的增加，约70%可能是由于12-24年前医学思想创新性的提升所致。在控制发病率的情况下，80岁和70岁之前因癌症而失去的潜在寿命年数与12-24年前文章中新思想的创新性呈负相关。医学思想创新性的提升估计在12-24年后导致了过早（80岁之前）癌症死亡率降低了38%。

abstract.text: Using two hundred years of national and Massachusetts data on medical care and health, we examine how central medical care is to life expectancy gains. While common theories about medical care cost growth stress growing demand, our analysis highlights the importance of supply side factors, including the major public investments in research, workforce training and hospital construction that fueled a surge in spending over the 1955-1975 span. There is a stronger case that personal medicine affected health in the second half of the twentieth century than in the preceding 150 years. Finally, we consider whether medical care productivity decreases over time, and find that spending increased faster than life expectancy, although the ratio stabilized in the past two decades.

10.3386/w25330.abstractZh: 我们利用两百年来关于美国各州及马萨诸塞州在医疗与健康方面的数据，研究医疗护理对预期寿命提升的重要性。虽然关于医疗成本增长的常见理论强调需求的增长，但我们的分析指出，供应方面的因素同样重要，其中包括政府对研究、劳动力培训以及医院建设的大规模投资，这些因素推动了1955年至1975年间医疗支出的快速增长。在二十世纪后半叶，个人医疗护理对健康的积极影响比前150年更为显著。最后，我们探讨了医疗护理的生产力是否随时间下降，发现医疗支出的增长速度超过了预期寿命的增长速度，尽管在过去二十年里这一比例趋于稳定。

abstract.text: In the first half of the twentieth century, the rate of death from infectious disease in the United States fell precipitously. Although this decline is well-known and well-documented, there is surprisingly little evidence about whether it took place uniformly across the regions of the U.S. We use data on infectious disease deaths from all reporting U.S. cities to describe regional patterns in the decline of urban infectious mortality from 1900 to 1948. We report three main results: First, urban infectious mortality was higher in the South in every year from 1900 to 1948. Second, infectious mortality declined later in southern cities than in cities in the other regions. Third, comparatively high infectious mortality in southern cities was driven primarily by extremely high infectious mortality among African Americans. From 1906 to 1920, African Americans in cities experienced a rate of death from infectious disease greater than what urban whites experienced during the 1918 flu pandemic.

10.3386/w25345.abstractZh: 在二十世纪上半叶，美国因传染病导致的死亡率急剧下降。尽管这一下降现象广为人知且记录详尽，但令人惊讶的是，几乎没有证据表明这一变化在美国各地区的分布是均匀的。我们利用所有美国城市的传染病死亡数据，来描述1900年至1948年间城市传染病死亡率下降的区域性特征。我们得出了三个主要结论：首先，从1900年到1948年，南部的城市传染病死亡率始终高于其他地区；其次，南部城市的传染病死亡率下降时间晚于其他地区的城市；第三，南部城市较高的传染病死亡率主要源于非裔美国人的极高死亡率。在1906年至1920年间，城市中的非裔美国人因传染病导致的死亡率高于1918年流感大流行期间城市白人。

abstract.text: We shot videos of criminal trials using 3D Virtual Reality (VR) technology, prosecuted by actual prosecutors and defended by actual defense attorneys in an actual courtroom. This is the first paper that utilizes VR technology in a non-computer animated setting, which allows us to replace white defendants in the courtroom with individuals who have Middle Eastern or North African descent in a real-life environment. We alter only the race of the defendants in these trials, holding all activity in the courtroom constant, creating arguably perfect counterfactuals (http://proficient.ninja/splitscreen/). Law students, economics students, practicing lawyers and judges are randomly assigned to watch with VR headsets, the trials that differed only in defendants’ race. Background information obtained from the evaluators allowed us to identify their cultural heritage. Evaluators made decisions on guilt/innocence in these burglary and assault cases, as well as prison sentence length and fine in accordance with the guidelines provided by the relevant law. There is evidence that evaluators are harsher towards defendants of their own race during the guilt-innocence decision. In the sentencing phase, we find in-group bias in the opposite direction: evaluators are more lenient towards defendants of their own race. This is the first paper that identifies such opposing effects of bias within the same decision sequence. Regarding overall racial bias, we document that minorities are more likely to get convicted, and that they are given stiffer punishment, conditional on conviction. We find only scant evidence that the concerns of the evaluators about terrorism, about immigration, or their trust in the judiciary or the police have an impact on their judicial decisions, suggesting that the source of the bias may be deep-rooted. Merging a small sample of judges and prosecutors with the sample of lawyers provides results that are very similar to those obtained from the analysis of lawyers.

10.3386/w25355.abstractZh: 我们使用3D虚拟现实技术拍摄了刑事审判的视频，由真正的检察官进行起诉，由真正的辩护律师进行辩护，场景则发生在真实的法庭上。这是第一篇在非计算机动画环境中运用虚拟现实技术的论文，它允许我们在真实环境中用具有中东或北非血统的人替代法庭上的白人被告。我们仅改变了被告的种族，同时保持法庭内所有活动的不变性，从而创造出近乎完美的反事实情境（http://proficient.ninja/splitscreen/）。法律专业的学生、经济学专业的学生、执业律师和法官被随机分配使用虚拟现实头盔观看这些仅在被告种族上有所不同的审判。从评估者那里获得的背景信息使我们能够识别他们的文化遗产。评估者根据这些盗窃和袭击案件中的有罪/无罪判断，以及根据相关法律规定的监狱服刑时间和罚款金额来做出裁决。有证据表明，评估者在判断有罪或无罪时，对自己种族的被告更为严厉。在量刑阶段，我们发现评估者对自己种族的被告更为宽容，这形成了相反的方向的群体偏见。这是第一篇在同一决策序列中识别出这种相反偏见效应的论文。关于整体种族偏见，我们发现少数族裔更有可能被定罪，并且即使被定罪，他们也会受到更严厉的惩罚。我们发现几乎没有证据表明评估者对于恐怖主义、移民问题，或者他们对司法系统或警察的信任，会对他们的司法决策产生影响，这表明偏见的来源可能是根深蒂固的。将一小部分法官和检察官与律师样本进行合并后，得到的结果与从律师分析中获得的结果非常相似。

abstract.text: We assess evidence from randomized control trials (RCTs) on long-run economic productivity and living standards in poor countries. We first document that several studies estimate large positive long-run impacts, but that relatively few existing RCTs have been evaluated over the long-run. We next present evidence from a systematic survey of existing RCTs, with a focus on cash transfer and child health programs, and show that a meaningful subset can realistically be evaluated for long-run effects. We discuss ways to bridge the gap between the burgeoning number of development RCTs and the limited number that have been followed up to date, including through new panel (longitudinal) data, improved participant tracking methods, alternative research designs, and access to administrative, remote sensing, and cell phone data. We conclude that the rise of development economics RCTs since roughly 2000 provides a novel opportunity to generate high-quality evidence on the long-run drivers of living standards.

10.3386/w25356.abstractZh: 我们评估了关于贫困国家长期经济生产力和生活水平的随机对照试验（RCTs）的证据。首先，我们发现一些研究估计了显著的长期积极影响，但迄今为止，相对较少的RCTs被评估了长期效果。接下来，我们通过对现有RCTs的系统调查，重点关注现金转移和儿童健康项目，并表明可以实际评估相当一部分RCTs的长期效果。我们讨论了如何弥合日益增多的发展RCTs与目前被跟进的有限数量之间的差距，包括使用新的面板数据、改进参与者跟踪方法、替代研究设计，以及获取行政、遥感和数据等途径。我们得出结论，自2000年左右以来，发展经济学RCTs的兴起为生成关于生活水平长期驱动因素的高质量证据提供了新的机会。

abstract.text: We develop a model of rational self-medication in which individuals use potentially dangerous or addictive substances (e.g., alcohol) to manage symptoms of illness (e.g., depression) outside of formal medical care. A model implication is that the emergence of better treatments reduces incentives to self-medicate. To investigate, we use forty years of longitudinal data from the Framingham Heart Study and leverage the exogenous introduction of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs). We demonstrate an economically meaningful reduction in alcohol consumption when SSRIs became available. Our findings illustrate how the effects of medical innovation operate, in part, through changes in behavior.

10.3386/w25371.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个理性自我用药的模型，其中个体使用可能具有危险性或成瘾性的物质（如酒精）来应对疾病症状（如抑郁症），而无需接受正式的医疗护理。该模型的一个推论是，更好的治疗方法的出现会降低自我用药的动机。为了验证这一推论，我们利用了弗雷明汉心脏研究四十年的纵向数据，并引入选择性血清素再摄取抑制剂（SSRIs）这一外生因素。我们发现，当SSRIs问世后，酒精消费量显著减少。我们的研究结果说明了医疗创新的影响部分是通过行为变化来实现的。

abstract.text: Reinsurance can complement risk adjustment of health plan payments to improve fit of payments to plan spending at the individual and group level. This paper proposes three improvements in health plan payment systems using reinsurance. First, we base reinsurance payments on spending not accounted for by the risk adjustment system, rather than just high spending. Second, we propose pairing reinsurance for individual-level losses with repayments for individual-level profits. Third, we optimize the weights on the risk adjustors taking account of the presence of reinsurance/repayment. We implement our methodology in data from Germany, The Netherlands and the U.S. Marketplaces, comparing our modified approach to plan payment with risk adjustment as currently practiced in the three settings. The combination of the three improvements yields very substantial improvements in the individual-level fit of payments to plan spending in all three countries.

10.3386/w25374.abstractZh: 再保险可以补充健康计划支付的风险调整，从而改善个人和群体层面支付与计划支出的匹配度。本文提出了三种利用再保险改进健康计划支付系统的方案。首先，我们基于风险调整系统未涵盖的支出进行再保险支付，而不仅仅是基于高支出进行支付。其次，我们建议将个人层面的损失再保险与个人层面的利润偿还相结合。第三，我们优化了风险调整因素的权重，同时考虑到了再保险/偿还的存在。我们在德国、荷兰和美国市场的数据上实施了我们的方法，并将我们改进的支付方法与当前三种情况下采用的风险调整方法进行了比较。这三种改进的结合，在所有三个国家都显著提高了支付与计划支出在个人层面的匹配度。

abstract.text: A large literature has documented links between harmful early life exposures and later life health and socioeconomic deficits. These studies, however, are typically unable to examine the possibility that these shocks are transmitted to the next generation. Our study traces the impacts of in utero exposure to the 1918 influenza pandemic on the outcomes of the children and grandchildren of those affected using representative survey data from the US. We find evidence of multigenerational effects on educational, economic, and health outcomes.

10.3386/w25377.abstractZh: 大量文献记录了有害的早期生活经历与后期健康和社会经济缺陷之间的关联。然而，这些研究通常无法探讨这些冲击是否会传递给下一代。我们的研究通过美国代表性的调查数据，追踪了1918年流感大流行在子宫内暴露对儿童及其孙辈的影响。我们发现存在多代影响，涉及教育、经济和健康方面的结果。

abstract.text: Individual producers exhibit enormous heterogeneity in many dimensions. This paper develops a theory in which the network structure of production—who buys inputs from whom—forms endogenously. Entrepreneurs produce using labor and exactly one intermediate input; the key decision is which other entrepreneur's good to use as an input. Their choices collectively determine the economy's equilibrium input–output structure, generating large differences in size and shaping both individual and aggregate productivity. When the elasticity of output to intermediate inputs in production is high, star suppliers emerge endogenously. This raises aggregate productivity as, in equilibrium, more supply chains are routed through higher‐productivity techniques.

10.3982/ecta10731.abstractZh: 个体生产者在许多方面表现出巨大的异质性。本文提出了一个理论，其中生产的网络结构——即从谁那里购买投入品——是内生形成的。企业家使用劳动和恰好一种中间投入品进行生产；关键的决定是选择使用哪位其他企业家的产品作为投入品。他们的选择共同决定了经济的均衡投入-产出结构，从而产生了巨大的规模差异，并影响个体和整体生产率。当生产中对中间投入品的产出弹性较高时，星形供应商会内生出现。这提高了总体生产率，因为在均衡状态下，更多的供应链会采用更高生产率的技术。

abstract.text: We analyze trading speed and fragmentation in asset markets. In our model, trading venues make technological investments and compete for investors who choose where and how much to trade. Faster venues charge higher fees and attract speed-sensitive investors. Competition among venues increases investor participation, trading volume, and allocative efficiency, but entry and fragmentation can be excessive, and speeds are generically inefficient. Regulations that protect transaction prices (e.g., Securities and Exchange Commission trade-through rule) lead to greater fragmentation. Our model sheds light on the experience of European and U.S. markets since the implementation of Markets in Financial Instruments Directive and Regulation National Markets System.

10.3982/ecta10762.abstractZh: 我们分析了资产市场的交易速度和市场碎片化现象。在我们的模型中，交易场所进行技术投资，并竞争那些选择交易地点和交易规模的投资者。速度更快的交易场所收取更高的费用，从而吸引对速度敏感的投资者。不同交易场所之间的竞争增加了投资者的参与度、交易量和资源配置效率，但过度竞争可能导致市场碎片化程度过高，整体交易速度也往往不够高效。保护交易价格的规定（例如证券交易委员会的交易直通规则）反而会导致市场更加碎片化。我们的模型揭示了自《金融工具市场指令》和《国家市场体系法规》实施以来，欧洲和美国市场的现状。

abstract.text: We propose uncertainty shocks as a new shock that drives business cycles. First, we demonstrate that microeconomic uncertainty is robustly countercyclical, rising sharply during recessions, particularly during the Great Recession of 2007-2009. Second, we quantify the impact of time-varying uncertainty on the economy in a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We find that reasonably calibrated uncertainty shocks can explain drops and rebounds in GDP of around 3%. Moreover, we show that increased uncertainty alters the relative impact of government policies, making them initially less effective and then subsequently more effective.

10.3982/ecta10927.abstractZh: 我们提出不确定性冲击作为驱动商业周期的新因素。首先，我们证明微观经济不确定性具有稳健的反周期特性，在经济衰退期间会显著上升，尤其是在2007-2009年的大衰退期间。其次，我们在一个包含异质企业的动态随机一般均衡模型中，量化了时间变化的不确定性对经济的影响。我们发现，经过合理校准的不确定性冲击可以解释GDP的约3%的波动。此外，我们还发现，不确定性增加会改变政府政策的相对影响，使得这些政策最初效果减弱，随后又变得更为有效。

abstract.text: We bring together the theories of duality and dynamic programming. We show that the dual of a separable dynamic optimization problem can be recursively decomposed. We provide a dual version of the principle of optimality and give conditions under which the dual Bellman operator is a contraction with the optimal dual value function its unique fixed point. We relate primal and dual problems, address computational issues and give examples.

10.3982/ecta11905.abstractZh: 我们将对偶性理论动态规划理论相结合。我们证明了可分离动态优化问题的对偶问题可以递归分解。我们提供了最优性原理的对偶版本，并给出了使对偶贝尔曼算子成为收缩映射的条件，该收缩映射以最优对偶值函数为其唯一固定点。我们建立了原问题与对偶问题的关系，解决了计算问题，并给出了实例。

abstract.text: Many time-series data are known to exhibit 'long memory', that is, they have an autocorrelation function that decays very slowly with lag. This behaviour has traditionally been attributed to either aggregation of heterogenous processes, nonlinearity, learning dynamics, regime switching, structural breaks, unit roots or fractional Brownian motion. This paper identifies an entirely different mechanism for long memory generation by showing that it can naturally arise when a large number of simply linear homogenous economic subsystems with a short memory are interconnected to form a network such that the outputs of each of the subsystem are fed into the inputs of others. This networking picture yields a type of aggregation that is not merely additive, resulting in a collective behaviour that is richer than that of individual subsystems. Interestingly, the long memory behaviour is found to be almost entirely determined by the geometry of the network while being relatively insensitive to the specific behaviour of individual agents.

10.3982/ecta11930.abstractZh: 许多时间序列数据表现出“长记忆”特性，即它们的自相关函数随着滞后时间的增加而缓慢衰减。这种行为传统上被归因于异质过程的聚合、非线性、学习动态、制度转换、结构突变、单位根或分数布朗运动等因素。本文提出了一种完全不同的长记忆生成机制，指出当大量具有短记忆特性的简单线性同质经济子系统相互连接形成网络时，长记忆现象可以自然产生。在这种网络中，各个子系统的输出被输入到其他子系统的输入中，从而形成一种并非单纯加和的聚合效应，导致整体行为比单个子系统更为复杂。有趣的是，长记忆行为几乎完全由网络的几何结构决定，而对单个代理人的具体行为相对不敏感。

abstract.text: We propose a model of trade in over-the-counter (OTC) markets in which each dealer with private information can engage in bilateral transactions with other dealers, as determined by her links in a network.Each dealer's strategy is represented as a quantity-price schedule.We analyze the effect of trade decentralization and adverse selection on information diffusion, expected profits, trading costs and welfare.Information diffusion through prices is not affected by dealers' strategic trading motives, and there is an informational externality that constrains the informativeness of prices.Trade decentralization can both increase or decrease welfare.A dealer's trading cost is driven by both her own and her counterparties' centrality.Central dealers tend to learn more, trade more at lower costs and earn higher expected profit.

10.3982/ecta12043.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个场外交易市场模型，在该模型中，每个拥有私人信息的交易商都可以与其他交易商进行双边交易，这种交易关系由网络中的联系决定。每个交易商的策略被表示为一个数量-价格表。我们分析了交易去中心化以及逆向选择对信息扩散、预期利润、交易成本和福利的影响。通过价格进行的信息扩散不受交易商的战略交易动机影响，而且存在一种信息外部性，限制了价格的信息含量。交易去中心化既可以增加也可以减少福利。一个交易商的交易成本受到其自身和交易对手的中心性影响。处于中心位置的交易商往往能够学习到更多信息，以更低的成本进行更多交易，并获得更高的预期利润。

abstract.text: We study commodity taxation and characterize the Laffer curve, a trade-off between tax rates and revenue, in noncompetitive markets. Pricing in these markets leads to incomplete tax pass-through and agents re-optimize their purchase and pricing decisions in response to any tax change. We use detailed data from Pennsylvania, a state that monopolizes retail sales of alcoholic beverages, to estimate a model of demand for horizontally differentiated products that ties consumers' demographic characteristics to heterogeneous preferences for spirits. We find that under the state's current tax policy, spirits are overpriced. Distillers respond to decreases in the tax rate by increasing wholesale prices, which limits the state's revenue gain to only 13% of the incremental tax revenue predicted under the common assumption of perfect competition. The strategic response of noncompetitive firms to changes in taxation therefore flattens the Laffer curve significantly.

10.3982/ecta12307.abstractZh: 我们研究了商品税收问题，并描述了拉弗曲线——即税率与税收收入之间的权衡关系——在非竞争市场中是如何形成的。在这些市场中，定价机制导致税收的传递不完全，企业会根据税收政策的变动重新优化其购买和定价决策。我们利用了宾夕法尼亚州的详细数据，该州是酒精饮料零售市场的垄断者，以此来估算一种针对水平差异化产品的需求模型，该模型将消费者的 demographic 特征与对烈酒的异质偏好联系起来。研究发现，在该州当前的税收政策下，烈酒的定价过高。蒸馏酒制造商对税率下降的反应是提高批发价格，这使得该州的税收收入仅增加了13%，而这一增长远远低于在完全竞争假设下预测的增量税收收入。因此，非竞争企业对于税收变化的战略反应显著地拉平了拉弗曲线。

abstract.text: We introduce the test-set equilibrium refinement of Nash equilibrium to formalize the idea that players contemplate only deviations from equilibrium play in which a single competitor plays a non-equilibrium best response. We then apply this refinement to three well-known auction games, comparing our findings to similar ones previously obtained by specialized equilibrium selections. We also introduce a theory of high stakes versions of games, in which strategies are first proposed and then subjected to a potentially costly review-and-revise process. We demonstrate a sense in which the test-set equilibria emerge from such processes when the cost of revision is small.

10.3982/ecta12536.abstractZh: 我们引入了纳什均衡的测试集精炼方法，以形式化这样一种观点：玩家只考虑偏离均衡行为的策略，其中单个竞争者的最佳响应是非均衡的。随后，我们将这一精炼方法应用于三种著名的拍卖游戏，并将我们的研究结果与通过专门均衡选择获得的类似结果进行比较。我们还提出了一种高风险游戏的理论，在这种理论中，策略首先被提出，然后经过可能成本高昂的评审与修订过程。我们证明了，在修订成本较低的情况下，测试集均衡是从这样的过程中产生的。

abstract.text: We study trading behavior and the properties of prices in informationally complex markets. Our model is based on the single-period version of the linear-normal framework of Kyle (1985). We allow for essentially arbitrary correlations among the random variables involved in the model: the value of the traded asset, the signals of strategic traders and competitive market makers, and the demand from liquidity traders. We show that there always exists a unique linear equilibrium, characterize it analytically, and illustrate its properties in a series of examples. We then use this characterization to study the informational efficiency of prices as the number of strategic traders becomes large. If liquidity demand is positively correlated (or uncorrelated) with the asset value, then prices in large markets aggregate all available information. If liquidity demand is negatively correlated with the asset value, then prices in large markets aggregate all information except that contained in liquidity demand.

10.3982/ecta12635.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息复杂市场中的交易行为及价格特性。我们的模型基于Kyle（1985）提出的线性-正态框架的单期版本。我们允许模型中涉及的随机变量之间存在几乎任意的相关性：交易资产的价值、策略性交易者的信号、竞争性做市商的行为，以及流动性交易者的需求。我们证明，总是存在一个唯一的线性均衡，并通过一系列例子对其特性进行了分析说明。随后，我们利用这一特性来研究当策略性交易者数量增加时，价格的信息效率。如果流动性需求与资产价值呈正相关（或负相关），那么大型市场中的价格会整合所有可用信息。如果流动性需求与资产价值呈负相关，那么大型市场中的价格会整合除流动性需求之外的所有信息。

abstract.text: To study intertemporal decisions under risk, we develop a new recursive model of non‐expected‐utility preferences. The main axiom of our analysis is called mixture aversion, as it captures a dislike of probabilistic mixtures of lotteries. Our representation for mixture‐averse preferences can be interpreted as if an individual optimally selects her risk attitude from some feasible set. We describe some useful parametric examples of our representation and provide comparative statics that tightly link decreases in risk aversion to larger sets of feasible risk attitudes. We then present several applications of the model. In an insurance problem, mixture‐averse preferences can produce a marginal willingness to pay for insurance coverage that increases in the level of existing coverage. In investment decisions, our model can generate endogenous heterogeneity in equilibrium stock market participation, even when consumers have identical preferences. Finally, we demonstrate that our model can address the Rabin paradox even in the presence of reasonable levels of background risk.

10.3982/ecta12687.abstractZh: 为了研究风险下的跨时决策，我们开发了一个新的递归模型，用于描述非期望效用偏好。我们分析的主要公理被称为混合厌恶，它反映了对概率混合结果的厌恶。我们对混合厌恶偏好的描述可以视为个体从某个可行集合中最优地选择其风险态度。我们描述了一些有用的参数化示例，并提供了将风险厌恶程度的降低与更大范围的可行风险态度紧密联系起来的比较静态分析。随后，我们展示了该模型的几个应用。在保险问题中，混合厌恶偏好可能导致对保险覆盖的支付意愿随着现有保险覆盖水平的增加而增加。在投资决策中，即使消费者具有相同的偏好，我们的模型也能产生均衡股市参与程度的内生异质性。最后，我们证明了即使在存在合理水平的背景风险的情况下，我们的模型也能解决拉宾悖论。

abstract.text: This paper develops asymptotic approximations for kernel-based semiparametric estimators under assumptions accommodating slower-than-usual rates of convergence of their nonparametric ingredients. Our first main result is a distributional approximation for semiparametric estimators that differs from existing approximations by accounting for a bias. This bias is nonnegligible in general, and therefore poses a challenge for inference. Our second main result shows that some (but not all) nonparametric bootstrap distributional approximations provide an automatic method of correcting for the bias. Our general theory is illustrated by means of examples and its main finite sample implications are corroborated in a simulation study.
