10.3982/ecta12701.abstractZh: 本文在假设条件下，针对基于核的半参数估计量提出了渐近近似方法，这些假设考虑了其非参数成分收敛速度低于常规情况的情况。我们的第一个主要结果是一种针对半参数估计量的分布近似方法，该方法与现有近似方法不同，因为它考虑了偏差的影响。这种偏差通常是不可忽视的，因此给推断带来了挑战。我们的第二个主要结果表明，某些（但并非全部）非参数自助法分布近似方法能够自动纠正偏差。我们的总体理论通过实例进行了说明，其主要有限样本推论也在模拟研究中得到了验证。

abstract.text: High pollution persists in many developing countries despite strict environmental rules.We use a field experiment and a structural model to study how plant emission standards are enforced.In collaboration with an Indian environmental regulator, we experimentally doubled the rate of inspection for treatment plants and required that the extra inspections be assigned randomly.We find that treatment plants only slightly increased compliance.We hypothesize that this weak effect is due to poor targeting, since the random inspections in the treatment found fewer extreme violators than the regulator's own discretionary inspections.To unbundle the roles of extra inspections and the removal of discretion over what plants to target, we set out a model of environmental regulation where the regulator targets inspections, based on a signal of pollution, to maximize plant abatement.Using the experiment to identify key parameters of the model, we find that the regulator aggressively targets its discretionary inspections, to the degree that half of plants receive fewer than one inspection per year, while plants expected to be the dirtiest may receive ten.Counterfactual simulations show that discretion in targeting helps enforcement: inspections that the regulator assigns cause three times more abatement than would the same number of randomly-assigned inspections.Nonetheless, we find that the regulator's information on plant pollution is poor, and improvements in monitoring would reduce emissions.

10.3982/ecta12876.abstractZh: 尽管有严格的环保规定，许多发展中国家仍然存在严重的污染问题。我们通过一项实地实验和结构性模型来研究植物排放标准的执行情况。与印度一家环保监管机构合作，我们实验性地将处理厂的检查频率翻倍，并要求这些额外的检查要随机分配。我们发现，处理厂的合规率仅有所提升，但幅度很小。我们认为这种微弱的效果是由于目标定位不准确造成的，因为随机检查发现，那些被重点检查的处理厂比监管机构自行决定的检查对象受到的违规处罚更少。为了分离额外检查的作用与取消对处理厂目标选择的自由裁量权，我们建立了一个环境监管模型，其中监管机构根据污染信号来分配检查任务，以最大化处理厂的减排效果。通过实验确定模型的关键参数后，我们发现监管机构会积极分配自由裁量检查任务，使得一半的处理厂每年接受的检查次数少于一次，而那些被认为污染最严重的地方则可能接受十次检查。反事实模拟表明，自由裁量目标分配有助于执法：监管机构分配的检查所带来的减排效果是随机分配检查的三倍。尽管如此，我们发现监管机构对工厂污染情况的信息不足，改进监测措施将有助于减少排放。

abstract.text: We develop a tractable method for augmenting macroeconomic models with autonomous variation in higher-order beliefs. We use this to accommodate a certain type of waves of optimism and pessimism that can be interpreted as the product of frictional coordination and, unlike the one featured in the news literature, regards the short-term economic outlook rather than the medium- to long-run prospects. We show that this enrichment provides a parsimonious explanation of salient features of the data; it accounts for a significant fraction of the business-cycle volatility in estimated models that allow for various competing structural shocks; and it captures a type of fluctuations that have a Keynesian flavor but do not rely on nominal rigidities.

10.3982/ecta13079.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种可行的方法，可以在宏观经济模型中加入高阶信念的自主变化。我们利用这一方法来适应某种类型的乐观与悲观情绪，这些情绪可以被解释为摩擦性协调的结果。与新闻文献中描述的情景不同，这种情绪关注的是短期经济前景，而非中长期前景。我们证明，这种补充为数据的显著特征提供了简洁的解释；它解释了在考虑各种竞争性结构冲击的估计模型中，商业周期波动的相当一部分；并且它捕捉到了一种具有凯恩斯特征的波动，但这种波动并不依赖于名义刚性。

abstract.text: One of the main objectives of empirical analysis of experiments and quasi-experiments is to inform policy decisions that determine the allocation of treatments to individuals with different observable covariates. We study the properties and implementation of the Empirical Welfare Maximization (EWM) method, which estimates a treatment assignment policy by maximizing the sample analog of average social welfare over a class of candidate treatment policies. The EWM approach is attractive in terms of both statistical performance and practical implementation in realistic settings of policy design. Common features of these settings include: (i) feasible treatment assignment rules are constrained exogenously for ethical, legislative, or political reasons, (ii) a policy maker wants a simple treatment assignment rule based on one or more eligibility scores in order to reduce the dimensionality of individual observable characteristics, and/or (iii) the proportion of individuals who can receive the treatment is a priori limited due to a budget or a capacity constraint. We show that when the propensity score is known, the average social welfare attained by EWM rules converges at least at n1/2 rate to the maximum obtainable welfare uniformly over a minimally constrained class of data distributions, and this uniform convergence rate is minimax optimal. We examine how the uniform convergence rate depends on the richness of the class of candidate decision rules, the distribution of conditional treatment effects, and the lack of knowledge of the propensity score. We offer easily implementable algorithms for computing the EWM rule and an application using experimental data from the National JTPA Study.

10.3982/ecta13288.abstractZh: 对实验和准实验进行实证分析的主要目的之一，是为决策提供依据，从而决定如何将治疗分配给具有不同可观测协变量的个体。我们研究了实证福利最大化方法的性质和实施情况。该方法通过最大化一类候选治疗政策下的样本平均社会福利来估计治疗分配政策。在现实的政策设计中，实证福利最大化方法在统计性能和实际实施方面都具有吸引力。这些场景的常见特点包括：(i) 出于伦理、立法或政治原因，可行的治疗分配规则受到外部限制；(ii) 政策制定者希望有一个基于一个或多个资格评分的简单治疗分配规则，以减少个体可观测特征的维度，和/或(iii) 由于预算或容量限制，能够接受治疗的个体比例事先是有限的。我们证明，当倾向得分已知时，EWM规则所达到的平均社会福利至少以n1/2的速率收敛到最大可能福利，这种均匀收敛速率是极小最优的。我们研究了均匀收敛速率如何依赖于候选决策规则类的丰富度、条件治疗效应的分布以及倾向得分的未知程度。我们提供了易于实施的算法来计算EWM规则，并应用了来自国家JTPA研究的实验数据进行了验证。

abstract.text: Conjugate duality relationships are pervasive in matching and implementation problems and provide much of the structure essential for characterizing stable matches and implementable allocations in models with quasilinear (or transferable) utility. In the absence of quasilinearity, a more abstract duality relationship, known as a Galois connection, takes the role of (generalized) conjugate duality. While weaker, this duality relationship still induces substantial structure. We show that this structure can be used to extend existing results for, and gain new insights into, adverse-selection principal-agent problems and two-sided matching problems without quasilinearity.

10.3982/ecta13307.abstractZh: 共轭对偶关系在匹配与实施问题中普遍存在，为刻画稳定匹配和可实现分配提供了重要的结构基础，这些模型具有准线性（或可转移）效用特性。在缺乏准线性性的情况下，一种更为抽象的对偶关系——伽罗瓦联络，取代了（广义的）共轭对偶关系。尽管这种对偶关系较为弱化，但它仍然能够引入重要的结构。我们展示了这种结构可以用来扩展现有结果，并对缺乏准线性性的逆向选择主体问题及双边匹配问题提供新的见解。

abstract.text: In the unconditional moment restriction model of Hansen (), specification tests and more efficient estimators are both available whenever the number of moment restrictions exceeds the number of parameters of interest. We show that a similar relationship between potential refutability of a model and existence of more efficient estimators is present in much broader settings. Specifically, a condition we name local overidentification is shown to be equivalent to both the existence of specification tests with nontrivial local power and the existence of more efficient estimators of some “smooth” parameters in general semi/nonparametric models. Under our notion of local overidentification, various locally nontrivial specification tests such as Hausman tests, incremental Sargan tests (or optimally weighted quasi likelihood ratio tests) naturally extend to general semi/nonparametric settings. We further obtain simple characterizations of local overidentification for general models of nonparametric conditional moment restrictions with possibly different conditioning sets. The results are applied to determining when semi/nonparametric models with endogeneity are locally testable, and when nonparametric plug‐in and semiparametric two‐step GMM estimators are semiparametrically efficient. Examples of empirically relevant semi/nonparametric structural models are presented.

10.3982/ecta13559.abstractZh: 在Hansen的无条件矩限制模型中，当矩限制的数量超过感兴趣参数的数量时，不仅可以进行规格检验，还可以使用更高效的估计量。我们表明，在更广泛的情境下，模型的潜在可证伪性与更高效的估计量的存在之间存在类似的关系。具体来说，我们提出了一种称为局部过度识别的条件，该条件等价于在一般半/非参数模型中存在具有非平凡局部功效的规格检验，以及存在对某些“平滑”参数的更高效的估计量。根据我们对局部过度识别的定义，各种局部非平凡的规格检验，如Hausman检验、增量Sargan检验（或最优加权拟似然比检验），自然可以应用于一般半/非参数模型。我们进一步得到了对具有可能不同条件集的一般非参数条件矩限制模型的局部过度识别的简单描述。这些结果用于确定何时具有内生性的半/非参数模型可以在局部上进行检验，以及何时非参数插入和半参数两步GMM估计量是半参数高效的。文中还举例说明了一些具有实际意义的半/非参数结构模型。

abstract.text: This paper provides a framework for identifying preferences in a large network where links are pairwise stable. Network formation models present difficulties for identification, especially when links can be interdependent, for example, when indirect connections matter. We show how one can use the observed proportions of various local network structures to learn about the underlying preference parameters. The key assumption for our approach restricts individuals to have bounded degree in equilibrium, implying a finite number of payoff‐relevant local structures. Our main result provides necessary conditions for parameters to belong to the identified set. We then develop a quadratic programming algorithm that can be used to construct this set. With further restrictions on preferences, we show that our conditions are also sufficient for pairwise stability and therefore characterize the identified set precisely. Overall, the use of both the economic model along with pairwise stability allows us to obtain effective dimension reduction.

10.3982/ecta13564.abstractZh: 本文提供了一个框架，用于识别在链接为成对稳定的大型网络中的偏好。网络形成模型在识别过程中存在困难，特别是当链接之间存在相互依赖关系时，例如当间接连接很重要时。我们展示了如何利用各种局部网络结构的观察比例来了解潜在的偏好参数。我们方法的关键假设是，个体在均衡状态下具有有限的度，这意味着存在有限数量的与收益相关的局部结构。我们的主要结果提供了参数属于已识别集合的必要条件。随后，我们开发了一种二次规划算法，可以用来构建这个集合。通过对偏好进行进一步的限制，我们证明了这些条件也足以保证成对稳定性，从而准确地描述了已识别集合。总体而言，结合经济模型与成对稳定性，我们能够实现有效的维度缩减。

abstract.text: Work schedules play an important role in utilizing labor in organizations.In this study of emergency department physicians in shift work, schedules induce two distortions: First, physicians "slack off" by accepting fewer patients near end of shift (EOS).Second, physicians distort patient care, incurring higher costs as they spend less time on patients accepted near EOS.Examining how these effects change with shift overlap reveals a tradeoff between the two.Within an hour after the normal time of work completion, physicians are willing to spend hospital resources eight times more than their market wage to preserve their leisure.Accounting for overall costs, I find that physicians slack off at approximately second-best optimal levels.

10.3982/ecta13565.abstractZh: 工作排班在组织中劳动力的利用中起着重要作用。本研究针对轮班工作的急诊科医生进行了分析，发现排班存在两种扭曲现象：首先，医生在轮班结束时接受的患者数量减少，从而导致“懈怠”现象；其次，医生在接诊轮班结束时接受的患者上花费的时间减少，从而影响了患者的护理质量，导致成本增加。通过考察轮班重叠情况下的这些影响，可以发现两者之间存在权衡。在正常工作完成时间后的一个小时内，医生为了保留休息时间，愿意花费相当于市场工资八倍的医院资源。从整体成本来看，我发现医生在懈怠时的程度大约处于次优水平。

abstract.text: We present new identification results for a class of nonseparable nonparametric simultaneous equations models introduced by Matzkin (2008). These models combine traditional exclusion restrictions with a requirement that each structural error enter through a “residual index.” Our identification results are constructive and encompass a range of special cases with varying demands on the exogenous variation provided by instruments and the shape of the joint density of the structural errors. The most important of these results demonstrate identification even when instruments have limited variation. A genericity result demonstrates a formal sense in which the associated density conditions may be viewed as mild, even when instruments vary only over a small open ball.

10.3982/ecta13575.abstractZh: 我们提出了针对Matzkin（2008）提出的一类非可分离非参数同时方程模型的新识别结果。这些模型结合了传统的排除限制条件，并要求每个结构误差通过“残差指数”进入模型。我们的识别结果是建设性的，涵盖了多种特殊情况，这些特殊情况对工具变量提供的外生变异量以及结构误差联合密度的形状有不同的要求。其中最重要的结果表明，即使工具变量的变异有限，模型仍然可以被识别。一个通用性结果表明，在工具变量仅在小的开放球范围内变化时，相关的密度条件可以被视为较为宽松的。

abstract.text: Several school districts use assignment systems that give students an incentive to misrepresent their preferences.We find evidence consistent with strategic behavior in Cambridge.Such strategizing can complicate preference analysis.This paper develops empirical methods for studying random utility models in a new and large class of school choice mechanisms.We show that preferences are non-parametrically identified under either sufficient variation in choice environments or a preference shifter.We then develop a tractable estimation procedure and apply it to Cambridge.Estimates suggest that while 82% of students are assigned to their stated first choice, only 72% are assigned to their true first choice because students avoid ranking competitive schools.Assuming that students behave optimally, the Immediate Acceptance mechanism is preferred by the average student to the Deferred Acceptance mechanism by an equivalent of 0.08 miles.The estimated difference is smaller if beliefs are biased, and reversed if students report truthfully.

10.3982/ecta13615.abstractZh: 一些学区采用分配系统，这种系统会激励学生歪曲自己的偏好。我们发现，在剑桥地区存在与策略性行为一致的证据。这种策略性行为可能会使偏好分析变得复杂。本文提出了一种用于研究新型学校选择机制中随机效用模型的实证方法。研究表明，在选择环境足够多样化或存在偏好调整因素的情况下，偏好是可以非参数地识别的。随后，我们开发了一种可行的估计方法，并将其应用于剑桥地区。估计结果显示，尽管82%的学生被分配到他们声称的首选学校，但实际上只有72%的学生被分配到他们真正的首选学校，因为学生们会避免选择竞争激烈的学校。假设学生行为是最优的，即时接受机制比延迟接受机制更受平均学生的青睐，优势相当于0.08英里。如果假设存在偏差，这种差异会更大；如果学生如实报告，则这种差异会逆转。

abstract.text: This paper defines and analyzes a new monotonicity condition for the identification of counterfactuals and treatment effects in unordered discrete choice models with multiple treatments, heterogenous agents and discrete-valued instruments. Unordered monotonicity implies and is implied by additive separability of choice of treatment equations in terms of observed and unobserved variables. These results follow from properties of binary matrices developed in this paper. We investigate conditions under which unordered monotonicity arises as a consequence of choice behavior. We characterize IV estimators of counterfactuals as solutions to discrete mixture problems.

10.3982/ecta13777.abstractZh: 本文定义并分析了在具有多个处理、异质代理人以及离散值工具的无序离散选择模型中，用于识别反事实与处理效应的一种新的单调性条件。无序单调性意味着处理选择的决策方程在观测变量与未观测变量方面具有可加性，同时这种可加性也是无序单调性的必然结果。这些结论基于本文所发展的二元矩阵性质。我们研究了无序单调性作为选择行为结果的产生条件，并将反事实的工具变量估计量描述为离散混合问题的解。

abstract.text: We investigate the welfare effects of vertical integration of regional sports networks (RSNs) with programming distributors in U.S. multichannel television markets.Vertical integration can enhance efficiency by reducing double marginalization and increasing carriage of channels, but can also harm welfare due to foreclosure and incentives to raise rivals' costs.We estimate a structural model of viewership, subscription, distributor pricing, and affiliate fee bargaining using a rich data set on the U.S. cable and satellite television industry (2000-2010).We use these estimates to analyze the impact of simulated vertical mergers and divestitures of RSNs on competition and welfare, and examine the efficacy of regulatory policies introduced by the U.S. Federal Communications Commission to address competition concerns in this industry.

10.3982/ecta14031.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国多频道电视市场中，区域体育网络与节目分发商进行垂直整合对福利的影响。垂直整合可以通过减少双重边缘化并增加频道播放量来提高效率，但也可能因市场封锁和激励因素导致竞争对手的成本上升，从而损害福利。我们基于美国有线电视和卫星电视行业的丰富数据（2000-2010年），构建了一个关于观众数量、订阅量、分发商定价以及附属费谈判的结构模型。利用这些估计结果，我们分析了区域体育网络进行模拟的垂直合并与剥离对竞争和福利的影响，并评估了美国联邦通信委员会为应对该行业竞争问题而制定的监管政策的有效性。

abstract.text: We explore the learning process and behavior of an individual with unrealistically high expectations (“overconfidence”) when outcomes also depend on an external fundamental that affects the optimal action. Moving beyond existing results in the literature, we show that the agent’s beliefs regarding the fundamental converge under weak conditions. Furthermore, we identify a broad class of situations in which “learning” about the fundamental is self-defeating: it leads the individual systematically away from the correct belief and toward lower performance. Due to his overconfidence, the agent—even if initially correct—becomes too pessimistic about the fundamental. As he adjusts his behavior in response, he lowers outcomes and hence becomes even more pessimistic about the fundamental, perpetuating the misdirected learning. The greater is the loss from choosing a suboptimal action, the further the agent’s action ends up from optimal. We partially characterize environments in which self-defeating learning occurs, and show that the decisionmaker learns to take the optimal action if and only if a specific non-identifiability condition is satisfied. In contrast to an overconfident agent, an underconfident agent’s misdirected learning is self-limiting and therefore not very harmful. We argue that the decision situations in question are common in economic settings, including delegation, organizational, effort, and public-policy choices.

10.3982/ecta14084.abstractZh: 我们探讨了具有不切实际高期望值的个体在结果还取决于一个外部基本因素时的学习过程和行为。与现有文献的结果相比，我们发现该个体对基本因素的信念在较弱条件下会趋于一致。此外，我们识别出一类广泛的情况，其中对基本因素的“学习”是自我挫败的：它导致个体系统性地偏离正确的信念，从而导致表现下降。由于过度自信，该个体即使最初是正确的，也会对基本因素过于悲观。随着他调整自己的行为，他降低了结果，从而更加悲观地看待基本因素，进一步加剧了错误的学习行为。选择次优行动的损失越大，个体的行为就越偏离最优状态。我们部分描述了发生自我挫败学习的环境，并表明决策者在满足特定非可识别性条件的情况下才会学习采取最优行动。与过度自信的个体不同，缺乏自信的个体的错误学习是自我限制的，因此危害不大。我们认为，这类决策情境在经济环境中很常见，包括委托、组织、努力和公共政策选择等方面。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a new semi‐parametric identification and estimation approach to multinomial choice models in a panel data setting with individual fixed effects. Our approach is based on cyclic monotonicity, which is a defining convex‐analytic feature of the random utility framework underlying multinomial choice models. From the cyclic monotonicity property, we derive identifying inequalities without requiring any shape restrictions for the distribution of the random utility shocks. These inequalities point identify model parameters under straightforward assumptions on the covariates. We propose a consistent estimator based on these inequalities.

10.3982/ecta14115.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种针对具有个体固定效应的面板数据环境下多项选择模型的新半参数识别与估计方法。我们的方法基于循环单调性这一随机效用框架中的凸分析特征。通过循环单调性性质，我们推导出了识别不等式，而无需对随机效用冲击的分布进行任何形状限制。这些不等式能够在对协变量做出简单假设的情况下，直接识别出模型参数。我们基于这些不等式提出了一种一致的估计方法。

abstract.text: This is a lab experiment studying whether people might want to avoid temptation not because they expect to succumb to it but because they want to avoid the self-control costs of resisting it.

10.3982/ecta14172.abstractZh: 这是一项实验室实验，旨在研究人们是否会因为不想屈服于诱惑而避免诱惑，还是因为不想承担抵抗诱惑所需的自我控制成本而选择避免。

abstract.text: This paper provides an alternative approach to penalized regression for model selection in the context of high‐dimensional linear regressions where the number of covariates is large, often much larger than the number of available observations. We consider the statistical significance of individual covariates one at a time, while taking full account of the multiple testing nature of the inferential problem involved. We refer to the proposed method as One Covariate at a Time Multiple Testing (OCMT) procedure, and use ideas from the multiple testing literature to control the probability of selecting the approximating model, the false positive rate, and the false discovery rate. OCMT is easy to interpret, relates to classical statistical analysis, is valid under general assumptions, is faster to compute, and performs well in small samples. The usefulness of OCMT is also illustrated by an empirical application to forecasting U.S. output growth and inflation.

10.3982/ecta14176.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种针对高维线性回归模型选择的替代方法，该方法适用于协变量数量远大于可用观测值数量的情况。我们逐一考虑各个协变量的统计显著性，同时充分考虑到推断问题的多重检验特性。我们将该方法称为“一次一个协变量多重检验”程序，并借鉴多重检验领域的思想来控制选择近似模型的概率、假阳性率和假发现率。OCMT方法易于理解，与经典统计分析方法相衔接，在一般假设下仍然有效，计算速度较快，并且在小样本情况下表现良好。通过一项针对美国产出增长和通货膨胀预测的实证应用，进一步证明了OCMT方法的实用性。

abstract.text: Multivalued treatment models have only been studied so far under restrictive assumptions: ordered choice, or more recently unordered monotonicity. We show how marginal treatment effects can be identified in a more general class of models. Our results rely on two main assumptions: treatment assignment must be a measurable function of threshold-crossing rules; and enough continuous instruments must be available. On the other hand, we do not require any kind of monotonicity condition. We illustrate our approach on several commonly used models; and we also discuss the identification power of discrete instruments.

10.3982/ecta14269.abstractZh: 迄今为止，多值处理模型仅在限制性假设下进行了研究：有序选择，或者更近期的无序单调性。我们展示了如何在更一般的模型类别中识别边际处理效应。我们的结果依赖于两个主要假设：处理分配必须是阈值穿越规则的可测量函数；并且必须有足够的连续工具变量。另一方面，我们不需要任何单调性条件。我们通过几个常用的模型来说明我们的方法，并且还讨论了离散工具变量的识别能力。

abstract.text: We develop a nonlinear state-space model that captures the joint dynamics of consumption, dividend growth, and asset returns. Building on Bansal and Yaron (2004), our model consists of an economy containing a common predictable component for consumption and dividend growth and multiple stochastic volatility processes. The estimation is based on annual consumption data from 1929 to 1959, monthly consumption data after 1959, and monthly asset return data throughout. We maximize the span of the sample to recover the predictable component and use high-frequency data, whenever available, to efficiently identify the volatility processes. Our Bayesian estimation provides strong evidence for a small predictable component in consumption growth (even if asset return data are omitted from the estimation). Three independent volatility processes capture different frequency dynamics; our measurement error specification implies that consumption is measured much more precisely at an annual than monthly frequency; and the estimated model is able to capture key asset-pricing facts of the data.

10.3982/ecta14308.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个非线性状态空间模型，能够捕捉消费、股息增长和资产回报的联合动态。该模型基于Bansal和Yaron（2004年）的研究，包含一个具有共同可预测成分的经济体系，用于描述消费和股息增长，以及多个随机波动过程。模型估计数据基于1929年至1959年的年度消费数据、1959年之后的月度消费数据，以及整个研究期间的月度资产回报数据。我们通过最大化样本跨度来提取可预测成分，并利用高频数据（在可获得的情况下）来有效识别波动过程。我们的贝叶斯估计提供了强有力的证据，表明消费增长的预测成分很小（即使在没有资产回报数据的情况下也是如此）。三个独立的波动过程分别描述了不同的频率动态；我们的测量误差设定表明，消费数据在年度频率上的测量更为精确；而估计出的模型能够捕捉到数据中的关键资产定价特征。

abstract.text: Measurements of ambiguity attitudes have so far focused on artificial events, where (subjective) beliefs can be derived from symmetry of events and can be then controlled for. For natural events as relevant in applications, such a symmetry and corresponding control are usually absent, precluding traditional measurement methods. This paper introduces two indexes of ambiguity attitudes, one for aversion and the other for insensitivity/perception, for which we can control for likelihood beliefs even if these are unknown. Hence, we can now measure ambiguity attitudes for natural events. Our indexes are valid under many ambiguity theories, do not require expected utility for risk, and are easy to elicit in practice. We use our indexes to investigate time pressure under ambiguity. People do not become more ambiguity averse under time pressure but become more insensitive (perceive more ambiguity). These findings are plausible and, hence, support the validity of our indexes.

10.3982/ecta14370.abstractZh: 迄今为止，对模糊性态度的测量主要集中在人造事件上，因为在这些事件中，可以从事件的对称性中推导出（主观）信念，并且可以对其进行控制。而在实际应用中相关的自然事件中，这种对称性和相应的控制通常是不存在的，这限制了传统测量方法的应用。本文介绍了两个模糊性态度指数，一个用于厌恶程度，另一个用于不敏感/感知程度，通过这两个指数，即使不知道可能性信念，我们仍然可以对其进行控制。因此，我们现在可以测量自然事件的模糊性态度。我们的指数在许多模糊性理论下都是有效的，不需要对风险使用期望效用方法，并且在实践中易于获取。我们使用这些指数来研究模糊性下的时间压力。人们在时间压力下并不会变得更加厌恶模糊性，而是变得更加不敏感（感知到更多的模糊性）。这些发现是合理的，因此支持了我们的指数的有效性。

abstract.text: This paper presents an analysis of general time preferences in the canonical Rubinstein (1982) model of bargaining, allowing for arbitrarily history-dependent strategies. I derive a simple sufficient structure for optimal punishments and thereby fully characterize (i) the set of equilibrium outcomes for any given preference profile, and (ii) the set of preference profiles for which equilibrium is unique. Based on this characterization, I establish that a weak notion of present bias - implied, e.g., by any hyperbolic or quasi-hyperbolic discounting - is sufficient for equilibrium to be unique, stationary and efficient. Conversely, I demonstrate how certain violations of present bias give rise to multiple (non-stationary) equilibria that feature delayed agreement under gradually increasing offers.

10.3982/ecta14396.abstractZh: 本文分析了在典型的Rubinstein（1982）讨价还价模型中，具有任意历史依赖策略的一般时间偏好问题。我们推导出一个简单的充分条件，用于确定最优惩罚机制，从而全面描述了：(i) 任何给定偏好配置下的均衡结果集合；(ii) 使得均衡唯一的偏好配置集合。基于这一描述，我们证明了一种弱形式的当前偏好观念——例如，由任何双曲线或准双曲线折扣所暗示的偏好观念——足以确保均衡的独特性、稳定性以及效率。相反地，我们展示了某些违反当前偏好观念的情况如何导致多个（非静态）均衡的出现，这些均衡在逐渐增加的报价下呈现出延迟达成协议的特点。

abstract.text: The partial (ceteris paribus) effects of interest in nonlinear and interactive linear models are heterogeneous as they can vary dramatically with the underlying observed or unobserved covariates. Despite the apparent importance of heterogeneity, a common practice in modern empirical work is to largely ignore it by reporting average partial effects (or, at best, average effects for some groups). While average effects provide very convenient scalar summaries of typical effects, by definition they fail to reflect the entire variety of the heterogeneous effects. In order to discover these effects much more fully, we propose to estimate and report sorted effects -- a collection of estimated partial effects sorted in increasing order and indexed by percentiles. By construction the sorted effect curves completely represent and help visualize the range of the heterogeneous effects in one plot. They are as convenient and easy to report in practice as the conventional average partial effects. They also serve as a basis for classification analysis, where we divide the observational units into most or least affected groups and summarize their characteristics. We provide a quantification of uncertainty (standard errors and confidence bands) for the estimated sorted effects and related classification analysis, and provide confidence sets for the most and least affected groups. The derived statistical results rely on establishing key, new mathematical results on Hadamard differentiability of a multivariate sorting operator and a related classification operator, which are of independent interest. We apply the sorted effects method and classification analysis to demonstrate several striking patterns in the gender wage gap.

10.3982/ecta14415.abstractZh: 在非线性及交互式线性模型中，利息的局部效应（在其他条件不变的情况下）具有异质性，这种异质性会随着潜在观测或未观测协变量的变化而显著波动。尽管异质性显然很重要，但现代实证研究中常见的做法是通过报告平均局部效应（或至少对某些群体进行平均效应分析）来忽略这种异质性。虽然平均效应提供了对典型效应的便捷标量描述，但它们无法反映所有异质性效应的多样性。为了更全面地揭示这些效应，我们提出估计并报告排序效应——即按升序排列的估计局部效应集合，并以百分位数进行索引。通过这种构造，排序效应曲线能够完整地表示并帮助可视化异质性效应的范围。这些排序效应在实际应用中的便捷性和易报告性与传统平均局部效应相当。它们还可以作为分类分析的基础，我们将观测单位划分为受影响最大或最小的群体，并总结它们的特征。我们为估计的排序效应及相关分类分析提供了不确定性量化（标准误差和置信区间），并为受影响最大和最小的群体提供了置信集。这些统计结果的推导依赖于建立关于多变量排序运算符和相关分类运算符的哈达玛可微性的关键新数学成果，这些成果本身也很有研究价值。我们将排序效应方法和分类分析应用于性别工资差距的多个显著现象。

abstract.text: Recent evidence suggests that investors are inattentive to their portfolios and hire expensive portfolio managers. This paper develops a life‐cycle portfolio‐choice model in which the investor experiences loss‐averse utility over news and can ignore his portfolio. In such a model, the investor prefers to ignore and not rebalance his portfolio most of the time because he dislikes bad news more than he likes good news such that expected news causes a first‐order decrease in utility. Consequently, the investor has a first‐order willingness to pay a portfolio manager who rebalances actively on his behalf. Moreover, the investor can diversify over time and his consumption aligns with predictions of mental accounting. I structurally estimate the preference parameters by matching stock shares and stock‐market non‐participation over the life cycle. My parameter estimates are in line with the literature, generate reasonable intervals of inattention, and simultaneously explain consumption and wealth accumulation over the life cycle. Here, it matters that news utility preserves first‐order risk aversion even in the presence of stochastic labor income, which also causes stock shares to rise in wealth.

10.3982/ecta14417.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明，投资者往往不注意自己的投资组合，并聘请昂贵的投资组合经理。本文提出了一个生命周期投资组合选择模型，在该模型中，投资者对新闻信息表现出厌恶损失的效用，并且可以忽视自己的投资组合。在这样的模型中，投资者大多数时候更愿意忽略投资组合，而不进行再平衡，因为他们对坏消息的厌恶程度超过了好消息带来的收益，因此预期中的新闻会导致效用的一级下降。因此，投资者愿意支付费用，聘请能够主动进行再平衡的投资组合经理。此外，随着时间的推移，投资者的投资方式会变得更加多样化，其消费行为也与心理账户理论相符。我通过匹配股票持有量以及生命周期中的股市不参与行为，来估计偏好参数。我的参数估计结果与现有文献一致，能够合理地解释投资者在生命周期中的疏忽行为，并同时解释其消费行为和财富积累情况。值得注意的是，即使存在随机性的劳动收入影响，新闻信息的效用仍然表现出一级的风险厌恶，这也导致了股票持有量的增加，进而提升了财富水平。

abstract.text: We consider the problem of constructing confidence intervals (CIs) for a linear functional of a regression function, such as its value at a point, the regression discontinuity parameter, or a regression coefficient in a linear or partly linear regression. Our main assumption is that the regression function is known to lie in a convex function class, which covers most smoothness and/or shape assumptions used in econometrics. We derive finite-sample optimal CIs and sharp efficiency bounds under normal errors with known variance. We show that these results translate to uniform (over the function class) asymptotic results when the error distribution is not known. When the function class is centrosymmetric, these efficiency bounds imply that minimax CIs are close to efficient at smooth regression functions. This implies, in particular, that it is impossible to form CIs that are tighter using data-dependent tuning parameters, and maintain coverage over the whole function class. We specialize our results to inference on the regression discontinuity parameter, and illustrate them in simulations and an empirical application.

10.3982/ecta14434.abstractZh: 我们研究了为回归函数的线性函数构建置信区间的问题，例如该函数在某一点的值、回归不连续性参数，或线性或部分线性回归中的回归系数。我们的主要假设是，回归函数已知属于凸函数类，而凸函数类涵盖了计量经济学中常用的大多数平滑性和/或形状假设。我们推导了在已知方差的正态误差下，有限样本最优置信区间和精确效率界限。我们表明，当误差分布未知时，这些结果可以转化为函数类上的均匀渐近结果。当函数类为中心对称时，这些效率界限意味着在平滑回归函数中，极小化置信区间接近有效。特别地，这意味着使用数据依赖的调整参数来构建更紧密的置信区间是不可能的，并且无法在整个函数类上保持覆盖性。我们将研究结果专门用于回归不连续性参数的推断，并通过模拟和实证应用进行了验证。

abstract.text: In this paper, we develop algorithms to independently draw from a family of conjugate posterior distributions over the structural parameterization when sign and zero restrictions are used to identify structural vector autoregressions (SVARs). We call this family of conjugate posteriors normal‐generalized‐normal. Our algorithms draw from a conjugate uniform‐normal‐inverse‐Wishart posterior over the orthogonal reduced‐form parameterization and transform the draws into the structural parameterization; this transformation induces a normal‐generalized‐normal posterior over the structural parameterization. The uniform‐normal‐inverse‐Wishart posterior over the orthogonal reduced‐form parameterization has been prominent after the work of Uhlig (2005). We use Beaudry, Nam, and Wang's (2011) work on the relevance of optimism shocks to show the dangers of using alternative approaches to implementing sign and zero restrictions to identify SVARs like the penalty function approach. In particular, we analytically show that the penalty function approach adds restrictions to the ones described in the identification scheme.

10.3982/ecta14468.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们开发了算法，用于从一组共轭后验分布中独立抽取结构参数化结果，其中使用符号和零限制来识别结构向量自回归（SVARs）。我们将这一组共轭后验称为“正态-广义-正态”。我们的算法从正交简化形式的参数化下的共轭均匀-正态-逆-Wishart后验中抽取数据，并将抽取的结果转换为结构参数化形式；这种转换会在结构参数化上产生一个正态-广义-正态后验。在Uhlig（2005）的工作之后，正交简化形式的参数化下的均匀-正态-逆-Wishart后验变得非常重要。我们参考了Beaudry、Nam和Wang（2011）关于乐观冲击相关性的研究，以说明使用替代方法实施符号和零限制来识别SVARs（如惩罚函数方法）的危险性。具体来说，我们从理论上证明了惩罚函数方法会为识别方案中添加额外的限制条件。

abstract.text: This paper develops and implements a nonparametric test of Random Utility Models. The motivating application is to test the null hypothesis that a sample of cross-sectional demand distributions was generated by a population of rational consumers. We test a necessary and sufficient condition for this that does not rely on any restriction on unobserved heterogeneity or the number of goods. We also propose and implement a control function approach to account for endogenous expenditure. An econometric result of independent interest is a test for linear inequality constraints when these are represented as the vertices of a polyhedron rather than its faces. An empirical application to the U.K. Household Expenditure Survey illustrates computational feasibility of the method in demand problems with 5 goods.

10.3982/ecta14478.abstractZh: 本文开发并实施了一种非参数检验方法，用于随机效用模型。该检验的动机在于验证这样一个零假设：样本中的横截面需求分布是由理性消费者群体产生的。我们检验了这一条件的必要充分条件，该条件并不依赖于对未观察到的异质性或商品数量的任何限制。我们还提出了一种控制函数方法，以处理内生支出问题。一个具有独立意义的计量经济学结果是：当线性不等式约束被表示为多面体的顶点而非其面时，该检验的有效性得到了验证。通过对英国家庭支出调查的实证应用，证明了该方法在包含5种商品的消费问题中具有计算可行性。

abstract.text: Conditional independence of treatment assignment from potential outcomes is a commonly used but nonrefutable assumption.We derive identified sets for various treatment effect parameters under nonparametric deviations from this conditional independence assumption.These deviations are defined via a conditional treatment assignment probability, which makes it straightforward to interpret.Our results can be used to assess the robustness of empirical conclusions obtained under the baseline conditional independence assumption.

10.3982/ecta14481.abstractZh: 治疗分配与潜在结果之间的条件独立性是一个常用的假设，但这一假设并非不可反驳。我们推导出了在违反这一条件独立性假设的非参数情况下，各种治疗效果参数的识别集合。这些违反假设的情况是通过条件治疗分配概率来定义的，因此很容易理解。我们的研究结果可以用来评估在基线条件独立性假设下得出的实证结论的稳健性。

abstract.text: We introduce …rm and worker heterogeneity into a model of innovation-driven endogenous growth.Individuals who di¤er in ability sort into either a research sector or a manufacturing sector that produces di¤erentiated goods.Each research project generates a new variety of the di¤erentiated product and a random technology for producing it.Technologies di¤er in complexity and productivity, and technological sophistication is complementary to worker ability.We study the co-determination of growth and income inequality in both the closed and open economy, as well as the spillover e¤ects of policy and conditions in one country to outcomes in others.

10.3982/ecta14518.abstractZh: 我们将企业与工人的异质性引入到一种由创新驱动的内生增长模型中。能力不同的个体会分别进入研究部门或制造部门，这两个部门生产差异化的产品。每个研究项目都会产生一种新型的差异化产品以及用于生产该产品的随机技术。这些技术的复杂性和生产力各不相同，而技术成熟度与工人的能力相辅相成。我们研究了在封闭经济与开放经济中，增长与收入不平等的共同决定因素，以及一国政策与条件对其他国家结果的影响。

abstract.text: In complicated/nonlinear parametric models, it is generally hard to know whether the model parameters are point identified. We provide computationally attractive procedures to construct confidence sets (CSs) for identified sets of full parameters and of subvectors in models defined through a likelihood or a vector of moment equalities or inequalities. These CSs are based on level sets of optimal sample criterion functions (such as likelihood or optimally-weighted or continuously-updated GMM criterions). The level sets are constructed using cutoffs that are computed via Monte Carlo (MC) simulations directly from the quasi-posterior distributions of the criterions. We establish new Bernstein-von Mises (or Bayesian Wilks) type theorems for the quasi-posterior distributions of the quasi-likelihood ratio (QLR) and profile QLR in partially-identified regular models and some non-regular models. These results imply that our MC CSs have exact asymptotic frequentist coverage for identified sets of full parameters and of subvectors in partially-identified regular models, and have valid but potentially conservative coverage in models with reduced-form parameters on the boundary. Our MC CSs for identified sets of subvectors are shown to have exact asymptotic coverage in models with singularities. We also provide results on uniform validity of our CSs over classes of DGPs that include point and partially identified models. We demonstrate good finite-sample coverage properties of our procedures in two simulation experiments. Finally, our procedures are applied to two non-trivial empirical examples: an airline entry game and a model of trade flows.

10.3982/ecta14525.abstractZh: 在复杂的非线性参数模型中，通常很难判断模型参数是否已被点识别。我们提出了计算上可行的程序，用于构建已识别的完整参数集和子向量集的置信集。这些置信集基于最优样本准则函数（如似然函数、最优加权函数或连续更新的GMM准则函数）的水平集。这些水平集是通过蒙特卡洛模拟直接从准则函数的准后验分布计算出的截断值来构建的。我们为部分识别的常规模型以及一些非常规模型的准似然比和剖面准似然比的准后验分布建立了新的Bernstein-von Mises（或贝叶斯Wilks）型定理。这些结果意味着，我们的蒙特卡洛置信集在部分识别的常规模型中对于已识别的完整参数集和子向量集具有精确的渐近频率覆盖性，并且在边界上具有有效但可能保守的覆盖性。我们还证明了我们的蒙特卡洛置信集在具有奇异性的模型中具有精确的渐近覆盖性。此外，我们还在包括点识别和部分识别模型在内的DGPs类别上提供了我们置信集的均匀有效性结果。我们在两个模拟实验中展示了我们的程序在有限样本下的良好覆盖性。最后，我们的程序被应用于两个非平凡的实证案例：一家航空公司的进入博弈和一种贸易流模型。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence shows that a large fraction of equity premium is realized on a relatively small number of trading days with significant macroeconomic news announcements. In the 1961-2014 period, for example, about 55% of the entire equity premium is earned on about 30 trading days per year with significant macroeconomic announcements. In addition, the market equity premium typically rises prior to the announcement and falls immediately afterwards. In this paper, we develop an abstract theory and a quantitative model for the equity premium associated with macroeconomic news announcements. We demonstrate that the announcement premium identifies the compensation for investors’ uncertainty aversion on capital markets. We present a dynamic model to account for the evolution of equity premium around macroeconomic announcements.

10.3982/ecta14607.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，大部分股权溢价是在相对较少的交易日内，在有重大宏观经济新闻公告时实现的。例如，在1961年至2014年期间，大约55%的整个股权溢价是在每年约有30个交易日内，在重大宏观经济公告期间获得的。此外，市场股权溢价通常在公告前上升，在公告后立即下降。在本文中，我们提出了一个关于与宏观经济新闻公告相关的股权溢价的抽象理论和一个定量模型。我们证明了这种公告溢价是对投资者在资本市场上的不确定性厌恶的补偿。我们还提出了一个动态模型，以解释股权溢价在宏观经济公告周围的演变情况。

abstract.text: This paper studies the behavioral foundations of non-Bayesian models of learning over social networks and develops a taxonomy of conditions for information aggregation in a general framework. As our main behavioral assumption, we postulate that agents follow social learning rules that satisfy “imperfect recall,” according to which they treat the current beliefs of their neighbors as sufficient statistics for the entire history of their observations. We augment this assumption with various restrictions on how agents process the information provided by their neighbors and obtain representation theorems for the corresponding learning rules (including the canonical model of DeGroot). We then obtain general long-run learning results that are not tied to the learning rules' specific functional forms, thus identifying the fundamental forces that lead to learning, non-learning, and mislearning in social networks. Our results illustrate that, in the presence of imperfect recall, long-run aggregation of information is closely linked to (i) the rate at which agents discount their neighbors' information over time, (ii) the curvature of agents' social learning rules, and (iii) whether their initial tendencies are amplified or moderated as a result of social interactions.

10.3982/ecta14613.abstractZh: 本文研究了非贝叶斯模型在社交网络中的学习行为基础，并构建了一个关于信息聚合条件的分类体系。作为主要的行为假设，我们假定代理人遵循满足“不完全回忆”原则的社会学习规则，即他们将邻居当前的信念视为其所有观察历史的信息统计特征。我们进一步对代理人的信息处理方式施加了各种限制，从而获得了相应学习规则的表示定理（包括DeGroot的典型模型）。最终，我们得到了与学习规则的具体功能形式无关的一般性长期学习结果，从而揭示了导致社交网络中学习、不学习和误学行为的基本因素。我们的研究结果表明，在存在不完全回忆的情况下，信息的长期聚合与以下因素密切相关：(i) 代理人随时间对邻居信息的折现率；(ii) 代理人社会学习规则的曲率；(iii) 初始倾向是否因社交互动而得到放大或调节。

abstract.text: Johansen's (1988,1991) likelihood ratio test for cointegration rank of a vector autoregression (VAR) depends only on the squared sample canonical correlations between current changes and past levels of a simple transformation of the data. We study the asymptotic behavior of the empirical distribution of those squared canonical correlations when the number of observations and the dimensionality of the VAR diverge to infinity simultaneously and proportionally. We find that the distribution weakly converges to the so‐called Wachter distribution. This finding provides a theoretical explanation for the observed tendency of Johansen's test to find “spurious cointegration.”

10.3982/ecta14649.abstractZh: Johansen在1988年和1991年提出的向量自回归模型协整秩的似然比检验，仅依赖于样本数据中的当前变化与过去水平之间的平方典型相关性。我们研究了当观测数量与向量自回归模型的维度同时无限增长时，这些平方典型相关性的经验分布的渐近行为。研究发现，该分布弱收敛于所谓的Wachter分布。这一发现为Johansen检验中出现的“虚假协整”现象提供了理论解释。

abstract.text: This paper introduces a new class of demand systems to study oligopolistic pricing games with multiproduct rms. We focus on the class of demand systems that can be derived from discrete/continuous choice with iid type 1 extreme-value taste shocks. We also show that these demand systems are integrable with quasi-linear preferences. The pricing game is aggregative and payo functions are uni-modal, although not necessarily quasi-concave. Firms’ tting-in and best-response functions can be entirely summarized by a uni-dimensional sucient statistic, called the iota-markup. This allows us to show that, under fairly weak conditions, the pricing game has a Nash equilibrium. Under stronger conditions, this equilibrium is unique. We also provide an algorithm which exploits the aggregative nature of the game to compute the pricing equilibrium with multiproduct rms and CES demands. The algorithm always converges. As an application, we derive a number of results on the dynamic optimality of myopic merger policy under dierentiated Bertrand competition.

10.3982/ecta14720.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种新的需求系统类别，用于研究具有多产品需求的寡头定价博弈。我们重点关注可以从离散/连续选择以及独立同分布的第一类极值偏好冲击中推导出的需求系统类别。我们还证明了这些需求系统可以通过准线性偏好进行积分处理。定价博弈具有聚合性，支付函数呈单峰型，但不一定是准凹函数。企业的参与和最佳响应函数可以通过一个单维的足够统计量来完全描述，这个统计量被称为iota加成。这使我们能够证明，在相当弱的条件下，定价博弈存在纳什均衡。在更强的条件下，该均衡是唯一的。我们还提供了一种算法，该算法利用博弈的聚合性质来计算具有多产品需求和CES需求情况下的定价均衡。该算法总是收敛的。作为应用，我们得出了一些关于在差异化伯特兰竞争下，短视合并政策动态最优性的结果。

abstract.text: More and more economists are finding both empirical and experimental evidence of economic behavior that is well beyond classical economics. In particular, empirical evidence ( Jullien and Salanié (2000)) and experimental evidence ( Kahneman and Tversky (1979)) supported the importance of risk loving, ambiguity loving, and related behavior in economics. However, these types of preferences have not been analyzed in the general equilibrium literature with a finite number of agents because non-convexity of preferences creates difficulty in proving existence of equilibrium. The main result in this paper provides a set of conditions under which equilibrium exists in such economies.We show that uncertainty of aggregate wealth, as well as some dominance of the endowment of the risk averters in the economy, play a role in the existence of Arrow–Debreu equilibria. This result can be extended to ambiguity in the sense of CEU, Smooth Ambiguity, and Variational Preference.

10.3982/ecta14777.abstractZh: 越来越多的经济学家发现，经济行为在实证和实验层面都远远超出了经典经济学的范畴。具体而言，实证研究（Jullien和Salanié，2000年）以及实验研究（Kahneman和Tversky，1979年）都表明，偏好风险、偏好不确定性以及相关行为在经济学中具有重要意义。然而，由于偏好行为的非凸性，这类偏好在一般均衡文献中并未得到分析，因为非凸性会导致难以证明均衡的存在。本文的主要成果提出了一组条件，在这些条件下，此类经济体系中存在均衡。我们表明，总体财富的不确定性，以及经济中风险规避者占主导地位的情况，对Arrow-Debreu均衡的存在起着重要作用。这一结果可以扩展到不确定性，包括CEU、平滑不确定性和变分偏好等情形。

abstract.text: We propose a theory of intertemporal choice that is robust to specific assumptions on the discount rate. One class of models requires that one utility stream be chosen over another if and only if its discounted value is higher for all discount factors in a set. Another model focuses on an average discount factor. Yet another model is pessimistic, and evaluates a flow by the lowest available discounted value.

10.3982/ecta14866.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种跨时选择理论，该理论对贴现率的具体假设具有鲁棒性。一类模型要求，如果某个效用流的贴现值在所有贴现因子下都高于另一个效用流，则选择前者。另一类模型则关注平均贴现因子。还有一种悲观的模型，它通过最低可用的贴现值来评估某种流。

abstract.text: We analyze dynamic trading by an activist investor who can expend costly effort to affect firm value. We obtain the equilibrium in closed form for a general activism technology, including both binary and continuous outcomes. Variation in parameters can produce either positive or negative relations between market liquidity and economic efficiency, depending on the activism technology and model parameters. Two results that contrast with the previous literature are that (a) the relation between market liquidity and economic efficiency is independent of the activist's initial stake for a broad set of activism technologies and (b) an increase in noise trading can reduce market liquidity, because it increases uncertainty about the activist's trades (the activist trades in the opposite direction of noise traders) and thereby increases information asymmetry about the activist's intentions.

10.3982/ecta14917.abstractZh: 我们分析了积极型投资者的动态交易行为，这类投资者能够投入大量精力来影响企业价值。我们为一般的积极型技术获得了封闭形式的均衡解，包括二元结果和连续结果两种情况。参数变化会导致市场流动性与经济效率之间的关系呈现正相关或负相关，这取决于积极型技术和模型参数。与以往文献不同的两个结论是：(a) 对于广泛的积极型技术而言，市场流动性与经济效率之间的关系与积极型投资者的初始持股无关；(b) 噪声交易的增加可能会降低市场流动性，因为它增加了对积极型投资者交易行为的不确定性（积极型投资者会与市场噪声交易者反向操作），从而加剧了关于积极型投资者意图的信息不对称。

abstract.text: We prove that a subtle but substantial bias exists in a common measure of the conditional dependence of present outcomes on streaks of past outcomes in sequential data.The magnitude of this streak selection bias generally decreases as the sequence gets longer, but increases in streak length, and remains substantial for a range of sequence lengths often used in empirical work.We observe that the canonical study in the influential hot hand fallacy literature, along with replications, are vulnerable to the bias.Upon correcting for the bias, we find that the longstanding conclusions of the canonical study are reversed.

10.3982/ecta14943.abstractZh: 我们证明，在序列数据中，对当前结果与过去结果序列之间的条件依赖性的常见衡量方法中存在一种微妙但显著的偏差。这种序列选择偏差的幅度通常随着序列长度的增加而减小，但在序列长度较长时会增加，并且在许多实证研究中仍然保持显著。我们观察到，在具有影响力的“热手谬误”文献中，典型的实证研究以及重复实验都容易受到这种偏差的影响。在纠正了这种偏差之后，我们发现该文献中长期的结论被逆转了。

abstract.text: I construct an informationally robust auction to sell a common‐value good. I examine the revenue guarantee of an auction over all information structures of bidders and all equilibria. As the number of bidders gets large, the revenue guarantee of my auction converges to the full surplus, regardless of how information changes as more bidders are added. My auction also maximizes the revenue guarantee when there is a single bidder.

10.3982/ecta14993.abstractZh: 我设计了一种信息上稳健的拍卖机制，用于出售一种共同价值商品。我研究了该拍卖机制在各类信息结构和所有均衡情况下的收入保障问题。随着参与竞拍的竞拍者数量增加，无论信息如何变化，我的拍卖机制所提供的总收入保障都会趋近于全部收益。此外，当只有一名竞拍者参与时，我的拍卖机制也能最大化收入保障。

abstract.text: The most critical issue in evaluating policies and projects that affect generations of individuals is the choice of social discount rate. This paper shows that there exist social discount rates such that the planner can simultaneously be (i) an exponential discounting expected utility maximizer; (ii) intergenerationally Pareto—that is, if all individuals from all generations prefer one policy/project to another, the planner agrees; and (iii) strongly non-dictatorial—that is, no individual from any generation is ignored. Moreover, to satisfy (i)–(iii), if the time horizon is long enough, it is generically sufficient and necessary for social discounting to be more patient than the most patient individual’s long-run discounting, independent of the social risk attitude.

10.3982/ecta15011.abstractZh: 在评估影响多代人的政策和项目时，最关键的问题在于社会折现率的选择。本文指出，存在这样的社会折现率：规划者可以同时具备以下特性：(i) 指数型折现下的期望效用最大化者；(ii) 代际间的帕累托最优性——即，如果所有世代的个体都偏好某一政策/项目，则规划者会达成一致；(iii) 强烈的非独裁性——即，没有任何一代的个体被忽视。此外，为了满足(i)–(iii) 特性，只要时间跨度足够长，社会折现率通常比最耐心的个体在长期折现率中更为宽容，这一点与社会的风险态度无关。

abstract.text: We study the design of provider incentives in the post-acute care setting - a high-stakes but under-studied segment of the healthcare system. We focus on long-term care hospitals (LTCHs) and the large (approximately $13,500) jump in Medicare payments they receive when a patient s stay reaches a threshold number of days. Discharges increase substantially after the threshold, with the marginal discharged patient in relatively better health. Despite the large financial incentives and behavioral response in a high mortality population, we are unable to detect any compelling evidence of an impact on patient mortality. To assess provider behavior under counterfactual payment schedules, we estimate a simple dynamic discrete choice model of LTCH discharge decisions. When we conservatively limit ourselves to alternative contracts that hold the LTCH harmless, we find that an alternative contract can generate Medicare savings of about $2,100 per admission, or about 5% of total payments. More aggressive payment reforms can generate substantially greater savings, but the accompanying reduction in LTCH profits has potential out-of-sample consequences. Our results highlight how improved financial incentives may be able to reduce healthcare spending, without negative consequences for industry profits or patient health.

10.3982/ecta15022.abstractZh: 我们研究了急性后期护理环境中的提供者激励设计——这一医疗系统中的高风险但研究不足的领域。我们重点关注长期护理医院，以及当患者住院天数达到某个阈值时，它们从医疗保险获得的支付额大幅增加（约13,500美元）。超过该阈值后，出院人数显著增加，而边际出院患者的健康状况相对较好。尽管在高死亡率人群中存在巨大的经济激励和行为反应，但我们未能发现任何能够显著影响患者死亡率的证据。为了评估在替代支付安排下提供者的行为，我们建立了一个简单的动态离散选择模型来模拟长期护理医院的出院决策。当我们保守地仅考虑那些不会给长期护理医院带来损失的替代合同时，我们发现一种替代合同可以为医疗保险节省约2,100美元的费用，约占总支付额的5%。更激进的支付改革可以带来更大的节省，但随之而来的长期护理医院利润减少可能会带来样本外的影响。我们的研究结果表明，改善经济激励措施有可能减少医疗支出，而不会对行业利润或患者健康产生负面影响。

abstract.text: We develop inference methods about long-run comovement of two time series. The parameters of interest are defined in terms of population second moments of low-frequency transformations (“low-pass” filtered versions) of the data. We numerically determine confidence sets that control coverage over a wide range of potential bivariate persistence patterns, which include arbitrary linear combinations of I(0), I(1), near unit roots, and fractionally integrated processes. In an application to U.S. economic data, we quantify the long-run covariability of a variety of series, such as those giving rise to balanced growth, nominal exchange rates and relative nominal prices, the unemployment rate and inflation, money growth and inflation, earnings and stock prices, etc.

10.3982/ecta15047.abstractZh: 我们开发了关于两个时间序列长期共动性的推断方法。所关注的参数是根据数据的低频变换（“低通”滤波版本）的人口二阶矩来定义的。我们通过数值方法确定了能够覆盖多种潜在双变量持续性模式的置信区间，这些模式包括I(0)、I(1)的任意线性组合、接近单位根的过程以及分数积分过程。在应用于美国经济数据的情况下，我们量化了多种序列的长期共变性，例如那些导致均衡增长的序列、名义汇率和相对名义价格、失业率与通货膨胀、货币增长与通货膨胀、收益与股票价格等。

abstract.text: There is a renewed interest in the size of labour supply elasticities and the discrepancy between micro and macro estimates. Recent contributions have stressed the distinction between changes in labour supply at the extensive and the intensive margin. In this paper, we stress the importance of individual heterogeneity and aggregation problems. At the intensive margins, simple specications that seem to fit the data give rise to non linear expressions that do not aggregate in a simple fashion. At the extensive margin, aggregate changes in participation are likely to depend on the cross sectional distribution of state variables when a shock hits and, therefore, are likely to be history dependent. We tackle these aggregation issues directly by specifying a life cycle model to explain female labour supply in the US and estimate its various components. We estimate the parameters of different component of the model. Our results indicate that (i) at the intensive margin, Marshallian and Hicksian elasticities are very heterogeneous and, on average, relatively large; (ii) Frisch elasticities are, as implied by the theory, even larger; (iii) aggregate labour supply elasticities seem to vary over the business cycle, being larger during recessions.

10.3982/ecta15067.abstractZh: 目前，人们对劳动力供给弹性的大小以及微观与宏观估计之间的差异重新产生了兴趣。近期的研究强调了在广度和集约性边际上劳动力供给变化之间的区别。在本文中，我们强调了个体异质性和聚合问题的重要性。在集约性边际上，看似符合数据的简单假设会导致非线性表达式，这些表达式不会以简单的方式聚合。在广度边际上，参与度的总体变化可能取决于状态变量的横截面分布，因此可能会受到历史因素的影响。我们通过构建一个生命周期模型来直接解决这些聚合问题，以解释美国女性的劳动力供给，并估算其各个组成部分。我们估算了模型不同组成部分的参数。我们的结果表明：(i) 在集约性边际上，马歇尔弹性和希克斯弹性非常异质，平均而言相对较大；(ii) 根据理论预期，弗里施弹性甚至更大；(iii) 总体劳动力供给弹性似乎在商业周期中有所变化，在经济衰退期间较大。

abstract.text: Which equilibria will arise in signaling games depends on how the receiver interprets deviations from the path of play.We develop a micro-foundation for these off-path beliefs, and an associated equilibrium refinement, in a model where equilibrium arises through non-equilibrium learning by populations of patient and long-lived senders and receivers.In our model, young senders are uncertain about the prevailing distribution of play, so they rationally send out-of-equilibrium signals as experiments to learn about the behavior of the population of receivers.Differences in the payoff functions of the types of senders generate different incentives for these experiments.Using the Gittins index (Gittins, 1979), we characterize which sender types use each signal more often, leading to a constraint on the receiver's off-path beliefs based on "type compatibility" and hence a learning-based equilibrium selection.

10.3982/ecta15085.abstractZh: 在信号博弈中会出现哪些均衡，取决于接收者对偏离游戏路径的解读方式。我们为这些偏离路径的信念建立了一个微观基础，并提出了与之相关的均衡细化方法。该模型通过患者和长寿的发送者与接收者之间的非均衡学习来产生均衡。在我们的模型中，年轻的发送者对当前的游戏分布并不确定，因此他们会理性地发送出均衡之外的信号，以了解接收者群体的行为。不同类型发送者的收益函数差异为这些实验提供了不同的激励。利用Gittins指数（Gittins, 1979），我们可以描述哪些发送者类型更频繁地使用某种信号，从而基于“类型兼容性”对接收者的偏离路径信念进行约束，进而实现基于学习的均衡选择。

abstract.text: Is the standard hyperbolic-discounting model capable of robust qualitative predictions for savings behavior?Despite results suggesting a negative answer, we provide a positive one.We give conditions under which all Markov equilibria display either saving at all wealth levels or dissaving at all wealth levels.Moreover, saving versus dissaving is determined by a simple condition comparing the interest rate to a threshold made up of impatience parameters only.Our robustness results illustrate a well-behaved side of the model and imply that qualitative behavior is determinate, dissipating indeterminacy concerns to the contrary (Krusell and Smith, 2003).We prove by construction that equilibria always exist and that multiplicity is present in some cases, highlighting that our robust predictions are not due to uniqueness.Similar results may be obtainable in related dynamic games, such as political economy models of public spending.

10.3982/ecta15112.abstractZh: 标准的 hyperbolic-discounting 模型是否能够对储蓄行为做出稳健的定性预测？尽管研究结果暗示答案是否定的，但我们给出了肯定的答案。我们提出了一些条件，在这些条件下，所有的马尔可夫均衡要么在所有财富水平上都表现出储蓄行为，要么表现出储蓄减少的行为。此外，储蓄与储蓄减少之间的选择取决于一个简单的条件，即比较利率与一个仅由不耐烦参数构成的阈值。我们的稳健性结果表明，该模型具有良好的行为特性，并表明定性行为是可以确定的，从而消除了相反的观点所提出的不确定性问题（Krusell 和 Smith，2003）。我们通过构造证明，均衡总是存在的，并且在某些情况下存在多重均衡，这强调了我们的稳健预测并非由于唯一性而产生的。在类似的动态博弈中，例如公共支出的政治经济学模型，也可能得到类似的结果。

abstract.text: This study examines how the historical state conditions long-run development, using Vietnam as a laboratory. Northern Vietnam (Dai Viet) was ruled by a strong centralized state in which the village was the fundamental administrative unit. Southern Vietnam was a peripheral tributary of the Khmer (Cambodian) Empire, which followed a patron-client model with weaker, more personalized power relations and no village intermediation. Using a regression discontinuity design across the Dai Viet-Khmer boundary, the study shows that areas historically under a strong state have higher living standards today and better economic outcomes over the past 150 years. Rich historical data document that in villages with a strong historical state, citizens have been better able to organize for public goods and redistribution through civil society and local government. This suggests that the strong historical state crowded in village-level collective action and that these norms persisted long after the original state disappeared.

10.3982/ecta15122.abstractZh: 本研究以越南为实验区，探讨历史国家状况对长期发展的影响。越南北部由强大的中央集权国家统治，村庄是基本的行政单位。而越南南部则是高棉帝国的附属地区，该帝国采用庇护-客户模式，权力关系较为薄弱且更具个性化，且不存在村庄的中介作用。通过跨越越南北部与南部边界的回归不连续设计，研究发现，历史上处于强大国家统治下的地区，在过去的150年中，生活水平更高，经济成果也更为显著。丰富的历史数据表明，在历史上受强大国家统治的村庄中，公民能够更好地组织公共事务，并通过民间社会和地方政府进行资源分配。这表明，强大的历史国家环境促进了村级集体行动的发展，而这些规范在原有国家消失后仍然持续存在。

abstract.text: We show how an insight from taxation theory allows identification of both the supply and demand elasticities using only one instrument. Most models of taxation since Ramsey (1927) assume that a tax levied on the demand side only affects demand through the price after taxation. Econometrically, we show that this assumption acts as an exclusion restriction. Under the Ramsey Exclusion Restriction (RER), a single tax reform can serve to simultaneously identify the demand and supply elasticity. We develop an estimation method, which includes 2SLS estimators for the elasticities, and a test for strength of the instrument. We discuss possible applications.

10.3982/ecta15129.abstractZh: 我们展示了如何通过税收理论的见解，仅使用一种工具就能同时识别供给弹性和需求弹性。自Ramsey（1927年）以来的大多数税收模型都假设，对需求方征收的税收只会通过征税后的价格影响需求。从计量经济学的角度来看，我们发现这一假设实际上是一种排除限制。在Ramsey排除限制下，一次税收改革可以同时用于识别供给弹性和需求弹性。我们开发了一种估算方法，该方法包括用于估计弹性的2SLS估计器，以及用于检验工具效度的测试。我们还讨论了该方法的潜在应用。

abstract.text: I show how the extensive margin of firm entry and exit can greatly amplify idiosyncratic shocks in an economy with a production network. I show that canonical input-output models, which lack the extensive margin of firm entry and exit, have some crucial limitations. In these models, the systemic importance of a firm does not respond to productivity shocks, depends only on the firm’s role as a supplier, and is equal to or well-approximated by the firm’s size. This means that for every canonical input-output model, there exists a non-interconnected model that has the same aggregate response to productivity shocks. I show that when we allow for entry and exit, the systemic importance of a firm responds endogenously to productivity shocks, depends on a firm’s role not just as a supplier but also as a consumer, and a firm’s systemic influence is no longer well-approximated by its size. Furthermore, I show that nondivisibilities in systemically important industries can cause one failure to snowball into a large-scale avalanche of failures. In this sense, shocks can be amplified as they travel through the network, whereas in canonical input-output models they cannot.

10.3982/ecta15280.abstractZh: 我展示了企业进入和退出过程的广泛边际如何显著放大具有生产网络的经济中的特异性冲击。我发现，缺乏企业进入和退出广泛边际的典型投入产出模型存在一些关键限制。在这些模型中，企业的系统重要性并不对生产率冲击作出反应，仅取决于企业作为供应商的角色，并且等于或可以近似为企业的规模。这意味着，对于每一个典型投入产出模型，都存在一个非相互连接的模型，该模型对生产率冲击的整体反应是相同的。我进一步表明，当允许企业进入和退出时，企业的系统重要性会内生性地对生产率冲击作出反应，企业的角色不仅取决于其作为供应商的角色，还取决于其作为消费者的角色，企业的系统影响力不再可以近似为其规模。此外，我还发现，在系统重要性行业中，非可分割性可能导致一次失败演变成大规模的失败。从这个意义上说，冲击在通过网络传播时会被放大，而在典型投入产出模型中则不会。

abstract.text: In French parliamentary and local elections, candidates ranked first and second in the first round automatically qualify for the second round, while a third candidate qualifies only when selected by more than 12.5 percent of registered citizens. Using a fuzzy RDD around this threshold, we find that the third candidate’s presence substantially increases the share of registered citizens who vote for any candidate and reduces the vote share of the top two candidates. It disproportionately harms the candidate ideologically closest to the third and causes her defeat in one fifth of the races. Additional evidence suggests that these results are driven by voters who value voting expressively over voting strategically for the top-two candidate they dislike the least to ensure her victory; and by third candidates who, absent party-level agreements leading to their dropping out, value the benefits associated with competing in the second round more than influencing its outcome.

10.3982/ecta15373.abstractZh: 在法国议会和地方选举中，首轮排名前两位的候选人自动晋级第二轮，而第三名候选人只有在获得超过12.5%的登记选民支持时才能晋级。通过设定一个模糊的随机分配阈值，我们发现第三名候选人的存在显著增加了投票给任何候选人的登记选民比例，同时降低了前两名候选人的得票率。这一结果对意识形态上最接近第三名候选人的候选人造成了不成比例的伤害，导致该候选人在一五分之一的选举中落败。额外的证据表明，这些结果是由那些更倾向于表达性投票而非战略性投票的选民所驱动的，他们投票给第三名候选人，以确保自己不喜欢的候选人获胜；同时，如果没有党派层面的协议导致第三名候选人退出，这些候选人更看重参加第二轮选举所带来的利益，而不是影响选举结果。

abstract.text: We propose a method for using instrumental variables (IV) to draw inference about causal effects for individuals other than those affected by the instrument at hand. Policy relevance and external validity turn on the ability to do this reliably. Our method exploits the insight that both the IV estimand and many treatment parameters can be expressed as weighted averages of the same underlying marginal treatment effects. Since the weights are identified, knowledge of the IV estimand generally places some restrictions on the unknown marginal treatment effects, and hence on the values of the treatment parameters of interest. We show how to extract information about the treatment parameter of interest from the IV estimand and, more generally, from a class of IV‐like estimands that includes the two stage least squares and ordinary least squares estimands, among others. Our method has several applications. First, it can be used to construct nonparametric bounds on the average causal effect of a hypothetical policy change. Second, our method allows the researcher to flexibly incorporate shape restrictions and parametric assumptions, thereby enabling extrapolation of the average effects for compliers to the average effects for different or larger populations. Third, our method can be used to test model specification and hypotheses about behavior, such as no selection bias and/or no selection on gain.

10.3982/ecta15463.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种使用工具变量进行推断的方法，用于分析那些不受当前工具变量影响的个体的因果效应。政策的相关性和外部有效性取决于是否能够可靠地执行这一操作。我们的方法利用了这样一个见解：工具变量估计值以及许多处理参数都可以表示为相同的基础边际处理效应的加权平均值。由于权重是确定的，因此了解工具变量估计值通常会对未知的边际处理效应施加一些限制，从而也限制了所关注的处理参数的值。我们展示了如何从工具变量估计值中提取有关感兴趣处理参数的信息，更一般地，从一类类似工具变量估计值中提取信息，其中包括两阶段最小二乘法和普通最小二乘法估计值等。我们的方法有多种应用。首先，它可以用来构建关于假设政策变化的平均因果效应的非参数界限。其次，我们的方法允许研究人员灵活地纳入形状限制和参数假设，从而能够将遵守规则的人群的平均效应外推到不同或更大人群的平均效应。第三，我们的方法可以用来检验关于行为的模型规范和假设，例如没有选择偏差和/或没有选择收益的情况。
